packages.name: ADCIRC

requirements.name: Meteorological forcing (wind + atmospheric pressure)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.source_kind: NWP / parametric (GFS/ERA5/HRRR/HWRF or Holland parametric track)
requirements.unit: wind m/s; pressure mb (hPa) in OWI input, m H2O internally
requirements.model_input_format: fort.22 control + fort.221 pressure (mb) + fort.222 wind u,v (m/s) for OWI NWS=12; NWS selects format (8=Holland, 12=OWI, 13=OWI netCDF, 14=GRIB2)
requirements.notes: Required when NWS!=0. OWI header (iLat,iLong,DX,DY,SWLat,SWLon,DT) is rigid fixed-width; off-by-one grid dims shift the field (dt_007). Internal pressure unit is m H2O = P_Pa/9806.65.

requirements.name: Bathymetric depth DP
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Sign convention couples to all elevation outputs; flipping sign silently inverts bathymetry (dt_001).

requirements.name: Manning's n at sea floor
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Bottom-friction parameter; n outside ~0.01-0.20 causes div-by-zero (n=0) or blocked flow (dt_014).

requirements.name: Mesh geometry and connectivity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: fort.14 node coordinates + element connectivity + boundary node lists
requirements.notes: Boundary nodes must be ordered counter-clockwise (dt_018); mesh must be connected for the METIS-based domain partitioning used by the parallel solver (dt_020). The partitioning itself is execution-layer preprocessing (adcprep), not a physics step.

requirements.name: GWCE/numerical/friction control parameters
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: mixed (DTDP s; G m/s^2; TAU0 dimensionless; ESLM m^2/s)
requirements.model_input_format: fort.15 (ICS, IM, G, DTDP, RNDAY, DRAMP, NOLIBF/CF, TAU0, ESLM, NOLIFA/H0/VELMIN, output control)
requirements.notes: G must be 9.81 when ICS=2 (metric); G=32.174 (feet) is silently fatal (dt_002). DTDP must satisfy CFL DTDP < dx_min/sqrt(g*h_max) (dt_006).

requirements.name: Hot-start restart state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Compiler/endianness/flag-specific; not portable across builds (dt_009). Optional — cold start (IHOT=0) otherwise.

requirements.name: Tidal harmonic open-boundary forcing
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: amplitude m; phase deg; period s
requirements.model_input_format: fort.15 harmonic constituents (NBFR) + tidal potential (NTIP); periods in seconds (dt_012)
requirements.notes: 30+ constituents; NTIP=1 tidal potential, NTIP=2 adds self-attraction/loading.

requirements.name: Non-periodic elevation boundary condition
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Non-periodic normal-flux boundary condition (e.g. river discharge)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: time s vs normal flux m^2/s

requirements.name: Self-attraction and earth-load tide forcing
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

packages.name: ANUGA

requirements.name: rainfall
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: volumetric rate per unit area applied via Rate_operator each step
requirements.notes: Rate_operator expects a rate in m/s; it adds (or, when negative for evaporation/abstraction, removes) water to the continuity equation. Negative rates also scale xmomentum/ymomentum by the local factors, so the rainfall operator can modify momentum, not only stage.

requirements.name: inflow discharge
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: prescribed total discharge via Inlet_operator, optional velocity direction

requirements.name: DEM / bed elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: terrain fitted to mesh as the 'elevation' quantity (per-cell under discontinuous-elevation DE methods)
requirements.notes: ANUGA uses raw elevation values without vertical-datum awareness; DEM and any prescribed boundary water levels must share the same vertical datum.

requirements.name: Manning's n (friction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 0.02-0.15 by land cover; 0.0 only for analytical benchmarks. manning_friction_semi_implicit is auto-appended to forcing_terms in Domain.__init__, so friction is always active.

requirements.name: maximum triangle area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: mesh-generation constraint (Triangle); optional interior_regions for local refinement
requirements.notes: Controls spatial resolution: ~100-1000 m^2 for real-world domains up to 10 km; 1-10 m^2 for benchmark accuracy.

requirements.name: g (gravitational acceleration)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Baked into the flux kernels; affects all wave-speed/celerity terms.

requirements.name: minimum storable height
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: config default 1e-3 m; cells shallower stored as dry in SWW (affects reported wet area)

requirements.name: minimum allowed height (H0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: algorithm-dependent: DE0/DE3 use 1e-12, DE1/DE2 use 1e-5; config global default 1e-5
requirements.notes: Effective value is set by the flow_algorithm method switch (DE0 forces H0=1e-12), not by config.py default.

requirements.name: CFL (Courant number)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Effective value is set by the flow_algorithm method switch (DE0 forces CFL=0.9), not by config.py default.

requirements.name: initial stage
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: set_quantity('stage', ...); for dry bed set stage=elevation so depth=0 everywhere
requirements.notes: Constant initial stage where bed varies produces a spurious startup shock; dry-bed requires stage=elevation at every vertex.

requirements.name: initial xmomentum
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: initial ymomentum
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: flow algorithm
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: set_flow_algorithm(); DE0 default (discontinuous elevation), DE1 higher order, 1_5 legacy
requirements.notes: Numerical-method / discretization switch (not a tuned physical parameter). DE0 silently overrides config-module defaults (cfl->0.9, beta limiters, minimum_allowed_height->1e-12, compute_fluxes_method->DE); the effective configuration is algorithm-derived, not config.py-derived.

requirements.name: Reflective boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: solid wall: interior quantities returned with normal momentum negated
requirements.notes: Use on upslope/lateral edges; all-Reflective traps water and grows total volume unbounded.

requirements.name: Transmissive boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required at catchment outlet so water can exit; oscillating boundary depth can spuriously inject/remove water and break mass balance.

requirements.name: Dirichlet boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: fixed constant stage / momenta at the edge
requirements.notes: Preferred for strict mass conservation at a prescribed-stage outlet.

requirements.name: Time boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: conserved quantities prescribed as a function of simulation time (tides, gate schedules)

requirements.name: File boundary / Field boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: stage/momentum time series read from an SWW file, space/time interpolated (nesting); Field_boundary adds a mean_stage offset

requirements.name: boundary tags
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: dict mapping tag names to 0-based polygon edge indices (e.g. {bottom:[0],right:[1],top:[2],left:[3]})
requirements.notes: Wrong or untagged edge indices fail domain creation or misapply boundary conditions.

requirements.name: finaltime
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: evolve endpoint (or duration); yieldstep controls SWW save cadence independently

packages.name: APEX

requirements.name: Daily precipitation (PRCP)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: May be read or stochastically generated (first-order Markov chain, Nicks 1974); partitioned to snowfall when mean of Tmax and surface soil temperature <= 0 C

requirements.name: Maximum air temperature (TMAX)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Read or generated (Richardson 1981 multivariate model)

requirements.name: Minimum air temperature (TMIN)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Read or generated

requirements.name: Solar radiation (SRAD)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required for Penman-family PET. Expected ~10-25 MJ/m2/day; supplying W/m2 (multiply by 0.0864) silently distorts ET/water yield

requirements.name: Wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required for Penman PET and wind erosion

requirements.name: Relative humidity (RHM)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required for Penman PET; fraction not percent

requirements.name: Atmospheric CO2 concentration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives radiation-use-efficiency CO2 response (bc1, bc2). ~420 ppm modern

requirements.name: Crop growth coefficients
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: TBSC base temp, TOPC optimal temp, potential heat units, DMLA/XLAI max LAI, HMX max height, RDMX max root depth, RUE radiation-use efficiency and CO2 response, WAVP VPD coefficient, HIP/WSYF harvest index, optimal N/P concentration coefficients, aluminum tolerance, critical aeration factor

requirements.name: Soil profile hydraulic and chemical properties
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Layer depths, sand/silt/clay, bulk density (g/cm3), field capacity, wilting point, porosity, organic C (% wt), pH, saturated K Ksat (mm/h), labile P, curve number

requirements.name: Site geometry
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Latitude/longitude (decimal degrees; southern hemisphere negative), elevation (m, not feet), azimuth, slope

requirements.name: Subarea routing geometry
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: WSA watershed area (ha; negative WSA adds this subarea's runoff to another before routing), CHL/RCHL channel length (km), CHS channel slope (m/m fraction, 0.05 = 5%); CHL==RCHL marks a headwater subarea

requirements.name: Monthly weather-generator statistics
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: *.WP1 (12 months x 13 variables), *.WND, WPM1.DAT/WINDCOM.DAT station lists
requirements.notes: Monthly storm mean/std/skew, wet-dry probabilities, monthly mean/std of Tmax/Tmin, monthly mean solar radiation, wind statistics

requirements.name: APEX general/internal parameters (PARM)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Internal coefficients including PARM42 (NRCS curve-number index), PARM23, PARM34, PARM84 used in calibration

requirements.name: Initial soil water content by layer
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Soil/nutrient pools start at the template's equilibrium (e.g. Texas climate); a non-template climate needs 20-25 year spin-up before pools reach steady state

requirements.name: Initial soil N (NO3) and P pool states
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial NO3 per layer, labile/active/stable P, organic N/C pools

requirements.name: Initial surface residue mass
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Surface residue carried into simulation start

requirements.name: Operation schedule (planting, tillage, fertilization, irrigation, harvest, kill, grazing)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: *.OPC/*.MGT (fixed-width rows: yr I3, month I3, day I3, opcode + 4 code fields I5, 8x F9.2 op params)
requirements.notes: Column 6 is the PLANT_ID (from CROPCOM.DAT) selecting the crop. APEX0806 operation codes: plant/drill 136, fertilize 261, harvest-grain 292, field cultivator 160, kill-crop 451; fertilizer elemental N 53 / P 54

requirements.name: Run control settings
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: NBYR years, IYR/IMO/IDA start, IPD print frequency, NGN weather generate/read code, IET PET-equation code, ISCN stochastic-CN code, ITYP peak-rate code, LPYR leap-year flag

packages.name: APSIM

requirements.name: Solar radiation (radn)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives biomass via RUE x intercepted radiation; APSIM reads each value as MJ/m^2 (W/m^2 or J/m^2/day cause 10-50x biomass error).

requirements.name: Maximum temperature (maxt)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Thermal time uses 3-hourly temps interpolated from daily max/min.

requirements.name: Minimum temperature (mint)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Rainfall (rain)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be daily totals; sub-daily (mm/3hr) drivers must be summed.

requirements.name: Vapour pressure (vp)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives VPD/ET; optional.

requirements.name: Wind (wind)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Pan evaporation (pan)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Atmospheric CO2 (co2)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Defaults to ambient if absent; affects RUE and transpiration efficiency.

requirements.name: Air pressure
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Silently defaults to 1010 hPa when absent from the weather file.

requirements.name: tav (annual average ambient temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives the CERES soil-temperature model; missing tav/amp gives wrong soil temps and germination timing.

requirements.name: amp (annual amplitude of mean monthly temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: latitude / longitude
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Latitude sets day length / radiation geometry.

requirements.name: Layer thickness
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 100-300 mm; cm input gives a 10x-too-shallow profile.

requirements.name: Bulk density (BD)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 1.0-1.8; kg/m^3 input crashes the water balance.

requirements.name: AirDry / LL15 / DUL / SAT
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Volumetric water limits; must satisfy AirDry <= LL15 <= DUL <= SAT per layer.

requirements.name: Saturated hydraulic conductivity (KS)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Air temperature (TA)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Authored in Kelvin; MeteoIO min_max filter (240-320 K) rejects Celsius values as nodata.

requirements.name: Relative humidity (RH)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Fraction, not percent; values >1 are clipped to 1.0 causing permanent saturation.

requirements.name: Wind speed (VW)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Wind direction (DW)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required for LISTON_WIND spatial interpolation.

requirements.name: Precipitation (PSUM)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Accumulated water-equivalent; accumulation period must equal the step length.

requirements.name: Incoming shortwave radiation (ISWR)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional; prefer MeteoIO CLEARSKY_SW generator over supplying synthesized values.

requirements.name: Incoming longwave radiation (ILWR)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional; can be generated by MeteoIO ALLSKY_LW (Unsworth) / CLEARSKY_LW (Dilley).

requirements.name: Atmospheric pressure (P)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional; STD_PRESS lapse used when absent.

requirements.name: Snow height (HS)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional; used for validation or with ENFORCE_MEASURED_SNOW_HEIGHTS.

requirements.name: 3-D / gridded wind fields
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: MeteoIO GRID3D plugin (e.g. ARPS), WINDFIELDS key
requirements.notes: Required only when SnowDrift is enabled (--enable-drift).

requirements.name: Roughness length (ROUGHNESS LENGTH)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.002 m; controls Monin-Obukhov turbulent exchange; high sensitivity.

requirements.name: Height of meteo values (HEIGHT OF METEO VALUES)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 2.0 m; measurement reference height for turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: Geothermal heat flux (GEO HEAT)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.06 W/m2; basal boundary flux controlling basal melt.

requirements.name: Rain/snow threshold (THRESH RAIN)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default ~1.2 K; partitions precipitation phase; high sensitivity.

requirements.name: Air-temperature lapse rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical -0.003 to -0.009 K/m; governs interpolated TA field.

requirements.name: Precipitation lapse rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets the elevation gradient of interpolated precipitation.

requirements.name: DEM grid
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Defines domain extent, resolution, CRS; shadow-casting cells outside the domain must be retained.

requirements.name: Land-use / land-cover grid
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: One code per cell; header (ncols,nrows,xllcorner,yllcorner,cellsize) must match the DEM exactly.

requirements.name: Catchment-definition grid
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional; needed for sub-catchment runoff aggregation.

requirements.name: Soil/snow layer physical coefficients (in .sno)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (Rho_S kg/m3, Conduc_S W/m/K, HeatCapac_S J/kg/K, rg/rb mm)
requirements.notes: Static substrate/snow microstructure coefficients within the initial profile.

requirements.name: Initial snow/soil stratigraphy (.sno)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: SMET 1.1 .sno per grid cell (or per land-cover class)
requirements.notes: Per-layer Layer_Thick (m), T (K), Vol_Frac_I/W/V/S (sum=1.0), density, grain rg/rb, dd, sp, mk; must be dated before simulation start. Recommended cold-start: bare ground on Oct 1, or 3-5 yr soil-temperature spinup.

requirements.name: Canopy initial state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial vegetation/canopy energy-mass state (CanopyData).

requirements.name: Distributed mode switch (ALPINE3D)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be TRUE; if FALSE, SNOWPACK runs each cell as an independent point ignoring distributed forcing/terrain.

requirements.name: Coordinate system (COORDSYS / COORDPARAM)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must match the DEM CRS and use MGRS band-letter notation for UTM; mismatch silently misplaces stations.

requirements.name: Computation step length (CALCULATION STEP LENGTH)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default 15 min; sets the SNOWPACK inner sub-step count only — the outer driver cadence is hardcoded at 3600 s.

requirements.name: Snow-erosion / SnowDrift enable (SNOW EROSION / --enable-drift)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Activates wind-driven redistribution and the 3-D wind-field requirement.

requirements.name: Snow water-transport model (WATERTRANSPORTMODEL SNOW)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects bucket vs Richards-equation percolation.

requirements.name: Atmospheric stability scheme (ATMOSPHERIC STABILITY)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default MO_MICHLMAYR; controls Monin-Obukhov correction; high sensitivity.

requirements.name: Terrain radiation method (TERRAIN RADIATION METHOD)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the terrain reflected/emitted radiation algorithm; only active when terrain radiation is enabled.

requirements.name: Precipitation undercatch correction (PSUM undercatch wmo)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Corrects solid-precipitation gauge undercatch (e.g. Hellmannsh); requires VW present.

requirements.name: acab (surface mass balance)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Accumulation minus ablation; must be m/yr ICE equivalent, not mm/yr and not water equivalent. Can be supplied externally or generated by the internal PDD scheme.

requirements.name: artm (annual mean surface air temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Degrees Celsius, NOT Kelvin. Sets the upper thermal boundary condition; with temperature=0 it overwrites the column each step.

requirements.name: Glint climate fields (temp, prcp, arng)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: deg C; m water/yr; deg C
requirements.model_input_format: global lat-lon climate fields via the Glint interface
requirements.notes: Daily-mean 2 m air temperature, precipitation, and air-temperature half-range that drive the internal PDD mass-balance schemes; downscaled to the ice grid by Glint.

requirements.name: default flwa (Glen flow-law rate factor A)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Ice softness; sane range 1e-18..1e-15, default 1e-16. Used when flow_law=0 (constant); with flow_law=2 (Paterson-Budd) A is temperature-dependent.

requirements.name: flow enhancement factor
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on flwa; range 0.5..5.0, default 1.0.

requirements.name: beta (basal traction coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 2-D field on staggered velocity grid (y0,x0)
requirements.notes: Higher-order bed-stress coefficient (tau_b = beta * u_b). Required when which_ho_babc=5 (beta from input).

requirements.name: btrac const (uniform basal friction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Spatially uniform basal friction; range 0..1e6, default 0.0.

requirements.name: tauf / mintauf (basal yield stress)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Higher-order basal yield stress for plastic (Coulomb / pseudo-plastic) sliding.

requirements.name: geothermal / bheatflx (basal geothermal heat flux)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: CISM sign convention: NEGATIVE = upward heat flux into the ice base. Default -42e-3 W/m^2; range -100e-3..-20e-3.

requirements.name: ice limit (minimum ice thickness for dynamics)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Cells thinner than this are treated as ice-free; range 0.1..100, default 1.0.

requirements.name: lapse rate (atmospheric temperature lapse rate)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Vertical lapse rate used to reference surface air temperature to elevation for the PDD scheme.

requirements.name: thk (initial ice thickness)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 2-D field on scalar grid (y1,x1); must be >= 0

requirements.name: topg (bedrock topography)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Negative = below sea level. Sign convention error produces false floating ice (dt_012).

requirements.name: usurf (initial upper surface elevation)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: temp (initial 3-D ice temperature)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: relx (relaxed bedrock topography)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 2-D field; reference bed for isostatic adjustment

requirements.name: uvel/vvel (restart velocity fields)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 3-D fields on staggered grid (level,y0,x0); restart only

requirements.name: dycore

requirements.notes: Selects the dynamical core. Hard-coupled to the evolution option (Glissade requires evolution=3 or 4; dt_007).

shared_requirements.notes: Accumulation minus ablation; must be m/yr ICE equivalent, not mm/yr and not water equivalent. Can be supplied externally or generated by the internal PDD scheme.

shared_requirements.name: artm (annual mean surface air temperature)
shared_requirements.notes: Degrees Celsius, NOT Kelvin. Sets the upper thermal boundary condition; with temperature=0 it overwrites the column each step.

shared_requirements.name: Glint climate fields (temp, prcp, arng)
shared_requirements.unit: deg C; m water/yr; deg C
shared_requirements.notes: Daily-mean 2 m air temperature, precipitation, and air-temperature half-range that drive the internal PDD mass-balance schemes; downscaled to the ice grid by Glint.

shared_requirements.name: default_flwa (Glen flow-law rate factor A)
shared_requirements.notes: Ice softness; sane range 1e-18..1e-15, default 1e-16. Used when flow_law=0 (constant); with flow_law=2 (Paterson-Budd) A is temperature-dependent.

shared_requirements.name: flow_enhancement_factor
shared_requirements.notes: Multiplier on flwa; range 0.5..5.0, default 1.0.

shared_requirements.name: beta (basal traction coefficient)
shared_requirements.notes: Higher-order bed-stress coefficient (tau_b = beta * u_b). Required when which_ho_babc=5 (beta from input).

shared_requirements.name: btrac_const (uniform basal friction)
shared_requirements.notes: Spatially uniform basal friction; range 0..1e6, default 0.0.

shared_requirements.name: tauf / mintauf (basal yield stress)
shared_requirements.notes: Higher-order basal yield stress for plastic (Coulomb / pseudo-plastic) sliding.

shared_requirements.name: geothermal / bheatflx (basal geothermal heat flux)
shared_requirements.notes: CISM sign convention: NEGATIVE = upward heat flux into the ice base. Default -42e-3 W/m^2; range -100e-3..-20e-3.

shared_requirements.name: ice_limit (minimum ice thickness for dynamics)
shared_requirements.notes: Cells thinner than this are treated as ice-free; range 0.1..100, default 1.0.

shared_requirements.name: lapse_rate (atmospheric temperature lapse rate)
shared_requirements.notes: Vertical lapse rate used to reference surface air temperature to elevation for the PDD scheme.

shared_requirements.name: topg (bedrock topography)
shared_requirements.notes: Negative = below sea level. Sign convention error produces false floating ice (dt_012).

shared_requirements.name: dycore
shared_requirements.notes: Selects the dynamical core. Hard-coupled to the evolution option (Glissade requires evolution=3 or 4; dt_007).

shared_requirements.name: which_ho_approx
shared_requirements.notes: Higher-order momentum approximation, Glissade only.

shared_requirements.name: which_ho_sparse (linear solver)
shared_requirements.notes: Value 4 requires a Trilinos-linked build, else runtime failure (dt_005).

shared_requirements.name: grid geometry (ewn, nsn, upn, dew, dns)
shared_requirements.notes: Grid spacing in km instead of m shrinks the domain 1000x and corrupts velocities (dt_006).

shared_requirements.name: time control (tstart, tend, dt, ntem)
shared_requirements.notes: dt is CFL-limited: dt < dew^2/(2*D_max) for diffusive stability (dt_004).

shared_requirements.name: kinbcmask (velocity Dirichlet mask)
shared_requirements.notes: Marks cells where uvel/vvel are held as Dirichlet boundary conditions; zero velocity is imposed where mask=1 if uvel/vvel absent.

requirements.name: rdrg2 (quadratic bottom drag coefficient)

requirements.name: Zob (bottom roughness length)

requirements.name: Tnudg (tracer nudging timescale)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Vstretching (S-coordinate stretching function)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

packages.name: COSIPY

requirements.name: T2
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: 2-m air temperature; valid 223.16-316.16 K. Celsius input silently forces 100% rain in the tanh snow/rain partition.

requirements.name: RH2
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: 2-m relative humidity. Supplying a 0-1 fraction collapses latent heat flux to ~0.

requirements.name: U2
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wind speed expected at the 2-m measurement height z; 10-m reanalysis wind without log-profile correction overestimates turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: G
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Instantaneous incoming shortwave; valid 0-1600. Accumulated J m^-2 is ~3600x too high.

requirements.name: PRES
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Surface air pressure; Pa input makes air density and turbulent fluxes ~100x too large.

requirements.name: RRR
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Total (liquid+solid) precipitation per timestep; the model uses the raw value and does NOT divide by dt. Required unless SNOWFALL supplied.

requirements.name: N
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Cloud cover, used to parametrize incoming longwave when LWin is absent. Required unless LWin given; percent input inflates LWin.

requirements.name: LWin
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional measured incoming longwave; when absent it is parametrized from T2, RH2 (vapour pressure) and N via a Konzelmann-type clear-sky emissivity blended with an overcast term.

requirements.name: SNOWFALL
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional direct snowfall as SNOW HEIGHT (not w.e.); units differ from the w.e. SNOWFALL output. mm or m-w.e. input creates hundreds of layers and hits max_layers.

requirements.name: albedo fresh snow / albedo firn / albedo ice
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Endpoint albedos (defaults 0.85 / 0.55 / 0.30) for the aging decay.

requirements.name: albedo decay timescales
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Snow-aging and depth-decay timescales of the Oerlemans98 / Bougamont05 schemes.

requirements.name: roughness lengths (fresh snow / firn / ice)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Moelg12 interpolates z0 between surface types by snow age; constant for ice, time-dependent for snow. Code divides the Moelg result by 1000 (mm->m).

requirements.name: snow/rain transfer temperature threshold and spread
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Center/width of the tanh snow-fraction transfer function.

requirements.name: densification coefficients (Boone / Vionnet / empirical)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Boone (c1=2.8e-6, eta0=3.7e7, rho0=150, ...) and Vionnet constants are hardcoded in-source, not in constants.toml.

requirements.name: fresh-snow density coefficients
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Empirical fit max(109 + 6*(T2-273.16) + 26*sqrt(U2), 50) with hardcoded coefficients and a 50 kg/m^3 floor; active unless densification_method=='constant'.

requirements.name: Bintanja shortwave extinction coefficients (snow 17.1, ice 2.5)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Hardcoded extinction coefficients for subsurface shortwave penetration.

requirements.name: thermal conductivity / heat-equation stability factor
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Explicit-conduction Courant safety factor c_stab=0.8 hardcoded; conductivity derived per-layer in Node.

requirements.name: turbulent Prandtl number
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Pr=0.8 hardcoded in the Monin-Obukhov bulk flux scheme.

requirements.name: remesh density/temperature thresholds
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Merge thresholds (density_threshold_merging, merge_max) controlling adaptive layer merging.

requirements.name: measurement height z
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Height at which forcing is assumed representative (default 2.0 m).

requirements.name: initial snowheight constant
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default 0.2 m; HIGH influence on first months. Zero snowheight with no early snowfall pins albedo at the ice value 0.3.

requirements.name: initial glacier height
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default 40 m; assumed thick enough that the column does not melt through.

requirements.name: initial top density snowpack / initial bottom density snowpack
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Defaults 300 / 600 kg/m^3 setting the initial density profile.

requirements.name: temperature bottom
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Bottom-boundary column temperature (default 270.16 K).

requirements.name: initial surface temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Hardcoded 270.0 K seed for the across-timestep surface_temperature scalar; read by the Bougamont05 albedo decay and used as the first energy-balance iteration guess. Not in constants.toml. Distinct from temperature_bottom (270.16 K bottom-boundary column temperature).

requirements.name: restart column state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Full layer-resolved heights/densities/temperatures/LWC from a spinup of >=1 year; recommended for production runs.

requirements.name: MASK (glacier mask)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Only MASK=1 cells are simulated. All-zero mask yields empty output; NaN forcing in a MASK=1 cell aborts the run.

requirements.name: HGT (elevation/DEM)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Elevation field defining the domain.

requirements.name: SLOPE / ASPECT
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Terrain slope and aspect (0=North); used for radiation geometry. Declared in the code/KI static set but not in the readthedocs static-field list.

requirements.name: albedo method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Oerlemans98 (default) vs Bougamont05 albedo evolution scheme.

requirements.name: stability correction
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Ri (default) vs MO Monin-Obukhov stability correction for turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: densification method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Boone (default) / Vionnet / empirical / constant compaction scheme.

requirements.name: sfc temperature method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Secant (default) / L-BFGS-B / SLSQP solver for the surface energy balance; L-BFGS-B and SLSQP can give different (potentially wrong) results since a Feb 2024 update.

requirements.name: remesh method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: log_profile (default, fast/smoothed) vs adaptive_profile (detailed, costlier) layer remeshing.

requirements.name: dt (time step)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default 3600 s; MUST equal input forcing resolution because all flux-to-mass conversions use raw per-step values.

requirements.name: WRF dimension flag
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects south_north/west_east WRF dimension names instead of lat/lon.

requirements.name: PET (potential evapotranspiration)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mm per config UNIT interval, or C (UNIT=C for internally-computed temperature-based PET)
requirements.notes: UNIT=C converts temperature to PET internally; temperature must be in Celsius (Kelvin causes near-total evaporation).

requirements.name: Temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded raster per timestep (TIF/ASC), driving Snow-17 and/or temperature-based PET
requirements.notes: Optional; only consumed when Snow-17 or temperature-PET is enabled.

requirements.name: WM
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Maximum soil water capacity (depth-integrated pore space). Negative values silently clamped to 100 mm.

requirements.name: B
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Variable-infiltration-curve exponent; higher B = more runoff for given soil moisture. B<0 clamped to 1.0, NaN to 0.0; B=0 risks VIC division-by-zero.

requirements.name: IM
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Impervious area ratio. Dual semantics: scalar divided by 100 (percent->fraction) when no grid; acts as direct multiplier when im_grid present.

requirements.name: KE
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: PET-to-actual-ET multiplier (adjPET = PET x KE).

requirements.name: FC (Ksat)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Saturated hydraulic conductivity controlling the overland/interflow split. Despite the FC label this is Ksat, not field capacity.

requirements.name: Channel routing coefficients (LR: RIVER, COEM, UNDER, LEAKO, LEAKI, TH; KW: ALPHA, BETA, ALPHA0, UNDER, LEAKI, TH)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: [LRParamSet] or [KWParamSet], selected by ROUTING and ROUTING_PARAM_SET
requirements.notes: Routing parameter set must match the chosen router. TH (FAM-cell threshold) defines channel cells. KW exponent BETA also has a hardcoded 0.6 fallback in the solver.

requirements.name: IWU
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial soil water as percent of WM; SM_init = IWU x WM / 100. Spin-up sensitive; warmup window set by TIME_WARMEND.

requirements.name: ISO / ISU
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial overland (ISO) and interflow (ISU) reservoir storages. ISU also used by KW interflow.

requirements.name: Saved state grids
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: crest_SM_YYYYMMDD_HHUU.tif (and routing/snow state grids) for warm restart
requirements.notes: Written and reloaded automatically for restart continuity.

requirements.name: ROUTING selector
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ROUTING=LR|KW plus ROUTING_PARAM_SET in the task section
requirements.notes: Must be set or only the water balance runs (no discharge produced). In EF5 v1.2.3, LR never assigns discharge (see safety); KW is the operative router.

requirements.name: DDM encoding flag (ESRIDDM)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: FAM self-inclusion flag (SELFFAM)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: SELFFAM=true when FAM minimum value is 1
requirements.notes: Mismatch causes off-by-one basin area and gauge snapping errors.

requirements.name: Simulation window and timestep (TIME BEGIN, TIME END, TIME WARMEND, TIMESTEP)

requirements.name: lateral surface runoff
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded (time, lat, lon) binary or NetCDF on the source model grid; latitude must be North-to-South (descending)
requirements.notes: Primary external driver. Model converts mm/day to m3/s internally using per-cell catchment area via the input matrix; runoff MUST NOT be pre-converted to m3/s. Interpolated to river-network cells by the input matrix (CMF_FORCING).

requirements.name: sub-surface runoff (baseflow)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded (time, lat, lon), optional second runoff field
requirements.notes: Consumed only when LROSPLIT is enabled; otherwise total runoff is treated as a single field. Routed to river/groundwater reservoir depending on LGDWDLY.

requirements.name: potential water evaporation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional open-water evaporation forcing, active only when LWEVAP is set; extracts water from open-water/floodplain storage.

requirements.name: PMANRIV (river channel Manning's n)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: namelist scalar (&NPARAM); spatial field rivman.bin (CRIVMAN) overrides where provided
requirements.notes: Default 0.03 hardcoded in cmf_ctrl_nmlist_mod before namelist override. Primary calibration lever; higher n slows flow, increases peak attenuation and lag.

requirements.name: PMANFLD (floodplain Manning's n)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 0.10, hardcoded scalar used directly in the floodplain local-inertial momentum equation; not spatially distributed.

requirements.name: river network topology (next-downstream cell)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Upstream-downstream flow-direction map defining routing; derived from MERIT-Hydro-based map.

requirements.name: unit-catchment area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: cell elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: distance to downstream cell
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Sets the slope length term in the local-inertial momentum equation and bounds the CFL adaptive time step.

requirements.name: river channel length
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: sub-grid floodplain height profile
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: fldhgt.bin (CFLDHGT), discretized into NLFP elevation sub-layers
requirements.notes: Sub-grid topographic profile used to diagnose flooded depth/area/fraction from storage (Yamazaki 2011).

requirements.name: river channel width
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Set as empirical power law of climatological mean discharge Q (W = WC*Q^WP, WC=2.50, WP=0.60, WMIN=5.0 m) during map preparation.

requirements.name: river channel bank height / depth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Set as empirical power law of climatological mean discharge Q (H = HC*Q^HP, HC=0.10, HP=0.50, HMIN=1.0 m).

requirements.name: PCADP (CFL adaptive time-step coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 0.7; DT_MIN = PCADP*dist/sqrt(g*depth) sets inner sub-step from minimum CFL across all cells.

requirements.name: PDSTMTH (river-mouth downstream distance)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 10000 m; assumed downstream distance at river-mouth cells, controlling mouth slope and mouth-cell CFL.

requirements.name: river channel storage
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Carried between time steps. Empty initial storage makes first-year results unreliable; 1-2 spin-up iterations of the first year recommended.

requirements.name: floodplain storage
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: downstream sea-level / ocean boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: optional boundary time series at river-mouth cells (&NBOUND)
requirements.notes: Sets tidal/sea-surface elevation at outlets when enabled; otherwise a default fixed sea level is assumed.

requirements.name: flow-solver selection (LADPSTP / LKINE / LSLPMIX / LFLDOUT / LPTHOUT)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switches selecting local-inertial (default) vs kinematic-wave vs slope-mixed routing, enabling floodplain outflow, and enabling bifurcation pathways.

requirements.name: optional sub-model activation (LDAMOUT / LLEVEE / LGDWDLY / LROSPLIT / LWEVAP)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Enable reservoir operation, levee scheme, groundwater delay, runoff split, and open-water evaporation respectively; all off by default.

requirements.name: outer time step DT and I/O frequency

requirements.notes: Default DT=86400 s; DT must be a multiple of 60 (model counts time in minutes), enforced with STOP 9 in CMF_CONFIG_CHECK.

packages.name: Cell2Fire

requirements.name: wind speed (WS)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: ROS scales approximately linearly with wind speed; wind also sets ellipse eccentricity. Expected in km/h; m/s input is ~3.6x too low.

requirements.name: wind direction (WD)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Sets spread direction (head of the ellipse). FROM convention; math (TO) convention reverses spread by 180 degrees.

requirements.name: air temperature (TMP)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: FBP (--sim C) only; feeds fine-fuel moisture. Kelvin input produces nonsensical FBP indices.

requirements.name: relative humidity (RH)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: FBP only; fraction (0-1) input drives FFMC/ISI to extreme values.

requirements.name: precipitation (APCP)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: FBP only; affects moisture codes.

requirements.name: Canadian FWI System indices (FFMC, DMC, DC, ISI, BUI, FWI)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: FBP (--sim C) only. Cell2Fire does NOT compute these; they must be derived externally via CFFDRS equations and supplied per weather row. Missing indices crash or silently default.

requirements.name: per-cell fuel type
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Selects fire-behavior parameters via a lookup table. S&B codes 0,91-99 (non-burnable) and 101-204; FBP codes 1-20. Codes 0 and 91-99 act as non-burnable firebreaks.

requirements.name: fuel lookup table
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Maps integer fuel codes to descriptive fuel type / behavior parameters.

requirements.name: per-fueltype FBP coefficients (p1,p2,p3,q,bui0,cfl,cbh,fmc)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: The 18-fueltype FBP coefficient table is baked into the binary, NOT read from input files. Spain/Kitral/Portugal models similarly carry built-in coefficient initializers selected by --scenario.

requirements.name: slope
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: slope.asc/.tif (optional; can be derived from elevation)
requirements.notes: Enters a polynomial slope-on-spread correction. Percent-rise input is ~2x too large.

requirements.name: slope aspect (saz)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Sets upslope direction for the directional slope effect.

requirements.name: elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used for slope derivation and (in FBP) foliar moisture content. Feet input exaggerates derived slope ~3.28x.

requirements.name: crown base height (cbh)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Crown-fire initiation. Optional unless --cros set with S&B.

requirements.name: crown bulk density (cbd)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Active crown spread threshold. lb/ft3 input is ~16x too low.

requirements.name: crown closure fraction (ccf) / foliar canopy cover (fcc)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Canopy descriptors for crown fire.

requirements.name: curing percentage (cur)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Grass-fuel curing multiplier in FBP.

requirements.name: ROS adjustment / ellipse factors (HFactor/FFactor/BFactor/EFactor, ROS10Factor, CBDFactor/CCFFactor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: CLI flags; defaults HFactor/FFactor/BFactor/EFactor=1.0, ROS10Factor=3.34, CBDFactor/CCFFactor=0.0
requirements.notes: Head/flank/back/eccentricity ROS multipliers (the calibration levers of Carrasco et al. 2019). Default 1.0 = untuned. ROS10Factor=3.34 is a Spain/Kitral ROS-at-10min magic scaling constant.

requirements.name: ignition point(s)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Ignitions.csv (1-based, row-major from top-left) or random sampling
requirements.notes: Fixed cells or sampled per simulation; can be weighted by probabilityMap. Ignition on a non-burnable cell yields zero burned cells.

requirements.name: initial cell states
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: derived from fuels grid (Available / Non-Fuel from non-burnable codes)
requirements.notes: All burnable cells start Available; non-burnable codes start Non-Fuel.

requirements.name: ignition probability map
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Spatial distribution from which random ignition cells are sampled.

requirements.name: fire-behavior model selector (--sim {S,C,K,P})
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects Scott&Burgan / Canadian FBP / Kitral / Portugal. Must match the fuel-code scheme; mixing FBP codes with the S&B model gives wrong behavior.

requirements.name: ensemble / stochastic controls (--nsims, --seed, --weather {rows,random}, ROS-CV)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Number of Monte Carlo simulations, RNG seed, deterministic vs randomized weather selection, and the ROS coefficient-of-variation perturbation level driving probabilistic scars.

requirements.name: time-stepping controls (--Weather-Period-Length, --Fire-Period-Length, --max-fire-periods)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Fire-Period-Length silently clamped to Weather-Period-Length if larger; too-large fire period skips cells (checkerboard scars).

requirements.name: spread / crown thresholds and switches (--ROS-Threshold, --cros, --fmc, --scenario)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CLI flags; defaults ROS-Threshold=0.1 m/min, fmc=100%, scenario=3, CROSThreshold=0.5
requirements.notes: ROS-Threshold is the per-cell ignition floor. --cros enables crown fire. --fmc is S&B foliar moisture; low values inflate crown fire. --scenario (1-3) sets S&B fire-weather severity and can shift burned area ~10x.

requirements.name: observation sequence (obs seq)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: obs_seq ASCII or binary file: header (copies, QC fields, count) + per-obs {location, time (days,seconds), obs type, error variance, value, QC}
requirements.notes: Consumed per assimilation window. Error field stores VARIANCE (sigma^2), NOT standard deviation. Missing-value sentinel is exactly -888888.0 (a valid float, never NaN).

requirements.name: cutoff
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Gaspari-Cohn localization half-width; observations beyond 2x cutoff have zero impact. Hardcoded default 0.2.

requirements.name: inflation parameters (inf initial, inf damping, inf lower bound, inf upper bound, inf sd *)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Multiplicative covariance inflation magnitude/persistence. Defaults: inf_initial=1.0 (none), inf_damping=1.0 (no damping), inf_upper_bound=1e6 (effectively unbounded), inf_sd_max_change=1.05.

requirements.name: ens size
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Number of ensemble members (20-1000 typical); trades sampling error against cost and keys the sampling-error-correction table. Default 20.

requirements.name: perturbation amplitude
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Stddev of Gaussian perturbation when building an ensemble from a single state (perturb_from_single_instance). Default 0.2; near-machine-epsilon values give zero spread.

requirements.name: outlier threshold / input qc threshold
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: outlier_threshold default -1 (disabled); positive N rejects obs with |obs - prior_mean| > N*sqrt(spread^2 + obs_err^2). input_qc_threshold default 3.0 rejects high incoming QC.

requirements.name: ensemble state files
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF filter_input*.nc (input_state_file_list, or single_file_in with an ens dimension)
requirements.notes: Ensemble of host-model restart states at cycle start; dimensionality and variables set by the host model. ens_size must match the available member count.

requirements.name: inflation restart fields
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Adaptive inflation mean/sd fields carried across cycles; required when inf_initial_from_restart=.true. Persistence governed by inf_damping.

requirements.name: model-advance mode (async)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 0 = synchronous in-binary adv_1step (built-in models e.g. Lorenz); 2 = shell command adv_ens_command; 4 = parallel shell launching concurrent advances (external models e.g. WRF, CAM).

requirements.name: filter algorithm (filter kind / QCEFF table)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: algorithm_info QCEFF table; filter_kind codes (EAKF=1, ENKF=2, KERNEL=3, OBS_PARTICLE=4, UNBOUNDED_RHF=8, GAMMA=11, BOUNDED_NORMAL_RHF=101, KDE=102)
requirements.notes: EAKF is the default per-obs increment kernel; QCEFF assigns per-quantity distributions/bounds to relax the Gaussian assumption for variables like precipitation and snow depth.

requirements.name: localization function (select localization)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: 1 = Gaspari-Cohn 5th-order (default, recommended); Boxcar and Ramped Boxcar also available.

requirements.name: stages to write
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects which NetCDF state stages are emitted. Default writes only the final 'output' stage; preassim/analysis diagnostics are suppressed unless listed.

requirements.name: inflow hydrograph
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Time column is in HOURS, whereas Time_Step/Simulation_Period are in SECONDS — mixed-unit convention that silently corrupts breach timing if confused.

requirements.name: upstream water level time series
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: m above embankment base, time in hours
requirements.notes: Optional time-varying head/tailwater; levels are relative to embankment base, not geo-referenced elevation.

requirements.name: wave and wind forcing
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Only used in the coastal dike/barrier extension; drives wave-overtopping and wind setup/setdown contributions to breach hydraulics.

requirements.name: Embankment Height
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Crest-to-base height (1-300 m valid), NOT geo-reference elevation.

requirements.name: Embankment Crest Width
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Embankment Upstream Slope
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: V/H convention (vertical/horizontal); 1V:3H = 0.333. Authoring as H/V silently produces impossible geometry.

requirements.name: Embankment Downstream Slope
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Embankment Length
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Base length = maximum possible breach bottom width; caps lateral breach growth.

requirements.name: Sediment Diameter d50
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Non-cohesive ~0.001 m; cohesive ~0.00003 m (representative floc diameter). Default 0.001 m.

requirements.name: Sediment Specific Gravity
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 2.65 (quartz).

requirements.name: Sediment Porosity
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: 0.30-0.45; default 0.35. Enter as decimal fraction, not percent.

requirements.name: Sediment Cohesion
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Used for slope-stability mass-wasting, not erosion rate.

requirements.name: Sediment Internal Friction
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: tan of friction angle, not degrees in the standalone card format. Governs side-slope stability.

requirements.name: Cohesive Soil Erosion kd
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Cohesive erodibility; the single most sensitive parameter for cohesive embankments. Range 2.5-30; default 10.0.

requirements.name: Cohesive Soil Erosion Tauc
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Critical shear stress for erosion initiation; range 0.01-10, default 0.15.

requirements.name: Noncohesive Sed Adaptation Lamda
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Non-equilibrium total-load adaptation length factor; field ~6.0, lab ~3.0.

requirements.name: Headcut Ct
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Headcut erosion coefficient for cohesive overtopping (Overtopping_Mode=2); range 0.0025-0.0049.

requirements.name: Breach Manning n
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: 0.010-0.060; default 0.025. Cohesive ~0.016; non-cohesive n = An*d50^(1/6).

requirements.name: Breach Weir Coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Broad-crested weir discharge coefficient for overtopping breach flow.

requirements.name: Piping Coefficient
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Orifice efficiency factor for piping mode; default ~0.5.

requirements.name: Reservoir Elevation Area Volume
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Upstream_Reservoir multiline card (5 methods: tabulated V-z, tabulated As-z, or power-law forms)
requirements.notes: Power-law exponent m~2 (range 1-3). Elevations above embankment base. MUST be SI (m3, m2); MCM/km2 makes the reservoir ~1e6x too small.

requirements.name: Initial Up&Downstream WSL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Upstream level must exceed crest for overtopping to initiate; relative to base, not absolute elevation.

requirements.name: Initial Overtopping Breach
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Pilot breach depth (0.2-0.4 m from crest) and bottom width (1-5 m); used when Breach_Mode=1.

requirements.name: Initial Piping Breach
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial pipe depth-below-crest and pipe width (~0.2 m); pipe elevation must lie below upstream WSL or no head drives flow. Used when Breach_Mode=2.

requirements.name: Breach Mode
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the failure mechanism.

requirements.name: Overtopping Mode
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Mutually exclusive overtopping erosion mechanisms; only used when Breach_Mode=1.

requirements.name: Headcut Formula
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Breach Location
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Switches side-flow breach geometry (symmetric vs one-sided).

requirements.name: Breach Side Slope Constant
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Time Step
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Field 1-5 s, lab 0.1-1 s, very large dams start 0.1 s. Too large -> explicit-scheme instability.

requirements.name: Simulation Period
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Dam 21600-172800 s (6-48 h). Authoring hours-as-seconds truncates output to 1-2 lines.

requirements.name: Downstream Channel Flow Out
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required for non-empty output; omission yields an empty output file.

requirements.name: RefEvap
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: RelHum
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: VapPres

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.notes: Fractions sum to ~1.0 excluding humus; percent (0-100) input causes a sum>1 startup crash.

requirements.name: Humus / organic fraction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typically 0.001-0.10 for mineral soils.

requirements.name: Dry bulk density
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: C/N ratio
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Saturated hydraulic conductivity K sat
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.notes: DayCent weather precipitation is in cm/day (NOT mm/day); feeding mm/day silently inflates the water balance ~10x. (.100 monthly PRECIP is cm/month.)

requirements.name: maximum air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: minimum air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: solar radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Read only when usexdrivers/usexdrvrs is enabled in sitepar.in (DDcentEVI infers from column count). When present, PET uses Penman (1948); otherwise the model computes its own radiation and PET from air temperature (Linacre 1977). 1 langley = 41.84 kJ/m2.

requirements.name: relative humidity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional extra driver; read only when extra-driver weather option is active. Wind speed (mph) is a further optional driver.

requirements.name: fixed decomposition parameters
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Biome-common fixed parameters governing organic-matter decomposition; must match rev 491; not normally adjusted between runs.

requirements.name: site climate / soil texture / initial SOM parameters
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Monthly PRECIP (cm/month), TMN2M/TMX2M (degC); sitlat/sitlng (decimal deg, +N/+E); sand/silt/clay (fraction 0-1); bulkd (g/cm3); nlayer/nlaypg, drain, basef, stormf, ph; epnfa/epnfs atmospheric N inputs; initial SOM pool sizes som1ci/som2ci/som3ci, strucc, metabc.

requirements.name: soil hydraulic / texture profile by layer
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per-layer: top/bottom depth (cm), bulk density (g/cm3), field capacity (vol/vol), wilting point (vol/vol), evap coefficient, root fraction (sums to ~1.0), sand fraction, clay fraction, organic-matter MASS fraction (0-1, not percent), delta_min (~WP*0.9), saturated K (cm/s), pH. rev 491 requires 13 columns (delta_min added vs rev 470); depth structure must match ADEP/EDEPTH in fix.100.

requirements.name: DayCent-specific site parameters
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Elevation, slope/aspect, albedo, snow flag, water-table, cloud cover, temperature coefficients, nitrification controls (maxNitAmt), monthly solar-radiation surface transmission, usexdrvrs flag. Retired in DayCentEVI variants that infer the weather option from column count.

requirements.name: crop / grass parameter library
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Crop/grass options (e.g. CORN, SOYB, GRASS) referenced by CROP events.

requirements.name: tree / forest parameter library
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: TREE submodel parameters; zero-byte in the public WoosterExampleLinux distribution so forest runs are non-functional without a tree.100 obtained from CSU/NREL.

requirements.name: management event parameter libraries
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: cult.100 / fert.100 / fire.100 / graz.100 / harv.100 / irri.100 / omad.100 / trem.100
requirements.notes: Option libraries referenced by the corresponding scheduled CULT/FERT/FIRE/GRAZ/HARV/IRRI/OMAD/tree-removal events.

requirements.name: initial SOM pool sizes
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: <site>.100 (som1ci/som2ci/som3ci, strucc, metabc) or extended from a prior .bin
requirements.notes: Passive/slow pools take centuries to equilibrate; an equilibrium (ACEQ) spin-up is run first. Initial values left at a desert template give wrong equilibrium SOM for a humid site.

requirements.name: prior-state binary archive
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: <root>.bin via -e (extend full state) or -i (initial conditions only, resets counters)
requirements.notes: 3-stage protocol: equilibrium (-N eq) -> base history (-e eq -N base) -> treatment (-e base -N treat). All stages must share the same <site>.100 or SOM jumps discontinuously.

requirements.name: timed management & disturbance schedule
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: CROP, FERT, HARV, GRAZ, FRST, LAST, SENM, FIRE, TREE, IRRI, OMAD, CULT, ACEQ. ACEQ triggers adaptive-equilibrium termination of the spin-up; LAST ends the growing season; the 'F' weather option (with the .wth filename) is the only valid weather option for the initial block.

requirements.name: weather-driver option (usexdrivers)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the 7-column air-temperature PET path (Linacre 1977) vs the extra-driver Penman (1948) path; structural switch over which optional .wth columns are read.

requirements.name: output channel toggles
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects which .out/.csv files are written; presets no_outfiles.in (equilibrium), few_outfiles.in, full outfiles.in. Controls observability of model output, not the physics.

requirements.name: optional climate/management scaling

requirements.model_input_format: nscale.dat / omadscale.dat / phscale.dat / tmaxscale.dat / tminscale.dat / precscale.dat
requirements.notes: Optional scenario-adjustment multipliers applied to N inputs, organic amendments, pH, and climate drivers.

packages.name: DuMux

requirements.name: Recharge / top boundary flux
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: Neumann boundary condition returned by the Problem class (per scvf), in kg/(m2*s)
requirements.notes: Sign convention: positive = outward (leaving domain); recharge/inflow must be NEGATIVE. Mass flux, not a volumetric mm/day rate (R[kg/m2/s] = R[mm/day]/86400).

requirements.name: Intrinsic permeability K
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: SpatialParams.permeabilityAtPos() returning a scalar or tensor K [m2]; or DGF element/node data; or Eclipse PERMX/PERMY keywords
requirements.notes: Intrinsic permeability in m2, NOT hydraulic conductivity K_h [m/s] or darcy. Typical aquifer range 1e-15 to 1e-8 m2. Must be > 0.

requirements.name: Porosity phi
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: SpatialParams.porosityAtPos() returning a fraction; or DGF/Eclipse PORO
requirements.notes: Pore volume fraction in [0,1]; must be > 0 (zero porosity yields NaN / solver crash). Typical 0.01-0.60.

requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha (capillary pressure scale)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: In 1/Pa, NOT 1/cm H2O (alpha_Pa = alpha_cm/98.0665). Applies to variably-saturated / multi-phase models, not 1p saturated flow.

requirements.name: van Genuchten n (pore-geometry index)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be > 1 for a well-defined capillary law (n<=1 makes pc(Sw) undefined / NaN).

requirements.name: Residual water saturation Swr
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Dispersivity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used by tracer/compositional transport, not by the flow-only models.

requirements.name: Molecular diffusion coefficient
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Consumed by compositional and tracer transport (FicksLaw).

requirements.name: Newton convergence/control parameters (MaxRelativeShift, TargetSteps, MaxSteps, MaxTimeStepDivisions)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: [Newton] group of the parameter tree (in-code defaults: MaxRelativeShift 1e-8, ResidualReduction 1e-5, TargetSteps 10, MaxSteps 18, MaxTimeStepDivisions 10)
requirements.notes: By default convergence is judged on relative shift only (EnableResidualCriterion false); residual may not be small even when Newton reports converged.

requirements.name: Initial primary-variable solution
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Problem.initial() per DOF; or restart via Dumux::loadSolution() from a prior VTK solution
requirements.notes: Restart requires the EXACT same grid (same cells, same ordering); changing resolution silently corrupts the restart. Should be consistent (e.g. hydrostatic) with the Dirichlet BCs to avoid first-step Newton failure.

requirements.name: Dirichlet boundary (fixed pressure / head)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Problem.dirichletAtPos() returning absolute pressure; p = 101325 + rho*g*(head - elevation)
requirements.notes: Absolute pressure, NOT gauge; surface p ~ 101325 Pa. Gauge use shifts head ~10.3 m.

requirements.name: Boundary-type assignment (Dirichlet vs Neumann per segment)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Source / sink terms (e.g. pumping wells)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Problem.source()/sourceAtPos() per control volume; required (with transient mode) for pumping wells

requirements.name: Gravity switch (Problem.EnableGravity)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Problem.EnableGravity bool read by the Darcy flux; gravity acts in -z (last coordinate)
requirements.notes: Structural switch: set false for plan-view 2D, true for vertical cross-sections. Read without an in-code default at the TPFA Darcy site; an unset value relies on a property-level default and can silently drop the gravity term.

requirements.name: Grid domain definition (extent, cells, refinement, grid file)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: [Grid] group (LowerLeft/UpperRight in meters, Cells, Refinement) consumed by Dumux::GridManager; or DGF / Gmsh MSH v2 / Eclipse GRDECL / VTK grid file
requirements.notes: Coordinates in meters. Gmsh meshes must be MSH version 2.

requirements.name: Time-loop control (TEnd, DtInitial, MaxTimeStepSize)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: All in seconds (1 day = 86400 s, 1 year = 31536000 s). DtInitial ~1% of TEnd is a safe start; a large initial dt causes Newton failure.
