requirements.name: wave kinematics (significant height Hs, peak period Tp / spectrum)
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: XML wavemaker (piston/flap) or spectral definition realized at the paddle/relaxation zone
requirements.notes: Heights in meters (ocean 0.5-5 m, lab 0.01-0.3 m); cm authoring blows up or vanishes.

requirements.name: inlet velocity / current
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Must be m/s; cm/s or knots can exceed artificial sound speed and destabilize.

requirements.name: water level / tide
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source

requirements.name: reference fluid density (rhop0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: 1000 freshwater, 1025 seawater. g/cm^3 (1.0) corrupts the EOS.

requirements.name: gravitational acceleration (gravity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Typical (0,0,-9.81); also couples into the density-diffusion term via DDTgz=rhop0*Gravity.z/CteB, so a wrong gravity direction silently alters the DDT2 correction. cm/s^2 authoring is a critical unit error.

requirements.name: polytropic constant (gamma)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: 7 for water (Tait EOS).

requirements.name: speed-of-sound coefficient (coefsound)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Sets artificial sound speed >=10x max velocity (typical 15-20).

requirements.name: smoothing-length coefficient (coefh)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: h = coefh*sqrt(n*dp^2); sets kernel support and neighbor count.

requirements.name: particle spacing (dp)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Fundamental resolution; 3-D cost ~dp^-3. mm/cm authoring yields billions of particles / OOM.

requirements.name: artificial viscosity coefficient / kinematic viscosity (Visco)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: UNITS depend on ViscoTreatment — conditional-unit trap; mismatch is ~10,000x error.

requirements.name: density-diffusion coefficient (DensityDTvalue)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: delta-SPH coefficient, typical 0.1.

requirements.name: initial particle distribution (Case.bi4)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: binary bi4 produced by GenCase from the XML geometry (box/sphere/cylinder/prism draw commands, CAD/STL)
requirements.notes: Particles fill fluid and boundary regions within pointmin/pointmax; geometry outside the box is clipped.

requirements.name: initial particle density / velocity
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: boundary method (Boundary: DBC vs mDBC)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: density exclusion thresholds (RhopOutMin/Max)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

packages.name: EF5

requirements.name: precipitation (prec)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Pobs.txt — tab-separated, header DATE + subbasin/pobsid columns, in forcingdir
requirements.notes: Mandatory for every timestep over the full bdate-edate range; no missing (-9999) or negative values; no interpolation/fill for gaps. Header must be line 1 (no !! comment lines) or data silently misparse.

requirements.name: air temperature (temp)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Tobs.txt — tab-separated, per subbasin/tobsid, in forcingdir
requirements.notes: Mandatory every timestep; assumed to represent the subbasin mean elevation unless elevation-corrected.

requirements.name: daily min / max air temperature (tmin/tmax)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required by PET models 3-5 (Hargreaves-Samani, Priestley-Taylor, Penman-Monteith).

requirements.name: shortwave radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required by PET models 3-5.

requirements.name: relative humidity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required by PET model 5 (FAO Penman-Monteith) only.

requirements.name: wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required by PET model 5 only.

requirements.name: lp (PET reduction limit)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.8; limits actual ET reduction relative to soil moisture.

requirements.name: cevp (PET coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Highly sensitive control on potential evapotranspiration.

requirements.name: cevpam / cevpph (PET seasonal amplitude / phase)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: ttmp (snow threshold temperature)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: cmlt (degree-day snowmelt factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: wcwp / wcfc / wcep (wilting point / field capacity / effective porosity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: par.txt soil-type-dependent (optionally per layer wcwp1-3 etc.)
requirements.notes: Must satisfy wcwp < wcfc < wcep and wcwp+wcfc+wcep < 1; ordering violation gives no percolation.

requirements.name: rrcs1 / rrcs2 / rrcs3 (upper / lower / deep recession coefficients)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: srrcs (surface runoff recession coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: rivvel / damp (river velocity / attenuation)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: lake rating-curve and depth parameters (gratk, gratefk, gldepi, gldepol)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: nutrient process parameters (denitrlu, denitwr, denitwl, minerfn, sedon, sedpp, soilcoh, soilerod)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Process-rate / transport coefficients for the N/P/sediment cycle. If 'substance N P' is enabled but these are absent from par.txt, nutrient processes are silently disabled. (Initial-pool *0 parameters humusn0/fastn0/humusp0/fastp0 are listed under initial_conditions.)

requirements.name: SLC class definitions (landuse, soil, crop, vegtype, special, tiledepth, streamdepth, numlayers, soildepth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: GeoClass.txt — numlayers 1-3 with matching soildepth columns; special=2 marks water/lake class

requirements.name: subbasin physiography (AREA, RIVLEN, latitude, elevation, slope, lake depth, SLC n fractions, parreg/wqparreg/lakeregion)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: GeoData.txt — time-invariant subbasin descriptors; SLC fractions per subbasin must sum to 1.0
requirements.notes: AREA in m^2 (discharge scales linearly with area); slope_mean mandatory for nutrient modelling.

requirements.name: initial soil water
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: set to wp+fc (optionally saturation wp+fc+ep); or restored from state_save file
requirements.notes: Hydrology needs ~1-2 yr warmup (bdate before cdate) for stable water states.

requirements.name: initial lake stage
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: outlet/local lake water depth set at threshold (gldepi/illdepth)

requirements.name: initial nutrient pools (humus/fast N and P: humusn0, fastn0, humusp0, fastp0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: par.txt initial-pool parameters (humusn0, fastn0, humusp0, fastp0; genpar/landpar)
requirements.notes: Initialization of the prognostic soil N/P pools; pools need ~3-5 yr warmup to stabilize seasonal pattern.

requirements.name: simulation period (bdate / cdate / edate) and output/model options
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: info.txt — all directory paths must end in trailing '/'
requirements.notes: Selects petmodel and snowmeltmodel options, substances ('substance N P'), output variables and criteria.

requirements.name: PET method selector (petmodel 0-5)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 0-2 use temperature only; 3-5 add radiation/min-max temp; 5 adds humidity and wind.

requirements.name: snowmelt method selector (snowmeltmodel)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: MAINDOWN routing topology
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be acyclic with a terminating outlet; cycles cause an infinite routing loop.

requirements.name: forcing-station mapping
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: lake / dam regulation configuration
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: LakeData.txt / DamData.txt (rating curves, regvol, production flows, minflow, seasonal inflows)
requirements.notes: Required if any SLC has special=2, else a zero-volume lake traps all water.

requirements.name: upstream inflow, atmospheric deposition, point/non-point sources, aquifer exchange
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: internal MAINDOWN inflow; AtmdepData.txt, PointSourceData.txt, NonPointSourceData.txt, AquiferData.txt

requirements.name: crop fertilizer / management data
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CropData.txt — crop/fertilizer management decisions (sowing, fertilizer timing/rates); required when NPC enabled
requirements.notes: Management input (fertilizer/crop decisions), not a calibrated physical coefficient.

requirements.name: observed discharge (for calibration)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Qobs.txt (gauged subbasins); optpar.txt for calibration ranges/tasks

requirements.name: Demand time pattern multipliers
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: .inp [PATTERNS] section, applied cyclically over the simulation
requirements.notes: Dimensionless multipliers scale junction base demand (and optionally reservoir head / source strength) per pattern time step.

requirements.name: Reservoir head pattern
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Time-varying fixed-grade boundary head; reservoir is an infinite source/sink.

requirements.name: Pipe roughness coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: Hazen-Williams C (unitless) | Darcy-Weisbach roughness height (10^-3 ft US / mm SI) | Chezy-Manning n (unitless)
requirements.model_input_format: .inp [PIPES] Roughness column; meaning set by [OPTIONS] Headloss
requirements.notes: Roughness scale MUST match the selected head-loss formula (H-W C ~50-160, D-W height, C-M n ~0.011-0.017); no internal validation of roughness-vs-formula consistency.

requirements.name: Pipe length, diameter, minor-loss coefficient
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: length (ft/m), diameter (in US / mm SI), minor-loss (unitless)

requirements.name: Node elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Junction base demand
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Base demand is scaled by the demand pattern at each time step; co-dominant calibrated quantity with roughness.

requirements.name: Tank geometry (diameter, min/max level, min volume, bottom elevation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: diameter (ft US / m SI), level (ft/m), volume (ft^3/m^3)
requirements.notes: Tank diameter is in ft (US) or m (SI), NOT inches/mm; wrong unit yields near-zero volume.

requirements.name: Pump characteristic curve / power / speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: head (ft/m) vs flow units; POWER in HP (US) / kW (SI)
requirements.notes: HEAD curve must be monotonically decreasing head with flow; mis-specification yields XHEAD/XFLOW non-delivery.

requirements.name: Valve type and setting
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.unit: PRV/PSV/PBV setting (psi or m), FCV (flow units), TCV (unitless loss coeff), GPV (curve ID)

requirements.name: Bulk reaction coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Negative = decay (chlorine loss), positive = growth (e.g. DBP formation); same in US and SI.

requirements.name: Wall reaction coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Unit-system dependent (ft/day vs m/day); pipe material/condition dependent.

requirements.name: Emitter (leakage) coefficient and exponent
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Models pressure-dependent outflow d = C*p^Qexp at a node.

requirements.name: Tank initial water level
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Initial node water quality / water age
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Zero initial quality with no source leaves the constituent at zero everywhere; existing systems may need a warm-up or non-zero initial age.

requirements.name: Initial link status
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Head-loss formula selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects which roughness law relates flow to head loss; dictates the meaning of the roughness column.

requirements.name: Flow units selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Flow-unit choice cascades to determine the unit system of ALL other parameters and outputs.

requirements.name: Demand model selection (DDA / PDA)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: .inp [OPTIONS] Demand Model / Minimum Pressure / Required Pressure / Pressure Exponent
requirements.notes: DDA forces full demand (can produce negative pressures); PDA makes delivered demand a power function of pressure (Pexp default 0.5).

requirements.name: Water-quality analysis type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Single-period (Duration=0) runs silently force Qualflag to NONE.

requirements.name: Quality source specification
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: CONCEN only sets concentration of external inflow; on a node with no external inflow use SETPOINT or FLOWPACED.

requirements.name: Simple controls and rule-based controls
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Open/close/set pumps and valves on tank level, node pressure, or time; controls without hysteresis can oscillate.

requirements.name: Tank mixing model selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Solver tolerances and limits
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: TRIALS (count), ACCURACY (ratio), UNBALANCED, DAMPLIMIT, VISCOSITY, DIFFUSIVITY
requirements.notes: Defaults: TRIALS 200, ACCURACY 0.001, DAMPLIMIT 0 (disabled), viscosity 1.1e-5 sq ft/s, diffusivity 1.3e-8 sq ft/s.

requirements.name: Simulation timing parameters
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: .inp [TIMES] Duration / Hydraulic / Quality / Pattern / Report timesteps
requirements.notes: Quality timestep must be <= hydraulic timestep (default Hstep/10); Hstep is clamped to <= pattern and <= report steps.

packages.name: EPIC

requirements.name: SRAD (solar radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: daily .DLY fixed-width record (3I4,6F6.2), no column labels; order YEAR MON DAY SRAD TMX TMN PRCP RH WSPD
requirements.notes: Range 0.01-900; 999.0 triggers weather-generator backfill. W m-2 vs MJ m-2 day-1 confusion silently depresses yields.

requirements.name: TMX (maximum air temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Range -50 to 100; Kelvin input inflates PET to ~6000 mm/yr silently.

requirements.name: TMN (minimum air temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: PRCP / RFV (precipitation, required)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Range 0-900; raw kg m-2 s-1 input gives yields 10-100x too small silently.

requirements.name: RH / RHD (relative humidity, fraction) or dew point
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: WSPD / U10 (wind velocity at 10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Penman-Monteith PET is sensitive to wind-speed errors; Hargreaves is more robust.

requirements.name: CO2 (atmospheric concentration)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: X1 column of .DLY (held constant between provided values) or EPICCONT.DAT control default
requirements.notes: Drives radiation-use-efficiency / water-use-efficiency CO2 response; CO2 set to zero causes near-zero yield. EPIC's built-in EPICCONT.DAT default CO2 is 370.0 ppm (held constant between any X1 values provided in .DLY).

requirements.name: EVI (vegetation index, optional)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: .DLY column, active only when IEVI flag set
requirements.notes: Range -1 to 1; optional remote-sensing driver.

requirements.name: Latitude / longitude / elevation / aspect / slope / channel geometry / SCS curve number
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Slope valid 0.001-0.2 m/m; CN2 75-85 typical for row crops.

requirements.name: Soil profile per layer (up to 10): depth bottom, bulk density, wilting point, field capacity, sand/silt/clay, rock fragment, organic C, pH, CEC, Ksat, albedo, hydrologic group, USL
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Bulk density 1.35-1.55 t/m3 typical; organic C expected as percent (0-100), C/N near 10 and N/P near 8. Hydrologic soil group must not be confused with curve number on soil line 2.

requirements.name: Crop parameter database (~58 columns, 150+ crops): harvest index, biomass-energy ratio, leaf-area, heat-unit coefficients
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Global equation/calibration coefficients (S-curve and 64 general parameters: root growth, N mineralization, denitrification, CENTURY rates, Hargreaves coefficients, etc.)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Shipped values are Texas A&M Blackland defaults; PARM(13)=0.6 and PARM(38)=0.0032 are model-modified Hargreaves PET coefficients (raised from origin 0.5/0.0023).

requirements.name: Fertilizer / tillage-implement / pesticide databases
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Initial soil water, nitrate/ammonium, organic C/N pools, residue per layer
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: .SOL profile initial values; first ~2 years treated as spin-up and discarded
requirements.notes: EPIC carries field state forward over the full multi-year run; soil-water pool must equilibrate (>=2-yr spin-up) or water-balance residual grows.

requirements.name: Operation schedule: plant, fertilize, irrigate, harvest, kill, tillage operations
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: date + equipment/crop/material codes + OPV1..OPV9 operation values
requirements.model_input_format: .OPC fixed-width op lines (YR MO DY equip tractor crop_id context OPV1..OPV9); Julian day must match month+day
requirements.notes: Wrong crop or equipment code yields zero/tiny yields silently; OPV6=0 in plant row applies a lifetime (not annual) max-N cap from CROPCOM.

requirements.name: Simulation control: NBYR years, start year/month/day, print code IPD, weather-input mode NGN, leap-year flag LPYR
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: NBYR*365 must be <= rows in .DLY or EPIC reads past EOF and crashes.

requirements.name: PET method selector IET (1=Penman-Monteith, 2=Penman, 3=Priestley-Taylor, 4=Hargreaves, 5=Baier-Robertson)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Penman-Monteith most accurate but wind-sensitive; Hargreaves most robust; Baier-Robertson for cold climates.

requirements.name: Water-erosion equation selector DRV (0=MUST, 2=USLE, 3=MUSS, 4=MUSL, 6=RUSL, 7=RUS2)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Irrigation flag IRR (0=dryland, 1=scheduled, 2=auto-stress, 3=auto-deficit)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: At water-surplus monsoon sites auto-irrigation never fires (WS=0) by correct physics.

requirements.name: Output variable / output-file selection (32 file-class toggles)

requirements.name: Surface Mass Balance (SMB)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.model_input_format: Top Surface Accumulation keyword / acabf element variable consumed by ThicknessSolver
requirements.notes: Sign convention is positive=accumulation; ablation must be negative or the ice grows everywhere with no ablation zone.

requirements.name: Surface Temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: deg C (SIF boundary condition); Kelvin internally for Arrhenius rate factor
requirements.model_input_format: Temperature boundary-condition value on the upper surface
requirements.notes: SIF boundary conditions are specified in Celsius while the Arrhenius viscosity law uses Kelvin; consistent reference temperature required.

requirements.name: Basal / sub-shelf Melt Rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Bottom Surface Accumulation keyword / libmassbf element variable consumed by ThicknessSolver

requirements.name: Geothermal Heat Flux (GHF)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Heat Flux boundary condition on the basal surface (feeds Temperature/Enthalpy solver)

requirements.name: Basal friction coefficient (beta / Slip Coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: depends on friction law (Linear Pa·s/m; Weertman Pa·(m/a)^(-1/n); regularized-Coulomb dimensionless ~0.1-0.5)
requirements.model_input_format: SSA Friction Parameter; friction law selected by 'SSA Friction Law' (linear/weertman/budd/coulomb/regularized coulomb)

requirements.name: Glen's flow-law exponent n
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: SIF 'Viscosity Exponent' expects 1/n (=0.333 for n=3), NOT n

requirements.name: Glen's flow-law rate factor A
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: Material rate factor; may be temperature-dependent via Arrhenius A(T)=A0·exp(-Q/(R·T))

requirements.name: Ice density
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: Seawater density
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: Clausius-Clapeyron slope (beta clapeyron)

requirements.name: Critical Shear Rate

packages.name: FSM2

requirements.name: SW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: DRIV1D=1 space-delimited ASCII met file, no header, one row per timestep (col 5)
requirements.notes: Incoming shortwave; must be >=0. Treated as all-diffuse unless SWPART=1, which splits diffuse/direct via solar position.

requirements.name: LW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Incoming longwave; physical range ~50-600 W m-2.

requirements.name: Sf
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met file col 7 (DRIV1D=1); cols 7-8 are Rf,Sf order-swapped in DRIV1D=2 ESM-SnowMIP
requirements.notes: Snowfall rate; reduced by canopy interception (INTERCEPT modifies Sf inout) before reaching the snowpack when VAI>0.

requirements.name: Rf
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Rainfall rate. ENSMBL perturbed-driving path re-derives rain/snow split from a Tc rule, overriding the forcing Rf/Sf phase.

requirements.name: Ta
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Air temperature in Kelvin; physical range 200-330 K.

requirements.name: RH
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Relative humidity. Converted internally to specific humidity Qa via Magnus formula using Ps; the raw RH is consumed in FSM2_DRIVE and does not reach the physics. DRIV1D=2 reads Qa directly.

requirements.name: Ua
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wind speed; floored to a minimum 0.1 m s-1 inside FSM2_DRIVE.

requirements.name: Ps
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Surface air pressure; physical range ~40000-110000 Pa; used in the RH->Qa conversion.

requirements.name: asmn
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Minimum (melting) snow albedo, default 0.5.

requirements.name: asmx
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Maximum (fresh) snow albedo, default 0.85.

requirements.name: rhof
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Fresh snow density, default 100 (DENSTY=1/2).

requirements.name: rfix
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Fixed snow density, default 300 (DENSTY=0).

requirements.name: rhow
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Wind-packed snow density, default 300 (DENSTY=1,2).

requirements.name: hfsn
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Snow-cover-fraction depth scale, default 0.1.

requirements.name: kfix
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Fixed snow thermal conductivity, default 0.24 (CONDCT=0).

requirements.name: rgr0
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Fresh snow grain radius, default 5e-5.

requirements.name: Wirr
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Irreducible liquid water content of snow, default 0.03 (HYDROL=1,2).

requirements.name: z0sn
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Snow surface roughness length, default 0.001.

requirements.name: z0sf
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Snow-free surface roughness length, default 0.1.

requirements.name: gsat
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Surface conductance for saturated soil, default 0.01.

requirements.name: alb0
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Snow-free ground albedo, default 0.2.

requirements.name: vegh
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Canopy height; 0 for open site. Requires VAI>0 to have radiative effect.

requirements.name: VAI
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Vegetation area index; 0 = open, conifer 3-6. Drives canopy presence, interception capacity, transmission, longwave.

requirements.name: fcly
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Soil clay fraction, default 0.3. Feeds Cosby-style pedotransfer (b, Vsat, sathh) computed once in the main program, not per timestep.

requirements.name: fsnd
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Soil sand fraction, default 0.6; fcly+fsnd<=1. Note hcon_soil derivation uses (1-fcly) as the sand exponent (apparent internal inconsistency).

requirements.name: lat
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Latitude in degrees, converted to radians internally (lat_rad = pi/180 * lat_deg). Used only when SWPART=1.

requirements.name: zT
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

packages.name: FloPy

requirements.name: recharge
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: areal flux array (nrow,ncol) per stress period via RCH/RCHA package
requirements.notes: Commonly derived as R = P x recharge_fraction; source data typically in mm/day and must be divided by 1000 to model units. Unit mismatch is silent (heads can rise above land surface yet still converge).

requirements.name: evapotranspiration
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: head-dependent ET sink via EVT/EVTA package (max rate evtr, extinction depth exdp, ET surface surf, option nevtop)
requirements.notes: Head-dependent sink; source data typically in mm/day and must be converted to model length/time units. FloPy EVT defaults are placeholders (nevtop=3 highest-active-cell, evtr=1e-3 L/T, exdp=1.0 L, surf=0.0); a run left at default ET surf=0.0 / evtr placeholder gives meaningless extraction.

requirements.name: well pumping / injection
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: per-stress-period list of [lay,row,col,flux] via WEL package
requirements.notes: Extraction is NEGATIVE, injection POSITIVE in MODFLOW convention. Source rates in L/s (x86.4) or m3/hr (x24) must be converted to m3/day.

requirements.name: horizontal hydraulic conductivity (K / hk)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: NPF (MF6) / LPF-UPW (MF2005) array; hardcoded FloPy default hk=1.0 (placeholder)
requirements.notes: Literature K often in cm/s (x864) or m/s (x86400) to convert to m/day. Default value is an unphysical placeholder; a run left at default produces meaningless heads.

requirements.name: vertical hydraulic conductivity / anisotropy (K33 / vka)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: NPF (MF6) / LPF-UPW (MF2005); interpretation depends on layvka; FloPy default vka=1.0
requirements.notes: Typically 0.01-0.1 x horizontal K.

requirements.name: specific storage (Ss / ss)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 1e-6 to 1e-4; governs confined transient storage response.

requirements.name: specific yield (Sy / sy)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 0.01-0.35; governs unconfined transient storage response.

requirements.name: riverbed / streambed conductance
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: C = K_bed x L_cell x W / d_bed; K_bed typically 0.01-1 m/day. Using aquifer K or wrong geometry makes the river over/under-connected.

requirements.name: layer type (laytyp / convertible flag)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: LPF/UPW laytyp (0=confined; >0=convertible/water-table); MF6 NPF icelltype; FloPy default laytyp=0
requirements.notes: Default 0 (confined) is a common silent trap; water-table behavior requires convertible layers.

requirements.name: starting heads (strt)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Should be above layer bottoms to avoid initial dry cells; default 1.0 everywhere is unphysical for transient/nonlinear runs.

requirements.name: active-cell domain (ibound / idomain)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: BAS ibound (active/inactive/CHD flags) / MF6 idomain; hnoflo no-flow sentinel
requirements.notes: Activates/deactivates cells for the solver; inactive cells carry the hnoflo sentinel (-999.99 FloPy default).

requirements.name: initial concentration (transport)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Only for solute/density-transport runs.

requirements.name: constant-head boundary (CHD)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Specified-head Dirichlet boundary; too many or too-low CHD cells can drain the model.

requirements.name: river / general-head / drain boundary (RIV/GHB/DRN)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Exchange flux = conductance x (boundary head - cell head); stage/datum must match grid elevation datum.

requirements.name: spatial & temporal discretization (DIS/TDIS)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: DIS (nlay,nrow,ncol,delr,delc,top,botm) + stress periods (nper,perlen,nstp,tsmult,steady); MF6 splits into DIS+TDIS
requirements.notes: Steady vs transient flag per period; perlen units must match ITMUNI.

requirements.name: unit-system codes (LENUNI / ITMUNI)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: MODFLOW is unit-agnostic; all quantities must be in the chosen consistent length/time units. 0=undefined is dangerous.

requirements.name: solver configuration (IMS / PCG / NWT / SMS)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: IMS (MF6) complexity (SIMPLE/MODERATE/COMPLEX), outer/inner_maximum, outer/inner_dvclose; PCG/NWT for MF2005
requirements.notes: Iteration limits, closure criteria, under-relaxation, and Newton formulation determine whether and how the head field converges.

requirements.name: output control (OC)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: OC package + ipakcb/save_flows flags selecting which timesteps save HEAD/BUDGET
requirements.notes: Heads and budget outputs are ABSENT (not zero) if OC is misconfigured; gates the existence of .hds/.cbc.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.notes: Raises ignition energy and lowers ROS; spread stops above the moisture of extinction.

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Optional NetCDF temperature layer; ambient Ta also a fuels-table column
requirements.notes: Used in the Balbi ignition-energy balance; Kelvin required (Celsius gives negative ignition energy).

requirements.name: digital elevation model (altitude)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: altitude variable in landscape NetCDF (DIMT,DIMZ,DIMY,DIMX); from SRTM/Copernicus DEM/LiDAR GeoTIFF reprojected to UTM
requirements.notes: Topography; internal slope (and aspect) are derived from altitude and drive slope-driven spread. A flat layer yields slope factor = 0.

requirements.name: fuel type map (fuel index)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: fuel variable in landscape NetCDF (integer raster); each index selects a row in the fuels table
requirements.notes: Index 0 should be non-burnable (e=0). Max index in the raster must be < number of fuel rows or an out-of-bounds read occurs.

requirements.name: fuel combustion parameters (Rothermel/Balbi SI set)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: mixed SI (kg/m3, 1/m, m, kg/m2, J/kg, K)
requirements.model_input_format: Semicolon-delimited fuels table, one row per fuel index: Rhod, Rhol, Md, Ml, sd, sl, e, Sigmad, Sigmal, stoch, RhoA, Ta, Tau0, Deltah, DeltaH, Cp, Cpa, Ti, X0, r00, Blai, me
requirements.notes: Rothermel/Balbi require SI in the CSV and convert internally to Imperial; do NOT pre-convert. me is a fraction here. Applies to Rothermel and Balbi propagation models.

requirements.name: fuel combustion parameters (RothermelAndrews2018 Imperial set)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: Semicolon-delimited fuels table: fl1h_tac, fd_ft, SAVcar_ftinv, mdOnDry1h_r, fuelDens_lbft3, H_BTUlb, Dme_pc, totMineral_r, effectMineral_r
requirements.notes: RothermelAndrews2018 consumes Imperial fuel parameters directly (no internal conversion of fuel params). Dme_pc is a percentage. Applies to the RothermelAndrews2018 model only.

requirements.name: ignition points / initial fire front
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: UTM m (or lon/lat degrees), time s
requirements.model_input_format: startFire[loc=(x,y,z);t=T] in UTM, startFire[lonlat=(lon,lat,z);t=T] in degrees, or an explicit FireFront/FireNode node hierarchy
requirements.notes: Seeds the initial front(s); multiple and delayed ignitions are supported. Must lie within the loaded domain bounds and on burnable fuel.

requirements.name: loaded landscape state / domain extent
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: loadData[data.nc;timestamp]; FireDomain[sw=(...);ne=(...)] or inferred from the NetCDF extent
requirements.notes: Establishes the domain SW/NE corners and the t=0 landscape fields before ignition.

requirements.name: propagationModel
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the rate-of-spread model; MUST match the fuels-table unit system. Engine default is Iso (isotropic), not Rothermel/Balbi — omitting it gives trivial constant spread.

requirements.name: spatialIncrement
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Lagrangian space step used in dt = ds/speed; controls integration accuracy/CFL. Sub-1 m values over large domains create millions of nodes and can hang.

requirements.name: perimeterResolution
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Target spacing between fire-front nodes (re-meshing resolution).

requirements.name: relax (front smoothing / ROS relaxation factor)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Temporal relaxation of node speed: speed = (1-relax)*speed + relax*newSpeed.

requirements.name: windReductionFactor
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Midflame wind reduction for canopy effects. When < 1.0 Rothermel also switches to the Andrews/Cruz/Rothermel (2013) wind-cap formula Uf=96.81*Ir^(1/3) - an undocumented coupling. Set 0 suppresses wind entirely.

requirements.name: propagationSpeedAdjustmentFactor
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: minSpeed / minimalPropagativeFrontDepth
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Stop thresholds: minimum propagation speed and minimum front depth for continued propagation.

requirements.name: time advancement command
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Without a step/goTo the simulation stays at t=0 and produces no advancement.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Swglobal
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Instantaneous incoming shortwave; accumulated J/m2 (e.g. ERA5) must be deaccumulated.

requirements.name: LWin
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional incoming longwave; if absent, parameterized from cloudiness (Konzelmann/Angstrom).

requirements.name: CloudTrans
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional cloud transmissivity; supplying both LWin and CloudTrans double-parameterizes longwave.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.notes: Soil layer thickness (range ~10-500 mm); m or cm input collapses sub-mm layers and diverges the Richards solver.

requirements.name: Kh
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Lateral saturated hydraulic conductivity (1E-7 to 1E-3 m/s).

requirements.name: Kv
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Vertical (normal) saturated hydraulic conductivity (1E-7 to 1E-3 m/s).

requirements.name: vwc r
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Residual water content; must satisfy vwc_r < vwc_w < vwc_fc < vwc_s.

requirements.name: vwc w
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wilting point.

requirements.name: vwc fc
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Field capacity.

requirements.name: vwc s
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Saturated water content.

requirements.name: alpha
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Van Genuchten alpha (0.0001-0.01 1/mm); 1/cm input distorts the retention curve by 10x.

requirements.name: n
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Van Genuchten n (1.1-3.0); n<=1.0 makes m=1-1/n non-positive (FPE).

requirements.name: stor
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: VegHeight
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: LSAI

requirements.name: MinStomatalRes
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Minimum stomatal resistance controlling transpiration demand.

requirements.notes: Enables horizon-obstruction shading; requires horizon files.

requirements.name: LWinParameterization

requirements.notes: Selects incoming-longwave parameterization when LWin not measured.

requirements.name: bottom/lateral water balance BC
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Subsurface bottom and lateral boundary specification for the Richards solver.

requirements.name: energy balance BC
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Surface/bottom energy-balance boundary specification.

shared_requirements.name: AirT
shared_requirements.notes: Required. Kelvin input drives energy-balance non-convergence / hanging.

shared_requirements.name: Iprec
shared_requirements.notes: Accumulated depth per model time step, NOT a rate; wrong rate units scale total precipitation by ~1000x.

shared_requirements.name: RelHum
shared_requirements.notes: Required. Fraction (0-1) is read as 0.x% (near-zero ET).

shared_requirements.name: WindDir
shared_requirements.notes: Recommended; drives terrain wind redistribution and blowing snow.

shared_requirements.name: Swglobal
shared_requirements.notes: Instantaneous incoming shortwave; accumulated J/m2 (e.g. ERA5) must be deaccumulated.

shared_requirements.name: LWin
shared_requirements.notes: Optional incoming longwave; if absent, parameterized from cloudiness (Konzelmann/Angstrom).

shared_requirements.name: CloudTrans
shared_requirements.notes: Optional cloud transmissivity; supplying both LWin and CloudTrans double-parameterizes longwave.

shared_requirements.name: DewT
shared_requirements.notes: Optional dew-point temperature.

shared_requirements.name: AirPress
shared_requirements.notes: Optional air pressure.

shared_requirements.name: Dz
shared_requirements.notes: Soil layer thickness (range ~10-500 mm); m or cm input collapses sub-mm layers and diverges the Richards solver.

shared_requirements.name: Kh
shared_requirements.notes: Lateral saturated hydraulic conductivity (1E-7 to 1E-3 m/s).

shared_requirements.name: Kv
shared_requirements.notes: Vertical (normal) saturated hydraulic conductivity (1E-7 to 1E-3 m/s).

shared_requirements.name: vwc_r
shared_requirements.notes: Residual water content; must satisfy vwc_r < vwc_w < vwc_fc < vwc_s.

shared_requirements.name: vwc_w
shared_requirements.notes: Wilting point.

shared_requirements.name: vwc_fc
shared_requirements.notes: Field capacity.

shared_requirements.name: vwc_s
shared_requirements.notes: Saturated water content.

shared_requirements.name: alpha
shared_requirements.notes: Van Genuchten alpha (0.0001-0.01 1/mm); 1/cm input distorts the retention curve by 10x.

shared_requirements.name: n
shared_requirements.notes: Van Genuchten n (1.1-3.0); n<=1.0 makes m=1-1/n non-positive (FPE).

shared_requirements.name: stor
shared_requirements.notes: Specific storativity (~5E-7).

shared_requirements.name: VegHeight
shared_requirements.notes: Canopy height (meadow 300-600, shrub 1000-3000, forest 5000-30000 mm); m input treated as mm (effectively bare ground).

shared_requirements.name: LSAI
shared_requirements.notes: Leaf+stem area index (0.5-8.0); below LSAIthres (~0.1) canopy is treated as absent.

shared_requirements.name: MinStomatalRes
shared_requirements.notes: Minimum stomatal resistance controlling transpiration demand.

shared_requirements.name: dem.txt
shared_requirements.notes: Distributed mode only; all maps must share ncols/nrows/cellsize/origin/NODATA.

shared_requirements.name: slope.txt
shared_requirements.notes: Percent instead of degrees distorts runoff response.

shared_requirements.name: aspect.txt
shared_requirements.notes: Radians instead of degrees flattens/reverses radiation pattern.

shared_requirements.name: horizonXXXX.txt
shared_requirements.notes: Required when FlagSkyViewFactor=1; missing file silently sets horizon angles to 0, over-predicting direct beam.

shared_requirements.name: LapseRateTair
shared_requirements.notes: Hardcoded default 6.5 C/km applied silently in meteo_distr when no LapseRateFile supplied.

shared_requirements.name: LapseRateTdew
shared_requirements.notes: Hardcoded default 2.5 C/km dew-point lapse-rate fallback.

shared_requirements.name: InitWaterTableDepth
shared_requirements.notes: Sets initial soil moisture profile (range 100-5000 mm); high calibration priority.

shared_requirements.name: initial soil temperature
shared_requirements.notes: Initial soil/rock temperature profile.

shared_requirements.name: snow initial state
shared_requirements.notes: Initial snowpack state; defaults to no snow.

shared_requirements.name: glacier initial conditions
shared_requirements.notes: Active only when glacier layers enabled.

shared_requirements.name: PointSim
shared_requirements.notes: 1 = point/1D column; 0 = distributed/3D catchment. Selects whether DEM/maps are required.

shared_requirements.name: InitDate / EndDate
shared_requirements.notes: Simulation period; European day-first dates.

packages.name: GLM

requirements.name: ShortWave (incoming shortwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column read per &meteorology; required for rad_mode 0-3
requirements.notes: Must be clipped to >= 0; un-clipped night-time negatives after interpolation can drive NaN temperatures. Daily values internally disaggregated to an idealized diurnal cycle.

requirements.name: LongWave (incoming longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column; consumed when lw_type=LW_IN / rad_mode=2
requirements.notes: lw_type selects handling: LW_IN reads this column, LW_CC computes longwave from cloud cover. Mismatch double-counts longwave and warms summer surface by 3-5 degC.

requirements.name: Clouds (cloud cover fraction)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column; required for rad_mode 0,1,4 / lw_type=LW_CC

requirements.name: AirTemp (air temperature at ~10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: RelHum (relative humidity at ~10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be percent (0-100), NOT fraction (0-1); a fractional value is read literally (0.7 -> 0.7% RH) and produces runaway evaporation.

requirements.name: WindSpeed (at ~10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Outliers (>30 m/s) can destabilize the mixing solver and yield NaN temperatures.

requirements.name: Rain (rainfall depth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Native unit is m/day, NOT mm/day; an mm/day value is 1000x too large and causes continuous overflow. Rain partitioned to snow below snow_threshold.

requirements.name: Snow (snowfall depth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column; consumed when snow_sw / snowice active

requirements.name: inflow FLOW (riverine inflow rate)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: inflow CSV column (daily); one file per configured inflow
requirements.notes: Inflow inserted at neutral-buoyancy depth set by its density relative to the column.

requirements.name: inflow TEMP (inflow water temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required; a missing/zero TEMP inserts 0 degC water forming an artificial cold density current that disrupts thermal structure.

requirements.name: inflow SALT (inflow salinity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be 0 for freshwater lakes; non-zero salinity raises inflow density and inserts the inflow too deep.

requirements.name: inflow WQ constituents (AED2)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: extra inflow CSV columns (NIT_nit, NIT_amm, PHS_frp, OGM_*, OXY_oxy, SIL_rsi, PHY_*) when AED2 enabled
requirements.notes: Absent nutrient columns give zero external loading; AED2 phytoplankton then collapse to near-zero biomass.

requirements.name: outflow FLOW (withdrawal/release rate)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: outflow CSV column (daily); one column per configured outlet; or internal natural overflow

requirements.name: Kw (light extinction coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Controls thermocline depth and light penetration; Kw ~ 1.7/Secchi_depth_m. Too high (>3) suppresses stratification; too low (<0.1) gives unrealistic deep heating.

requirements.name: coef wind stir (wind stirring coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets surface mixed-layer depth; too high prevents stratification in small sheltered lakes.

requirements.name: coef mix hyp (hypolimnetic/deep mixing coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: coef mix conv (convective mixing coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: ce, ch, cd (bulk transfer coefficients for latent, sensible, momentum flux)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: wind factor, sw factor, lw factor, rain factor, at factor, rh factor (forcing scaling factors)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplicative scalings applied to met forcing variables; wind_factor and sw_factor are dominant temperature calibration levers.

requirements.name: hypsographic curve H[] / A[] (depth-area, optionally volume)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: H[] and A[] must be monotonically ascending bottom-to-top with A[0]~0 and crest_elev=max(H); >=10-15 points recommended for realistic volume.

requirements.name: min layer thick / max layer thick (h min / h max)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Bound the adaptive Lagrangian layer thickness; max_layer_thick too small triggers layer-merge errors/hangs.

requirements.name: strm hf angle, strmbd slope, strmbd drag, submerged
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: outl elevs, bsn len outl, bsn wid outl, seepage rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: R growth (max phytoplankton growth rate)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets total phytoplankton biomass level.

requirements.name: I S (light saturation)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: w p (phytoplankton sedimentation velocity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Negative sinks, positive floats.

requirements.name: Fsed frp (sediment P release / internal loading)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Fsed oxy (sediment oxygen demand)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: initial temperature/salinity depth profiles
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: &init_profiles namelist (depth-value pairs; initial layers equal thickness)
requirements.notes: lake_depth must not exceed morphometry max depth (max(H)-min(H)).

requirements.name: initial AED2 WQ depth profiles
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: &init_profiles WQ entries; count must equal num_wq_vars * num_depths

requirements.name: rad mode (radiation mode selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects required shortwave/longwave/cloud combination; the supplied met columns must be consistent with it.

requirements.name: lw type (longwave handling: LW IN vs LW CC)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: subdaily (sub-daily forcing switch)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: subdaily=.true. with 3-hourly forcing produces flat/unrealistic temperatures; use daily forcing with subdaily=.false. unless forcing is hourly.

requirements.name: timefmt + start/stop (simulation time configuration)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: timefmt=2 for datetime strings, timefmt=3 for integer seconds; mismatch crashes the namelist read.

requirements.name: dt iceon avg + min ice thickness (ice model enablement)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Both must be set to enable the ice model; otherwise ice is silently disabled and surface temperature floors near 0.002 degC. For deep reservoirs (>50 m) dt_iceon_avg <= 0.04.

requirements.name: outflow mode (natural overflow / constant / scheduled / balance)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: num inflows / num outlets (inflow & outlet counts)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: num_inflows must match the number of inflow files; a count of 0 with files listed silently ignores all inflow.

requirements.name: AED2 module activation list (&aed models)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Phytoplankton requires oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus and organic_matter modules (silica for diatoms) listed before it; missing dependencies crash at init.

shared_requirements.notes: Must be clipped to >= 0; un-clipped night-time negatives after interpolation can drive NaN temperatures. Daily values internally disaggregated to an idealized diurnal cycle.

shared_requirements.notes: lw_type selects handling: LW_IN reads this column, LW_CC computes longwave from cloud cover. Mismatch double-counts longwave and warms summer surface by 3-5 degC.

shared_requirements.notes: Must be percent (0-100), NOT fraction (0-1); a fractional value is read literally (0.7 -> 0.7% RH) and produces runaway evaporation.

shared_requirements.name: WindSpeed (at ~10 m)
shared_requirements.notes: Outliers (>30 m/s) can destabilize the mixing solver and yield NaN temperatures.

shared_requirements.name: Rain (rainfall depth)
shared_requirements.notes: Native unit is m/day, NOT mm/day; an mm/day value is 1000x too large and causes continuous overflow. Rain partitioned to snow below snow_threshold.

shared_requirements.name: inflow FLOW (riverine inflow rate)
shared_requirements.notes: Inflow inserted at neutral-buoyancy depth set by its density relative to the column.

shared_requirements.name: inflow TEMP (inflow water temperature)
shared_requirements.notes: Required; a missing/zero TEMP inserts 0 degC water forming an artificial cold density current that disrupts thermal structure.

shared_requirements.name: inflow SALT (inflow salinity)
shared_requirements.notes: Must be 0 for freshwater lakes; non-zero salinity raises inflow density and inserts the inflow too deep.

shared_requirements.name: inflow WQ constituents (AED2)
shared_requirements.notes: Absent nutrient columns give zero external loading; AED2 phytoplankton then collapse to near-zero biomass.

shared_requirements.name: Kw (light extinction coefficient)
shared_requirements.notes: Controls thermocline depth and light penetration; Kw ~ 1.7/Secchi_depth_m. Too high (>3) suppresses stratification; too low (<0.1) gives unrealistic deep heating.

shared_requirements.name: coef_wind_stir (wind stirring coefficient)
shared_requirements.notes: Sets surface mixed-layer depth; too high prevents stratification in small sheltered lakes.

shared_requirements.name: ce, ch, cd (bulk transfer coefficients for latent, sensible, momentum flux)
wind_factor, sw_factor, lw_factor, rain_factor, at_factor, rh_factor (forcing scaling factors)
shared_requirements.notes: Multiplicative scalings applied to met forcing variables; wind_factor and sw_factor are dominant temperature calibration levers.

shared_requirements.name: hypsographic curve H[] / A[] (depth-area, optionally volume)
shared_requirements.notes: H[] and A[] must be monotonically ascending bottom-to-top with A[0]~0 and crest_elev=max(H); >=10-15 points recommended for realistic volume.

shared_requirements.name: min_layer_thick / max_layer_thick (h_min / h_max)
shared_requirements.notes: Bound the adaptive Lagrangian layer thickness; max_layer_thick too small triggers layer-merge errors/hangs.

shared_requirements.name: R_growth (max phytoplankton growth rate)
shared_requirements.notes: Sets total phytoplankton biomass level.

shared_requirements.name: w_p (phytoplankton sedimentation velocity)
shared_requirements.notes: Negative sinks, positive floats.

shared_requirements.name: initial temperature/salinity depth profiles
shared_requirements.notes: lake_depth must not exceed morphometry max depth (max(H)-min(H)).

shared_requirements.name: rad_mode (radiation mode selector)
shared_requirements.notes: Selects required shortwave/longwave/cloud combination; the supplied met columns must be consistent with it.

shared_requirements.name: subdaily (sub-daily forcing switch)
shared_requirements.notes: subdaily=.true. with 3-hourly forcing produces flat/unrealistic temperatures; use daily forcing with subdaily=.false. unless forcing is hourly.

shared_requirements.name: timefmt + start/stop (simulation time configuration)
shared_requirements.notes: timefmt=2 for datetime strings, timefmt=3 for integer seconds; mismatch crashes the namelist read.

shared_requirements.name: dt_iceon_avg + min_ice_thickness (ice model enablement)
shared_requirements.notes: Both must be set to enable the ice model; otherwise ice is silently disabled and surface temperature floors near 0.002 degC. For deep reservoirs (>50 m) dt_iceon_avg <= 0.04.

shared_requirements.name: outflow mode (natural overflow / constant / scheduled / balance)
num_inflows / num_outlets (inflow & outlet counts)
shared_requirements.notes: num_inflows must match the number of inflow files; a count of 0 with files listed silently ignores all inflow.

shared_requirements.name: AED2 module activation list (&aed_models)
shared_requirements.notes: Phytoplankton requires oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus and organic_matter modules (silica for diatoms) listed before it; missing dependencies crash at init.

requirements.name: Precip
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: catchment-average daily precipitation total (sum of any sub-daily values), aligned 1:1 with DatesR
requirements.notes: Must be >= 0 with no NA (NA triggers a stop() at input creation). Sub-daily forcing must be SUMMED to daily, not averaged.

requirements.name: PotEvap
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: daily catchment-average potential evapotranspiration, aligned 1:1 with DatesR
requirements.notes: Either observed/pre-computed or derived from the Oudin formula (PE = GE*(T+5)/100/28.5 for T >= -5 degC, GE = extraterrestrial radiation from Julian day + latitude). Must be >= 0, no NA.

requirements.name: DatesR
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: continuous daily date vector (no gaps, no duplicates), same length as Precip and PotEvap

requirements.name: X1 — production store capacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical 100-1200 mm; calibrated in log space
requirements.notes: Maximum capacity of the production (soil-moisture) store.

requirements.name: X2 — inter-catchment exchange coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical -5 to 3 mm/day; can be negative (catchment loses water to groundwater); calibrated in sinh space
requirements.notes: Groundwater exchange term; sign sets water gain vs loss.

requirements.name: X3 — routing store capacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical 20-300 mm; calibrated in log space
requirements.notes: Maximum (one-day-ahead) capacity of the nonlinear routing store.

requirements.name: X4 — unit hydrograph time constant
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical 1.1-2.9 d; calibrated via linear rescaling; hard physical floor 0.5 d
requirements.notes: Time base of UH1 (length X4) and UH2 (length 2*X4).

requirements.name: Production store initial level
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: fraction of X1 (default 0.30 * X1) or supplied state vector index 1
requirements.notes: Stores typically start far from equilibrium; >= 1 year warm-up advised (2-3 yr for arid catchments).

requirements.name: Routing store initial level
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: fraction of X3 (default 0.50 * X3) or supplied state vector index 2

requirements.name: UH1 / UH2 initial ordinate storages
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: default all-zero; or supplied at state-vector offsets 7+K (UH1) and 7+NH+K (UH2)

requirements.name: Warm-up period selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: warm-up index window preceding the run period; >= 1 year recommended
requirements.notes: Control choice that sets how far stores are spun up before the scored run window.

requirements.name: precipitation

requirements.unit: mm/day (daily); mm/hr at sub-daily step; mm in event mode
requirements.model_input_format: per-timestep precipitation time series at the subbasin
requirements.notes: At a sub-daily timestep the per-step depth must equal the daily depth divided by steps-per-day; missing days should be flagged (NaN/interpolated), not zero-filled, to avoid artificial dry spells.

requirements.name: temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Consumed only when snowmelt or temperature-based PET is active. Must be Celsius; Kelvin-valued inputs produce astronomically high PET.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Units are method-dependent and must match the selected ET method.

requirements.name: solar radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used by Priestley-Taylor PET when active.

requirements.name: Curve Number (CN)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar per subbasin (derived from hydrologic soil group + land cover)
requirements.notes: Controls total runoff volume; valid range 30-100. Sets maximum retention S = 25400/CN - 254 (mm).

requirements.name: Hydrologic Soil Group (A/B/C/D)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Infiltration class (A = high infiltration, D = low); feeds CN derivation.

requirements.name: initial abstraction ratio (lambda ia)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.05-0.20; 0.20 classic SCS, 0.05 per Woodward et al. 2003. Higher values raise the rainfall threshold below which runoff is zero.

requirements.name: time of concentration (Tc)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Drives the unit-hydrograph time-to-peak Tp = 0.6*Tc + D/2.

requirements.name: Muskingum K
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Routing travel-time / delay; K > 0 required.

requirements.name: Muskingum X
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Routing attenuation weight; valid range 0.0-0.5 (typically 0-0.3). X > 0.5 yields negative routing coefficients and negative flows.

requirements.name: Muskingum Steps
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Number of routing subreaches.

requirements.name: baseflow recession constant (k base)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Linear-reservoir recession ratio; range 0.5-0.99, near 1.0 = slow recession. It is a dimensionless ratio, NOT a rate constant or conductivity.

requirements.name: recharge fraction
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Fraction of loss diverted to the groundwater/baseflow store (calibration parameter); range 0.01-0.20.

requirements.name: basin area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: basin slope / longest-flow-path length

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Steady: '.fNN'/'.rNN' Section - Flow Data; Unsteady: '.uNN' boundary time series
requirements.notes: Primary forcing. Steady consumes one discharge per profile; unsteady consumes Q(t). HEC-RAS PRODUCES stage from Q — Q is conserved along the reach for steady flow and must not be treated as a model product. 1 m^3/s = 35.3147 cfs.

requirements.name: manning n (channel and overbanks)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: theta (implicit weighting) and friction-slope averaging method
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: Mesh cell elevation (dElevation mean / dElevation raw)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-cell field in mesh JSON (resampled from a GeoTIFF DEM, EPSG:4326, elevation in meters)
requirements.notes: Single most critical input. DEM must be GCS degrees with meters elevation and nodata matching dMissing_value_dem. dElevation_raw preserves the original; dElevation_mean is what depression filling mutates.

requirements.name: Cell geometry (vVertex, dLongitude/dLatitude center degree, dArea)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: degrees (GCS) for coordinates; m^2 for dArea
requirements.notes: Coordinates must be EPSG:4326 geographic degrees; model converts internally to 3D Cartesian. dArea must be m^2, not km^2.

requirements.name: Cell adjacency (aNeighbor, aNeighbor distance, lCellID)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: neighbor distance in m; IDs dimensionless
requirements.model_input_format: per-cell neighbor lists in mesh JSON
requirements.notes: aNeighbor_distance must be meters. vNeighbor_land excludes ocean/edge cells; a cell with fewer land neighbors than vertices is treated as a domain-edge outlet.

requirements.name: Preprocessed topological flowline network
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PyFlowline-preprocessed topological flowlines with cell-to-stream mapping
requirements.notes: Used only when stream burning is enabled. Raw NHDPlus/HydroSHEDS shapefiles WITHOUT topology mapping are silently ignored. Must be EPSG:4326 to intersect the mesh.

requirements.name: Earth radius (dRadius earth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: hardcoded 6378137.0 (WGS84 equatorial radius) for haversine neighbor distances

requirements.name: Raw cell elevation surface
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: dElevation_mean initialized from mesh JSON before Priority-Flood mutates it
requirements.notes: The delineation has no time-evolving state; the initial condition is the raw elevation surface that depression filling overwrites in place.

requirements.name: sMesh type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: config JSON string (hexagon | square | latlon | mpas | dggrid | tin)
requirements.notes: Selects the mesh JSON parser. A mismatch vs the actual JSON structure segfaults or misreads connectivity.

requirements.name: iFlag resample method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: dMissing value dem
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: config JSON float (default -9999.0); must equal the DEM nodata exactly

requirements.name: Outlet specification (lCellID outlet, lBasinID, dLatitude/dLongitude outlet degree)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

shared_requirements.name: Mesh cell elevation (dElevation_mean / dElevation_raw)

shared_requirements.name: Cell geometry (vVertex, dLongitude/dLatitude_center_degree, dArea)

shared_requirements.name: Cell adjacency (aNeighbor, aNeighbor_distance, lCellID)
shared_requirements.unit: neighbor distance in m; IDs dimensionless
shared_requirements.notes: aNeighbor_distance must be meters. vNeighbor_land excludes ocean/edge cells; a cell with fewer land neighbors than vertices is treated as a domain-edge outlet.

shared_requirements.name: Preprocessed topological flowline network
shared_requirements.notes: Used only when stream burning is enabled. Raw NHDPlus/HydroSHEDS shapefiles WITHOUT topology mapping are silently ignored. Must be EPSG:4326 to intersect the mesh.

shared_requirements.name: Raw cell elevation surface
shared_requirements.notes: The delineation has no time-evolving state; the initial condition is the raw elevation surface that depression filling overwrites in place.

shared_requirements.name: sMesh_type

shared_requirements.name: iFlag_stream_grid_option
shared_requirements.notes: KI/wrapper documents default 2; the C++ parameter.cpp constructor default is 3 (combined).

shared_requirements.name: iFlag_stream_burning_topology
shared_requirements.notes: When 1 without a topology file, silently falls back to elevation-based routing.

shared_requirements.name: dBreach_threshold
shared_requirements.notes: Wrapper default 0.0 (breaching disabled); C++ constructor default 5.0 m. Also scales the outlet deep-reduction (20x).

shared_requirements.name: Outlet specification (lCellID_outlet, lBasinID, dLatitude/dLongitude_outlet_degree)
