requirements.name: precipitation (prec)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Internal area-to-discharge conversion (0.01*Area*10000/86400) confirms the model expects cm/day; mm/day, m/day, or kg/m2/s forcing runs silently with magnitude errors.

requirements.name: temperature (temp)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives Hamon PET (exp(temp/16)) and degree-day snowmelt; a monthly-mean resample of temp also selects the GWLF growing-season CN antecedent-moisture branch. Kelvin input silently saturates PET seasonality.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration (pet)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional. If omitted, computed internally by Hamon from temperature + subbasin latitude + Julian day; PET forced to 0 where temp<=0. Pre-supplying it avoids recomputation each calibration run.

requirements.name: CN2 (SCS runoff curve number)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: RainfallRunoff entry in model.yaml; -99 flags for calibration
requirements.notes: Range [25,100]; most sensitive GWLF parameter. Internally converted to dry/wet CN1/CN3 and detention DSkt.

requirements.name: IS (interception fraction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Res (baseflow recession coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [1e-3,0.5]; sets groundwater discharge Gt=Res*St.

requirements.name: Sep (deep seepage fraction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,0.5]; deep seepage Dt=Sep*St lost from the basin.

requirements.name: Alpha (groundwater discharge / baseflow coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1]. Docs/KI overlap Alpha (baseflow rate) vs Res (recession); both govern shallow-groundwater discharge.

requirements.name: Beta (unsaturated-zone percolation coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1].

requirements.name: Ur (available soil water capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [1,15]; water-stress onset Ks ramps below 0.5*Ur. mm input silently suppresses runoff.

requirements.name: Df (degree-day snowmelt coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1]; melt=min(SnowSt, Df*temp) for temp>0. Shared with ABCD.

requirements.name: Kc (land cover / crop coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: a (runoff/recharge control under unsaturation)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1].

requirements.name: b (maximum soil water storage)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,400]; upper limit on ET + soil moisture storage.

requirements.name: c (groundwater recharge fraction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1].

requirements.name: d (groundwater discharge rate)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1].

requirements.name: GShape (within-subbasin gamma UH shape)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [1,100]. Interacts with GScale → calibrate jointly. Silently set to a single impulse (no in-grid lag) when assigned_Q or InstreamControl is active.

requirements.name: GScale (within-subbasin gamma UH scale)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [1e-2,150]; clamped to >=0.0001 to avoid divide-by-zero in gamma.cdf.

requirements.name: Velo (Saint-Venant wave celerity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0.5,55]; between-subbasin channel wave velocity.

requirements.name: Diff (Saint-Venant diffusivity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [200,4000]; controls hydrograph attenuation.

requirements.name: subbasin drainage area (Area)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Used to convert runoff depth (cm) to discharge (cms). km2 or m2 input silently mis-scales discharge.

requirements.name: subbasin latitude (Latitude)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Used by Hamon PET solar-declination term.

requirements.name: flow length between outlets (FlowLength)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Sets Lohmann travel time/attenuation. km input makes routing ~1000x too fast.

requirements.name: S0 (initial shallow saturated soil water, GWLF)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Requires 1-2 yr warm-up to equilibrate.

requirements.name: U0 (initial unsaturated soil water, GWLF)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Requires warm-up.

requirements.name: SnowS (initial snow storage)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Shared concept for GWLF and ABCD; requires warm-up.

requirements.name: XL (initial saturated/lower soil water, ABCD)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: ABCD groundwater store initial value.

requirements.name: LSM rainfall-runoff scheme selector (GWLF | ABCD | Other)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 'Other' lets the user inject pre-computed subbasin runoff.

requirements.name: simulation period (StartDate / EndDate / DataLength)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: WaterSystem in model.yaml; dates as YYYY/M/D
requirements.notes: DataLength MUST equal (EndDate-StartDate).days+1 or arrays mis-size (fatal IndexError). Hyphenated dates silently misparse.

requirements.name: routing network topology (Outlets / Routing links)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Node-link connectivity from which SimSeq routing order is derived.

requirements.name: InstreamControl flag
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: When True, in-grid UH collapses to a single impulse (no within-subbasin lag) for a reservoir-controlled outlet.

requirements.name: ABM agent rules and priority ordering
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ABM section in model.yaml + user .py modules at Path.Modules
requirements.notes: Agents execute in priority order (lower number first); dam release must precede downstream diversion or water balance is silently violated. Priorities must be unique.

requirements.name: observed streamflow
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: supplied to GA / Indicator for calibration only
requirements.notes: Not consumed by the forward simulation; used only as the calibration/evaluation target.

requirements.name: md.smb.mass balance
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex field on the mesh (or SMBcomponents: accumulation/runoff/evaporation)
requirements.notes: Prescribed surface mass balance; SMBgradients variant is in mm/yr water equivalent. Common unit trap: datasets in kg/m^2/yr or mm w.e./yr must be converted via division by rho_ice (917).

requirements.name: md.thermal.spctemperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex Dirichlet surface-temperature constraint (NaN = free node)
requirements.notes: Surface temperature boundary forcing for the thermal solve; must be in Kelvin.

requirements.name: md.basalforcings.geothermalflux
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex field (Neumann basal flux for thermal solve)
requirements.notes: Common trap: geothermal datasets in mW/m^2 are off by 1000x.

requirements.name: md.basalforcings.groundedice melting rate / floatingice melting rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Floating-ice melt enters the shelf thickness budget; can also be computed by a basal-melt parameterization (linear/quadratic/PICO/ISMIP6).

requirements.name: md.materials.rheology B
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: per-element ice-hardness field; default 1e8, typically set via paterson(T_in_K)
requirements.notes: Glen's flow-law ice hardness (B convention). Trap: Glen's fluidity A must be converted as B = A^(-1/n), not used directly. Units reduce to Pa s^(1/3) only when n=3.

requirements.name: md.materials.rheology n
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: md.materials.rho ice / rho water / rho freshwater
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: rho_ice and rho_water set flotation and hydrostatic base; using freshwater 1000 instead of seawater 1023 for marine ice sheets shifts the grounding line.

requirements.name: md.materials.heatcapacity / latentheat / thermalconductivity / meltingpoint / beta
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Clausius-Clapeyron beta sets pressure-dependence of the melting point; meltingpoint is the 1-atm pressure-melting reference.

requirements.name: md.friction.coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: law-dependent (e.g. (Pa m^-1 s)^(1/2) for the default law)
requirements.notes: MUST be 0 on floating ice (ocean_levelset < 0), else artificial drag slows shelves. Dimensional meaning depends on the configured friction law (p/q exponents).

requirements.name: md.friction.p / md.friction.q
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: md.geometry.bed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Static substrate; consumed by the flotation criterion.

requirements.name: md.geometry.surface / base / thickness
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex geometry fields; surface = base + thickness must hold
requirements.notes: Initial ice geometry; thickness evolves prognostically in transient runs. Inconsistent surface/base/thickness causes solver instability. Trap: thickness in km is off by 1000x.

requirements.name: md.initialization.vx / vy / vz
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex initial velocity (initial guess; transient flux)
requirements.notes: For transient runs, seed from a prior Stressbalance solve; zero/NaN initial velocity gives a spurious first-step jump. Trap: m/s input is off by ~3.15e7.

requirements.name: md.initialization.temperature
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Trap: Celsius input shifts by 273.15 and corrupts paterson()-derived rheology.

requirements.name: md.initialization.pressure
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex initial pressure (preferably computed from geometry)

requirements.name: md.initialization.waterfraction
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex temperate-ice liquid water fraction (enthalpy formulation)

requirements.name: domain outline / ice-front contour
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: closed .exp Argus contour polygon in projected meters (read by expread)
requirements.notes: Defines the meshed domain; Front contour sets the ice-shelf / marine boundary. Trap: degree (lat/lon) coordinates give a microscopic mesh; reproject to polar stereographic (EPSG:3031/3413).

requirements.name: mesh resolution / hmin / hmax / gradation
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Trap: resolution in km yields too-fine or too-coarse meshes.

requirements.name: md.mask.ocean levelset / ice levelset
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex signed-distance levelsets; negative = inside (ocean_levelset<0 floating, ice_levelset<0 ice present)
requirements.notes: Partitions grounded/floating and ice/no-ice. Inverted sign convention inverts the velocity pattern.

requirements.name: md.stressbalance.spcvx / spcvy
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex Dirichlet velocity constraint (NaN = free node)
requirements.notes: Use NaN, not 0, for free nodes; 0 constrains the node and creates artificial frozen interiors/divides.

requirements.name: md.flowequation (approximation choice)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: flow-equation selector: SIA / SSA / L1L2 / MOLHO / HO / FS, assigned by setflowequation()
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the momentum approximation; wrong choice for the regime degrades magnitudes (e.g. SSA on slow grounded interior).

requirements.name: md.groundingline.migration / md.masstransport.stabilization / md.thermal.isenthalpy / md.friction.coupling
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: method/scheme selectors (migration scheme; stabilization 0-5; enthalpy on/off; effective-pressure coupling 0-4)
requirements.notes: Numerical-scheme and formulation switches. Advection-dominated thermal/mass-transport equations require stabilization (artificial diffusion or SUPG).

requirements.name: md.timestepping.start time / final time / time step / time adapt / cfl coefficient
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Time step must satisfy the CFL condition dt < dx/max(vel); too-large steps make transient thickness oscillate or diverge.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives Green-Ampt infiltration and infiltration-excess runoff. Model performs NO internal unit conversion; native sources are commonly kg/m2/s, mm/3h, or m/d and must be converted to mm/d before entry (see safety.hazards).

requirements.name: temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: daily mean air temperature time series
requirements.notes: Consumed internally by the Hamon PET routine. Native sources commonly in Kelvin; model expects deg C.

requirements.name: Ks
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Green-Ampt saturated hydraulic conductivity; very high sensitivity. Typical range [1,80] mm/d. May be estimated from soil texture via pedotransfer functions.

requirements.name: psi f
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Wetting-front suction (net capillary drive analog); typical range [10,500] mm.

requirements.name: Smax
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Maximum soil-moisture storage; typical range [100,800] mm.

requirements.name: fc
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: field capacity as fraction of Smax
requirements.notes: Field capacity fraction; typical range [0.2,0.8]. Sets gravity-drainage threshold.

requirements.name: k fast
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Fast (surface) nonlinear-reservoir recession; typical range [0.01,0.5] 1/d.

requirements.name: k slow
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Slow (baseflow) linear-reservoir recession; typical range [0.001,0.05] 1/d.

requirements.name: f slow
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: fraction of runoff routed to slow reservoir
requirements.notes: Runoff split to baseflow reservoir; typical range [0.1,0.7].

requirements.name: alpha
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Nonlinear storage-discharge exponent; physical reference ~5/3 (1.667, Manning). Typical range [1.0,2.0]; low sensitivity.

requirements.name: basin area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required for mm/d-to-m3/s discharge conversion (Q_m3s = Q_mmd * area_km2 * 1e6 / 86400 / 1000).

requirements.name: latitude

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Tracked between days for continuous use; a warm-start near ~0.5*Smax with a >=1 year spinup (excluded from metrics) is required to avoid first-year transients.

requirements.name: initial reservoir storage
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: tavg (or tmin/tmax)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: tab-separated climate.txt, one row per day
requirements.notes: Must be Celsius; Kelvin is read silently as Celsius and corrupts all temperature-dependent processes. Precip must be the daily SUM of sub-daily steps.

requirements.name: prec
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: All precipitation treated as snow when air temperature < TLIMIT=0 degC.

requirements.name: grad (incoming global shortwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: lrad (incoming longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: wind
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: rh / vpd / press (humidity, vapour pressure deficit, air pressure)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: co2
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typically 280-600 ppm historical, up to ~1200 ppm future; with airchemistry endless='yes' a single row repeats for all years.

requirements.name: N deposition (nh4 dep, no3 dep)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be kgN/ha/yr; g/m2/yr is a factor-of-10 silent inflation of the N budget.

requirements.name: texture fractions (clay, sand, silt)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Layer-specific soil type assigned only if clay+sand+silt sums to ~1.0; otherwise a profile-wide soil type is used.

requirements.name: bulk density (bd)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Valid 0.5-2.0; zero/negative bd drives negative porosity (1 - bd/2.65) and segfaults. Must represent stone-free bulk soil.

requirements.name: soil organic carbon content (corg)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Mass fraction (0.005-0.05 mineral soils), NOT percent; falls back to humus-type/CN-ratio defaults when omitted. Initializes the soil C pool.

requirements.name: soil organic nitrogen content (norg)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: stone/gravel fraction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Handled internally; soil inputs must be the stone-free bulk soil.

requirements.name: saturated hydraulic conductivity (sks)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: LDNDC unit is cm/min; mm/hr or m/day left unconverted gives ~600x too-fast drainage.

requirements.name: pH
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Valid 3.0-10.0; modulates nitrification.

requirements.name: crop/vegetation species coefficients
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: parameters_species.xml leaf-node entries (e.g. tbase, topt, gdd_maturity, maxlai, cn_leaf, rootdepth, harvest_index)
requirements.notes: Species name must EXACTLY (case-sensitive) match a runnable leaf node; abstract bases like RICE are silent no-ops. Must come from the same distribution as the binary.

requirements.name: site/soil/global biogeochemical defaults (Lresources)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.notes: Override precedence: compiled defaults < parameters/*.xml < project site.xml.

requirements.notes: Sets the starting humus/microbial/litter C pools.

shared_requirements.notes: Must be kgN/ha/yr; g/m2/yr is a factor-of-10 silent inflation of the N budget.

shared_requirements.name: texture fractions (clay, sand, silt)
shared_requirements.notes: Layer-specific soil type assigned only if clay+sand+silt sums to ~1.0; otherwise a profile-wide soil type is used.

shared_requirements.name: bulk density (bd)
shared_requirements.notes: Valid 0.5-2.0; zero/negative bd drives negative porosity (1 - bd/2.65) and segfaults. Must represent stone-free bulk soil.

shared_requirements.name: soil organic carbon content (corg)
shared_requirements.notes: Mass fraction (0.005-0.05 mineral soils), NOT percent; falls back to humus-type/CN-ratio defaults when omitted. Initializes the soil C pool.

shared_requirements.name: stone/gravel fraction
shared_requirements.notes: Handled internally; soil inputs must be the stone-free bulk soil.

shared_requirements.name: saturated hydraulic conductivity (sks)
shared_requirements.notes: LDNDC unit is cm/min; mm/hr or m/day left unconverted gives ~600x too-fast drainage.

shared_requirements.name: pH
shared_requirements.notes: Valid 3.0-10.0; modulates nitrification.

shared_requirements.name: crop/vegetation species coefficients
shared_requirements.notes: Species name must EXACTLY (case-sensitive) match a runnable leaf node; abstract bases like RICE are silent no-ops. Must come from the same distribution as the binary.

shared_requirements.name: site/soil/global biogeochemical defaults (Lresources)
shared_requirements.notes: Override precedence: compiled defaults < parameters/*.xml < project site.xml.

shared_requirements.name: initial soil organic C pools
shared_requirements.notes: Sets the starting humus/microbial/litter C pools.

shared_requirements.name: initial soil organic and mineral N pools
shared_requirements.notes: Sets starting NH4/NO3/organic-N pools.

shared_requirements.name: initial per-layer soil water and groundwater state
simulation schedule and site geometry (lat, lon, time span)
shared_requirements.notes: Management/event dates must fall within the schedule (out-of-range is fatal).

shared_requirements.name: MoBiLE modulelist (ecosystem + process kernel choice)
shared_requirements.notes: Case-sensitive, version-dependent; kernel stack must match ecosystem type (dryland metrx stack vs paddy stack).

shared_requirements.name: tillage events
shared_requirements.notes: Depth in METERS (0.25 = 25 cm); cm values silently mean tens of metres.

shared_requirements.name: flood / drain events
shared_requirements.notes: Required to establish the ponded water layer for paddy/flooded rice; absence yields no CH4 and an unrealistic water balance.

shared_requirements.name: output sink configuration
shared_requirements.notes: At least one output module must be declared or no output is written (silent).

requirements.name: Precipitation (pr / P)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (PrecipitationMaps)
requirements.notes: Total liquid+solid precipitation; PrScaling converts from input unit to mm/timestep; negative values clipped to 0. Unit confusion (m/day, mm/3hr) is silent and shifts discharge ~1000x.

requirements.name: Average air temperature (ta / T avg)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (TavgMaps)
requirements.notes: Drives rain/snow partitioning and frost index; the TemperatureInKelvin flag must match the input units or snow thresholds shift by 273.15.

requirements.name: Reference (potential) evapotranspiration (et0 / ET0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (ET0Maps); preparable with LISVAP
requirements.notes: Must be POTENTIAL ET; LISFLOOD reduces it internally via soil-moisture stress. Supplying actual ET silently double-reduces evaporation.

requirements.name: Potential open-water evaporation (e0 / EW0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (E0Maps); preparable with LISVAP
requirements.notes: Penman open-water rate (~1.05 × et0); a distinct required input.

requirements.name: Potential bare-soil evaporation (ES0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series; preparable with LISVAP
requirements.notes: Potential evaporation from bare soil; reduced internally by soil-moisture availability.

requirements.name: Local Drainage Direction (Ldd)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: MUST be PCRaster encoding, NOT ArcGIS D8 (1,2,4,…,128); wrong encoding crashes or misroutes flow.

requirements.name: Channel geometry (ChanBottomWidth, ChanGrad, ChanLength, ChanManMaps, side slope, bankfull depth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: ChanGrad in m/m (not %), ChanLength in m (not km), ChanManMaps is Manning's n modified by the CalChanMan multiplier.

requirements.name: Elevation and elevation standard deviation (Elevation, elvstd)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Elevation StD drives sub-pixel 3-zone snow partitioning (DeltaTSnow).

requirements.name: Saturated hydraulic conductivity per layer (MapKSat1/2/3 +Forest)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: mm/day, NOT cm/day (HWSD) or m/s (SoilGrids).

requirements.name: Van Genuchten alpha per layer (MapGenuAlpha1/2/3 +Forest)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: 1/cm, NOT 1/m; 100x error shifts the water-retention curve.

requirements.name: Van Genuchten pore-size index Lambda per layer (MapLambda1/2/3 +Forest)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Saturated and residual water content per layer (MapThetaSat / MapThetaRes 1/2/3 +Forest)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: ThetaRes typically ~0.01; ThetaSat is porosity.

requirements.name: Soil layer depths (SoilDepth1/2/3)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: mm, NOT m or cm; SoilDepth1 ~50-300 mm, SoilDepth2/3 ~300-1500 mm.

requirements.name: Land-use fraction maps (Forest / Sealed-impervious / Water / Irrigation / Other)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per-class ET and fluxes are area-weighted by these fractions.

requirements.name: Leaf Area Index (LAI) per land-use class
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PCRaster / NetCDF maps + day-of-year lookup table
requirements.notes: Drives canopy interception and transpiration.

requirements.name: Lake / reservoir property tables (TabLakeArea, TabTotStorage, outflow parameters)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Tab-separated text lookup tables keyed by water-body ID
requirements.notes: Every lake/reservoir ID in the spatial map must have an entry in all Tab* tables or routing produces NaN.

requirements.name: UpperZoneTimeConstant
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Quick groundwater (upper-zone) residence time; HIGH-sensitivity calibration parameter.

requirements.name: LowerZoneTimeConstant
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Lower-zone baseflow recession time constant; HIGH-sensitivity calibration parameter.

requirements.name: b Xinanjiang
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Saturation-excess runoff shape; HIGH-sensitivity. Near-0 gives a flashy, no-baseflow hydrograph.

requirements.name: PowerPrefFlow
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Preferential (bypass) flow nonlinearity.

requirements.name: CalChanMan
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on ChanManMaps Manning's n — NOT a raw n value; setting it to 0.03-0.05 gives near-zero effective roughness.

requirements.name: SnowMeltCoef
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Degree-day snowmelt rate; matters in snow-influenced basins.

requirements.name: GwPercValue
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Maximum upper-zone → lower-zone percolation.

requirements.name: GwLoss
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Groundwater loss to a deep aquifer; if it exceeds percolation, baseflow depletes.

requirements.name: LZThreshold
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Lower-zone no-outflow (baseflow cutoff) threshold.

requirements.name: LakeMultiplier
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Lake outflow scaling; matters in lake basins.

requirements.name: Soil moisture per layer (ThetaInit1/2/3Value → theta1/2/3)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: settings XML *InitValue or warm-start EndMaps NetCDF

requirements.name: Upper-zone groundwater storage (UZInitValue → uz)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: settings XML *InitValue or warm-start EndMaps NetCDF

requirements.name: Lower-zone groundwater storage (LZInitValue → lz)

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: settings XML *InitValue or warm-start EndMaps NetCDF

requirements.name: initial topography / DEM (topographic  elevation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: node field topographic__elevation on the model grid (read from gridded elevation; must be projected to a metric CRS)
requirements.notes: Bottom-to-top node ordering; NoData must be masked and set to a closed boundary; elevation in meters (feet inflates slopes ~3.28x).

requirements.name: rainfall / runoff (water  unit flux in)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: node field water__unit_flux_in consumed by FlowAccumulator (scalar or time series)
requirements.notes: Must be m/s; mm/hr or mm/day inflate discharge by ~3.6e6x. For landscape-evolution runs commonly a uniform runoff_rate.

requirements.name: K sp (stream-power erodibility)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: StreamPowerEroder coefficient in E = K A^m S^n
requirements.notes: Units depend on m_sp,n_sp; a K calibrated for one exponent set is dimensionally invalid for another. Default 0.001 is dimensionally ambiguous and application-specific.

requirements.name: m sp (drainage-area exponent)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: StreamPowerEroder area exponent in E = K A^m S^n
requirements.notes: Typical 0.3-0.7; m_sp/n_sp ratio sets steady-state concavity (theta = m/n). Default 0.5.

requirements.name: n sp (slope exponent)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: StreamPowerEroder slope exponent in E = K A^m S^n
requirements.notes: Typical 0.7-2.0. Default 1.0.

requirements.name: linear diffusivity (D)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: LinearDiffuser hillslope transport coefficient q = -D grad(z)
requirements.notes: Must share time units with dt; literature m^2/s values need conversion. Default 0.01.

requirements.name: v s (effective settling velocity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: ErosionDeposition/SPACE deposition term controlling transport-vs-detachment regime
requirements.notes: Sets deposition length scale; b->0.5 (detachment-limited) at high v_s, b->1.0 (transport-limited) at low v_s. Default 1.0.

requirements.name: K sed / K br (SPACE alluvium / bedrock erodibility)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Bedrock vs alluvium erodibility in the SPACE bedrock-alluvium law.

requirements.name: H star (alluvial cover decay depth)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets how alluvial thickness shields bedrock from erosion.

requirements.name: soil production maximum rate (P0)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: ExponentialWeatherer maximum production in P = P0 exp(-H/H*)

requirements.name: soil production decay depth (H*)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: mannings n (overland-flow roughness)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Manning n (0.01-0.1), NOT Chezy C; confusing the two inverts/rescales velocity. Default 0.03.

requirements.name: soil  depth (initial regolith thickness)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: node field soil__depth at simulation start
requirements.notes: Must be meters (HWSD cm read as m collapses weathering and SPACE). For SPACE concavity tests initialize > 0 (e.g. 2 m) or SPACE falls back to bedrock-only mode.

requirements.name: bedrock  elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: SPACE/ErosionDeposition auto-create this if absent and maintain the topo = bedrock + soil invariant.

requirements.name: grid type and geometry
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: grid class (RasterModelGrid/HexModelGrid/VoronoiDelaunayGrid/NetworkModelGrid/IcosphereGlobalGrid) with shape and xy_spacing in meters
requirements.notes: xy_spacing must be meters; degrees (unreprojected WGS84) inflate slopes ~1e5x.

requirements.name: timestep dt
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: dt argument to each component's run_one_step(dt)
requirements.notes: Must share time units with all rate parameters; mismatch (s vs yr) rescales all rates by ~3.15e7.

requirements.name: boundary-node status (status at node)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-node BC: CORE / FIXED_VALUE / FIXED_GRADIENT / LOOPED / CLOSED, set before component instantiation
requirements.notes: At least one open (FIXED_VALUE) outlet required or drainage_area=0. closed_all_but_outlet for watershed sediment-yield; open_all for DEM slope-area clips.

requirements.name: uplift rate (tectonic forcing)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: applied in the user time loop as z[core_nodes] += uplift_rate * dt before flow routing
requirements.notes: Only core nodes uplifted; never fixed-value boundary nodes.

requirements.name: runoff rate (steady-state discharge scaling)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: FlowAccumulator multiplier: steady-state Q = drainage_area * runoff_rate
requirements.notes: Must be consistent with the basin (e.g. Q_mean*3.156e7/(A_basin*1e6)) or SPACE SSC-Q rating curves are wrong.

requirements.name: flow-routing / depression-handling method

requirements.model_input_format: FlowAccumulator flow_director choice (D8/Dinf/MFD) and optional depression_finder (DepressionFinderAndRouter / PriorityFloodFlowRouter)
requirements.notes: Depression routing is not automatic; real DEMs need it or flow stalls at pits.

packages.name: Lohmann_Routing

requirements.name: surface runoff
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Per-cell daily VIC flux ASCII file (7-column: year month day prec evap runoff baseflow); only column 6 (runoff) is read
requirements.notes: Valid model range 0-500 mm/day. Read in MAKE_CONVOLUTION; converted to m3/s via FACTOR = fraction*area/86400 then *1/1000 (mm->m). Feeding raw 22-column VIC flux files reads the wrong column and yields extreme/negative discharge.

requirements.name: baseflow
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Per-cell daily VIC flux ASCII file; column 7 (baseflow) is read
requirements.notes: Valid model range 0-100 mm/day. Summed with surface_runoff inside the routing module to give total per-cell channel inflow.

requirements.name: velocity (channel wave celerity C)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Scalar default 1.5 m/s (INIT_ARRAY when rout_global flag is .false.) or per-cell ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header
requirements.notes: Most-calibrated channel parameter. Documented ranges 1-3 m/s (Weser), 0.5-2.0 m/s (Columbia). Used in MAKE_UHM (Lohmann eq.15). Model-side valid range 0.5-5.0 m/s.

requirements.name: diffusion (channel diffusivity D)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Scalar default 800 m2/s (INIT_ARRAY) or per-cell ArcInfo ASCII grid
requirements.notes: Controls hydrograph spreading/attenuation. Documented range 200-4000 m2/s (Weser). Used in MAKE_UHM impulse-response denominator.

requirements.name: unit hydrograph (within-cell box UH)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: ASCII UH file; exactly KE=12 daily ordinates (index 0-11 + weight), weights summing to 1.0
requirements.notes: Within-cell hillslope impulse response. Must be exactly 12 lines or the Fortran READ fails with 'End of file'.

requirements.name: flow direction (D8 network)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header; READ_DIREC decodes SEQUENTIAL codes 1-8 (1=E,2=NE,3=N,4=NW,5=W,6=SW,7=S,8=SE on the left-right-flipped internal grid)
requirements.notes: Defines the drainage network connecting cells to the outlet. The model's sequential 1-8 decoding differs from the ArcGIS power-of-two convention some docs/prep scripts assume; mismatched codes silently misroute.

requirements.name: fraction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header; 0-1 fraction of cell draining to gauge
requirements.notes: Enters FACTOR = fraction*area/86400, so it scales discharge magnitude. Supplying km2 area instead of a 0-1 fraction inflates discharge by orders of magnitude.

requirements.name: xmask (flow distance)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header; per-cell channel/flow length in metres (cell-size*cos(lat) for irregular grids)
requirements.notes: Flow-distance numerator in the cell impulse response (MAKE_UHM).

requirements.name: cached source-to-outlet unit hydrograph (.uh s)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: Per-station <NAME5>.uh_s cache; supplied via staloc line 2 path, or recomputed when that line is 'NONE'
requirements.notes: Precomputed per-station impulse response. A stale cache from a prior basin (5-char NAME5 collision) corrupts peak timing; STATUS='NEW' open fails if the file already exists.

requirements.name: station/outlet location (staloc)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ASCII; line 1 = '1 NAME column row AREA'; line 2 = UH_STRING ('NONE' to recompute UH_S, else a .uh_s cache path). Both lines mandatory.
requirements.notes: Selects which grid cells produce output discharge. Missing line 2 crashes 'ERROR reading station file'.

requirements.name: simulation and output write windows (rout global.txt date block)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: rout_global.txt START/STOP and FIRST/LAST year-month fields
requirements.notes: First row's year/month of each per-cell VIC flux file must match START_YEAR/START_MO or MAKE_CONVOLUTION STOPs.

packages.name: MARRMoT

requirements.name: Precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: input_climate column 1 of the [P, Ep, T] climate array (mm per time step)
requirements.notes: Consumed each timestep. Model performs no unit check; common source units (mm/3h, kg/m2/s, m/d) silently produce wrong runoff if not pre-converted to mm/d.

requirements.name: Potential evapotranspiration (Ep)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: input_climate column 2 of the [P, Ep, T] climate array (mm per time step)
requirements.notes: Must be pre-computed externally (Hargreaves / Penman-Monteith). The model does NOT derive Ep from radiation; passing net radiation as Ep causes Ea>P and store drainage.

requirements.name: Temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: input_climate column 3 of the [P, Ep, T] climate array (mean daily deg C)
requirements.notes: Required by snow-capable structures for rain/snow partitioning; optional otherwise. Kelvin or Fahrenheit values silently break snow partitioning and degree-day melt.

requirements.name: theta (model parameter vector)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: numeric vector of length model.numParams (1 to ~23 depending on structure); bounds defined per structure in the parRanges property
requirements.notes: Structure-specific. Standardized literature-based parameter ranges are provided across all 47 structures to make cross-structure calibration and sensitivity comparable.

requirements.name: Maximum soil/production store capacity (Smax; e.g. GR4J x1, HYMOD Cmax)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Unit-hydrograph time base (e.g. GR4J x4, HBV maxbas)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Areal recharge (RCH RATE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: RCH package; array-based applied to highest active cell per column, or list-based per cellid
requirements.notes: A RATE in LENGTH/TIME, NOT a volume. Primary inflow driving head/water-table elevation. List-based cellid with layer>0 silently injects recharge into a deep layer and leaves the water table unresponsive.

requirements.name: Evapotranspiration demand (EVT)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: EVT package (surface elevation, max rate, extinction depth)
requirements.notes: Optional head-dependent sink representing ET withdrawal from the saturated zone.

requirements.name: Hydraulic conductivity tensor (K11/K22/K33)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: NPF package; K (horizontal), K33 (vertical), optional angle1/2/3 rotation
requirements.notes: Material-dependent (gravel 100-1000 to clay 1e-4..0.01 m/day); K33/K typically ~0.1 for layered sediments. NPF stores a pristine copy (k11input) so TVK/VSC can recompute working K each step.

requirements.name: Cell type (ICELLTYPE)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: NPF package; 0=confined (full thickness), 1=convertible (saturated thickness varies with head)

requirements.name: Specific storage (Ss)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Confined transient storage term.

requirements.name: Specific yield (Sy)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Water-table drainable porosity, 0.01-0.35 for natural materials (>0.5 physically impossible).

requirements.name: Grid geometry (TOP/BOTM, DELR/DELC)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: DIS/DISV/DISU package; TOP (2-D), BOTM (3-D), DELR/DELC cell spacing
requirements.notes: BOTM must be monotonically decreasing; zero-thickness layers (TOP==BOTM) produce NaN heads.

requirements.name: Active-domain mask (IDOMAIN)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: GWT dispersivity (ALH/ATH1/ATV) and diffusion
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: DSP package; ALH longitudinal (~L/10), ATH1 transverse (~ALH/10), ATV vertical (~ALH/100), diffc

requirements.name: GWT mobile-storage / sorption / decay (porosity, bulk density, distcoef, decay)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: porosity [-]; rho_b kg/L; Kd L/kg; lambda 1/day

requirements.name: SFR reach geometry and roughness (rlen, rwid, rgrd, rtp, rbth, rhk, man)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: rgrd must be > 0; rtp - rbth must lie above the cell BOTM.

requirements.name: Starting hydraulic head (STRT)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be >= BOTM and within layer bounds, else cells start dry and may never rewet. Also seeds NPF saturated-thickness initialization (THICKSTRT), not only the head vector.

requirements.name: Initial solute concentration
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Constant head (CHD)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CHD package; (cellid, head) — acts as infinite source/sink

requirements.name: Well pumping/injection (WEL)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: WEL package; volumetric rate, negative=pumping, positive=injection

requirements.name: Drain (DRN)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: DRN package; (cellid, elevation, conductance) — removes water when head > elevation

requirements.name: River (RIV)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: stage m; conductance m2/day; rbot m
requirements.model_input_format: RIV package; (cellid, stage, conductance, rbot) — rbot must be > cell BOTM and < stage

requirements.name: General head boundary (GHB)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Temporal discretization (TDIS)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: TDIS package; TIME_UNITS, NPER stress periods, PERLEN, NSTP, TSMULT
requirements.notes: Per-period boundary conditions held constant; steady-state vs transient set per period via the STO iss flag.

requirements.name: Solver configuration (IMS complexity preset)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: IMS package; COMPLEXITY SIMPLE/MODERATE/COMPLEX selecting linear method (CG vs BICGSTAB), under-relaxation, backtracking, DVCLOSE/RCLOSE
requirements.notes: Structural switch. SIMPLE/CG fails on the asymmetric matrix produced by Newton or convertible layers; GWT must use BICGSTAB. Default SIMPLE preset: DVCLOSE=1e-3, MXITER=25, no under-relaxation.

requirements.name: Newton-Raphson formulation switch (NEWTON UNDER RELAXATION)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch enabling stable drying/rewetting of unconfined cells; requires MODERATE/COMPLEX solver.

requirements.name: Output control (OC) save/print settings
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required to write .hds/.cbc spatial output; without it mf6 runs but emits no spatial output.

requirements.name: Q2D (specific humidity at reference height)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Specific humidity, NOT relative humidity; typical 0.001-0.025, physical ceiling ~0.04.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: V2D (meridional wind component)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: PSFC (surface pressure)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Sets air density P/(R*T); scales all turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: LWDOWN (downward longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: SWDOWN (downward shortwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Model does not internally clip to >=0; negative interpolation artifacts act as an energy sink.

requirements.name: RAINRATE (precipitation rate)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Internally partitioned into rain/snow (OPT_SNF); rate units are mm/s, not mm/hr.

requirements.name: SMCMAX (porosity / saturated soil moisture)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per soil-texture class; must satisfy SMCMAX > SMCREF > SMCWLT > 0.

requirements.name: DKSAT (saturated hydraulic conductivity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Controls infiltration vs runoff partitioning; ~1e-7..1e-4 m/s.

requirements.name: BEXP (Clapp-Hornberger pore-size exponent)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: SMCWLT (wilting point)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: MFSNO (snowmelt curve parameter)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: VCMX25 (max carboxylation rate at 25C)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: CWPVT (canopy wind extinction parameter)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: ISLTYP (soil-type index)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: STATSGO/STAS texture; selects the soil-parameter row; 14=Water cells skipped, 15=Bedrock.

requirements.name: IVGTYP (vegetation-type index)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: VEGFRA (green vegetation fraction)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Percent, not 0-1 fraction; driver only divides by 100 when max>1.

requirements.name: TMN/TBOT (deep-soil annual-mean temperature, lower BC)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

packages.name: OGGM

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: monthly mean temperature time series at the glacier; downscaled to elevation bands with a fixed lapse rate
requirements.notes: Baseline datasets W5E5 (default, calibration tuned against it), GSWP3, CRU TS4, ERA5. Default temperature lapse rate -6.5 K/km (cfg.PARAMS temp_default_gradient = -0.0065 K/m). CMIP6/ISIMIP3b raw fields may be delivered in Kelvin and must be converted to degC before use.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: monthly total precipitation at the glacier; no precipitation gradient applied by default, scaled by the precipitation factor
requirements.notes: Solid/liquid partition by temp_all_solid (default 0 degC) and temp_all_liq (default 2 degC), linearly interpolated.

requirements.name: melt f (degree-day / temperature-sensitivity melt factor; legacy mu star)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: per-glacier calibrated coefficient stored after mass-balance calibration
requirements.notes: v1.6 MonthlyTIModel uses melt_f; the v1.1-era equivalent is mu_star (typical 50-600, can reach 0-1000). Pinning at a bound signals climate mismatch.

requirements.name: prcp fac (precipitation correction factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: multiplicative factor applied to climate precipitation
requirements.notes: Default ~2.5; typical 0.5-5.0, higher (2-4) for high-altitude Himalaya/Karakoram due to gauge undercatch.

requirements.name: temp bias (temperature bias adjustment)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical -3 to +3 degC, compensates systematic climate biases.

requirements.name: T Melt (melt threshold temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: monthly mean air temperature threshold above which melt occurs
requirements.notes: Default -1 degC.

requirements.name: Glen creep parameter A (f d = 2A/(n+2), n=3)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: deformation parameter for the shallow-ice flow law
requirements.notes: Default ~2.4e-24; calibrated against the Farinotti 2019 consensus volume in OGGM v1.4+.

requirements.name: f s (basal sliding parameter)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: basal sliding coefficient in the velocity law
requirements.notes: Free parameter, zero by default (often ignored initially).

requirements.name: glacier outlines (RGI)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: RGI shapefile polygons (RGIId, GLIMSId, Area, Zmin/Zmax/Zmed, Aspect, TermType, Surging, Form); RGI v6.0 default, v7.0 partial

requirements.name: digital elevation model (DEM)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: raster GeoTIFF clipped to glacier extent plus border
requirements.notes: SRTM (60S-60N, default), COPDEM (global), NASADEM, AW3D30, DEM3, RAMP. Use COPDEM above 60N where SRTM has voids.

requirements.name: spun-up glacier geometry
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: flowline ice-thickness / surface geometry produced by dynamic spinup that evolves forward to match the RGI inventory date
requirements.notes: Spinup default on; if it fails (surging/calving/DEM-outline errors or short history) the run starts from the RGI-date geometry with an initial shock.

requirements.name: inverted bed topography and initial ice thickness
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: bed_h and section thickness from the mass-conservation bed inversion

requirements.name: geodetic mass-balance reference (Hugonnet et al. 2021)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-glacier 2000-2020 geodetic MB rate used as the calibration target for melt_f/prcp_fac/temp_bias
requirements.notes: ~1-3% of RGI glaciers lack geodetic MB; regional means or parameter transfer used as fallback. Per-glacier uncertainty ~200-500 mm w.e./yr — avoid overfitting.

requirements.name: Farinotti 2019 consensus ice thickness

requirements.model_input_format: consensus thickness/volume used to calibrate the inversion creep parameter A

packages.name: OpenFOAM

requirements.name: Inlet velocity
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Volumetric discharge Q (m^3/s) is imposed as U = Q/A_inlet at the inlet patch; OpenFOAM consumes velocity, not discharge.

requirements.name: Outlet / reference pressure
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Incompressible solvers operate on kinematic pressure p/rho, NOT Pa; a dynamic-pressure (Pa) field crashes at startup with a dimension mismatch.

requirements.name: nu (kinematic viscosity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Kinematic nu = mu/rho, NOT dynamic mu [Pa.s]; water 20C ~1.004e-6, air 20C ~1.516e-5, seawater 15C ~1.19e-6. Sets the Reynolds number / flow regime.

requirements.name: sigma (surface tension)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Water-air at 20C = 0.072 N/m. dev incompressibleVoF expects a scalar sigma in phaseProperties (not the legacy ((air water) 0.07) syntax).

requirements.name: k-epsilon closure constants (Cmu, C1, C2, sigmak, sigmaEps)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: momentumTransport coeffDict (overridable; baked defaults Cmu=0.09, C1=1.44, C2=1.92, sigmak=1.0, sigmaEps=1.3)
requirements.notes: Hardcoded constructor defaults in the kEpsilon model; overridable but undocumented in the wrapper layer.

requirements.name: Initial velocity / pressure fields
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Vector fields require vector syntax 'uniform (0 0 0)'; a scalar 'uniform 0' for U is a fatal parse error.

requirements.name: Initial turbulence fields (k, epsilon, omega)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be non-zero/physical: k = 1.5*(U_ref*TI)^2 with TI 0.01-0.10; epsilon = Cmu^0.75*k^1.5/l; omega = k^0.5/(Cmu^0.25*l). Zero values make the closure equations singular.

requirements.name: Initial phase fraction alpha.water and hydrostatic p rgh
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: alpha.water=1 is water, 0 is air; uniform-0 init gives an all-air domain. p_rgh must be initialised to per-phase hydrostatic values aligned with the free surface, else a large interface imbalance drives spurious velocity spikes.

requirements.name: Computational mesh (polyMesh)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: blockMeshDict convertToMeters scales ALL vertices; a wrong value silently rescales the domain (e.g. 1000x) and every derived Re / pressure. Patch names must exactly match field-file patches.

requirements.name: Boundary-condition patch types
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: 0/<field> patch entries (fixedValue, zeroGradient, inletOutlet, noSlip, slip, empty, symmetry, wedge, cyclic, fixedFluxPressure)
requirements.notes: empty for 1D/2D (faces normal to ignored direction), wedge for axisymmetric, symmetryPlane only on a perfectly planar patch; cyclic requires matching face areas.

requirements.name: g (gravity)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must point downward in mesh coordinates: (0 -9.81 0) Y-up or (0 0 -9.81) Z-up; wrong sign/axis silently reverses buoyancy.

requirements.name: Discretisation schemes (fvSchemes)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects temporal order (Euler/backward/CrankNicolson), convection scheme (upwind/linearUpwind/QUICK/vanLeer) and non-orthogonal correction; controls numerical diffusion and stability. dev VoF compression set here via interfaceCompression (cAlpha removed).

requirements.name: Linear solvers and algorithm controls (fvSolution)

requirements.model_input_format: system/fvSolution (GAMG for p, smoothSolver for U/k/eps; PIMPLE nOuterCorrectors/nCorrectors/nNonOrthogonalCorrectors/residualControl/relaxationFactors)
requirements.notes: nOuterCorrectors=1 is PISO, >1 is PIMPLE; SIMPLE uses relaxation <1 for steady pseudo-time.

requirements.name: Run controls (controlDict)

requirements.model_input_format: system/controlDict (startTime/endTime, deltaT, adjustTimeStep, maxCo, writeControl, writeInterval, purgeWrite)

requirements.name: Recharge / infiltration flux (top boundary)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: FLOW_CONDITION LIQUID_FLUX NEUMANN; time-varying via FILE or RATE LIST
requirements.notes: recharge = precipitation * infiltration_fraction - ET; native unit m/s. Inline unit keyword (e.g. 'mm/yr') accepted and converted; bare numbers are interpreted as m/s.

requirements.name: Root-zone evapotranspiration sink
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Applied as a distributed volumetric sink over the root zone (negative = extraction), not as a negative top Neumann BC, to avoid single-cell depletion. Sign convention: extraction MUST be negative.

requirements.name: River / lake stage (head boundary)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: P = rho*g*(stage - z_cell) + P_atm; time-varying river stage imposed as a pressure (Dirichlet) lateral boundary.

requirements.name: Well pumping / injection rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Intrinsic permeability (PERM ISO)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Native basis is intrinsic permeability in m^2 (1e-20 to 1e-8), NOT hydraulic conductivity. Highest calibration priority; controls flow magnitude. Tensor (X/Y/Z) supported.

requirements.name: Porosity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Storage and transport-velocity control; 0.01-0.60. Must be a fraction, not percent.

requirements.name: Tortuosity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Longitudinal dispersivity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Capillary curve scale; native unit 1/Pa (1e-7 to 1e-3), NOT 1/cm. alpha_Pa = alpha_cm / 9804.139.

requirements.name: air temp
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series (monthly or finer); near-surface air temperature consumed by the PDD/temperature-index surface model
requirements.notes: Distinct from ice_surface_temp used by the 'surface given' mode; supplying the wrong one for the chosen surface model is a silent error. degC accepted ONLY if the units attribute is set correctly, else +273.15 must be applied.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series; total precipitation, phase split by air temperature (>2C rain, <0C snow) in the PDD scheme
requirements.notes: Manual/source canonical flux unit is kg m-2 s-1; the bootstrap/per-year convenience unit kg m-2 year-1 is also accepted via UDUNITS. m w.e. year-1 is a fatal 1000x trap.

requirements.name: air temp sd
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF; standard deviation of daily temperature variation used by the PDD scheme

requirements.name: theta ocean
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series; potential temperature on the continental shelf (PICO ocean model input)
requirements.notes: PICO expects degC, not kelvin; supplying kelvin is a silent trap.

requirements.name: salinity ocean
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series; shelf salinity (PICO ocean model input)

requirements.name: delta SL
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar time series; sea-level offset relative to present

requirements.name: delta T
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar paleo time series; relative temperature anomaly applied to the surface forcing
requirements.notes: An anomaly: degC and K are equivalent here; adding 273.15 double-converts (silent ~273 K offset).

requirements.name: frac P / delta P
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar time series; multiplicative or additive precipitation scaling

requirements.name: SIA enhancement factor (stress balance.sia.enhancement factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Model's own default is E=1.0 (pism_config.cdl). Multiplies internal shear deformation; the single strongest control on ice volume and a primary control on flow speed.

requirements.name: SSA enhancement factor (stress balance.ssa.enhancement factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Scales membrane (shelf/stream) flow.

requirements.name: pseudo-plastic sliding exponent q (basal resistance.pseudo plastic.q)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: till friction angle parameterization (topg to phi)

requirements.model_input_format: config option (-topg_to_phi phi_min,phi_max,topg_min,topg_max); maps bed elevation to till friction angle
requirements.notes: Low bed elevation -> low friction angle -> weak till -> fast sliding.

requirements.name: PDD factor for ice (surface.pdd.factor ice)

shared_requirements.name: precipitation
shared_requirements.notes: Manual/source canonical flux unit is kg m-2 s-1; the bootstrap/per-year convenience unit kg m-2 year-1 is also accepted via UDUNITS. m w.e. year-1 is a fatal 1000x trap.

shared_requirements.notes: PICO expects degC, not kelvin; supplying kelvin is a silent trap.

shared_requirements.name: delta_T
shared_requirements.notes: An anomaly: degC and K are equivalent here; adding 273.15 double-converts (silent ~273 K offset).

shared_requirements.name: SIA enhancement factor (stress_balance.sia.enhancement_factor)

shared_requirements.name: SSA enhancement factor (stress_balance.ssa.enhancement_factor)
shared_requirements.notes: Scales membrane (shelf/stream) flow.

shared_requirements.name: pseudo-plastic sliding exponent q (basal_resistance.pseudo_plastic.q)
shared_requirements.notes: q=0 is purely plastic, q=1 is linear-viscous. With q=0 and no till friction parameterization, basal yield stress can collapse to zero (infinite sliding).

shared_requirements.name: till friction angle parameterization (topg_to_phi)
shared_requirements.notes: Low bed elevation -> low friction angle -> weak till -> fast sliding.

requirements.name: permeability / saturated conductivity K (perm x/y/z, anisotropic)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PFB field per cell (ProblemData permeability tensor)
requirements.notes: Unit is m/hr in ParFlow (not m/day MODFLOW, not m/s SI). Use physical matrix Ksat from soil texture, not VIC-calibrated Ksat (includes macropores, 100-500x too high).

requirements.name: porosity (phi)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 0.2-0.6.

requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Unit is 1/m (not 1/cm as in Rosetta/Carsel-Parrish; factor 100). Typical 0.5 (clay) to 15 (sand).

requirements.name: van Genuchten n
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives BOTH the saturation curve and the relative-permeability curve. m is derived as m=1-1/n (Mualem); user cannot set m independently. Typical 1.05-4.0.

requirements.name: specific storage Ss
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Elastic storage in saturated zone; typical 1e-5 to 1e-3.

requirements.name: Kz/Kx anisotropy ratio
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Vertical-to-horizontal conductivity ratio; typical 0.01-1.0 (default ~0.1).

requirements.name: Manning's roughness n
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 0.01 (urban) to 0.4 (dense forest); values < 0.01 cause CFL instability.

requirements.name: slope x, slope y (terrain slopes)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: PFB slope fields (TSlopeX/TSlopeY), derived from sink-filled DEM
requirements.notes: Sign convention: positive slope in positive coordinate direction. Min slope ~0.0001 in flat terrain.

requirements.name: CLM vegetation maps (IGBP type, LAI/SAI/z0 per PFT)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only. All-barren/water (type 16/17) gives zero ET.

requirements.name: initial pressure-head field
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: constant, hydrostatic from water-table depth, or PFB file (e.g. global WTD / MODFLOW steady state)
requirements.notes: Negative = unsaturated suction, positive = saturated, zero = water table. Spinup of 10-100 yr (or less if seeded from steady state) needed to equilibrate; equilibrium when inter-annual water-balance residual < 1% of precipitation. HydroStaticPatch with bottom RefPatch sets pressure at the BOTTOM (surface = Value - total_depth).

requirements.name: domain mask / indicator field
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Defines basin extent.

requirements.name: Overland flow boundary condition (top patch)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Always present at the top; couples surface and subsurface via pressure continuity. Selecting the kinematic vs diffusive overland scheme is set through the top-patch BC TYPE, not a standalone Solver boolean.

requirements.name: lateral/bottom boundary conditions
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: FluxConst / DirEquilRefPatch / PressureConst / Dirichlet / Neumann per patch
requirements.notes: Bottom no-flow by default; sides no-flow by default. At least one outflow boundary (e.g. DirEquilRefPatch seepage face) required, otherwise the domain is a closed box with no drainage.

requirements.name: Solver mode selection (Richards vs Impes vs Diffusion)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Defaults to Impes (two-phase) if omitted; integrated surface-subsurface hydrology requires Solver=Richards. CLM coupling requires Solver=Richards plus Solver.LSM=CLM (compiled --with-clm; defaults to NOT calling CLM).

requirements.name: terrain-following grid + variable-dz (dz mult / nzList)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: With TerrainFollowingGrid=True, dz values are FRACTIONS of total depth summing to 1.0, not absolute thicknesses. dz_mult silently rescales vertical cell thickness in accumulation/flux terms.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Mandatory volumetric source-term keys; absence aborts the run before computation.

shared_requirements.notes: Unit is m/hr in ParFlow (not m/day MODFLOW, not m/s SI). Use physical matrix Ksat from soil texture, not VIC-calibrated Ksat (includes macropores, 100-500x too high).

shared_requirements.name: porosity (phi)
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 0.2-0.6.

shared_requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha
shared_requirements.notes: Unit is 1/m (not 1/cm as in Rosetta/Carsel-Parrish; factor 100). Typical 0.5 (clay) to 15 (sand).

shared_requirements.name: van Genuchten n
shared_requirements.notes: Drives BOTH the saturation curve and the relative-permeability curve. m is derived as m=1-1/n (Mualem); user cannot set m independently. Typical 1.05-4.0.

shared_requirements.name: specific storage Ss
shared_requirements.notes: Elastic storage in saturated zone; typical 1e-5 to 1e-3.

shared_requirements.name: Kz/Kx anisotropy ratio
shared_requirements.notes: Vertical-to-horizontal conductivity ratio; typical 0.01-1.0 (default ~0.1).

shared_requirements.name: Manning's roughness n
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 0.01 (urban) to 0.4 (dense forest); values < 0.01 cause CFL instability.

shared_requirements.name: slope_x, slope_y (terrain slopes)
shared_requirements.notes: Sign convention: positive slope in positive coordinate direction. Min slope ~0.0001 in flat terrain.

shared_requirements.name: CLM vegetation maps (IGBP type, LAI/SAI/z0 per PFT)
shared_requirements.notes: CLM enabled only. All-barren/water (type 16/17) gives zero ET.

shared_requirements.name: initial pressure-head field
shared_requirements.notes: Negative = unsaturated suction, positive = saturated, zero = water table. Spinup of 10-100 yr (or less if seeded from steady state) needed to equilibrate; equilibrium when inter-annual water-balance residual < 1% of precipitation. HydroStaticPatch with bottom RefPatch sets pressure at the BOTTOM (surface = Value - total_depth).

shared_requirements.name: domain mask / indicator field
shared_requirements.notes: Defines basin extent.

shared_requirements.name: Overland flow boundary condition (top patch)
shared_requirements.notes: Always present at the top; couples surface and subsurface via pressure continuity. Selecting the kinematic vs diffusive overland scheme is set through the top-patch BC TYPE, not a standalone Solver boolean.

shared_requirements.name: lateral/bottom boundary conditions
shared_requirements.notes: Bottom no-flow by default; sides no-flow by default. At least one outflow boundary (e.g. DirEquilRefPatch seepage face) required, otherwise the domain is a closed box with no drainage.

shared_requirements.name: Solver mode selection (Richards vs Impes vs Diffusion)
shared_requirements.notes: Defaults to Impes (two-phase) if omitted; integrated surface-subsurface hydrology requires Solver=Richards. CLM coupling requires Solver=Richards plus Solver.LSM=CLM (compiled --with-clm; defaults to NOT calling CLM).

shared_requirements.name: terrain-following grid + variable-dz (dz_mult / nzList)
shared_requirements.notes: With TerrainFollowingGrid=True, dz values are FRACTIONS of total depth summing to 1.0, not absolute thicknesses. dz_mult silently rescales vertical cell thickness in accumulation/flux terms.

shared_requirements.name: PhaseSources / KnownSolution
shared_requirements.notes: Mandatory volumetric source-term keys; absence aborts the run before computation.
