requirements.notes: Domain length parallel to inlet; default 5000 m. Must be in meters (km gives 1000x-too-small domain).

requirements.name: Width
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Domain width perpendicular to inlet; default 10000 m.

requirements.name: dx
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Cell face length / grid resolution; default 50 m. Must satisfy 0 < dx < Length and dx < Width.

requirements.name: L0 meters
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Inlet channel length; default 150 m. Realized inlet length L0 (in cells) is silently capped at L//4.

requirements.name: N0 meters
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Inlet channel width; default 250 m. Realized N0 (cells) is floored at 3 and capped at W//4; N0_meters/dx >= 3 required.

requirements.name: S0
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Characteristic dimensionless topset slope; default 0.00015. Enters the stability coefficient gamma = g*S0*dx/u0^2.

requirements.name: u0
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Reference inlet velocity; default 1.0. Sets Qw0, gamma, and the velocity cap u_max = 2*u0.

requirements.name: h0
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Reference inlet depth; default 5.0. Sets reference cell volume V0 = h0*dx^2 and dry_depth = min(0.1, 0.1*h0).

requirements.name: hb
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Basin depth; default null => hb = h0.

requirements.name: C0 percent
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Inlet sediment concentration as volume percent; default 0.1. Internally C0 = C0_percent/100; authoring as a fraction (0.001) makes supply 100x too low.

requirements.name: f bedload
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Fraction of sediment routed as sand/bedload; default 0.5. Natural deltas 0.2-0.7; 0 or 1 gives all-mud or all-sand.

requirements.name: Np water
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Number of water parcels routed per timestep; default 2000. Too low -> checkerboard/noisy free surface.

requirements.name: Np sed
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Number of sediment parcels per timestep; default 2000. Split f_bedload sand / (1-f_bedload) mud.

requirements.name: itermax
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Water-routing iterations per timestep; default 3; >=3 for free-surface convergence.

requirements.name: theta water
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Depth-weighting exponent in routing weights (R_i = 1/h_i^theta); default 1.0. Higher concentrates flow into deep channels.

requirements.name: coeff theta sand
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on theta_water for sand routing; default 2.0.

requirements.name: coeff theta mud
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on theta_water for mud routing; default 1.0.

requirements.name: beta
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exponent in sand transport capacity q_s_cap = q_s0 (u_loc/u0)^beta (Meyer-Peter & Muller 1948).

requirements.name: coeff U ero sand
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) for sand erosion.

requirements.name: coeff U ero mud
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) for mud erosion.

requirements.name: coeff U dep mud
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) below which mud deposits.

requirements.name: alpha
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Topographic cross-stream diffusion coefficient (bank erodibility / cross-slope sediment flux).

requirements.name: sed lag
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Lambda-style lag weighting on mud deposition.

requirements.name: Csmooth / omega sfc / omega flow / Nsmooth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Free-surface smoothing and flow under-relaxation coefficients controlling stability of the reconstructed stage and flow fields.

requirements.name: stepmax
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Max parcel walk steps; when null defaults to 2*(L+W) cells.

requirements.name: eta (initial bed)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Initial bed elevation built from S0 topset slope, h0, and basin geometry; not a user-supplied field.

requirements.name: H SL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial sea-level elevation; default 0.0. Advances each timestep by SLR*dt.

requirements.name: seed
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Random seed (numba RNG, not numpy). If unset a random seed is generated and always logged; required for reproducible runs.

requirements.name: resume checkpoint state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional restart: restores all grids, counters, H_SL, and RNG state from a prior checkpoint.

requirements.name: SLR
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Sea-level-rise rate; default 0.0. Must be m/s of model time (convert mm/yr via /1000/(365.25*86400)*If); realistic O(1e-12)-O(1e-9).

requirements.name: toggle subsidence
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Enables the radial subsidence sub-system; default false.

requirements.name: subsidence rate
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Maximum subsidence rate; default 2e-9. Same unit pitfall as SLR (mm/yr vs m/s).

requirements.name: start subsidence
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Model time at which subsidence begins; default 216000 s. Authoring in years starts subsidence immediately.

requirements.name: timesteps / target model time
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Run length; the run ends when elapsed model time >= requested time, so realized duration may exceed the request.

requirements.name: save dt
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Output save interval in seconds of model time; default 86400 (=daily). save_dt=1 yields per-second frames.

requirements.name: save <var> grids flags
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Select which fields are written; with none enabled the NetCDF has coordinates only.

requirements.name: catchment inflow
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: time-varying flow at a Catchment node, supplied by a DataFrameParameter reading a daily CSV timeseries (datetime index + flow column)
requirements.notes: Primary exogenous driver of the network. Must cover the full simulation period at the model timestep; out-of-range dates raise a date/keys error. Inflow is supplied as flow per timestep and treated as volume-per-timestep within the LP.

requirements.name: irrigation demand
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: demand at an Output node, set by a Parameter (constant, monthly profile, or dataframe)
requirements.notes: Optional. Time-varying water demand requested at a demand sink.

requirements.name: municipal/industrial demand
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: demand at an Output node, set by a Parameter
requirements.notes: Optional time-varying demand.

requirements.name: reservoir-surface precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional direct rainfall onto the reservoir surface.

requirements.name: max volume (reservoir capacity)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Maximum reservoir storage volume; bounds the storage state. Typical major-dam capacities exceed 1e8 m3.

requirements.name: min volume / dead storage
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Lower bound on storage; dead storage typically 10-20% of max_volume.

requirements.name: node cost (priority penalty)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: cost field on each node / cost Parameter
requirements.notes: Sets allocation priority in the LP objective: more negative cost attracts water (higher priority), positive cost repels it. Encodes demand ranking (environmental > municipal > irrigation > industrial) and spill penalty.

requirements.name: max flow / min flow (node capacity, MRF)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: max_flow/min_flow fields on non-storage nodes; mrf on RiverGauge
requirements.notes: Capacity and minimum-flow constraints bounding the LP feasible region; min_flow encodes minimum residual / environmental flow (typically 10-30% of mean annual flow).

requirements.name: control curve
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Monthly target storage levels; selects the storage node's cost band (above-curve vs below-curve) to produce smooth intermediate regulation. Absent it, the reservoir fills to max or empties to min.

requirements.name: demand profile
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Temporal shape of demand at a demand node.

requirements.name: initial volume
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required starting storage volume; the only state carried into the first timestep.

requirements.name: simulation period
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Defines the daily integration window; must align with the inflow timeseries date range.

requirements.name: spill / overflow path
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Link from the storage node to a high-cost spill Output node
requirements.notes: Mandatory feasibility safeguard: a slack/spill route the LP can use when inflow exceeds demand plus available capacity. Absence causes InfeasibleError.

requirements.name: network topology
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: JSON nodes[] and edges[] (directional connections; node 'name'+'type' required, edge endpoints must reference existing node names)
requirements.notes: The user-defined graph IS the spatial discretization; topology determines what is allocated where.

shared_requirements.name: catchment inflow
shared_requirements.notes: Primary exogenous driver of the network. Must cover the full simulation period at the model timestep; out-of-range dates raise a date/keys error. Inflow is supplied as flow per timestep and treated as volume-per-timestep within the LP.

shared_requirements.name: irrigation demand

shared_requirements.name: municipal/industrial demand
shared_requirements.notes: Optional time-varying demand.

shared_requirements.name: reservoir-surface precipitation
shared_requirements.notes: Optional direct rainfall onto the reservoir surface.

shared_requirements.name: max_volume (reservoir capacity)
shared_requirements.notes: Maximum reservoir storage volume; bounds the storage state. Typical major-dam capacities exceed 1e8 m3.

shared_requirements.name: min_volume / dead storage
shared_requirements.notes: Lower bound on storage; dead storage typically 10-20% of max_volume.

shared_requirements.name: node_cost (priority penalty)
shared_requirements.notes: Sets allocation priority in the LP objective: more negative cost attracts water (higher priority), positive cost repels it. Encodes demand ranking (environmental > municipal > irrigation > industrial) and spill penalty.

shared_requirements.name: max_flow / min_flow (node capacity, MRF)
shared_requirements.notes: Capacity and minimum-flow constraints bounding the LP feasible region; min_flow encodes minimum residual / environmental flow (typically 10-30% of mean annual flow).

shared_requirements.name: control curve
shared_requirements.notes: Monthly target storage levels; selects the storage node's cost band (above-curve vs below-curve) to produce smooth intermediate regulation. Absent it, the reservoir fills to max or empties to min.

shared_requirements.name: demand profile
shared_requirements.notes: Temporal shape of demand at a demand node.

shared_requirements.name: initial_volume
shared_requirements.notes: Required starting storage volume; the only state carried into the first timestep.

shared_requirements.name: simulation period
shared_requirements.notes: Defines the daily integration window; must align with the inflow timeseries date range.

shared_requirements.name: spill / overflow path
shared_requirements.notes: Mandatory feasibility safeguard: a slack/spill route the LP can use when inflow exceeds demand plus available capacity. Absence causes InfeasibleError.

shared_requirements.name: network topology
shared_requirements.notes: The user-defined graph IS the spatial discretization; topology determines what is allocated where.

packages.name: RAPID

requirements.name: Vlat
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: m3 (accumulated volume over ZS_TauR, NOT a rate)
requirements.notes: Surface+subsurface runoff volume entering each reach per routing period. RAPID internally computes Qlat = Vlat / ZS_TauR; supplying m3/s instead of m3 makes discharge ~ZS_TauR x (e.g. ~10800x) too small (silent). RAPID reads Vlat by position, so the rivid dimension order must match riv_bas_id ordering exactly.

requirements.name: k
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: k_file CSV, one value per reach ordered to riv_bas_id
requirements.notes: Muskingum wave travel time (k = length / celerity), typical hundreds to tens of thousands of s (range ~900-360000). Must be seconds not hours; too small relative to dtR drives unstable C1/C2/C3 and KSP divergence.

requirements.name: x
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: x_file CSV, one value per reach
requirements.notes: Muskingum attenuation weighting factor in [0, 0.5] (typical 0.1-0.3). x=0 maximizes attenuation; x=0.5 is pure translation. x>0.5 or x as percentage causes negative C3 and oscillating negative discharge.

requirements.name: kfac / xfac
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multipliers applied to k and x during calibration (kfac ~0.1-10, xfac ~0.1-5, default 1.0).

requirements.name: rapid connect
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CSV: reach_id downstream_id num_upstream up_id_1..n (outlet downstream_id=0, headwater num_upstream=0)
requirements.notes: Defines the sparse network connectivity matrix Net (1 where reach j flows into reach i). IS_max_up must equal the actual max upstream count; undersizing overruns array bounds. Circular references cause water to recirculate.

requirements.name: riv bas id
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CSV, one ordered reach ID per line
requirements.notes: Ordered list of reaches in the simulated subbasin; fixes the PETSc vector row order for ALL state vectors and must match the Vlat rivid order. IDs must all exist in rapid_connect exactly once or PETSc matrix assembly segfaults.

requirements.name: Qinit
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF Qout(time=1, rivid), read only if BS_opt_Qinit=.true.
requirements.notes: Initial reach discharge for restart. If absent the model cold-starts all reaches at zero flow (ZS_Qout0=0), requiring days-to-weeks spinup; best practice seeds Qinit from a prior warmup Qfinal. Initial volume defaults to a hardcoded ZS_V0=10000 m3 per reach when no Qinit supplied.

requirements.name: IS opt run
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects standard routing vs TAO k/x calibration vs Kalman-filter assimilation phases.

requirements.name: IS opt routing
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: namelist integer (1=matrix Muskingum KSP solve, 2=traditional, 3=transboundary, 4=Muskingum operator)
requirements.notes: Operator mode (4) prunes small matrix entries via ZS_threshold and gives results that differ from the KSP solve (1) by an approximation that is not documented as accuracy-affecting.

requirements.name: ZS TauM / ZS dtM / ZS TauR / ZS dtR
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: namelist reals (e.g. TauM=2592000, dtM=86400, TauR=10800, dtR=900)
requirements.notes: Total duration / output step / routing period (=Vlat step) / routing sub-step. Must satisfy divisibility (TauM mod dtM, TauR mod dtR, TauM mod TauR all 0) and TauM/TauR must equal the Vlat time-step count, or runs read past EOF or produce wrong step counts. dtR must satisfy the Courant/Muskingum stability bound.

requirements.name: Qobs (+ obs tot id / obs use id)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF Qobs(time, rivid) + CSV gage ID lists; required when IS_opt_run=2
requirements.notes: Observed gage discharge driving TAO calibration of k,x and the Kalman-filter correction. Must be m3/s (cfs mismatch gives +/-100% PBIAS).

requirements.name: Qfor / dam IDs
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional forced flow at specified reaches and dam-reach lists for the optional non-data-driven reservoir submodel; both off by default.

packages.name: RHESSys

requirements.name: rain (precipitation, rain+snow)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: .rain ASCII daily series referenced by base-station file
requirements.notes: MUST be m/day, not mm/day; mm/day silently inflates all water fluxes ~1000x (dt_001).

requirements.name: tmax (daily maximum temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Celsius, not Kelvin (dt_003). Day-to-day tmax-tmin range drives MTCLIM/Bristow-Campbell cloud correction; a constant range disables it (dt_020).

requirements.name: tmin (daily minimum temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: relative humidity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Fraction not percent; % input must be divided by 100.

requirements.name: wind
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Kdown direct
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be supplied together with Kdown_diffuse; supplying only one makes RHESSys zero both and recompute clear-sky radiation, causing vegetation collapse in humid climates (dt_019).

requirements.name: Kdown diffuse
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: base-station daily sequence, paired with Kdown_direct

requirements.name: daytime rain duration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: If absent, rain_duration defaults to 86400 s (all day) for any precip, zeroing transpiration on every rainy day (dt_022).

requirements.name: CO2 / N deposition (NO3, NH4) / atmospheric transmissivity / cloud fraction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional atmospheric drivers when corresponding climate sequences are provided.

requirements.name: Ksat 0 (surface saturated hydraulic conductivity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.001-100; cm/hr input must be x0.24 (dt_005). Very-high calibration sensitivity.

requirements.name: m (transmissivity decay parameter)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.01-20; controls exponential decay of transmissivity with depth (TOPMODEL).

requirements.name: porosity 0
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.2-0.7; >1.0 (percent) crashes the model (dt_006).

requirements.name: porosity decay
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: pore size index (Brooks-Corey)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: psi air entry (air-entry pressure)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.01-3.0; kPa input must be /9.81 (dt_010).

requirements.name: soil depth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.5-5.0; cm input gives unrealistically deep soil (dt_004).

requirements.name: epc.max lai
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 1-12; maximum leaf area index.

requirements.name: epc.proj sla (specific leaf area)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: epc.leaf turnover
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: epc.livewood turnover
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: epc.height to stem coef
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: epc.allocation flag
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Carbon allocation strategy selector.

requirements.name: epc.veg type
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: sat to gw coeff (gw1, saturation-to-groundwater fraction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: gw loss coeff (gw2, groundwater recession)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: lapse rate / atm trans lapse rate / dewpoint lapse rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Temperature/transmissivity lapse rates for topographic downscaling.

requirements.name: impervious fraction / irrigation / fertilizer NO3 / fertilizer NH4
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Land-use management parameters; fertilizer/irrigation only when landuse layer active.

requirements.name: sat deficit / unsat storage / rz storage / detention store
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Hydrologic stores reach equilibrium quickly relative to BGC.

requirements.name: snowpack.water equivalent depth
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: initial soil/litter/canopy C and N pools (soil cs.*, litter cs.*, cs.leafc, cs.frootc, leafn, frootn)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: g/m^2 instead of kg/m^2 causes 1000x runaway growth (dt_009). BGC pools require 200-500 yr spin-up to steady state (dt_012).

requirements.name: cs.leafc transfer / cs.leafc store (leaf expansion budgets)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: For deciduous dormant-season start, cs.leafc_transfer (=max_lai/proj_sla) must be set, not only leafc_store, else Year 1 has no leaves.

requirements.name: worldfile (.world)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: hierarchical text; 'value variable_name' pairs per object
requirements.notes: Whitespace/ordering-sensitive; misalignment causes silent misassignment or segfault (dt_011). Fixed per-level variable counts (17/18/22/47/71 for basin/hillslope/zone/patch/stratum).

requirements.name: worldfile header (.hdr)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: maps definition IDs to .def files and lists base-station filenames
requirements.notes: Every base-station filename used must be listed here.

requirements.name: flow table (.flow)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Every worldfile patch must appear; ID mismatch segfaults during routing init (dt_015).

requirements.name: TEC file (temporal event control)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Events scheduled before -st start date are ignored, producing empty output (dt_014).

requirements.name: base station file
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: links climate files; base_station_ID, x/y/z elevation, effective_lai, screen_height, daily sequences
requirements.notes: Defines which optional daily climate sequences are present.

requirements.name: run mode flags (-r explicit routing, -g C/N cycling, -gw groundwater, -b basin output, -p patch output, -DLIU NETCDF READER compile-time NetCDF)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Without -g only hydrology runs and vegetation is static; without -r TOPMODEL hillslope redistribution is used; NetCDF forcing requires the compile-time reader flag (dt_016).

requirements.name: sensitivity multipliers (-s m mult Ksat mult, -sv vertical, -svalt pore size/psi air entry)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Never set to 0 (zeros Ksat or m -> division-by-zero / infinite loop, dt_013).

requirements.name: Uwind

requirements.name: Vwind
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: 10 m wind N-component

requirements.name: Tair
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: air temperature; Celsius, not Kelvin (BULK_FLUXES)

requirements.name: Pair
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: surface pressure in millibar, not Pa

requirements.name: Qair
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: specific humidity (0.001-0.020), not % relative humidity (BULK_FLUXES)

requirements.name: rain
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: precipitation; mm/day must be divided by 86400

requirements.name: swrad
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: shortwave radiation, positive downward into ocean; SOLAR_SOURCE controls subsurface penetration

requirements.name: lwrad
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: net longwave (positive=warming) or downwelling-only when LONGWAVE_OUT active

requirements.name: sustr
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: surface U-momentum stress; supplied directly only when BULK_FLUXES is NOT defined (else double-counting)

requirements.name: svstr
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: surface V-momentum stress; non-bulk path only

requirements.name: shflux
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: net surface heat flux; prescribed when BULK_FLUXES NOT defined

requirements.name: swflux / EminusP
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: net freshwater flux evaporation minus precipitation; non-bulk path

requirements.name: open boundary T/S/u/v/zeta
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: time-varying open-boundary data; must cover full simulation period (daily min, 6-hourly preferred), else last record is extrapolated

requirements.name: tidal elevation/velocity constituents
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: harmonic constituents added at open boundaries; forcing time must match TIME_REF epoch

requirements.name: river transport / river temp / river salt
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: runoff point sources injected at named grid cells

requirements.name: h
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: bathymetry; must be positive in water; smooth so r-factor |dh|/sum(h) < 0.2

requirements.name: pm, pn
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: inverse curvilinear metrics 1/dx, 1/dy

requirements.name: f
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Coriolis parameter 2*omega*sin(lat)

requirements.name: lon rho/lat rho, angle, mask rho
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: coordinates, grid rotation angle, land/sea mask

requirements.name: THETA S
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: surface S-coordinate stretching (0.1-10); recommended 3-7

requirements.name: THETA B
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: bottom S-coordinate stretching (0-4); recommended 0-2

requirements.name: TCLINE
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: critical depth for stretching (5-200 m)

requirements.name: VISC2
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: horizontal momentum viscosity (1-100)

requirements.name: TNU2
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: horizontal tracer diffusivity (0-50)

requirements.name: AKV BAK, AKT BAK
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: background vertical viscosity/diffusivity (1e-6-1e-4)

requirements.name: RDRG2
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: quadratic bottom drag coefficient (0-0.01); small changes can destabilize

requirements.name: Zob
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: bottom roughness length (0.001-0.05)

requirements.name: Tnudg
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: boundary/interior nudging time scale (recommended 3-30, typically 10 for T/S)

requirements.name: RHO0
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Boussinesq reference seawater density; appears in pressure gradient and gorho0=g/rho0 buoyancy

requirements.name: Cp
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: specific heat of seawater converting surface heat flux to temperature flux; not a roms.in input

requirements.name: EOS polynomial coefficients
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Jackett & McDougall (1995) nonlinear UNESCO density fit; defines ROMS density, not user-configurable

requirements.name: variable-name mapping
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: maps internal ROMS names to NetCDF variable names; mismatch causes GET_*FLD read failure

requirements.name: zeta
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: free-surface elevation at start

requirements.name: ubar, vbar
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: barotropic 2D velocity at start

requirements.name: u, v
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 3D baroclinic velocity at start

requirements.name: temp
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: initial potential temperature in Celsius, not Kelvin (HYCOM/GLORYS conversion)

requirements.name: salt
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: initial salinity

requirements.name: ocean time
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: initialization epoch; all NetCDF time variables must reference the same TIME_REF (YYYYMMDD.dd)

requirements.name: Lm, Mm, N
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: interior XI/ETA points and vertical levels; Lm=xi_rho-2, Mm=eta_rho-2

requirements.name: DT
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: NDTFAST
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: NTIMES, TIME REF

requirements.name: daily meteorology (Tmin, Tmax, wind run, solar radiation, relative humidity, rainfall; optional E-pan, PAR)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: Tmin/Tmax degC; wind km/day; SRAD MJ/m^2/day; RH %; rainfall mm; E-pan cm/day; PAR mol quanta/m^2/day
requirements.model_input_format: .met (36-line header then one 10-column row per day)
requirements.notes: No missing-value handler: every day must carry a complete numeric row. Setting E-pan and PAR columns to 0 triggers the model's internal Penman-Monteith/Shuttleworth-Wallace ET estimation; supplying non-zero values overrides it. Wind is a daily run (km/day), solar radiation is MJ/m^2/day. When the PAR column is 0/absent, the model internally derives PAR as 0.48 × shortwave (SRAD) in the meteorology reader (hmet); this is the model's built-in PAR estimate, not a host-tool conversion.

requirements.name: breakpoint (sub-daily) rainfall intensity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: .brk (20-line header, per-event control line, breakpoint time/depth pairs)
requirements.notes: Drives the sub-daily infiltration intensity that the Green-Ampt/macropore routine consumes. The binary expects breakpoint precipitation in INCHES (not mm); mm supplied without /25.4 inflates infiltration ~25x.

requirements.name: ambient CO2 concentration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Atmospheric driver to the crop assimilation routines; specified as a site property rather than a per-day column.

requirements.name: site geometry (latitude, longitude, elevation, slope, aspect, area)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.unit: lat/lon RADIANS; elevation m; slope fraction 0-1; aspect deg from north; area m^2
requirements.notes: Latitude and longitude MUST be in radians; |lat|>pi/2 indicates a degrees error that silently corrupts solar geometry and PET.

requirements.name: soil horizon physical properties (bulk density, particle density, sand/silt/clay, porosity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: RZWQM.dat soil physical section (per horizon, max 20 horizons / 3000 cm)

requirements.name: Brooks-Corey hydraulic parameters (bubbling pressure, pore-size index lambda, Ksat, residual/saturated water content, field-capacity points, lateral Ksat)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: bubbling pressure cm H2O; Ksat cm/hr; water contents cm^3/cm^3
requirements.notes: Dominant water-flux controls; sensitivity order Ksat > effective porosity (ws-wr) > macroporosity > bubbling pressure > pore-size index.

requirements.name: macropore / micropore properties (total macroporosity, radius, width, crack/aggregate geometry, dead-end fraction, microporosity by texture)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: soil heat / thermal parameters (method flag, thermal conductivity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: potential evaporation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per-area flux in m/s; negative values are treated as condensation (adds water).

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Prescribed lateral inflow to the basin (e.g. from an external runoff source).

requirements.name: infiltration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Prescribed loss flux out of the basin.

requirements.name: FlowBoundary flow rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: External prescribed inflow/outflow time series; block (step) interpolation by default. Gaps may interpolate to zero (dry-spell artifact).

requirements.name: LevelBoundary level
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: External prescribed water level at a system edge.

requirements.name: UserDemand demand time series
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Time-varying demand per priority; consumes (1-return_factor) and returns the rest.

requirements.name: Basin profile (area-level-storage curve)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: level m / area m² / storage m³
requirements.notes: Most critical input; storage derived by trapezoidal integration of area over level. Levels must be strictly monotonically increasing.

requirements.name: Pump flow rate / min upstream level
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Outlet flow rate / min upstream level
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: TabulatedRatingCurve Q(h) table
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Stage-discharge lookup; one-directional upstream-head flow.

requirements.name: LinearResistance resistance / max flow rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Q = Δh/R; natural channels typically 1e2-1e6 s/m². Too high silently disconnects basins.

requirements.name: ManningResistance length / manning n / profile width / profile slope
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: manning_n typically 0.01-0.10.

requirements.name: PidControl gains (proportional, integral, derivative) and target
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Gains must be NEGATIVE for outlet/pump-based level regulation; positive gains cause runaway oscillation.

requirements.name: DiscreteControl conditions and logic (thresholds, truth-state→control-state)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Hysteresis band (threshold_high/threshold_low); too-small gap causes per-timestep chatter.

requirements.name: UserDemand return factor / min level / demand priority
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: return_factor in [0,1]; >1 creates water from nothing. Lower priority number = higher priority.

requirements.name: Basin initial level
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must fall within the Basin profile level range; missing Basin/state table is FATAL. Storage initialized from level via the profile. Final levels in basin_state.nc are reusable as restart.

requirements.name: PidControl integral term initial value
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Accumulated integral-error state; not typically user-set.

requirements.name: Node table (node id, node type, subnetwork id, geometry)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: subnetwork_id=0 excludes a node from allocation. Geometry must match declared CRS (no auto-reproject).

requirements.name: Link table (from node id, to node id, link type)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: link_type ∈ flow/control/listen. Strict allowed from→to connectivity; Basin→Basin direct links are fatal. Control nodes must use 'control' links.

requirements.name: CRS (coordinate reference system)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: All geometries must use this CRS; mismatch silently corrupts distances/areas/Manning flows.

requirements.name: Solver algorithm selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: FBDF preferred over QNDF for very stiff systems.

requirements.name: Output interval (saveat)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: In seconds; too large misses sub-daily peaks/control switching.

requirements.name: Allocation enable + allocation timestep
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: allocation block in ribasim.toml (experimental, off by default; timestep default 86400)
requirements.notes: Timestep in seconds; days-vs-seconds confusion starves demands or crawls.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must cover all time-series data; non-ISO formats cause fatal TOML parse errors.

requirements.notes: Instantaneous rate in mm/hr; drives pluvial flooding. Time-interpolated each step by the meteo module into prcp.

requirements.name: river discharge boundary
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Injected as point/source discharge qsrc; the CaMa-Flood->SFINCS fluvial coupling path.

requirements.name: water level boundary
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Coastal/downstream water-level BC; vertical datum must match the DEM datum.

requirements.name: wind speed and direction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: spiderweb / amu-amv wind fields (dtwnd update interval, default 1800 s)
requirements.notes: Optional; produces wind stress (tauwu/tauwv) for surge/setup. Not active in default pluvial/fluvial runs.

requirements.name: atmospheric pressure
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: atmospheric pressure forcing field / spwfile composite
requirements.notes: Optional; barometric forcing for surge runs.

requirements.name: bed level (topography/bathymetry)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: m (vertical datum must match boundary conditions)
requirements.model_input_format: sfincs.dep (binary float32 row-major), sourced from a DEM raster (GeoTIFF)
requirements.notes: Terrain elevation, positive upward; defines conveyance with subgrid tables.

requirements.name: active cell mask
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: SKILL.md convention adopted (1=active). Interior cells must be 1; mask=3 on interior makes SFINCS prescribe water level and compute zero flood depth.

requirements.name: active-cell index map
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Maps active cells to grid / subgrid; header int32 must equal n_active.

requirements.name: Manning's n roughness
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: sfincs.man (binary float32 row-major) or uniform manning; manning_land 0.04 / manning_sea 0.02 split at rgh_lev_land
requirements.notes: Primary calibration parameter. Precomputed once into gn2=g*n^2 at init (compute_fluxes reads gn2); editing manning after init is inert. In subgrid mode roughness is embedded in the subgrid tables instead.

requirements.name: subgrid tables
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Optional but dominant control on coarse-grid accuracy; continuity maps storage volume to water level via these tables.

requirements.name: infiltration parameters
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: qinf constant or qinffile; scsfile/sfacinf (CN); ksfile/sigmafile/psifile (Green-Ampt); f0file/fcfile/kdfile (Horton)
requirements.notes: Optional infiltration sink subtracted from precipitation in the continuity balance.

requirements.name: grid definition
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: EPSG must be a projected (UTM) CRS; geographic 4326 with metric dx/dy is fatal.

requirements.name: initial water level
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: zsini uniform (default 0.0) or inifile (binary spatially varying)
requirements.notes: Sets zs at simulation start.

requirements.name: restart state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: rstfile containing zs, qx, qy, umean, vmean
requirements.notes: Optional warm-start from a prior run.

requirements.name: momentum advection toggle
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the reduced-physics regime; default 0.

requirements.name: minimum flow depth threshold (huthresh)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Wetting/drying threshold; cells below huthresh treated dry, controlling flood-extent edges and wet/dry stability. Default split across streams: docs default 0.05 m (range 0.001-0.1); binary symbol __sfincs_data_MOD_huthresh default 0.01 m. Unresolved across docs vs binary streams - use SFINCS-manual 0.05 m unless byte-confirmed otherwise.

requirements.name: momentum time-integration / smoothing weight (theta)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Momentum time-integration / numerical-smoothing weight affecting stability. Default split across streams: source binary symbol __sfincs_data_MOD_theta default 0.9; docs default 1.0. Unresolved across docs vs binary streams.

requirements.name: simulation time window
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Reference, start and stop times; forcing times are relative to tref.

requirements.name: computational timestep control
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: alpha Courant limiter (default 0.5; binary alfa default 0.75) constraining dt <= alpha*dx/sqrt(g*h_max)
requirements.notes: Adaptive CFL-limited timestep; violation produces NaN crash.

requirements.name: output format and intervals
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: outputformat must be 'net' for NetCDF map/his output; otherwise binary.

requirements.name: hydraulic structures
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional; override fluxes between cells inside the momentum step.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: MWATRXT (external soil source/sink flag)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

packages.name: SNOWPACK

requirements.name: TA
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Air temperature; must be MKSA Kelvin. Drives the surface energy balance and Monin-Obukhov turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: RH
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Relative humidity as a 0-1 fraction (not percent); enters latent-heat / sublimation computation.

requirements.name: VW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wind speed; scales turbulent exchange coefficients and drives saltation/erosion and drifting-snow compaction.

requirements.name: DW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wind direction; optional, used by drift bookkeeping.

requirements.name: ISWR / RSWR / NET SW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Shortwave radiation; at least one form required. SW_MODE selects whether incoming, reflected, or both are provided (BOTH derives albedo = RSWR/ISWR).

requirements.name: ILWR
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: SMET column ILWR (or TSS as alternative upper-boundary surface temperature)
requirements.notes: Incoming longwave; if absent under FORCING=ATMOS the model assumes zero incoming longwave (severe cold bias).

requirements.name: PSUM
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Incremental precipitation per timestep (rain+snow); phase split internal. Either PSUM or measured HS must be supplied as the mass driver.

requirements.name: HS
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Measured snow depth; optional driver/assimilation source for snow-depth-based precipitation correction (do not combine with PSUM correction, double-count risk). NB: the .smet HS forcing is in metres, but the .met HS output column is emitted in centimetres - see safety.conflicts.

requirements.name: TSG
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Ground/soil surface temperature; lower-boundary forcing alternative to a prescribed geothermal flux.

requirements.name: P
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Atmospheric pressure; optional, affects vapour pressure and air density.

requirements.name: slope angle / azimuth
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Station slope and aspect; below Constants::min_slope_angle (3 deg) the site is treated as flat for precip routing.

requirements.name: latitude / longitude / altitude
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: ROUGHNESS LENGTH
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Aerodynamic roughness length entering Monin-Obukhov surface-layer fluxes.

requirements.name: HEIGHT OF METEO VALUES / HEIGHT OF WIND VALUE
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Must match real sensor install heights or stability extrapolation biases turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: soil layer properties (Rho S, Conduc S, HeatCapac S, Vol Frac S)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Soil thermal/hydraulic properties supplied inside the initial profile file.

requirements.name: MINIMUM L ELEMENT / REDUCE N ELEMENTS
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Control finite-element layer thickness and merging; too-small values cause zero-thickness layers and ill-conditioned matrices.

requirements.name: soil albedo
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: initial layered stratigraphy
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: .sno data rows (soil bottom-to-top then snow bottom-to-top, 18 fields/row)
requirements.notes: Per-layer Layer_Thick, T, Vol_Frac_I/W/V/S, grain microstructure (rg, rb, dd, sp, mk), mass_hoar, CDot, metamo. Volume fractions per layer must sum to exactly 1.0. ProfileDate must be <= first forcing timestamp.

requirements.name: soil temperature and moisture profile (spun-up)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Requires spinup (>= ~2 annual cycles; permafrost 10+ years) to equilibrate before production, or a restart .sno from a prior run.

requirements.name: FORCING
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: ATMOS drives the full surface energy balance from radiation/wind/humidity; MASSBAL uses precipitation+temperature only (use when radiation absent).

requirements.name: SW MODE
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects which shortwave fields are present and how albedo is obtained.

requirements.name: CHANGE BC
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Toggles the surface thermal boundary between Neumann (flux) and Dirichlet (measured TSS).

requirements.name: GEO HEAT
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Geothermal/basal heat flux at the column base (alternative to prescribed TSG).

requirements.name: VARIANT
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects climate-regime presets that switch hardcoded new-snow microstructure, RH limits, and bond-strength factors; SEAICE force-enables coupled phase changes.

requirements.name: WATERTRANSPORTMODEL SNOW
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the liquid-water percolation scheme; structurally controls meltwater timing and runoff.

requirements.name: ALBEDO PARAMETERIZATION
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects snow-albedo evolution scheme.

requirements.name: METAMORPHISM MODEL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: ATMOSPHERIC STABILITY
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Turbulence/stability correction scheme for the surface-layer flux computation.

requirements.name: CALCULATION STEP LENGTH
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Read internally as minutes; the explicit/adaptive solver diverges or floods the hazard-interval logic with overly large steps.

skill_stages.name: Site identification
skill_stages.text: s0 Site identification (manual) Define station location, elevation, slope, aspect

skill_stages.name: Forcing preparation
skill_stages.text: s1 Forcing preparation convert_forcing.py Convert global meteo data to SMET format convert_forcing.py s1 tools/convert_forcing.py ~280 Global meteo → SMET with unit conversions

skill_stages.name: Soil/profile setup
skill_stages.text: s2 Soil/profile setup build_sno_profile.py Create initial .sno file with soil/snow layers build_sno_profile.py s2 tools/build_sno_profile.py ~250 HWSD/manual → .sno initial profile

skill_stages.name: Configuration
skill_stages.text: s3 Configuration generate_config.py Generate .ini config file from parameters generate_config.py s3 tools/generate_config.py ~320 Parameter dict → SNOWPACK .ini config

skill_stages.name: Spinup
skill_stages.text: s4 Spinup run_snowpack.py Run spinup simulation to stabilize soil temperatures

skill_stages.name: Production run
skill_stages.text: s5 Production run run_snowpack.py Execute main simulation

skill_stages.name: Output extraction
skill_stages.text: s6 Output extraction parse_output.py Parse .pro/.met output to CSV/NetCDF parse_output.py s6 tools/parse_output.py ~270 .pro/.met files → CSV with selected variables

skill_stages.text: s7 Binary test run_snowpack.py Verify binary with bundled test case

skill_stages.name: Validation
skill_stages.text: s8 Validation (Python script) Compare to observations, compute metrics

packages.name: SUMMA

requirements.name: pptrate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: precipitation rate; partitioned to rain/snow by air temperature relative to tempCritRain; temperate mean ~1e-5 to 1e-4 kg/m2/s

requirements.name: airtemp
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: air temperature at measurement height; controls rain/snow phase partition and melt energy

requirements.name: SWRadAtm
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: downward shortwave radiation at upper boundary

requirements.name: LWRadAtm
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: downward longwave radiation at upper boundary

requirements.name: windspd
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: wind speed at measurement height

requirements.name: airpres
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: air pressure at measurement height; expected ~80000-105000 Pa, in kPa breaks saturation-vapour-pressure/energy balance

requirements.name: spechum
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: specific humidity (mass ratio, numerically kg/kg); expected ~0.002-0.015; sets vapour-pressure deficit for ET

requirements.name: k soil (saturated hydraulic conductivity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: range ~1e-7 to 1e-3

requirements.name: theta sat (porosity / saturated water content)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: theta res (residual water content)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: must be < theta_sat; range ~0.01-0.15

requirements.name: vGn alpha (van Genuchten alpha)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: matric-head sign convention: SUMMA requires NEGATIVE values (valid ~[-1.0,-0.01]); positive yields NaN

requirements.name: vGn n (van Genuchten n shape)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: critSoilWilting (wilting point)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: ET shutoff; must satisfy theta_res < critSoilWilting < critSoilTranspire < fieldCapacity < theta_sat

requirements.name: critSoilTranspire (transpiration threshold)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: fieldCapacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: theta at -33 kPa; ~0.30

requirements.name: heightCanopyTop (canopy height)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: controls radiation and roughness; ~0.1-40 m

requirements.name: rootingDepth (root zone depth)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: qSurfScale (surface runoff scaling)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: aquiferScaleFactor (aquifer response time)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: tempCritRain (rain/snow threshold)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: frozenPrecipMultip (snow undercatch correction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: vegTypeIndex / soilTypeIndex / slopeTypeIndex
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: classification indices selecting Noah-MP VEGPARM/SOILPARM/GENPARM lookup-table defaults unless overridden by trialParams

requirements.name: HRU geometry (HRUarea, elevation, tan slope, contourLength, mHeight, downHRUindex)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: local spatial attributes; downHRUindex=0 marks the outlet

requirements.name: mLayerTemp (initial soil/snow layer temperature)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: cold-start ~ mean annual air temperature; unrealistic values motivate nrg_flux convergence failure / two-phase spinup

requirements.name: mLayerVolFracLiq / mLayerVolFracIce (initial layer moisture)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: cold-start ~field capacity 0.25-0.35; too dry causes 5+ yr spinup, above theta_sat causes runoff spikes

requirements.name: mLayerMatricHead (initial soil matric head)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: scalarSWE / nSnow (initial snow water equivalent / snow layer count)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: typically SWE=0, nSnow=0; snow builds up naturally

requirements.name: canopy state (scalarCanopyLiq, scalarCanopyIce)

packages.name: SWMM

requirements.name: Precipitation (rainfall)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mm/hr (intensity) or mm/interval (volume), CMS; in/hr or in (CFS)
requirements.model_input_format: [RAINGAGES] + [TIMESERIES] in INP; FORMAT INTENSITY|VOLUME|CUMULATIVE, held constant within a runoff timestep
requirements.notes: FORMAT (INTENSITY vs VOLUME) must match the data encoding; an interval mismatch scales runoff by intervals-per-hour with no warning.

requirements.name: Air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives snowmelt partitioning and Hargreaves evaporation.

requirements.name: Evaporation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: [EVAPORATION] time series (actual; pan x ~0.7) or Hargreaves from temperature
requirements.notes: SWMM expects actual evaporation; Hargreaves needs a multi-day (7-day running) temperature average.

requirements.name: Wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Refines snowmelt rate during rain-on-snow.

requirements.name: Area (A)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Characteristic width (W)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Implied overland flow length L = Area/Width; over-large W (e.g., sqrt(Area) shortcut) artificially peaks the hydrograph.

requirements.name: Slope (S)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Percent imperviousness
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: % Zero-Imperv (impervious area with no depression storage)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Manning's n (pervious n P, impervious n I)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: No range check; a dropped/added zero shifts velocity 10-13x. Typical range [0.005, 0.100].

requirements.name: Depression storage (pervious S-perv, impervious S-imperv)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Infiltration parameters
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Column layout MUST match the method in [OPTIONS] INFILTRATION; mismatch silently misreads columns.

requirements.name: Aquifer parameters (up to 14 per subcatchment)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Only required when groundwater is modeled.

requirements.name: Node attributes (invert elev, max depth, surcharge depth, ponded area Aponded)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Conduit attributes (length, Manning roughness, inlet/outlet offsets, cross-section)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Length=0 (coincident nodes) causes division-by-zero/NaN.

requirements.name: LID layer properties (Surface/Soil/Pavement/Storage/Drain)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: thicknesses mm; porosity/FC/WP fractions; conductivity mm/hr
requirements.notes: Soil layer must satisfy Wilting Point < Field Capacity < Porosity; SWMM does not validate this.

requirements.name: Pollutant buildup/washoff and treatment coefficients
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Ponded runoff depth d
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: Infiltration sub-states / antecedent dry time
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: Horton DryTime / soil moisture storage S
requirements.notes: Most infiltration sub-states (t_p, F_e, Fu, T, P) start at 0; soil moisture storage S is user-supplied.

requirements.name: Snow pack initial state (w snow, fw, ati)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Initial unsaturated moisture theta u and saturated depth d L
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Node initial depth / link initial flow
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: LID initial soil saturation (InitSat)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 30-50% typical for event runs; washes out over continuous simulation.

requirements.name: FLOW UNITS
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Silently sets the unit system for ALL inputs and outputs; no dimension validation. Single most dangerous silent error.

requirements.name: INFILTRATION method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: ROUTING MODEL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Kinematic wave cannot represent adverse slopes, backwater, or surcharging; only dynamic wave handles reverse flow.

requirements.name: ALLOW PONDING
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default NO removes flood water as a mass sink; YES with Aponded>0 conserves it.

requirements.name: Timesteps (WET STEP, DRY STEP, ROUTING STEP, REPORT STEP) and VARIABLE STEP
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: ROUTING_STEP must satisfy the Courant condition for dynamic wave.

requirements.name: Outfall stage boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Time-varying head boundary (e.g., downstream river stage). TIMESERIES name must exist and span the simulation period.

requirements.name: External inflow hydrographs / pollutographs at nodes
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: External lateral inflow (e.g., upstream rural runoff coupling).

requirements.name: Dry-weather sanitary flow
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required for combined-sewer dry-weather base flow.

requirements.name: Control rules for pumps and regulators
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

shared_requirements.unit: thicknesses mm; porosity/FC/WP fractions; conductivity mm/hr

shared_requirements.name: Infiltration sub-states / antecedent dry time

shared_requirements.name: ALLOW_PONDING

shared_requirements.name: Timesteps (WET_STEP, DRY_STEP, ROUTING_STEP, REPORT_STEP) and VARIABLE_STEP
shared_requirements.notes: ROUTING_STEP must satisfy the Courant condition for dynamic wave.

shared_requirements.name: Outfall stage boundary
shared_requirements.notes: Time-varying head boundary (e.g., downstream river stage). TIMESERIES name must exist and span the simulation period.

shared_requirements.name: External inflow hydrographs / pollutographs at nodes
shared_requirements.notes: External lateral inflow (e.g., upstream rural runoff coupling).

shared_requirements.name: Dry-weather sanitary flow

requirements.name: EM source frequencies / time channels / waveform
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: EM methods only. FDEM expects ordinary frequency f in Hz, NOT angular frequency omega (rad/s); f = omega/(2*pi). Wrong unit corrupts phase/amplitude silently.

requirements.name: inducing geomagnetic field (amplitude, inclination, declination)
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Magnetics only; total-field anomalies are typically 1-500 nT.

requirements.name: subsurface physical-property model (density / susceptibility / conductivity / resistivity / chargeability / velocity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: kg/m^3, SI, S/m, Ohm*m, V/V, m/s
requirements.model_input_format: model vector over active mesh cells, shape (n_active,)
requirements.notes: SI units are mandatory: density kg/m^3 (not g/cm^3; x1000), susceptibility SI (not CGS; x4*pi), conductivity S/m. Values are in MODEL space AFTER the map (e.g. ln(sigma) under ExpMap), not directly in physical-property space.

requirements.name: background physical-property value
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: For a log map the background is ln(sigma), not sigma.

requirements.name: air / inactive-cell physical-property value
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Must be a small nonzero value (1e-8 S/m / 1e8 Ohm*m, or ln(1e-8) under a log map); exactly 0 yields a singular stiffness matrix.

requirements.name: regularization weights alpha s / alpha x,y,z, depth weighting, sensitivity weighting
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: alpha_s (smallness, closeness-to-reference) vs alpha_x/y/z (smoothness); depth weighting counters potential-field kernel decay with depth. Default ratios assume ~uniform cells and need scaling on TreeMesh / stretched TensorMesh.

requirements.name: starting model m0
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: The Gauss-Newton iteration begins here; an over-large beta can leave the recovered model stuck near m0.

requirements.name: reference model m ref
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Enters the smallness term; biases the recovery toward known geology where data are uninformative.

requirements.name: finite-volume mesh discretization (cell counts, padding, mesh type)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Core region must extend >=2-3x target depth beyond the survey footprint with geometric padding (factor 1.3-1.5); TreeMesh recommended for large 3-D problems.

requirements.name: survey sources/receivers, locations, and measured component
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: z is ELEVATION (positive up), not depth. Receiver component (e.g. bz / tmi / bx) must match the actually measured field, else predicted data are silently wrong.

requirements.name: topography / active-cell definition
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Elevation positive up; passing depth (positive down) inverts air vs active cells.

requirements.name: observed geophysical data (dobs) with uncertainties
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: method-specific (mGal, nT, Ohm*m, A/m, V/m^2, T/s, ...)
requirements.notes: std = sqrt(noise_floor^2 + (relative_error*|dobs|)^2); noise_floor must be >0 (about 1-5% of |d|) to avoid overfitting noise. Magnetics in nT not T (Tesla inflates misfit ~1e18).

requirements.name: geophysical method and model map type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: method in {gravity, magnetics, dc, ip, fdem, tdem, mt, seismic, flow}; map in {identity, exp/log, reciprocal}. DC defaults to sigmaMap (conductivity); supplying resistivity needs ReciprocalMap.

requirements.name: model upper / lower bounds
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Bounds are enforced only by the bounded optimizer (ProjectedGNCG); InexactGaussNewton ignores them.

requirements.name: trade-off schedule (beta0 ratio, coolingFactor) and iteration limits (maxIter, maxIterCG)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: BetaEstimate_ByEig sets the initial beta; BetaSchedule cools it each outer iteration; target is Phi_d ~= nD (chi-squared criterion).

packages.name: SuperflexPy

requirements.name: Precipitation (P)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: numpy array of length n_timesteps passed via set_input(); flux order is element-specific
requirements.notes: Total rainfall flux. Framework is unit-agnostic; mm/d is the operational convention. Input array order differs by entry element (GR4J InterceptionFilter expects [PET, P]; HBV UnsaturatedReservoir expects [P, PET]) — wrong order silently produces nonsense.

requirements.name: Potential evapotranspiration (PET)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: numpy array of length n_timesteps via set_input()
requirements.notes: Drives interception, production store, and unsaturated/upper-zone reservoir AET demand.

requirements.name: Temperature (T)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Consumed only by the Snow Reservoir element; required only when a snow module is present in the assembled structure.

requirements.name: x1 (GR4J production-store capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Production store size; partitions precipitation between storage and percolation. Very high calibration sensitivity. KI documents conflicting defaults (SKILL table 50.0 vs tool/example 350.0).

requirements.name: x2 (GR4J groundwater exchange coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exchange flux magnitude. SuperflexPy sign convention: positive x2 = EXPORT/loss from the catchment (losing stream), negative = import (gaining stream) — per gr4j.py docstring 'Exchange flux (F), positive if loss' (CORRECTED 2026-08-22; this note previously taught the inverted sign).

requirements.name: x3 (GR4J routing-store capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Routing store size, controls baseflow depletion. KI default conflicts (table 20.0 vs tool 90.0).

requirements.name: x4 (GR4J unit-hydrograph base time)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: UH base time; controls peak timing. KI default conflicts (table 3.5 vs tool 1.7).

requirements.name: GR4J fixed shape exponents (alpha=2.0, beta=5.0, ni=4/9, gamma=5.0, omega=3.5)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: hardcoded element defaults in gr4j.py flux equations
requirements.notes: Canonical GR4J shape constants baked into the production-store, routing-store, and exchange flux equations; not normally calibrated.

requirements.name: HBV/HYMOD soil parameters (Smax, Ce, m, beta)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Smax = storage capacity (high sensitivity), beta = runoff partitioning exponent (high sensitivity), Ce = ET correction, m = smoothing coefficient. Smax/beta may be derived from soil databases (HWSD) via pedotransfer.
