requirements.notes: Internally treated as a per-step depth in metres; the 'h-1' BMI label is a misnomer when dt != 1 h, and the model is structurally only safe for dt = 1.0 in the inputs.dat header.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration (pe)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: TOPMODEL does NOT compute PET internally; it must be supplied (e.g., from Hargreaves or Penman-Monteith).

requirements.name: observed discharge (Qobs)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: inputs.dat column 3, per-timestep depth; optional, used only for diagnostic NSE and hyd.out comparison
requirements.notes: Read by inputs() in standalone mode; not a BMI input variable. Used by results() to compute internal NSE and to write the observed column of hyd.out.

requirements.name: szm
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exponential transmissivity-decay parameter; controls baseflow recession shape. szm > 0 is required (zero -> division by zero in qb = szq*exp(-sbar/szm)).

requirements.name: t0 (ln T0)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Input is the natural log of saturated surface transmissivity, NOT linear T0. The binary computes szq = exp(t0 + log(dt) - tl); supplying linear T0 silently mis-scales baseflow.

requirements.name: td
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Unsaturated-zone time delay per unit local saturation deficit.

requirements.name: chv
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Main-channel routing velocity used in the time-delay histogram.

requirements.name: rv
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Internal (overland) routing velocity used in the time-delay histogram.

requirements.name: srmax
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Maximum root-zone storage deficit; cap on ET supply and root-zone water available for percolation.

requirements.name: xk0
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Surface saturated hydraulic conductivity for the Green-Ampt option; consumed only when infex=1.

requirements.name: hf
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Green-Ampt wetting-front suction; consumed only when infex=1.

requirements.name: dth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Green-Ampt water-content change at the wetting front; consumed only when infex=1.

requirements.name: TWI histogram (lnaotb, dist area lnaotb)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: subcat.dat — 10-30 (ln(a/tanB), area-fraction) pairs ordered high to low TWI
requirements.notes: Derived from a depressionless DEM. Must be ordered HIGH to LOW TWI; the code does not check ordering and silently produces wrong qof if reversed. Area fractions must sum to ~1.0 (water-balance error otherwise).

requirements.name: channel network (cum dist area, dist from outlet)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Combined with chv and rv to build the time-delay histogram. Channel distances must be in metres, not km.

requirements.name: subcatchment area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used to convert per-step depth fluxes to volumetric discharge.

requirements.name: Q0
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial subsurface flow; init_water_balance computes sbar = -szm*log(Q0/szq). Q0 = 0 produces -inf and silently propagates as NaN.

requirements.name: sr0
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial root-zone deficit; must satisfy sr0 <= srmax (otherwise initial water-balance error).

requirements.name: infex (infiltration-excess flag)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch enabling the Green-Ampt infiltration-excess path; default 0 (off).

requirements.name: stand alone flag
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch: 1 = standalone driver (reads inputs.dat, writes topmod.out/hyd.out); 0 = BMI framework coupling (rain/PE injected by caller).

requirements.name: rainfall intensity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar per rainfall period (cri) and/or per-period intensity grids; step-function constant intensity over nper periods
requirements.notes: Strict m/s; supplied as nper constant-intensity periods. A negative scalar signals that a spatially-variable grid is read. May exceed infiltrability Ks, generating runoff.

requirements.name: steady background infiltration rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar (rizero) or grid (negative scalar = read grid)
requirements.notes: Pre-storm steady seepage rate setting the initial pressure-head baseline; should be < Ks. Internally normalized to the background flux ratio rikzero = rizero/Ks, whose sign affects the beta line and upward-seepage path.

requirements.name: residual volumetric water content

requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: forcing JSON field prec_mm_d (basin-average daily series)
requirements.notes: Basin-averaged daily precipitation consumed each timestep; partitioned to rain/snow by t_snow threshold.

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: forcing JSON field temp_K (basin-average daily series)
requirements.notes: Expected in Kelvin; model subtracts 273.15 internally. Non-finite values silently replaced with 288 K inside the loop. Passing Celsius collapses PET to 0 and forces all precip to snow.

requirements.name: incoming solar radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: forcing JSON field srad_Wm2 (basin-average daily series)
requirements.notes: Drives PET via Rn = srad*0.0864/2.45. Expected W/m2 (~100-300 daily mean); MJ/m2/d or kJ/m2/d mis-units produce catastrophic PET errors. Non-finite values silently replaced with 150 W/m2.

requirements.name: layer porosity fraction (layer porosity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per-layer void-space fraction; layer_cap = porosity*LAYER_THICK. Must be <1.0 (percent values inflate capacity 100x).

requirements.name: layer field-capacity fraction (layer fc frac)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: layer wilting-point fraction (layer wp frac)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: saturated hydraulic conductivity (layer ks mm d)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Default from Rawls/Clapp-Hornberger texture lookup with depth scaling. mm/h instead of mm/d makes percolation 24x too slow.

requirements.name: vertical percolation rate coefficients (perc1-3)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: L4 percolation is hardcoded to 0.0; only three percolation coefficients are honored by the engine.

requirements.name: lateral flow coefficients (klat1-4)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: baseflow recession coefficient (k base)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Draws L4 down to wilting point (not field capacity); too-low values let L4 grow without bound.

requirements.name: fast/slow reservoir recession (k fast, k slow)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: PET scale factor (pet scale)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Linear multiplier on PET; reasonable range [0.3,2.5], typical 0.8-1.5. Hargreaves PET is linearly sensitive to it.

requirements.name: degree-day melt factor (ddf)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: basin area
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Wrong area unit (ha vs km2) directly biases discharge magnitude.

requirements.name: direct-runoff fraction (f direct)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: per-layer soil water (sw[4])
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Starting far from equilibrium produces a strong first-year transient; first year (2-3 for L4) discarded as spin-up.

requirements.name: snow water equivalent (swe)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: SWE=0 default; mid-winter start in a snow-dominated basin misses the first spring melt peak.

requirements.name: fast/slow routing storage (S fast, S slow)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: snow/rain and melt temperature thresholds (t snow, t melt)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: routing split fraction (split)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: params JSON split (fraction of total runoff to fast reservoir)
requirements.notes: split->1.0 starves baseflow and overestimates peaks 2-5x; calibration bound typically [0.2,0.7].

requirements.name: run mode (simulate vs calibrate)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CLI mode selector; calibrate mode invokes differential_evolution against observed discharge

requirements.name: calibration window start / warmup
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Calibration start must exclude the spin-up year or the optimizer overfits the initial transient.

requirements.name: observed discharge (calibrate mode)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: aligned observed series Q_obs_m3s for objective/metrics

shared_requirements.notes: Basin-averaged daily precipitation consumed each timestep; partitioned to rain/snow by t_snow threshold.

shared_requirements.name: air temperature
shared_requirements.notes: Expected in Kelvin; model subtracts 273.15 internally. Non-finite values silently replaced with 288 K inside the loop. Passing Celsius collapses PET to 0 and forces all precip to snow.

shared_requirements.name: incoming solar radiation
shared_requirements.notes: Drives PET via Rn = srad*0.0864/2.45. Expected W/m2 (~100-300 daily mean); MJ/m2/d or kJ/m2/d mis-units produce catastrophic PET errors. Non-finite values silently replaced with 150 W/m2.

shared_requirements.name: layer porosity fraction (layer_porosity)
shared_requirements.notes: Per-layer void-space fraction; layer_cap = porosity*LAYER_THICK. Must be <1.0 (percent values inflate capacity 100x).

shared_requirements.name: saturated hydraulic conductivity (layer_ks_mm_d)
shared_requirements.notes: Default from Rawls/Clapp-Hornberger texture lookup with depth scaling. mm/h instead of mm/d makes percolation 24x too slow.

shared_requirements.name: vertical percolation rate coefficients (perc1-3)
shared_requirements.notes: L4 percolation is hardcoded to 0.0; only three percolation coefficients are honored by the engine.

shared_requirements.name: baseflow recession coefficient (k_base)
shared_requirements.notes: Draws L4 down to wilting point (not field capacity); too-low values let L4 grow without bound.

shared_requirements.name: PET scale factor (pet_scale)
shared_requirements.notes: Linear multiplier on PET; reasonable range [0.3,2.5], typical 0.8-1.5. Hargreaves PET is linearly sensitive to it.

shared_requirements.name: basin area
shared_requirements.notes: Wrong area unit (ha vs km2) directly biases discharge magnitude.

shared_requirements.name: per-layer soil water (sw[4])
shared_requirements.notes: Starting far from equilibrium produces a strong first-year transient; first year (2-3 for L4) discarded as spin-up.

shared_requirements.name: snow water equivalent (swe)
shared_requirements.notes: SWE=0 default; mid-winter start in a snow-dominated basin misses the first spring melt peak.

shared_requirements.name: snow/rain and melt temperature thresholds (t_snow, t_melt)
routing split fraction (split)
shared_requirements.notes: split->1.0 starves baseflow and overestimates peaks 2-5x; calibration bound typically [0.2,0.7].

shared_requirements.name: calibration window start / warmup
shared_requirements.notes: Calibration start must exclude the spin-up year or the optimizer overfits the initial transient.

requirements.name: Global reanalysis/forecast lateral boundary fields (3-D temperature, u/v wind, geopotential height, relative humidity, surface and mean-sea-level pressure)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Lateral boundary fields in wrfbdy_d01 (NetCDF), updated at interval_seconds; derived from interpolated met_em fields
requirements.notes: Drives the domain-1 lateral boundary tendencies throughout the run. interval_seconds must match the driving-data frequency (hourly=3600, 6-hourly=21600). 12-24 h spin-up recommended before the analysis period.

requirements.name: Skin/sea-surface temperature, soil moisture and temperature, land-sea mask, 2-m fields
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Terrain elevation, dominant land-use category, dominant soil category (top/bottom), slope category
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Monthly green-vegetation fraction, monthly surface albedo, maximum snow albedo, leaf area index, deep soil temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: geo_em.d0N.nc (GREENFRAC, ALBEDO12M, SNOALB) and met_em annual-mean deep soil temperature

requirements.notes: Radiation lookup tables must be present in the run directory at runtime or radiation crashes or uses wrong physics.

requirements.name: Scheme tuning coefficients (e.g. Kain-Fritsch entrainment/downdraft multipliers, CAPE consumption time, Noah saturated-soil-water multiplier, PBL momentum-diffusivity profile expon

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Q2D (specific humidity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: U2D (near-surface wind, u-component)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: V2D (near-surface wind, v-component)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: REFKDT
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Infiltration vs surface-runoff partition; #1 calibration parameter. Default 3.0; reduce to 0.3-1.0 for thin-soil mountain/semi-arid basins.

requirements.name: Soil hydraulic properties (SMCMAX, SMCREF, SMCWLT, DKSAT/SATDK, BEXP, SLOPE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: SMCMAX (max soil moisture) strongly influences flood generation.

requirements.name: NEXP (transmissivity depth-decay exponent)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Power-law exponent (default 1.0) for Ksat decay with depth in subsurface transmissivity T=(Ksat*D/n)(1-z/D)^n.

requirements.name: LKSATFAC (saturated conductivity multiplier)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: OV ROUGH / OVROUGHRTFAC (overland Manning roughness and scale factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: HYDRO.TBL (by USGS land class); OVROUGHRTFAC in Fulldom_hires.nc / hydro.namelist
requirements.notes: Default factor 1.0, range 0.1-10; controls overland flow speed and peak delay.

requirements.name: RETDEPRTFAC (surface retention depth factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Channel geometry/roughness by Strahler order (Bw, ChSSlp, MannN, HLINK)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: MannN channel roughness controls hydrograph peak timing and attenuation; default ~0.02-0.09 by order.

requirements.name: GW bucket parameters (Coeff C, Expon E, Zmax, Zinit)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exponential law Q=C(exp(E*z/Zmax)-1). Default Zmax 50 mm is too shallow for deep-aquifer basins (raise to 200-500); recommended Coeff ~0.04.

requirements.name: Lake level-pool parameters (WeirC/L/E, OrificeC/A/E, LkArea, LkMxE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Weir Qw=Cw*L*h^(3/2), orifice Qo=Co*Oa*sqrt(2gh); constant surface area assumed.

requirements.name: stream threshold (flow-accumulation channel-definition threshold)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Defines channel network density; must scale with basin size and routing resolution.

requirements.name: Soil moisture (SMOIS / SOIL M), 4 Noah layers
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Cold-start at field capacity over-generates ~237 mm/d day-1 runoff; discard 6-12 month spinup or reuse a RESTART.

requirements.name: Soil temperature (TSLB / SOILTEMP/TMN), 4 layers
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be non-zero (use 280-290 K); 0 K propagates NaN through the soil energy balance.

requirements.name: Snow water equivalent (SNEQV)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Cold start needs a full winter to accumulate.

requirements.name: GW bucket storage (z gwsubbas, init = Zinit)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Conceptual reservoir depth; needs months to equilibrate from cold start.

requirements.name: RUNOFF OPTION (runoff-generation scheme selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 1=SIMGM TOPMODEL, 2=SIMTOP, 3=Schaake96 infiltration-excess (default/only globally crash-safe), 4=BATS, 5=Xinanjiang/VIC (needs MMF_RUNOFF_FILE).

requirements.name: channel option (channel routing method selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 3=gridded diffusive wave (default); 1=Muskingum, 2=Muskingum-Cunge (require UDMP_OPT=1 + Route_Link.nc + spatialweights.nc).

requirements.name: GWBASESWCRT (groundwater scheme selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 1=exponential bucket (default), 2=pass-through, 4=area-dependent exponential (needs UDMP_OPT=1); 0 disables bucket and breaks water balance.

requirements.name: Routing activation switches (OVRTSWCRT, SUBRTSWCRT, CHANRTSWCRT, rt option)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: rt_option=1 (D8 steepest descent) is the only active overland scheme; rt_option=2 (CASC2D) is inactive in v5.2.0.

requirements.name: lake option (lake/reservoir routing selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 0=disabled, 1=level pool, 2=pass-through.

requirements.name: UDMP OPT (user-defined mapping toggle)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required (=1) for reach-based routing, area-dependent bucket, and compound channel.

requirements.notes: AGGFACTRT = Fulldom_x / wrfinput_x; DTRT must satisfy CFL DTRT_CH < DXRT/V_max.

requirements.name: domainSize
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: All spatial dimensions strictly in meters (SI); km/cm inputs silently produce explosive or microscopic networks.

requirements.name: domainSizeIncrease
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Oversize generation buffer; fractures are generated in the buffered domain then truncated to domainSize, which sets boundary-face flags.

requirements.name: h
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Minimum feature size; simultaneously the FRAM rejection threshold and the LaGriT mesh resolution. Must be < 0.5*min_radius (recommended < 0.1) and > 1e-3*min_radius.

requirements.name: fracture shape
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Elliptical, rectangular, or polygonal planar fractures.

requirements.name: size distribution (edistr/rdistr)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Selector per family; TPL exponent alpha, min/max radius, log_mean/log_std, or exp_mean parameterize the chosen law.

requirements.name: min radius / max radius
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Fisher kappa (ekappa/rkappa)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Controls orientation clustering: ~0 random, high nearly parallel. Too low overestimates connectivity.

requirements.name: orientation (theta/phi trend & plunge, or dip/strike)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Model default unit is degrees.

requirements.name: aspect ratio (easpect/raspect)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: p32 targets (e p32Targets/r p32Targets)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: fracture surface area per domain volume per family
requirements.notes: Fracture intensity; typical field range 0.01-10 /m. Used when stopCondition=1.

requirements.name: famProb / probability
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: permeability k
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Intrinsic permeability (NOT hydraulic conductivity K m/s). Cubic-law default k=b^2/12. Calibrated range 1e-15 to 1e-8 m^2; highest-sensitivity parameter.

requirements.name: aperture b
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Calibrated range 1e-6 to 1e-2 m. Cubic law amplifies aperture error quadratically into permeability. v2.6+ supports stress-field-based hydraulic aperture.

requirements.name: transmissivity T
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Under-documented input path; only permeability is exercised in worked examples.

requirements.name: fluid viscosity
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Hardcoded model default 8.9e-4 (water ~20C) when caller does not override; governs Darcy flux = (k/mu)*(dp/L).

requirements.name: fluid density
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: matrix porosity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Calibrated range 0.001-0.3; only used when tdrw_flag enabled.

requirements.name: matrix diffusivity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Calibrated range 1e-12 to 1e-9 m^2/s; cm^2/s confusion gives 1e4x retardation.

requirements.name: phi (graph-flow velocity porosity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Hardcoded default 1; edge velocity = flux/phi, so default makes velocity equal Darcy flux and directly scales travel times if not overridden.

requirements.name: seed
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: seed>0 reproducible; seed==0 substitutes a clock-based seed at runtime, making every run a different network.

requirements.name: stopCondition
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: nPoly
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: boundaryFaces
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

packages.name: icepack

requirements.name: accumulation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Surface mass-balance source term in the mass-continuity equation; positive = accumulation. If supplied as m w.e./yr it must be scaled by rho_w/rho_i ~= 1.09 to m ice/yr.

requirements.name: fluidity (A)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Glen's-law rate factor; normally computed from temperature via icepack.rate_factor(T). Typical 1-100 over T in [-30,0] degC. Can instead be inferred via the inverse problem.

requirements.name: temperature (T)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Bulk ice temperature, converted to fluidity A; valid 243-273 K. rate_factor switches Arrhenius branch at 263.15 K (cold Q=60 kJ/mol vs warm Q=139 kJ/mol).

requirements.name: friction (C)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Weertman basal friction coefficient for grounded models; must be non-negative, typical 0.01-0.1. Can be inferred via the inverse problem. m = Weertman exponent (default 3).

requirements.name: bed (b)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Bed elevation (negative below sea level); used to compute hydrostatic surface for grounded models.

requirements.name: Glen flow-law exponent (n)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default n = 3.0.

requirements.name: Weertman sliding exponent (m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default m = 3.0.

requirements.name: thickness (h)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Primary prognostic state; must be > 0 everywhere (min_thickness default 10 m). Negative thickness makes the action functional ill-defined and crashes the Newton solve.

requirements.name: velocity initial guess (u)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial guess for the diagnostic solve; using observed velocity as the guess greatly improves Newton convergence.

requirements.name: model type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: selection of IceShelf | IceStream | ShallowIce | HybridModel
requirements.notes: Selects the momentum-balance physics (floating SSA, grounded SSA+friction, SIA, or 3D hybrid).

requirements.name: dirichlet ids
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: list of mesh boundary segment IDs
requirements.notes: Boundary segments where velocity is prescribed (Dirichlet). Must be inflow only; assigning all boundaries forces u=0 everywhere.

requirements.name: side wall ids
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: list of mesh boundary segment IDs
requirements.notes: Boundary segments with zero normal flow (fjord side walls).

requirements.name: timestep (dt)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Prognostic timestep, typically 0.01-0.5 yr; CFL-constrained (Courant < 1, dt < dx/max|u|) for Lax-Wendroff stability.

requirements.name: glacier outline
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of LineString/MultiLineString with labeled boundary segments
requirements.notes: Mesh-generation input; must form a single orientable closed loop with inner features as holes.

requirements.name: mesh resolution (lcar)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: characteristic element length passed to the mesher
requirements.notes: ~500 m local to ~10 km continental; too small a value explodes element count and OOM-kills meshing.

shared_requirements.name: accumulation
shared_requirements.notes: Surface mass-balance source term in the mass-continuity equation; positive = accumulation. If supplied as m w.e./yr it must be scaled by rho_w/rho_i ~= 1.09 to m ice/yr.

shared_requirements.name: fluidity (A)
shared_requirements.notes: Glen's-law rate factor; normally computed from temperature via icepack.rate_factor(T). Typical 1-100 over T in [-30,0] degC. Can instead be inferred via the inverse problem.

shared_requirements.name: temperature (T)
shared_requirements.notes: Bulk ice temperature, converted to fluidity A; valid 243-273 K. rate_factor switches Arrhenius branch at 263.15 K (cold Q=60 kJ/mol vs warm Q=139 kJ/mol).

shared_requirements.name: friction (C)
shared_requirements.notes: Weertman basal friction coefficient for grounded models; must be non-negative, typical 0.01-0.1. Can be inferred via the inverse problem. m = Weertman exponent (default 3).

shared_requirements.name: bed (b)
shared_requirements.notes: Bed elevation (negative below sea level); used to compute hydrostatic surface for grounded models.

shared_requirements.name: Glen flow-law exponent (n)
shared_requirements.notes: Default n = 3.0.

shared_requirements.name: Weertman sliding exponent (m)
shared_requirements.notes: Default m = 3.0.

shared_requirements.name: thickness (h)
shared_requirements.notes: Primary prognostic state; must be > 0 everywhere (min_thickness default 10 m). Negative thickness makes the action functional ill-defined and crashes the Newton solve.

shared_requirements.name: velocity initial guess (u)
shared_requirements.notes: Initial guess for the diagnostic solve; using observed velocity as the guess greatly improves Newton convergence.

shared_requirements.name: model_type
shared_requirements.notes: Selects the momentum-balance physics (floating SSA, grounded SSA+friction, SIA, or 3D hybrid).

shared_requirements.name: dirichlet_ids
shared_requirements.notes: Boundary segments where velocity is prescribed (Dirichlet). Must be inflow only; assigning all boundaries forces u=0 everywhere.

shared_requirements.name: side_wall_ids
shared_requirements.notes: Boundary segments with zero normal flow (fjord side walls).

shared_requirements.name: timestep (dt)
shared_requirements.notes: Prognostic timestep, typically 0.01-0.5 yr; CFL-constrained (Courant < 1, dt < dx/max|u|) for Lax-Wendroff stability.

shared_requirements.name: glacier_outline
shared_requirements.notes: Mesh-generation input; must form a single orientable closed loop with inner features as holes.

shared_requirements.name: mesh_resolution (lcar)
shared_requirements.notes: ~500 m local to ~10 km continental; too small a value explodes element count and OOM-kills meshing.

requirements.name: gridded runoff (surface RUNOFF + subsurface BASEFLOW)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF runoff time series on HRU/grid; variable name, units, and timestep declared in control file
requirements.notes: mizuRoute expects a runoff RATE in mm/s. Surface runoff and baseflow must be summed before routing (omitting baseflow loses roughly 30-70% of total flow). Driving land-surface models (VIC OUT_RUNOFF+OUT_BASEFLOW, WRF-Hydro SFCRNOFF+UGDRNOFF, mHM) report mm/timestep, so a divide-by-timestep conversion to mm/s is a model input-contract requirement.

requirements.name: river-network topology (seg id, tosegment, seg length, seg slope, hru id, hru seg id, hru area, hru lat, hru lon)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (m for length, m/m for slope, m2 for area)
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF; variable names configurable via control-file vname_* mappings (HydroCraft seg_id/tosegment, NHDPlus COMID/toComid, MERIT Hydro RIVID/NextDownID)
requirements.notes: Defines every reach and its contributing catchment (HRU). tosegment==0 marks an outlet. Topology must be a single connected tree with valid downstream references.

requirements.name: reach hydraulic/geometry parameters (R SLOPE, R MAN N, R WIDTH, R DEPTH bankfull, RLENGTH, R STORAGE, SIDE SLOPE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (m/m slope, s/m^(1/3) Manning n, m width/depth, m3 storage)
requirements.model_input_format: RPARAM block derived from network NetCDF and parameter namelists; augmented params read only when hydGeometryOption / topoNetworkOption enabled
requirements.notes: Channel width may be estimated by a Leopold-Maddock power law W=a*A^b; default temperate coefficients are wrong for arid/tropical zones. Minimum reach slope clamped (model floor min_slope=1e-6; operational guidance applies max(slope,1e-4)).

requirements.name: routing-method parameters (wave velocity velo, diffusivity diff, KWT wave-scale, gamma-UH shape/timescale)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: velo m/s; diff m2/s; UH shape dimensionless; UH timescale s
requirements.model_input_format: parameter namelists (IRF_UH / KWT / HSLOPE) and control-file entries; defaults applied uncalibrated (velo~1.0, diff~800)
requirements.notes: IRF prescribed celerity+diffusivity; KWT/MC/DW celerity derived from Manning n and channel geometry. Several solver constants are hardcoded and not user-tunable: Muskingum weighting Y=0.5; KW/DW finite-difference nodes per reach=20; MC nodes=2; KWT particle cap MAXQPAR=20.

requirements.name: lake/reservoir attributes and operation parameters (is lake, lake id, lake area, lake max storage, lake min storage, d h d a; Doll03/Hanasaki06/HYPE blocks)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (m2 area, m3 storage, m/m2 height-area derivative)
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF variables added to network topology + RPARAM reservoir blocks (D03_*, H06_* monthly inflow/demand, HYP_*)
requirements.notes: Read only when lake routing enabled (is_lake_sim=.True.). lake_model_type selects level-pool/Doll(1), Hanasaki(2), or HYPE(3).

requirements.name: reach routing state restart (per-reach discharge, channel volume, wave/particle states, future-runoff queues)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: optional restart NetCDF (QFUTURE, QFUTURE_IRF, per-method wave/particle states, REACH_VOL)
requirements.notes: Optional; initializes reach states for a continued run. Absent for a cold start.

requirements.name: routing method selection (route opt / routeMethods)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: control-file route_opt selecting accumulation(0), IRF, KWT, KW-Euler, MC, DW
requirements.notes: Multiple methods may be active simultaneously; each emits its own routed-discharge variable.

requirements.name: hillslope-routing switch (doesBasinRoute) and accumulation switch (doesAccumRunoff)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: doesBasinRoute=1 applies the gamma-UH hillslope delay before reach routing; set 0 to avoid double-counting against a driver that already includes hillslope delay (e.g. Lohmann).

requirements.name: simulation window and calendar (sim start, sim end, dt, calendar)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: dt must satisfy CFL (dt < dx/c) for the conditionally stable KW-Euler and DW methods.

requirements.name: spatial remapping enable (is remap) and remap weights
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: control-file is_remap + remap-weight NetCDF (area-weighted grid-to-HRU mapping)
requirements.notes: Required unless runoff units align 1:1 with routing basins. Per-HRU weight sum should be ~1.0; grid and HRU-polygon CRS must match.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: uniform rainfall rate (rval)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Units are m/year, NOT mm/year or mm/day; convert mm/day via *365.25/1000. rval=0 yields zero runoff and no fluvial erosion.

requirements.name: spatial rainfall map
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: orographic rainfall parameters (ortime, rbgd, rmin, rmax, windx, windy)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Elevation-dependent precipitation recomputed every ortime interval; couples topography back to rainfall.

requirements.name: sea-level curve
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Time column in years, NOT ka/Ma.

requirements.name: tectonic vertical (uplift/subsidence) displacement map (ufile)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: single-column z-value displacement map, no header, per displacement event
requirements.notes: Map holds TOTAL displacement over the event duration, NOT a rate (m/year).

requirements.name: tectonic horizontal (3D) displacement map (dfile)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: single-column displacement map referenced by <disp3d>; triggers TIN mesh reconstruction

requirements.name: river point input (rQw discharge, rQs sediment load, rposX/rposY)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: rQw in m^3/s (NOT L/s); rQs in Mt/year (internally qs_m3 = rQs*1e9/rhoS, so kg/year is 1e9x too large).

requirements.name: SPL discharge/area exponent m (SPLm)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.5 when absent; canonical XML tag is <sp_law>/<m> (not <SPLm>).

requirements.name: SPL slope exponent n (SPLn)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 1.0 when absent.

requirements.name: SPL erodibility coefficient Kd (SPLero)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.0 -> NO fluvial erosion unless set (silent no-op). Units are dimensionally m-dependent; literature Kd must be calibrated with the same m,n. Bedrock ~1e-8-1e-5, alluvial ~1e-5-1e-3.

requirements.name: precipitation exponent l
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0 (off); climate-dependent weathering term, secondary.

requirements.name: aerial (subaerial) hillslope diffusion coefficient (caerial)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: m^2/year NOT m^2/kyr. Dominant denudation control on low-relief (<200 m) domains.

requirements.name: marine (submarine) hillslope diffusion coefficient (cmarine)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: critical slope Sc (non-linear diffusion threshold, cslp)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: river sediment diffusion coefficient (criver)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: mass-failure threshold slope (sfail) and failure diffusion coefficient (cfail)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: transport-capacity coefficients (kt, mt, nt, modeltype)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: XML transport-law elements; modeltype selects detachment vs transport-limited variant

requirements.name: flexural isostasy parameters (dmantle, dsediment, youngMod, poisson, elasticH)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: elasticH in metres NOT km (typical 5e3-100e3 m); youngMod default 6.5e10 Pa, dmantle ~3300, dsediment ~2500 kg/m^3.

requirements.name: sediment porosity / compaction (poro0, poroC) and grain density (rhoS)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: poro0/poroC default 0 disables compaction -> stratigraphic thickness 2-3x too large. rhoS default 2650 kg/m^3.

requirements.name: wave parameters (wbase, d50, hs, dir, wEro)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: d50 in metres NOT mm/um (sand 1e-4-1e-3 m); hs in metres NOT cm; wbase default 20 m.

requirements.name: carbonate growth rates (growth sp1, growth sp2) and depth/sediment/wave control curves
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: depthControl curve must be monotonic peaking in the shallow photic zone (0-20 m).

requirements.name: multi-lithology erodibility layers (erocst/eromap, thcst/thmap, actlay)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: XML <erocoeff>/<erolay> with spatial maps and layer thicknesses
requirements.notes: When active, per-node erodibility is dynamically updated from net erosion depth each step (not static).

requirements.name: initial topography (DEM)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: GeoTIFF/netCDF/regular-grid CSV (x y z) via <grid>/<demfile>; converted to TIN
requirements.notes: Elevation must be in metres with no NoData/NaN; regular uniform grid. cm/mm/feet silently corrupt all slope-dependent erosion.

requirements.name: initial erodibility/thickness layers
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: restart checkpoint (rfolder, rstep)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: XML <time>/<restart> referencing a prior output step

requirements.name: domain boundary type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: XML <grid>/<boundary> in {slope, flat, wall, fixed, outlet}
requirements.notes: Must match domain geometry; 'fixed'/'wall' on an open landscape ponds water at edges and prevents erosion. 'slope' for open domains, 'outlet' for single-outlet catchments.

requirements.name: flexure edge boundary conditions (boundary W/E/S/N)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: resolution factor (resfactor)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Too large drops effective resolution below feature scale; keep key features > 3x (DEM_res * resfactor).

shared_requirements.notes: Must match domain geometry; 'fixed'/'wall' on an open landscape ponds water at edges and prevents erosion. 'slope' for open domains, 'outlet' for single-outlet catchments.

requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source

requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: data error estimate (relative + absolute)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: per-datum error vector; default ert.estimateError() relativeError=0.03 + absolute-V from assumed 0.1 A current
requirements.notes: Fraction, NOT percent; sets the data-weighting matrix W_d and therefore chi^2.

requirements.name: zWeight (vertical smoothness anisotropy)

requirements.name: starting model (m0)

packages.name: pySTEPS

requirements.name: precipitation intensity field sequence
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: sequence of 2-D arrays (T, m, n) on a uniform Cartesian radar grid plus a metadata dict (projection, x1/y1/x2/y2, xpixelsize/ypixelsize, unit, transform, accutime, threshold, zerovalue, zr_a, zr_b)
requirements.notes: At least 2 consecutive frames required for motion estimation; typically 3-4 past frames at 5-15 min cadence. May be supplied as reflectivity (dBZ) or log-rain (dBR); STEPS works internally in dBR. Unit state is carried implicitly through the metadata dict, so the caller must ensure the correct transform domain; feeding dBZ where mm/h is expected produces chaotic motion and inflated nowcasts.

requirements.name: external NWP precipitation nowcast
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: precomputed NWP precipitation field array supplied to the blending path
requirements.notes: Optional. When provided to the blending module, the autoregression and advection steps are omitted for the extrapolation cascade and the NWP component is blended per cascade level by skill-dependent weights.

requirements.name: n ens members
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Source default 24; >=20 required for stable probability estimates, 48-100 for severe-threshold research; 1 = deterministic.

requirements.name: n cascade levels
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: integer number of FFT bandpass spatial scales
requirements.notes: Source default 6 (chosen via upstream issue #385). Must satisfy 2^n_levels <= min(nx, ny).

requirements.name: ar order
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: integer AR model order per cascade level
requirements.notes: Source default 2 (AR(2) standard); valid range 1-3.

requirements.name: zr a, zr b (Marshall-Palmer Z-R coefficients)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Source defaults zr_a=200.0, zr_b=1.6 when metadata lacks them; convert dBZ to mm/h before nowcasting.

requirements.name: velocity perturbation BPS coefficients (p par/p perp)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Tunable parallel/perpendicular velocity-perturbation scaling coefficients applied when the 'bps' velocity-perturbation method is active; they set lead-time-dependent motion-field uncertainty and ensemble spread. (The on/off SELECTION of the velocity-perturbation and noise methods is a structural switch, recorded under boundary_conditions.)

requirements.name: antecedent radar frame sequence
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: the most recent observed frames used to seed motion estimation and cascade decomposition at t=0
requirements.notes: pySTEPS is a stateless functional library: there is no persistent simulation state across runs; the antecedent frames ARE the effective initial condition for a nowcast call.

requirements.name: timesteps / n leadtimes
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: integer number, or explicit list, of forecast lead times
requirements.notes: User choice controlling the nowcast horizon; skill degrades significantly beyond 2-3 hours (e.g. 36 steps at 5-min cadence).

requirements.name: nowcast method (extrapolation / sprog / steps / sseps / anvil / linda)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting deterministic vs ensemble vs localized nowcast algorithm.

requirements.name: noise method / velocity perturbation method
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: method selector strings (noise_method e.g. 'nonparametric'; velocity_perturbation_method e.g. 'bps')
requirements.notes: Source defaults: noise active and velocity_perturbation_method='bps' ON for STEPS; 'bps' requires kmperpixel and timestep. Selecting/disabling these is a structural switch on ensemble spread (the tunable BPS p_par/p_perp coefficients are a separate parameter entry).

requirements.name: mask method / probmatching method
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Incremental masking requires timestep and kmperpixel (raises ValueError if timestep=None); CDF probability matching re-anchors each member to the observed field each step.

packages.name: wflow

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF forcing variable (precip), per cell per timestep
requirements.notes: MUST be mm/timestep (mm/day at daily Δt), NOT mm/s or mm/3hr; no internal unit check, so a wrong unit silently scales runoff by up to 86400x.

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF forcing variable (temp), per cell per timestep
requirements.notes: MUST be Celsius, NOT Kelvin; drives snow precipitation-phase split (threshold tt) and degree-day melt. Kelvin values silently break the snow module and PET.

requirements.name: potential (reference) evapotranspiration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF forcing variable (pet), per cell per timestep
requirements.notes: Required unless wflow computes PET internally (Penman-Monteith / De Bruin) from individual met variables; if missing or zero, all precipitation becomes runoff.

requirements.name: vertical saturated hydraulic conductivity (KsatVer)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 10-10000 mm/day. Units differ across models (VIC mm/s, MODFLOW m/day); cross-model transfer without conversion makes the soil 86400x too permeable.

requirements.name: horizontal conductivity fraction (KsatHorFrac)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc per-cell grid (multiplier on KsatVer for lateral subsurface flow)
requirements.notes: Sets lateral subsurface saturated conductivity = KsatHorFrac × KsatVer; in practice the primary streamflow calibration parameter.

requirements.name: Ksat exponential decay parameter (f)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Exponential decline of saturated conductivity with depth; controls baseflow-vs-quickflow partitioning and recession. Too low → flat baseflow-dominated hydrograph.

requirements.name: soil thickness (SoilThickness)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 500-5000 mm; controls total column water storage capacity.

requirements.name: Brooks-Corey exponent (c)

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: rooting depth (RootingDepth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: canopy/LAI parameters (max canopy storage, LAI, light extinction, canopy gap fraction, crop coefficient)

requirements.name: river/land geometry (slope, river width, bankfull depth, river length)

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Meteorological forcing (wind + atmospheric pressure)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.source_kind: NWP / parametric (GFS/ERA5/HRRR/HWRF or Holland parametric track)
requirements.unit: wind m/s; pressure mb (hPa) in OWI input, m H2O internally
requirements.model_input_format: fort.22 control + fort.221 pressure (mb) + fort.222 wind u,v (m/s) for OWI NWS=12; NWS selects format (8=Holland, 12=OWI, 13=OWI netCDF, 14=GRIB2)
requirements.notes: Required when NWS!=0. OWI header (iLat,iLong,DX,DY,SWLat,SWLon,DT) is rigid fixed-width; off-by-one grid dims shift the field (dt_007). Internal pressure unit is m H2O = P_Pa/9806.65.

requirements.name: Bathymetric depth DP
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Sign convention couples to all elevation outputs; flipping sign silently inverts bathymetry (dt_001).

requirements.name: Manning's n at sea floor
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Bottom-friction parameter; n outside ~0.01-0.20 causes div-by-zero (n=0) or blocked flow (dt_014).

requirements.name: Mesh geometry and connectivity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: fort.14 node coordinates + element connectivity + boundary node lists
requirements.notes: Boundary nodes must be ordered counter-clockwise (dt_018); mesh must be connected for the METIS-based domain partitioning used by the parallel solver (dt_020). The partitioning itself is execution-layer preprocessing (adcprep), not a physics step.

requirements.name: GWCE/numerical/friction control parameters

requirements.unit: mixed (DTDP s; G m/s^2; TAU0 dimensionless; ESLM m^2/s)

requirements.name: rainfall
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: volumetric rate per unit area applied via Rate_operator each step
requirements.notes: Rate_operator expects a rate in m/s; it adds (or, when negative for evaporation/abstraction, removes) water to the continuity equation. Negative rates also scale xmomentum/ymomentum by the local factors, so the rainfall operator can modify momentum, not only stage.

requirements.name: inflow discharge
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: prescribed total discharge via Inlet_operator, optional velocity direction

requirements.name: DEM / bed elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: terrain fitted to mesh as the 'elevation' quantity (per-cell under discontinuous-elevation DE methods)
requirements.notes: ANUGA uses raw elevation values without vertical-datum awareness; DEM and any prescribed boundary water levels must share the same vertical datum.

requirements.name: Manning's n (friction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 0.02-0.15 by land cover; 0.0 only for analytical benchmarks. manning_friction_semi_implicit is auto-appended to forcing_terms in Domain.__init__, so friction is always active.

requirements.name: maximum triangle area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: mesh-generation constraint (Triangle); optional interior_regions for local refinement
requirements.notes: Controls spatial resolution: ~100-1000 m^2 for real-world domains up to 10 km; 1-10 m^2 for benchmark accuracy.

requirements.name: g (gravitational acceleration)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Baked into the flux kernels; affects all wave-speed/celerity terms.

requirements.name: minimum storable height
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: config default 1e-3 m; cells shallower stored as dry in SWW (affects reported wet area)

requirements.name: minimum allowed height (H0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: algorithm-dependent: DE0/DE3 use 1e-12, DE1/DE2 use 1e-5; config global default 1e-5
requirements.notes: Effective value is set by the flow_algorithm method switch (DE0 forces H0=1e-12), not by config.py default.

requirements.name: CFL (Courant number)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Effective value is set by the flow_algorithm method switch (DE0 forces CFL=0.9), not by config.py default.

requirements.name: initial stage
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: set_quantity('stage', ...); for dry bed set stage=elevation so depth=0 everywhere
requirements.notes: Constant initial stage where bed varies produces a spurious startup shock; dry-bed requires stage=elevation at every vertex.

requirements.name: initial xmomentum
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: initial ymomentum
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: flow algorithm
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: set_flow_algorithm(); DE0 default (discontinuous elevation), DE1 higher order, 1_5 legacy
requirements.notes: Numerical-method / discretization switch (not a tuned physical parameter). DE0 silently overrides config-module defaults (cfl->0.9, beta limiters, minimum_allowed_height->1e-12, compute_fluxes_method->DE); the effective configuration is algorithm-derived, not config.py-derived.

requirements.name: Reflective boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: solid wall: interior quantities returned with normal momentum negated
requirements.notes: Use on upslope/lateral edges; all-Reflective traps water and grows total volume unbounded.

requirements.name: Transmissive boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required at catchment outlet so water can exit; oscillating boundary depth can spuriously inject/remove water and break mass balance.

requirements.name: Dirichlet boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: fixed constant stage / momenta at the edge
requirements.notes: Preferred for strict mass conservation at a prescribed-stage outlet.

requirements.name: Time boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: conserved quantities prescribed as a function of simulation time (tides, gate schedules)

requirements.name: File boundary / Field boundary
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: stage/momentum time series read from an SWW file, space/time interpolated (nesting); Field_boundary adds a mean_stage offset

requirements.name: boundary tags
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: dict mapping tag names to 0-based polygon edge indices (e.g. {bottom:[0],right:[1],top:[2],left:[3]})
requirements.notes: Wrong or untagged edge indices fail domain creation or misapply boundary conditions.

requirements.name: finaltime
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: evolve endpoint (or duration); yieldstep controls SWW save cadence independently

shared_requirements.name: rainfall

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Intrinsic permeability k
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: materials block (tensor); derived from soil texture/K_sat

requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 1e-6–1e-2 1/Pa.

requirements.name: van Genuchten n
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 1.1–3.0; high n (>2.5) gives stiff retention curves.

requirements.name: van Genuchten m
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: derived internally from n; m=1-1/n under Mualem (n=1/(1-m)), m=1-2/n under Burdine
requirements.notes: Wrapper-supplied n reconciles only under the Mualem rel-perm branch (default).

requirements.name: Mualem rel-perm pore-connectivity exponent l
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Defaults to 0.5 when 'van Genuchten l' not supplied.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Residual saturation S r
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: S_r = theta_r/theta_s; must be <1.0 (typical 0.05–0.35).

requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Sorption distribution coefficient Kd
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 0.001–1.0 m^3/kg; high transport sensitivity.

requirements.name: Gravity vector
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Wrong sign/magnitude inverts the hydrostatic gradient.

requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: chann lateral erosion / lateral erosion rate

requirements.name: creep rate (soil creep)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: slope failure thresh (landslide critical angle)

requirements.name: acab (surface mass balance)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Accumulation minus ablation; must be m/yr ICE equivalent, not mm/yr and not water equivalent. Can be supplied externally or generated by the internal PDD scheme.

requirements.name: artm (annual mean surface air temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Degrees Celsius, NOT Kelvin. Sets the upper thermal boundary condition; with temperature=0 it overwrites the column each step.

requirements.name: Glint climate fields (temp, prcp, arng)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: deg C; m water/yr; deg C
requirements.model_input_format: global lat-lon climate fields via the Glint interface
requirements.notes: Daily-mean 2 m air temperature, precipitation, and air-temperature half-range that drive the internal PDD mass-balance schemes; downscaled to the ice grid by Glint.

requirements.name: default flwa (Glen flow-law rate factor A)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Ice softness; sane range 1e-18..1e-15, default 1e-16. Used when flow_law=0 (constant); with flow_law=2 (Paterson-Budd) A is temperature-dependent.

requirements.name: flow enhancement factor
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on flwa; range 0.5..5.0, default 1.0.

requirements.name: beta (basal traction coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 2-D field on staggered velocity grid (y0,x0)
requirements.notes: Higher-order bed-stress coefficient (tau_b = beta * u_b). Required when which_ho_babc=5 (beta from input).

requirements.name: btrac const (uniform basal friction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Spatially uniform basal friction; range 0..1e6, default 0.0.

requirements.name: tauf / mintauf (basal yield stress)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Higher-order basal yield stress for plastic (Coulomb / pseudo-plastic) sliding.

requirements.name: geothermal / bheatflx (basal geothermal heat flux)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: CISM sign convention: NEGATIVE = upward heat flux into the ice base. Default -42e-3 W/m^2; range -100e-3..-20e-3.

requirements.name: ice limit (minimum ice thickness for dynamics)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Cells thinner than this are treated as ice-free; range 0.1..100, default 1.0.

requirements.name: lapse rate (atmospheric temperature lapse rate)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Vertical lapse rate used to reference surface air temperature to elevation for the PDD scheme.

requirements.name: thk (initial ice thickness)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 2-D field on scalar grid (y1,x1); must be >= 0

requirements.name: topg (bedrock topography)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Negative = below sea level. Sign convention error produces false floating ice (dt_012).

requirements.name: usurf (initial upper surface elevation)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: temp (initial 3-D ice temperature)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: relx (relaxed bedrock topography)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 2-D field; reference bed for isostatic adjustment

requirements.name: uvel/vvel (restart velocity fields)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: netCDF 3-D fields on staggered grid (level,y0,x0); restart only

requirements.name: dycore
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the dynamical core. Hard-coupled to the evolution option (Glissade requires evolution=3 or 4; dt_007).

requirements.name: which ho approx
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Higher-order momentum approximation, Glissade only.

requirements.name: which ho babc (basal boundary condition)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: which ho sparse (linear solver)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Value 4 requires a Trilinos-linked build, else runtime failure (dt_005).

requirements.name: which ho nonlinear (nonlinear iteration)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: temperature (thermal mode)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: flow law
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: evolution (thickness scheme)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: marine margin (calving scheme)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: isostasy
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: basal water
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Grid spacing in km instead of m shrinks the domain 1000x and corrupts velocities (dt_006).

requirements.name: Uwind / Vwind (10 m wind components)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ROMS atmospheric forcing NetCDF (xi_rho x eta_rho x time)
requirements.notes: Drives wind stress directly (prescribed) or via COARE bulk fluxes when BULK_FLUXES is defined.

requirements.name: Tair (air temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Expected in Celsius; Kelvin input silently drives runaway heat flux under BULK_FLUXES.

requirements.name: Pair (sea-level air pressure)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: mb (hPa); Pa input must be divided by 100.

requirements.name: Qair (specific humidity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Specific humidity, not relative humidity; valid 0.0001-0.04 kg/kg.

requirements.name: rain (precipitation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Internal flux unit kg/m2/s; mm/day must be divided by 86400.

requirements.name: swrad (shortwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Converted internally to temperature flux by dividing by rho0*Cp.

requirements.name: lwrad (longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: lateral open-boundary temp/salt/u/v/zeta time series
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ROMS boundary NetCDF (boundary x s_rho x time)
requirements.notes: Must be on the correct Arakawa-C stagger for each variable.

requirements.name: tidal elevation/current constituents (Eamp, Ephase, Cangle, Cphase)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ROMS tidal forcing NetCDF (xi x eta x tide_period)

requirements.name: river discharge
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: m3/s; m3/day must be divided by 86400 or estuary salinity is wrong.

requirements.name: open-boundary wave spectra / parameters
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Supplied when SWAN is the wave component on a regional grid.

requirements.name: theta s (surface S-coordinate stretching)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.1-10.0; high sensitivity on thermocline resolution.

requirements.name: theta b (bottom S-coordinate stretching)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Tcline (thermocline stretching depth)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 10-300 m.

requirements.name: VISC2 (horizontal Laplacian viscosity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 1-100 m2/s.

requirements.name: TNU2 (horizontal tracer diffusion)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0-50 m2/s.

requirements.name: rdrg2 (quadratic bottom drag coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 1e-4 to 1e-2; high sensitivity on bottom stress.

requirements.name: Zob (bottom roughness length)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.001-0.1 m, used with LOG_PROFILE.

requirements.name: Znudg (free-surface nudging timescale)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.01-30 day.

requirements.name: Tnudg (tracer nudging timescale)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 1-360 day.

requirements.name: rho0 (Boussinesq reference seawater density)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 1025.0; used in wind-stress and heat-flux unit conversions.

requirements.name: Cp (specific heat of seawater)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 3985.0; pairs with rho0 in heat-flux to temperature-flux conversion.

requirements.name: g (gravitational acceleration)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 9.81 (set to 1.0 in non-dimensional test configs).

requirements.name: h (bottom depth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Positive down (depth below MSL); GEBCO/ETOPO must be negated. rx0 should be < 0.2 to avoid spurious slope currents.

requirements.name: grid metrics (pm, pn, angle, f, mask rho)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: initial temp / salt
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ROMS initial NetCDF (xi x eta x s_rho)
requirements.notes: Must lie in EOS-valid range (T -2..40 degC, S 0..42 PSU); fill values (9999) produce NaN density.

requirements.name: initial u / v / ubar / vbar
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: initial zeta (free surface)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: With WET_DRY, must give h+zeta>Dcrit on intended wet cells to avoid checkerboard oscillation.

requirements.name: initial sediment bed (thickness, fractions)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Active only when the sediment module is enabled.

requirements.name: restart record (NRREC)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must match restart file time record or the simulation clock misaligns.

requirements.name: DT (baroclinic timestep)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Range 1-300 s; bound by CFL on the barotropic substep.

requirements.name: NDTFAST (barotropic:baroclinic substep ratio)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Range 10-60; barotropic dt = DT/NDTFAST must satisfy CFL < ~0.7.

requirements.name: Vtransform (S-coordinate transformation type)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: V2 recommended.

requirements.name: Vstretching (S-coordinate stretching function)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: V4 recommended.

requirements.name: BULK FLUXES (bulk vs prescribed surface flux)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: If defined, fluxes computed from atmospheric variables via COARE; otherwise prescribed sustr/svstr/shflux/swrad expected. Mismatch silently zeroes forcing.

requirements.name: WET DRY (dynamic wet/dry masking)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: RadNud open-boundary scheme + obcfac
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: obcfac range 0-10; too small reflects, too large ignores boundary data.

requirements.name: TIME REF (model time epoch)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must match forcing time units epoch or interpolation extrapolates / yields NaN.

requirements.name: coupling interval (TI OCN2WAV etc.)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be an integer multiple of every coupled component timestep.

requirements.name: NtileI x NtileJ tiling and node allocation
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

shared_requirements.notes: Range 10-300 m.

shared_requirements.name: VISC2 (horizontal Laplacian viscosity)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 1-100 m2/s.

shared_requirements.name: TNU2 (horizontal tracer diffusion)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 0-50 m2/s.

shared_requirements.name: rdrg2 (quadratic bottom drag coefficient)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 1e-4 to 1e-2; high sensitivity on bottom stress.

shared_requirements.name: Zob (bottom roughness length)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 0.001-0.1 m, used with LOG_PROFILE.

shared_requirements.name: Znudg (free-surface nudging timescale)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 0.01-30 day.

shared_requirements.name: Tnudg (tracer nudging timescale)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 1-360 day.

shared_requirements.name: rho0 (Boussinesq reference seawater density)
shared_requirements.notes: Default 1025.0; used in wind-stress and heat-flux unit conversions.

shared_requirements.name: Cp (specific heat of seawater)
shared_requirements.notes: Default 3985.0; pairs with rho0 in heat-flux to temperature-flux conversion.

shared_requirements.name: g (gravitational acceleration)
shared_requirements.notes: Default 9.81 (set to 1.0 in non-dimensional test configs).

shared_requirements.name: h (bottom depth)
shared_requirements.notes: Positive down (depth below MSL); GEBCO/ETOPO must be negated. rx0 should be < 0.2 to avoid spurious slope currents.

shared_requirements.name: grid metrics (pm, pn, angle, f, mask_rho)
initial temp / salt
shared_requirements.notes: Must lie in EOS-valid range (T -2..40 degC, S 0..42 PSU); fill values (9999) produce NaN density.

shared_requirements.name: initial zeta (free surface)
shared_requirements.notes: With WET_DRY, must give h+zeta>Dcrit on intended wet cells to avoid checkerboard oscillation.

shared_requirements.name: initial sediment bed (thickness, fractions)
shared_requirements.notes: Active only when the sediment module is enabled.

shared_requirements.name: restart record (NRREC)
shared_requirements.notes: Must match restart file time record or the simulation clock misaligns.

shared_requirements.name: DT (baroclinic timestep)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 1-300 s; bound by CFL on the barotropic substep.

shared_requirements.name: NDTFAST (barotropic:baroclinic substep ratio)
shared_requirements.notes: Range 10-60; barotropic dt = DT/NDTFAST must satisfy CFL < ~0.7.

shared_requirements.name: Vtransform (S-coordinate transformation type)
shared_requirements.notes: V2 recommended.

shared_requirements.name: Vstretching (S-coordinate stretching function)
shared_requirements.notes: V4 recommended.

shared_requirements.name: BULK_FLUXES (bulk vs prescribed surface flux)
shared_requirements.notes: If defined, fluxes computed from atmospheric variables via COARE; otherwise prescribed sustr/svstr/shflux/swrad expected. Mismatch silently zeroes forcing.

shared_requirements.name: RadNud open-boundary scheme + obcfac
shared_requirements.notes: obcfac range 0-10; too small reflects, too large ignores boundary data.

shared_requirements.name: TIME_REF (model time epoch)
shared_requirements.notes: Must match forcing time units epoch or interpolation extrapolates / yields NaN.

shared_requirements.name: coupling interval (TI_OCN2WAV etc.)
shared_requirements.notes: Must be an integer multiple of every coupled component timestep.

shared_requirements.name: NtileI x NtileJ tiling and node allocation
shared_requirements.notes: NtileI x NtileJ must equal NnodesOCN or MPI deadlocks.

shared_requirements.name: SWAN spectral resolution (direction / frequency bins)
shared_requirements.notes: Recommend >=36 directions, >=31 frequencies (0.04-1.0 Hz) to resolve swell.
