shared_requirements.notes: Snow-cover-fraction depth scale, default 0.1.

shared_requirements.name: kfix
shared_requirements.notes: Fixed snow thermal conductivity, default 0.24 (CONDCT=0).

shared_requirements.name: rgr0
shared_requirements.notes: Fresh snow grain radius, default 5e-5.

shared_requirements.name: Wirr
shared_requirements.notes: Irreducible liquid water content of snow, default 0.03 (HYDROL=1,2).

shared_requirements.name: z0sn
shared_requirements.notes: Snow surface roughness length, default 0.001.

shared_requirements.name: z0sf
shared_requirements.notes: Snow-free surface roughness length, default 0.1.

shared_requirements.name: gsat
shared_requirements.notes: Surface conductance for saturated soil, default 0.01.

shared_requirements.name: alb0
shared_requirements.notes: Snow-free ground albedo, default 0.2.

shared_requirements.name: vegh
shared_requirements.notes: Canopy height; 0 for open site. Requires VAI>0 to have radiative effect.

shared_requirements.name: VAI
shared_requirements.notes: Vegetation area index; 0 = open, conifer 3-6. Drives canopy presence, interception capacity, transmission, longwave.

shared_requirements.name: fcly
shared_requirements.notes: Soil clay fraction, default 0.3. Feeds Cosby-style pedotransfer (b, Vsat, sathh) computed once in the main program, not per timestep.

shared_requirements.name: fsnd
shared_requirements.notes: Soil sand fraction, default 0.6; fcly+fsnd<=1. Note hcon_soil derivation uses (1-fcly) as the sand exponent (apparent internal inconsistency).

shared_requirements.name: lat
shared_requirements.notes: Latitude in degrees, converted to radians internally (lat_rad = pi/180 * lat_deg). Used only when SWPART=1.

shared_requirements.name: zT
shared_requirements.notes: Temperature/humidity measurement height.

shared_requirements.name: zU
shared_requirements.notes: Wind speed measurement height.

shared_requirements.name: Dzsnow
shared_requirements.notes: Minimum snow layer thicknesses, default 0.1,0.2,0.4 (assigned only when Nsmax=3).

shared_requirements.name: Dzsoil
shared_requirements.notes: Soil layer thicknesses, default 0.1,0.2,0.4,0.8 (assigned only when Nsoil=4).

shared_requirements.name: Nsnow
shared_requirements.notes: Number of active snow layers; cold-start = 0 (no snow) when no dump file.

shared_requirements.name: albs
shared_requirements.notes: Initial snow albedo; cold-start init 0.8.

shared_requirements.name: Dsnw
shared_requirements.notes: Initial snow layer thicknesses.

shared_requirements.name: Sice
shared_requirements.notes: Initial ice content of snow layers.

shared_requirements.name: Sliq
shared_requirements.notes: Initial liquid content of snow layers.

shared_requirements.name: Rgrn
shared_requirements.notes: Initial snow grain radii; cold-start init rgr0=5e-5.

shared_requirements.name: Tsnow
shared_requirements.notes: Initial snow layer temperatures; cold-start init 273.

shared_requirements.name: Tsoil
shared_requirements.notes: Initial soil layer temperatures; default 285.

shared_requirements.name: Vsmc
shared_requirements.notes: Initial volumetric soil moisture; cold-start init fsat*Vsat (fsat default 0.5).

shared_requirements.name: Tsrf
shared_requirements.notes: Initial surface temperature.

shared_requirements.name: Sveg
shared_requirements.notes: Initial canopy snow mass; -999 sentinel where VAI=0.

shared_requirements.name: Tveg
shared_requirements.notes: Initial vegetation layer temperatures; init 285, -999 where VAI=0.

shared_requirements.name: Tcan
shared_requirements.notes: Initial canopy air space temperatures; init 285.

shared_requirements.name: Qcan
shared_requirements.notes: Initial canopy air space specific humidities; init 0.

shared_requirements.name: ALBEDO
shared_requirements.notes: 1=diagnostic (temperature) / 2=prognostic (age decay + snowfall refresh) snow albedo.

shared_requirements.name: DENSTY
shared_requirements.notes: 0=fixed / 1=age-compaction / 2=overburden snow density evolution.

shared_requirements.name: CONDCT
shared_requirements.notes: 0=fixed kfix / 1=density-dependent (Yen 1981) snow thermal conductivity.

shared_requirements.name: HYDROL
shared_requirements.notes: 0=free-draining / 1=bucket / 2=gravitational drainage snow hydrology.

shared_requirements.name: SGRAIN
shared_requirements.notes: 1=temperature / 2=temperature-gradient grain metamorphism.

shared_requirements.name: SNFRAC
shared_requirements.notes: 1=linear / 2=tanh / 3=asymptotic snow-cover-fraction parameterization.

shared_requirements.name: EXCHNG
shared_requirements.notes: 0=neutral fixed exchange / 1=Monin-Obukhov stability correction of turbulent exchange.

shared_requirements.name: CANMOD
shared_requirements.notes: 1=single canopy layer / 2=two canopy layers.

shared_requirements.name: CANRAD
shared_requirements.notes: 1=Beer-Lambert / 2=two-stream canopy radiative transfer.

shared_requirements.name: CANINT
shared_requirements.notes: 1=linear / 2=nonlinear (exponential saturation) canopy snow interception.

shared_requirements.name: CANUNL
shared_requirements.notes: 1=time/melt-dependent / 2=temperature/wind-driven canopy snow unloading.

shared_requirements.name: SWPART
shared_requirements.notes: 0=all SW diffuse (solar elevation forced 0) / 1=solar-position diffuse/direct split. Default 0 is a silent partitioning pitfall.

shared_requirements.name: ZOFFST
shared_requirements.notes: 0=height above ground / 1=height above canopy top for measurement heights.

shared_requirements.name: DRIV1D
shared_requirements.notes: 1=FSM native met format / 2=ESM-SnowMIP format (column order and humidity handling differ).

shared_requirements.name: PROFNC
shared_requirements.notes: 0=ASCII output / 1=NetCDF profile output (valid only for Npnts=1).

shared_requirements.name: Npnts
shared_requirements.notes: Number of independent simulation points; must match length of each &veg array. Default 1.

shared_requirements.name: dt
shared_requirements.notes: Timestep, default 3600 s; must match the forcing interval.

shared_requirements.name: start_file
shared_requirements.notes: Optional restart dump file; if absent the model cold-starts with no snow.

packages.name: FloPy

requirements.name: recharge
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: areal flux array (nrow,ncol) per stress period via RCH/RCHA package
requirements.notes: Commonly derived as R = P x recharge_fraction; source data typically in mm/day and must be divided by 1000 to model units. Unit mismatch is silent (heads can rise above land surface yet still converge).

requirements.name: evapotranspiration
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: head-dependent ET sink via EVT/EVTA package (max rate evtr, extinction depth exdp, ET surface surf, option nevtop)
requirements.notes: Head-dependent sink; source data typically in mm/day and must be converted to model length/time units. FloPy EVT defaults are placeholders (nevtop=3 highest-active-cell, evtr=1e-3 L/T, exdp=1.0 L, surf=0.0); a run left at default ET surf=0.0 / evtr placeholder gives meaningless extraction.

requirements.name: well pumping / injection
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: per-stress-period list of [lay,row,col,flux] via WEL package
requirements.notes: Extraction is NEGATIVE, injection POSITIVE in MODFLOW convention. Source rates in L/s (x86.4) or m3/hr (x24) must be converted to m3/day.

requirements.name: horizontal hydraulic conductivity (K / hk)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: NPF (MF6) / LPF-UPW (MF2005) array; hardcoded FloPy default hk=1.0 (placeholder)
requirements.notes: Literature K often in cm/s (x864) or m/s (x86400) to convert to m/day. Default value is an unphysical placeholder; a run left at default produces meaningless heads.

requirements.name: vertical hydraulic conductivity / anisotropy (K33 / vka)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: NPF (MF6) / LPF-UPW (MF2005); interpretation depends on layvka; FloPy default vka=1.0
requirements.notes: Typically 0.01-0.1 x horizontal K.

requirements.name: specific storage (Ss / ss)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 1e-6 to 1e-4; governs confined transient storage response.

requirements.name: specific yield (Sy / sy)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 0.01-0.35; governs unconfined transient storage response.

requirements.name: riverbed / streambed conductance
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: C = K_bed x L_cell x W / d_bed; K_bed typically 0.01-1 m/day. Using aquifer K or wrong geometry makes the river over/under-connected.

requirements.name: layer type (laytyp / convertible flag)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: LPF/UPW laytyp (0=confined; >0=convertible/water-table); MF6 NPF icelltype; FloPy default laytyp=0
requirements.notes: Default 0 (confined) is a common silent trap; water-table behavior requires convertible layers.

requirements.name: starting heads (strt)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Should be above layer bottoms to avoid initial dry cells; default 1.0 everywhere is unphysical for transient/nonlinear runs.

requirements.name: active-cell domain (ibound / idomain)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: BAS ibound (active/inactive/CHD flags) / MF6 idomain; hnoflo no-flow sentinel
requirements.notes: Activates/deactivates cells for the solver; inactive cells carry the hnoflo sentinel (-999.99 FloPy default).

requirements.name: initial concentration (transport)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Only for solute/density-transport runs.

requirements.name: constant-head boundary (CHD)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Specified-head Dirichlet boundary; too many or too-low CHD cells can drain the model.

requirements.name: river / general-head / drain boundary (RIV/GHB/DRN)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Exchange flux = conductance x (boundary head - cell head); stage/datum must match grid elevation datum.

requirements.name: spatial & temporal discretization (DIS/TDIS)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: DIS (nlay,nrow,ncol,delr,delc,top,botm) + stress periods (nper,perlen,nstp,tsmult,steady); MF6 splits into DIS+TDIS
requirements.notes: Steady vs transient flag per period; perlen units must match ITMUNI.

requirements.name: unit-system codes (LENUNI / ITMUNI)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: MODFLOW is unit-agnostic; all quantities must be in the chosen consistent length/time units. 0=undefined is dangerous.

requirements.name: solver configuration (IMS / PCG / NWT / SMS)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: IMS (MF6) complexity (SIMPLE/MODERATE/COMPLEX), outer/inner_maximum, outer/inner_dvclose; PCG/NWT for MF2005
requirements.notes: Iteration limits, closure criteria, under-relaxation, and Newton formulation determine whether and how the head field converges.

requirements.name: output control (OC)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: OC package + ipakcb/save_flows flags selecting which timesteps save HEAD/BUDGET
requirements.notes: Heads and budget outputs are ABSENT (not zero) if OC is misconfigured; gates the existence of .hds/.cbc.

packages.name: ForeFire

requirements.name: wind field (windU eastward, windV northward)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF landscape layers windU/windV (DIMT,DIMZ,DIMY,DIMX), or trigger[wind;vel=(u,v,w)] constant/time-varying in the .ff script
requirements.notes: Primary driver of wind-driven spread; enters the ROS wind factor. Must be m/s; time-varying wind triggers use absolute time from domain start.

requirements.name: fuel moisture (dead Md / live Ml, optional moisture layer)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Optional NetCDF moisture layer and/or Md/Ml columns in the fuels table
requirements.notes: Raises ignition energy and lowers ROS; spread stops above the moisture of extinction.

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Optional NetCDF temperature layer; ambient Ta also a fuels-table column
requirements.notes: Used in the Balbi ignition-energy balance; Kelvin required (Celsius gives negative ignition energy).

requirements.name: digital elevation model (altitude)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: altitude variable in landscape NetCDF (DIMT,DIMZ,DIMY,DIMX); from SRTM/Copernicus DEM/LiDAR GeoTIFF reprojected to UTM
requirements.notes: Topography; internal slope (and aspect) are derived from altitude and drive slope-driven spread. A flat layer yields slope factor = 0.

requirements.name: fuel type map (fuel index)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: fuel variable in landscape NetCDF (integer raster); each index selects a row in the fuels table
requirements.notes: Index 0 should be non-burnable (e=0). Max index in the raster must be < number of fuel rows or an out-of-bounds read occurs.

requirements.name: fuel combustion parameters (Rothermel/Balbi SI set)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: mixed SI (kg/m3, 1/m, m, kg/m2, J/kg, K)
requirements.model_input_format: Semicolon-delimited fuels table, one row per fuel index: Rhod, Rhol, Md, Ml, sd, sl, e, Sigmad, Sigmal, stoch, RhoA, Ta, Tau0, Deltah, DeltaH, Cp, Cpa, Ti, X0, r00, Blai, me
requirements.notes: Rothermel/Balbi require SI in the CSV and convert internally to Imperial; do NOT pre-convert. me is a fraction here. Applies to Rothermel and Balbi propagation models.

requirements.name: fuel combustion parameters (RothermelAndrews2018 Imperial set)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: Semicolon-delimited fuels table: fl1h_tac, fd_ft, SAVcar_ftinv, mdOnDry1h_r, fuelDens_lbft3, H_BTUlb, Dme_pc, totMineral_r, effectMineral_r
requirements.notes: RothermelAndrews2018 consumes Imperial fuel parameters directly (no internal conversion of fuel params). Dme_pc is a percentage. Applies to the RothermelAndrews2018 model only.

requirements.name: ignition points / initial fire front
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: UTM m (or lon/lat degrees), time s
requirements.model_input_format: startFire[loc=(x,y,z);t=T] in UTM, startFire[lonlat=(lon,lat,z);t=T] in degrees, or an explicit FireFront/FireNode node hierarchy
requirements.notes: Seeds the initial front(s); multiple and delayed ignitions are supported. Must lie within the loaded domain bounds and on burnable fuel.

requirements.name: loaded landscape state / domain extent
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: loadData[data.nc;timestamp]; FireDomain[sw=(...);ne=(...)] or inferred from the NetCDF extent
requirements.notes: Establishes the domain SW/NE corners and the t=0 landscape fields before ignition.

requirements.name: propagationModel
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the rate-of-spread model; MUST match the fuels-table unit system. Engine default is Iso (isotropic), not Rothermel/Balbi — omitting it gives trivial constant spread.

requirements.name: spatialIncrement
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Lagrangian space step used in dt = ds/speed; controls integration accuracy/CFL. Sub-1 m values over large domains create millions of nodes and can hang.

requirements.name: perimeterResolution
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Target spacing between fire-front nodes (re-meshing resolution).

requirements.name: relax (front smoothing / ROS relaxation factor)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Temporal relaxation of node speed: speed = (1-relax)*speed + relax*newSpeed.

requirements.name: windReductionFactor
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Midflame wind reduction for canopy effects. When < 1.0 Rothermel also switches to the Andrews/Cruz/Rothermel (2013) wind-cap formula Uf=96.81*Ir^(1/3) - an undocumented coupling. Set 0 suppresses wind entirely.

requirements.name: propagationSpeedAdjustmentFactor
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Global multiplier on computed ROS.

requirements.name: minSpeed / minimalPropagativeFrontDepth
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Stop thresholds: minimum propagation speed and minimum front depth for continued propagation.

requirements.name: time advancement command
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Without a step/goTo the simulation stays at t=0 and produces no advancement.

requirements.name: dumpMode / output format
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects serialization format for emitted fronts.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: LWin
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Vertical (normal) saturated hydraulic conductivity (1E-7 to 1E-3 m/s).

requirements.name: vwc r
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: vwc w
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: vwc fc
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Field capacity.

requirements.name: vwc s
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Saturated water content.

requirements.name: alpha
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: MinStomatalRes
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

packages.name: GLM

requirements.name: ShortWave (incoming shortwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column read per &meteorology; required for rad_mode 0-3
requirements.notes: Must be clipped to >= 0; un-clipped night-time negatives after interpolation can drive NaN temperatures. Daily values internally disaggregated to an idealized diurnal cycle.

requirements.name: LongWave (incoming longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column; consumed when lw_type=LW_IN / rad_mode=2
requirements.notes: lw_type selects handling: LW_IN reads this column, LW_CC computes longwave from cloud cover. Mismatch double-counts longwave and warms summer surface by 3-5 degC.

requirements.name: Clouds (cloud cover fraction)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column; required for rad_mode 0,1,4 / lw_type=LW_CC

requirements.name: AirTemp (air temperature at ~10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: RelHum (relative humidity at ~10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be percent (0-100), NOT fraction (0-1); a fractional value is read literally (0.7 -> 0.7% RH) and produces runaway evaporation.

requirements.name: WindSpeed (at ~10 m)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Outliers (>30 m/s) can destabilize the mixing solver and yield NaN temperatures.

requirements.name: Rain (rainfall depth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Native unit is m/day, NOT mm/day; an mm/day value is 1000x too large and causes continuous overflow. Rain partitioned to snow below snow_threshold.

requirements.name: Snow (snowfall depth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: met CSV column; consumed when snow_sw / snowice active

requirements.name: inflow FLOW (riverine inflow rate)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: inflow CSV column (daily); one file per configured inflow
requirements.notes: Inflow inserted at neutral-buoyancy depth set by its density relative to the column.

requirements.name: inflow TEMP (inflow water temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required; a missing/zero TEMP inserts 0 degC water forming an artificial cold density current that disrupts thermal structure.

requirements.name: inflow SALT (inflow salinity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Must be 0 for freshwater lakes; non-zero salinity raises inflow density and inserts the inflow too deep.

requirements.name: inflow WQ constituents (AED2)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: extra inflow CSV columns (NIT_nit, NIT_amm, PHS_frp, OGM_*, OXY_oxy, SIL_rsi, PHY_*) when AED2 enabled
requirements.notes: Absent nutrient columns give zero external loading; AED2 phytoplankton then collapse to near-zero biomass.

requirements.name: outflow FLOW (withdrawal/release rate)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: outflow CSV column (daily); one column per configured outlet; or internal natural overflow

requirements.name: Kw (light extinction coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Controls thermocline depth and light penetration; Kw ~ 1.7/Secchi_depth_m. Too high (>3) suppresses stratification; too low (<0.1) gives unrealistic deep heating.

requirements.name: coef wind stir (wind stirring coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets surface mixed-layer depth; too high prevents stratification in small sheltered lakes.

requirements.name: coef mix hyp (hypolimnetic/deep mixing coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: coef mix conv (convective mixing coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: ce, ch, cd (bulk transfer coefficients for latent, sensible, momentum flux)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: wind factor, sw factor, lw factor, rain factor, at factor, rh factor (forcing scaling factors)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplicative scalings applied to met forcing variables; wind_factor and sw_factor are dominant temperature calibration levers.

requirements.name: hypsographic curve H[] / A[] (depth-area, optionally volume)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: H[] and A[] must be monotonically ascending bottom-to-top with A[0]~0 and crest_elev=max(H); >=10-15 points recommended for realistic volume.

requirements.name: min layer thick / max layer thick (h min / h max)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Bound the adaptive Lagrangian layer thickness; max_layer_thick too small triggers layer-merge errors/hangs.

requirements.name: strm hf angle, strmbd slope, strmbd drag, submerged
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: outl elevs, bsn len outl, bsn wid outl, seepage rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: R growth (max phytoplankton growth rate)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets total phytoplankton biomass level.

requirements.name: I S (light saturation)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: w p (phytoplankton sedimentation velocity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Negative sinks, positive floats.

requirements.name: Fsed frp (sediment P release / internal loading)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Fsed oxy (sediment oxygen demand)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: initial temperature/salinity depth profiles
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: &init_profiles namelist (depth-value pairs; initial layers equal thickness)
requirements.notes: lake_depth must not exceed morphometry max depth (max(H)-min(H)).

requirements.name: initial AED2 WQ depth profiles
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: &init_profiles WQ entries; count must equal num_wq_vars * num_depths

requirements.name: rad mode (radiation mode selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects required shortwave/longwave/cloud combination; the supplied met columns must be consistent with it.

requirements.name: lw type (longwave handling: LW IN vs LW CC)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: subdaily (sub-daily forcing switch)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: subdaily=.true. with 3-hourly forcing produces flat/unrealistic temperatures; use daily forcing with subdaily=.false. unless forcing is hourly.

requirements.name: timefmt + start/stop (simulation time configuration)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: timefmt=2 for datetime strings, timefmt=3 for integer seconds; mismatch crashes the namelist read.

requirements.name: dt iceon avg + min ice thickness (ice model enablement)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Both must be set to enable the ice model; otherwise ice is silently disabled and surface temperature floors near 0.002 degC. For deep reservoirs (>50 m) dt_iceon_avg <= 0.04.

requirements.name: outflow mode (natural overflow / constant / scheduled / balance)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: num inflows / num outlets (inflow & outlet counts)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: num_inflows must match the number of inflow files; a count of 0 with files listed silently ignores all inflow.

requirements.name: AED2 module activation list (&aed models)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Phytoplankton requires oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus and organic_matter modules (silica for diatoms) listed before it; missing dependencies crash at init.

requirements.name: Precip
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: catchment-average daily precipitation total (sum of any sub-daily values), aligned 1:1 with DatesR
requirements.notes: Must be >= 0 with no NA (NA triggers a stop() at input creation). Sub-daily forcing must be SUMMED to daily, not averaged.

requirements.name: PotEvap
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: daily catchment-average potential evapotranspiration, aligned 1:1 with DatesR
requirements.notes: Either observed/pre-computed or derived from the Oudin formula (PE = GE*(T+5)/100/28.5 for T >= -5 degC, GE = extraterrestrial radiation from Julian day + latitude). Must be >= 0, no NA.

requirements.name: DatesR
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: continuous daily date vector (no gaps, no duplicates), same length as Precip and PotEvap

requirements.name: X1 — production store capacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical 100-1200 mm; calibrated in log space
requirements.notes: Maximum capacity of the production (soil-moisture) store.

requirements.name: X2 — inter-catchment exchange coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical -5 to 3 mm/day; can be negative (catchment loses water to groundwater); calibrated in sinh space
requirements.notes: Groundwater exchange term; sign sets water gain vs loss.

requirements.name: X3 — routing store capacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical 20-300 mm; calibrated in log space
requirements.notes: Maximum (one-day-ahead) capacity of the nonlinear routing store.

requirements.name: X4 — unit hydrograph time constant
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: scalar real; typical 1.1-2.9 d; calibrated via linear rescaling; hard physical floor 0.5 d
requirements.notes: Time base of UH1 (length X4) and UH2 (length 2*X4).

requirements.name: Production store initial level
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: fraction of X1 (default 0.30 * X1) or supplied state vector index 1
requirements.notes: Stores typically start far from equilibrium; >= 1 year warm-up advised (2-3 yr for arid catchments).

requirements.name: Routing store initial level
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: fraction of X3 (default 0.50 * X3) or supplied state vector index 2

requirements.name: UH1 / UH2 initial ordinate storages
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: default all-zero; or supplied at state-vector offsets 7+K (UH1) and 7+NH+K (UH2)

requirements.name: Warm-up period selection

requirements.unit: mm/day (daily); mm/hr at sub-daily step; mm in event mode
requirements.model_input_format: per-timestep precipitation time series at the subbasin
requirements.notes: At a sub-daily timestep the per-step depth must equal the daily depth divided by steps-per-day; missing days should be flagged (NaN/interpolated), not zero-filled, to avoid artificial dry spells.

requirements.name: temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Consumed only when snowmelt or temperature-based PET is active. Must be Celsius; Kelvin-valued inputs produce astronomically high PET.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Units are method-dependent and must match the selected ET method.

requirements.name: solar radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used by Priestley-Taylor PET when active.

requirements.name: Curve Number (CN)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar per subbasin (derived from hydrologic soil group + land cover)
requirements.notes: Controls total runoff volume; valid range 30-100. Sets maximum retention S = 25400/CN - 254 (mm).

requirements.name: Hydrologic Soil Group (A/B/C/D)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Infiltration class (A = high infiltration, D = low); feeds CN derivation.

requirements.name: initial abstraction ratio (lambda ia)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range 0.05-0.20; 0.20 classic SCS, 0.05 per Woodward et al. 2003. Higher values raise the rainfall threshold below which runoff is zero.

requirements.name: time of concentration (Tc)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Drives the unit-hydrograph time-to-peak Tp = 0.6*Tc + D/2.

requirements.name: Muskingum K
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Routing travel-time / delay; K > 0 required.

requirements.name: Muskingum X
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Routing attenuation weight; valid range 0.0-0.5 (typically 0-0.3). X > 0.5 yields negative routing coefficients and negative flows.

requirements.name: Muskingum Steps
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Number of routing subreaches.

requirements.name: baseflow recession constant (k base)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Linear-reservoir recession ratio; range 0.5-0.99, near 1.0 = slow recession. It is a dimensionless ratio, NOT a rate constant or conductivity.

requirements.name: recharge fraction
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Fraction of loss diverted to the groundwater/baseflow store (calibration parameter); range 0.01-0.20.

requirements.name: basin area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: basin slope / longest-flow-path length

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

packages.name: HEC_RAS

requirements.name: discharge (upstream inflow hydrograph)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Steady: '.fNN'/'.rNN' Section - Flow Data; Unsteady: '.uNN' boundary time series
requirements.notes: Primary forcing. Steady consumes one discharge per profile; unsteady consumes Q(t). HEC-RAS PRODUCES stage from Q — Q is conserved along the reach for steady flow and must not be treated as a model product. 1 m^3/s = 35.3147 cfs.

requirements.name: downstream stage or stage hydrograph
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: '.fNN'/'.uNN' Reach Boundaries section; type code 1 (Known WS) or 4 (Rating Curve)
requirements.notes: Only when downstream BC type is Known Water Surface or Rating Curve; otherwise the downstream condition is parameter-driven (normal depth or critical depth).

requirements.name: lateral inflow hydrograph
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional; supplied at internal cross sections for unsteady runs.

requirements.name: precipitation on grid
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional, 2-D unsteady only. Acts as a surface boundary input; HEC-RAS does NOT compute watershed hydrologic losses internally beyond simple infiltration options.

requirements.name: cross section geometry (station/elevation pairs)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.unit: ft or m (per project unit system)
requirements.model_input_format: '.gNN' Sta/Elev blocks per river station; preprocessed into '.gNN.hdf' hydraulic-property tables (conveyance / area-vs-elevation)
requirements.notes: Irreducible substrate parameter. Required at locations where discharge, slope, shape, or roughness change; at structures; at levee ends; around junctions.

requirements.name: reach length (LOB / channel / ROB)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: '.gNN' Type RM Length L Ch R
requirements.notes: Distance between successive cross sections, separately for left-overbank, channel, right-overbank.

requirements.name: main channel bank stations
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: 2-D computational mesh + underlying terrain
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Sub-grid bathymetry — fine-scale terrain integrated as cell properties on a coarser computational grid.

requirements.name: manning n (channel and overbanks)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Identical numerical value in English and SI — NEVER convert. Conveyance K = (1.486/n)·A·R^(2/3) (English) or (1.0/n)·A·R^(2/3) (SI); the unit factor is internal to the solver. Typical channel 0.025–0.05; typical overbank 0.04–0.15; physical range 0.005–0.5.

requirements.name: expansion contraction coefficients
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Default 0.1 contraction / 0.3 expansion for gradual transitions; 0.3 / 0.5 at bridges. Multiplies the |α·V^2/2g − α_prev·V_prev^2/2g| transition-loss term.

requirements.name: bridge / culvert / weir / gate coefficients
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Discharge coefficients and geometry for hydraulic structures.

requirements.name: theta (implicit weighting) and friction-slope averaging method
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Theta in [0.6, 1.0] for the implicit box scheme; friction-slope averaging method ∈ {average conveyance (default), average friction slope, geometric mean, harmonic mean}.

requirements.name: eddy viscosity / turbulence closure parameters (2-D)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Reynolds-averaged turbulence closure for SWE solver.

requirements.name: initial flow at upstream end of each reach (1-D unsteady)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: '.uNN' initial conditions section; or steady backwater warm-up
requirements.notes: Defines the steady backwater profile used as t=0 state for unsteady routing.

requirements.name: initial water-surface profile (restart)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional alternative to the warm-up; supplies WS at every cross section at t=0.

requirements.name: initial water-surface elevation per 2-D area
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Or supplied implicitly by a warm-up period.

requirements.name: initial bed elevation and gradation (sediment runs)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: ft or m; fraction by mass
requirements.notes: Active-layer composition initialised per cross section.

requirements.name: upstream BC type code
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects how the upstream end of the domain is closed.

requirements.name: downstream BC type code
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default Normal Depth (Type 3) uses bed slope as energy slope; induces an error band typically ≥ 5 km near the downstream boundary.

requirements.name: downstream boundary slope (when BC type = Normal Depth)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Slope is dimensionless — never scale across unit systems.

requirements.name: flow regime
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Mixed allows hydraulic-jump location; subcritical solves upstream from the downstream BC, supercritical solves downstream from the upstream BC.

requirements.name: unit system
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Controls the 1.486 vs 1.0 internal conveyance factor and the expected units of geometry/observed-WS inputs.

requirements.name: 2-D solver type (SWE vs DSW)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: DSW is faster but valid only when barotropic pressure gradient and bottom friction dominate.

requirements.name: gate openings, pump rules, rule-controlled structure states
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: varies (gate openings in ft or m; rule-time series)
requirements.notes: Time-varying operational decisions for hydraulic structures during unsteady runs.

shared_requirements.name: manning_n (channel and overbanks)
shared_requirements.notes: Identical numerical value in English and SI — NEVER convert. Conveyance K = (1.486/n)·A·R^(2/3) (English) or (1.0/n)·A·R^(2/3) (SI); the unit factor is internal to the solver. Typical channel 0.025–0.05; typical overbank 0.04–0.15; physical range 0.005–0.5.

shared_requirements.name: expansion_contraction_coefficients
shared_requirements.notes: Default 0.1 contraction / 0.3 expansion for gradual transitions; 0.3 / 0.5 at bridges. Multiplies the |α·V^2/2g − α_prev·V_prev^2/2g| transition-loss term.

shared_requirements.name: bridge / culvert / weir / gate coefficients
shared_requirements.notes: Discharge coefficients and geometry for hydraulic structures.

shared_requirements.name: theta (implicit weighting) and friction-slope averaging method
shared_requirements.notes: Theta in [0.6, 1.0] for the implicit box scheme; friction-slope averaging method ∈ {average conveyance (default), average friction slope, geometric mean, harmonic mean}.

shared_requirements.name: eddy viscosity / turbulence closure parameters (2-D)
shared_requirements.notes: Reynolds-averaged turbulence closure for SWE solver.

shared_requirements.name: initial flow at upstream end of each reach (1-D unsteady)
shared_requirements.notes: Defines the steady backwater profile used as t=0 state for unsteady routing.

shared_requirements.name: initial water-surface profile (restart)
shared_requirements.notes: Optional alternative to the warm-up; supplies WS at every cross section at t=0.

shared_requirements.name: initial water-surface elevation per 2-D area
shared_requirements.notes: Or supplied implicitly by a warm-up period.

shared_requirements.name: initial bed elevation and gradation (sediment runs)
shared_requirements.unit: ft or m; fraction by mass
shared_requirements.notes: Active-layer composition initialised per cross section.

shared_requirements.name: upstream BC type code
shared_requirements.notes: Selects how the upstream end of the domain is closed.

shared_requirements.name: downstream BC type code
shared_requirements.notes: Default Normal Depth (Type 3) uses bed slope as energy slope; induces an error band typically ≥ 5 km near the downstream boundary.

shared_requirements.name: downstream_boundary_slope (when BC type = Normal Depth)
shared_requirements.notes: Slope is dimensionless — never scale across unit systems.

shared_requirements.name: flow_regime
shared_requirements.notes: Mixed allows hydraulic-jump location; subcritical solves upstream from the downstream BC, supercritical solves downstream from the upstream BC.

shared_requirements.name: unit_system
shared_requirements.notes: Controls the 1.486 vs 1.0 internal conveyance factor and the expected units of geometry/observed-WS inputs.

shared_requirements.name: 2-D solver type (SWE vs DSW)
shared_requirements.notes: DSW is faster but valid only when barotropic pressure gradient and bottom friction dominate.

shared_requirements.name: gate openings, pump rules, rule-controlled structure states
shared_requirements.unit: varies (gate openings in ft or m; rule-time series)
shared_requirements.notes: Time-varying operational decisions for hydraulic structures during unsteady runs.

packages.name: HydroCNHS

requirements.name: precipitation (prec)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Internal area-to-discharge conversion (0.01*Area*10000/86400) confirms the model expects cm/day; mm/day, m/day, or kg/m2/s forcing runs silently with magnitude errors.

requirements.name: temperature (temp)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives Hamon PET (exp(temp/16)) and degree-day snowmelt; a monthly-mean resample of temp also selects the GWLF growing-season CN antecedent-moisture branch. Kelvin input silently saturates PET seasonality.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration (pet)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Optional. If omitted, computed internally by Hamon from temperature + subbasin latitude + Julian day; PET forced to 0 where temp<=0. Pre-supplying it avoids recomputation each calibration run.

requirements.name: CN2 (SCS runoff curve number)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: RainfallRunoff entry in model.yaml; -99 flags for calibration
requirements.notes: Range [25,100]; most sensitive GWLF parameter. Internally converted to dry/wet CN1/CN3 and detention DSkt.

requirements.name: IS (interception fraction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Res (baseflow recession coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [1e-3,0.5]; sets groundwater discharge Gt=Res*St.

requirements.name: Sep (deep seepage fraction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,0.5]; deep seepage Dt=Sep*St lost from the basin.

requirements.name: Alpha (groundwater discharge / baseflow coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1]. Docs/KI overlap Alpha (baseflow rate) vs Res (recession); both govern shallow-groundwater discharge.

requirements.name: Beta (unsaturated-zone percolation coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [0,1].

requirements.name: Ur (available soil water capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Range [1,15]; water-stress onset Ks ramps below 0.5*Ur. mm input silently suppresses runoff.

requirements.name: Df (degree-day snowmelt coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: md.smb.mass balance
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex field on the mesh (or SMBcomponents: accumulation/runoff/evaporation)
requirements.notes: Prescribed surface mass balance; SMBgradients variant is in mm/yr water equivalent. Common unit trap: datasets in kg/m^2/yr or mm w.e./yr must be converted via division by rho_ice (917).

requirements.name: md.thermal.spctemperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex Dirichlet surface-temperature constraint (NaN = free node)
requirements.notes: Surface temperature boundary forcing for the thermal solve; must be in Kelvin.

requirements.name: md.basalforcings.geothermalflux
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex field (Neumann basal flux for thermal solve)
requirements.notes: Common trap: geothermal datasets in mW/m^2 are off by 1000x.

requirements.name: md.basalforcings.groundedice melting rate / floatingice melting rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Floating-ice melt enters the shelf thickness budget; can also be computed by a basal-melt parameterization (linear/quadratic/PICO/ISMIP6).

requirements.name: md.materials.rheology B
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: per-element ice-hardness field; default 1e8, typically set via paterson(T_in_K)
requirements.notes: Glen's flow-law ice hardness (B convention). Trap: Glen's fluidity A must be converted as B = A^(-1/n), not used directly. Units reduce to Pa s^(1/3) only when n=3.

requirements.name: md.materials.rheology n
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: md.materials.rho ice / rho water / rho freshwater
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: rho_ice and rho_water set flotation and hydrostatic base; using freshwater 1000 instead of seawater 1023 for marine ice sheets shifts the grounding line.

requirements.name: md.materials.heatcapacity / latentheat / thermalconductivity / meltingpoint / beta
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Clausius-Clapeyron beta sets pressure-dependence of the melting point; meltingpoint is the 1-atm pressure-melting reference.

requirements.name: md.friction.coefficient
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: law-dependent (e.g. (Pa m^-1 s)^(1/2) for the default law)
requirements.notes: MUST be 0 on floating ice (ocean_levelset < 0), else artificial drag slows shelves. Dimensional meaning depends on the configured friction law (p/q exponents).

requirements.name: md.friction.p / md.friction.q
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: md.geometry.bed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Static substrate; consumed by the flotation criterion.

requirements.name: md.geometry.surface / base / thickness
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex geometry fields; surface = base + thickness must hold
requirements.notes: Initial ice geometry; thickness evolves prognostically in transient runs. Inconsistent surface/base/thickness causes solver instability. Trap: thickness in km is off by 1000x.

requirements.name: md.initialization.vx / vy / vz
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex initial velocity (initial guess; transient flux)
requirements.notes: For transient runs, seed from a prior Stressbalance solve; zero/NaN initial velocity gives a spurious first-step jump. Trap: m/s input is off by ~3.15e7.

requirements.name: md.initialization.temperature
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Trap: Celsius input shifts by 273.15 and corrupts paterson()-derived rheology.

requirements.name: md.initialization.pressure
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex initial pressure (preferably computed from geometry)

requirements.name: md.initialization.waterfraction
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex temperate-ice liquid water fraction (enthalpy formulation)

requirements.name: domain outline / ice-front contour
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: closed .exp Argus contour polygon in projected meters (read by expread)
requirements.notes: Defines the meshed domain; Front contour sets the ice-shelf / marine boundary. Trap: degree (lat/lon) coordinates give a microscopic mesh; reproject to polar stereographic (EPSG:3031/3413).

requirements.name: mesh resolution / hmin / hmax / gradation
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Trap: resolution in km yields too-fine or too-coarse meshes.

requirements.name: md.mask.ocean levelset / ice levelset
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex signed-distance levelsets; negative = inside (ocean_levelset<0 floating, ice_levelset<0 ice present)
requirements.notes: Partitions grounded/floating and ice/no-ice. Inverted sign convention inverts the velocity pattern.

requirements.name: md.stressbalance.spcvx / spcvy
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-vertex Dirichlet velocity constraint (NaN = free node)
requirements.notes: Use NaN, not 0, for free nodes; 0 constrains the node and creates artificial frozen interiors/divides.

requirements.name: md.flowequation (approximation choice)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: flow-equation selector: SIA / SSA / L1L2 / MOLHO / HO / FS, assigned by setflowequation()
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the momentum approximation; wrong choice for the regime degrades magnitudes (e.g. SSA on slow grounded interior).

requirements.name: md.groundingline.migration / md.masstransport.stabilization / md.thermal.isenthalpy / md.friction.coupling
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: method/scheme selectors (migration scheme; stabilization 0-5; enthalpy on/off; effective-pressure coupling 0-4)
requirements.notes: Numerical-scheme and formulation switches. Advection-dominated thermal/mass-transport equations require stabilization (artificial diffusion or SUPG).

requirements.name: md.timestepping.start time / final time / time step / time adapt / cfl coefficient
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Time step must satisfy the CFL condition dt < dx/max(vel); too-large steps make transient thickness oscillate or diverge.

shared_requirements.name: md.smb.mass_balance
shared_requirements.notes: Prescribed surface mass balance; SMBgradients variant is in mm/yr water equivalent. Common unit trap: datasets in kg/m^2/yr or mm w.e./yr must be converted via division by rho_ice (917).

shared_requirements.name: md.thermal.spctemperature
shared_requirements.notes: Surface temperature boundary forcing for the thermal solve; must be in Kelvin.

shared_requirements.name: md.basalforcings.geothermalflux
shared_requirements.notes: Common trap: geothermal datasets in mW/m^2 are off by 1000x.

shared_requirements.name: md.basalforcings.groundedice_melting_rate / floatingice_melting_rate
shared_requirements.notes: Floating-ice melt enters the shelf thickness budget; can also be computed by a basal-melt parameterization (linear/quadratic/PICO/ISMIP6).

shared_requirements.name: md.materials.rheology_B
shared_requirements.notes: Glen's flow-law ice hardness (B convention). Trap: Glen's fluidity A must be converted as B = A^(-1/n), not used directly. Units reduce to Pa s^(1/3) only when n=3.

shared_requirements.name: md.materials.rho_ice / rho_water / rho_freshwater
shared_requirements.notes: rho_ice and rho_water set flotation and hydrostatic base; using freshwater 1000 instead of seawater 1023 for marine ice sheets shifts the grounding line.

shared_requirements.name: md.materials.heatcapacity / latentheat / thermalconductivity / meltingpoint / beta
shared_requirements.notes: Clausius-Clapeyron beta sets pressure-dependence of the melting point; meltingpoint is the 1-atm pressure-melting reference.

shared_requirements.name: md.friction.coefficient
shared_requirements.unit: law-dependent (e.g. (Pa m^-1 s)^(1/2) for the default law)
shared_requirements.notes: MUST be 0 on floating ice (ocean_levelset < 0), else artificial drag slows shelves. Dimensional meaning depends on the configured friction law (p/q exponents).

shared_requirements.name: md.geometry.bed
shared_requirements.notes: Static substrate; consumed by the flotation criterion.

shared_requirements.name: md.geometry.surface / base / thickness
shared_requirements.notes: Initial ice geometry; thickness evolves prognostically in transient runs. Inconsistent surface/base/thickness causes solver instability. Trap: thickness in km is off by 1000x.

shared_requirements.name: md.initialization.vx / vy / vz
shared_requirements.notes: For transient runs, seed from a prior Stressbalance solve; zero/NaN initial velocity gives a spurious first-step jump. Trap: m/s input is off by ~3.15e7.

shared_requirements.name: md.initialization.temperature
shared_requirements.notes: Trap: Celsius input shifts by 273.15 and corrupts paterson()-derived rheology.

shared_requirements.name: domain outline / ice-front contour
shared_requirements.notes: Defines the meshed domain; Front contour sets the ice-shelf / marine boundary. Trap: degree (lat/lon) coordinates give a microscopic mesh; reproject to polar stereographic (EPSG:3031/3413).

shared_requirements.name: mesh resolution / hmin / hmax / gradation
shared_requirements.notes: Trap: resolution in km yields too-fine or too-coarse meshes.

shared_requirements.name: md.mask.ocean_levelset / ice_levelset
shared_requirements.notes: Partitions grounded/floating and ice/no-ice. Inverted sign convention inverts the velocity pattern.

shared_requirements.name: md.stressbalance.spcvx / spcvy
shared_requirements.notes: Use NaN, not 0, for free nodes; 0 constrains the node and creates artificial frozen interiors/divides.

shared_requirements.name: md.flowequation (approximation choice)
shared_requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the momentum approximation; wrong choice for the regime degrades magnitudes (e.g. SSA on slow grounded interior).

shared_requirements.name: md.groundingline.migration / md.masstransport.stabilization / md.thermal.isenthalpy / md.friction.coupling
shared_requirements.notes: Numerical-scheme and formulation switches. Advection-dominated thermal/mass-transport equations require stabilization (artificial diffusion or SUPG).

shared_requirements.name: md.timestepping.start_time / final_time / time_step / time_adapt / cfl_coefficient
shared_requirements.notes: Time step must satisfy the CFL condition dt < dx/max(vel); too-large steps make transient thickness oscillate or diverge.

requirements.name: Precipitation (pr / P)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (PrecipitationMaps)
requirements.notes: Total liquid+solid precipitation; PrScaling converts from input unit to mm/timestep; negative values clipped to 0. Unit confusion (m/day, mm/3hr) is silent and shifts discharge ~1000x.

requirements.name: Average air temperature (ta / T avg)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (TavgMaps)
requirements.notes: Drives rain/snow partitioning and frost index; the TemperatureInKelvin flag must match the input units or snow thresholds shift by 273.15.

requirements.name: Reference (potential) evapotranspiration (et0 / ET0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (ET0Maps); preparable with LISVAP
requirements.notes: Must be POTENTIAL ET; LISFLOOD reduces it internally via soil-moisture stress. Supplying actual ET silently double-reduces evaporation.

requirements.name: Potential open-water evaporation (e0 / EW0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series (E0Maps); preparable with LISVAP
requirements.notes: Penman open-water rate (~1.05 × et0); a distinct required input.

requirements.name: Potential bare-soil evaporation (ES0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF stack or PCRaster map series; preparable with LISVAP
requirements.notes: Potential evaporation from bare soil; reduced internally by soil-moisture availability.

requirements.name: Local Drainage Direction (Ldd)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: initial topography / DEM (topographic  elevation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: node field topographic__elevation on the model grid (read from gridded elevation; must be projected to a metric CRS)
requirements.notes: Bottom-to-top node ordering; NoData must be masked and set to a closed boundary; elevation in meters (feet inflates slopes ~3.28x).

requirements.name: rainfall / runoff (water  unit flux in)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: node field water__unit_flux_in consumed by FlowAccumulator (scalar or time series)
requirements.notes: Must be m/s; mm/hr or mm/day inflate discharge by ~3.6e6x. For landscape-evolution runs commonly a uniform runoff_rate.

requirements.name: K sp (stream-power erodibility)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: StreamPowerEroder coefficient in E = K A^m S^n
requirements.notes: Units depend on m_sp,n_sp; a K calibrated for one exponent set is dimensionally invalid for another. Default 0.001 is dimensionally ambiguous and application-specific.

requirements.name: m sp (drainage-area exponent)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: StreamPowerEroder area exponent in E = K A^m S^n
requirements.notes: Typical 0.3-0.7; m_sp/n_sp ratio sets steady-state concavity (theta = m/n). Default 0.5.

requirements.name: n sp (slope exponent)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: StreamPowerEroder slope exponent in E = K A^m S^n
requirements.notes: Typical 0.7-2.0. Default 1.0.

requirements.name: linear diffusivity (D)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: LinearDiffuser hillslope transport coefficient q = -D grad(z)
requirements.notes: Must share time units with dt; literature m^2/s values need conversion. Default 0.01.

requirements.name: v s (effective settling velocity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: ErosionDeposition/SPACE deposition term controlling transport-vs-detachment regime
requirements.notes: Sets deposition length scale; b->0.5 (detachment-limited) at high v_s, b->1.0 (transport-limited) at low v_s. Default 1.0.

requirements.name: K sed / K br (SPACE alluvium / bedrock erodibility)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Bedrock vs alluvium erodibility in the SPACE bedrock-alluvium law.

requirements.name: H star (alluvial cover decay depth)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Sets how alluvial thickness shields bedrock from erosion.

requirements.name: soil production maximum rate (P0)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: ExponentialWeatherer maximum production in P = P0 exp(-H/H*)

requirements.name: soil production decay depth (H*)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: mannings n (overland-flow roughness)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Manning n (0.01-0.1), NOT Chezy C; confusing the two inverts/rescales velocity. Default 0.03.

requirements.name: soil  depth (initial regolith thickness)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: node field soil__depth at simulation start
requirements.notes: Must be meters (HWSD cm read as m collapses weathering and SPACE). For SPACE concavity tests initialize > 0 (e.g. 2 m) or SPACE falls back to bedrock-only mode.

requirements.name: bedrock  elevation
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: SPACE/ErosionDeposition auto-create this if absent and maintain the topo = bedrock + soil invariant.

requirements.name: grid type and geometry
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: grid class (RasterModelGrid/HexModelGrid/VoronoiDelaunayGrid/NetworkModelGrid/IcosphereGlobalGrid) with shape and xy_spacing in meters
requirements.notes: xy_spacing must be meters; degrees (unreprojected WGS84) inflate slopes ~1e5x.

requirements.name: timestep dt
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: dt argument to each component's run_one_step(dt)
requirements.notes: Must share time units with all rate parameters; mismatch (s vs yr) rescales all rates by ~3.15e7.

requirements.name: boundary-node status (status at node)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-node BC: CORE / FIXED_VALUE / FIXED_GRADIENT / LOOPED / CLOSED, set before component instantiation
requirements.notes: At least one open (FIXED_VALUE) outlet required or drainage_area=0. closed_all_but_outlet for watershed sediment-yield; open_all for DEM slope-area clips.

requirements.name: uplift rate (tectonic forcing)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: applied in the user time loop as z[core_nodes] += uplift_rate * dt before flow routing
requirements.notes: Only core nodes uplifted; never fixed-value boundary nodes.

requirements.name: runoff rate (steady-state discharge scaling)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: FlowAccumulator multiplier: steady-state Q = drainage_area * runoff_rate
requirements.notes: Must be consistent with the basin (e.g. Q_mean*3.156e7/(A_basin*1e6)) or SPACE SSC-Q rating curves are wrong.

requirements.name: flow-routing / depression-handling method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: FlowAccumulator flow_director choice (D8/Dinf/MFD) and optional depression_finder (DepressionFinderAndRouter / PriorityFloodFlowRouter)
requirements.notes: Depression routing is not automatic; real DEMs need it or flow stalls at pits.

packages.name: Lohmann_Routing

requirements.name: surface runoff
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Per-cell daily VIC flux ASCII file (7-column: year month day prec evap runoff baseflow); only column 6 (runoff) is read
requirements.notes: Valid model range 0-500 mm/day. Read in MAKE_CONVOLUTION; converted to m3/s via FACTOR = fraction*area/86400 then *1/1000 (mm->m). Feeding raw 22-column VIC flux files reads the wrong column and yields extreme/negative discharge.

requirements.name: baseflow
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Per-cell daily VIC flux ASCII file; column 7 (baseflow) is read
requirements.notes: Valid model range 0-100 mm/day. Summed with surface_runoff inside the routing module to give total per-cell channel inflow.

requirements.name: velocity (channel wave celerity C)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Scalar default 1.5 m/s (INIT_ARRAY when rout_global flag is .false.) or per-cell ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header
requirements.notes: Most-calibrated channel parameter. Documented ranges 1-3 m/s (Weser), 0.5-2.0 m/s (Columbia). Used in MAKE_UHM (Lohmann eq.15). Model-side valid range 0.5-5.0 m/s.

requirements.name: diffusion (channel diffusivity D)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Scalar default 800 m2/s (INIT_ARRAY) or per-cell ArcInfo ASCII grid
requirements.notes: Controls hydrograph spreading/attenuation. Documented range 200-4000 m2/s (Weser). Used in MAKE_UHM impulse-response denominator.

requirements.name: unit hydrograph (within-cell box UH)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: ASCII UH file; exactly KE=12 daily ordinates (index 0-11 + weight), weights summing to 1.0
requirements.notes: Within-cell hillslope impulse response. Must be exactly 12 lines or the Fortran READ fails with 'End of file'.

requirements.name: flow direction (D8 network)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header; READ_DIREC decodes SEQUENTIAL codes 1-8 (1=E,2=NE,3=N,4=NW,5=W,6=SW,7=S,8=SE on the left-right-flipped internal grid)
requirements.notes: Defines the drainage network connecting cells to the outlet. The model's sequential 1-8 decoding differs from the ArcGIS power-of-two convention some docs/prep scripts assume; mismatched codes silently misroute.

requirements.name: fraction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header; 0-1 fraction of cell draining to gauge
requirements.notes: Enters FACTOR = fraction*area/86400, so it scales discharge magnitude. Supplying km2 area instead of a 0-1 fraction inflates discharge by orders of magnitude.

requirements.name: xmask (flow distance)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ArcInfo ASCII grid with 6-line header; per-cell channel/flow length in metres (cell-size*cos(lat) for irregular grids)
requirements.notes: Flow-distance numerator in the cell impulse response (MAKE_UHM).

requirements.name: cached source-to-outlet unit hydrograph (.uh s)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: Per-station <NAME5>.uh_s cache; supplied via staloc line 2 path, or recomputed when that line is 'NONE'
requirements.notes: Precomputed per-station impulse response. A stale cache from a prior basin (5-char NAME5 collision) corrupts peak timing; STATUS='NEW' open fails if the file already exists.

requirements.name: station/outlet location (staloc)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ASCII; line 1 = '1 NAME column row AREA'; line 2 = UH_STRING ('NONE' to recompute UH_S, else a .uh_s cache path). Both lines mandatory.
requirements.notes: Selects which grid cells produce output discharge. Missing line 2 crashes 'ERROR reading station file'.

requirements.name: simulation and output write windows (rout global.txt date block)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: rout_global.txt START/STOP and FIRST/LAST year-month fields
requirements.notes: First row's year/month of each per-cell VIC flux file must match START_YEAR/START_MO or MAKE_CONVOLUTION STOPs.

requirements.name: input-file toggles and paths (rout global.txt)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: rout_global.txt switches for direc/velo/diff/xmask/fraction (use grid file vs scalar default), inpath+coordinate precision, outpath, UH file path
requirements.notes: When a grid toggle is .false. the model falls back to INIT_ARRAY scalar defaults (velocity 1.5, diffusion 800).

packages.name: MARRMoT

requirements.name: Precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: input_climate column 1 of the [P, Ep, T] climate array (mm per time step)
requirements.notes: Consumed each timestep. Model performs no unit check; common source units (mm/3h, kg/m2/s, m/d) silently produce wrong runoff if not pre-converted to mm/d.

requirements.name: Potential evapotranspiration (Ep)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: input_climate column 2 of the [P, Ep, T] climate array (mm per time step)
requirements.notes: Must be pre-computed externally (Hargreaves / Penman-Monteith). The model does NOT derive Ep from radiation; passing net radiation as Ep causes Ea>P and store drainage.

requirements.name: Temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: input_climate column 3 of the [P, Ep, T] climate array (mean daily deg C)
requirements.notes: Required by snow-capable structures for rain/snow partitioning; optional otherwise. Kelvin or Fahrenheit values silently break snow partitioning and degree-day melt.

requirements.name: theta (model parameter vector)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: numeric vector of length model.numParams (1 to ~23 depending on structure); bounds defined per structure in the parRanges property
requirements.notes: Structure-specific. Standardized literature-based parameter ranges are provided across all 47 structures to make cross-structure calibration and sensitivity comparable.

requirements.name: Maximum soil/production store capacity (Smax; e.g. GR4J x1, HYMOD Cmax)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: element of theta; typical range ~[1, 2000] mm
requirements.notes: First-order control on runoff partitioning. Values in m or cm (not mm) silently mis-fill the store.

requirements.name: Soil-moisture distribution / saturation-variability shape (e.g. HYMOD b/Bexp)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Controls saturation-excess runoff generation.

requirements.name: Reservoir rate constants / residence times (e.g. HYMOD kf, ks; GR4J x3 routing-store capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Set the timing and split of fast vs slow flow / baseflow.

requirements.name: Unit-hydrograph time base (e.g. GR4J x4, HBV maxbas)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: element of theta used by init() to build the routing kernel
requirements.notes: Must be rescaled if delta_t changes (maxbas_new = maxbas/delta_t), or the hydrograph peak timing shifts.

requirements.name: S0 (initial storage vector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: numeric vector of length exactly model.numStores; defaults to zeros (dry start)
requirements.notes: Length must equal numStores: too few elements is a fatal index error, too many is silently ignored. First-year results are unreliable; a spin-up of >=1 year is recommended.

requirements.name: Model structure selection (m 01..m 47)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: choice of the concrete MARRMoT_model child class (e.g. m_07_gr4j_4p_2s, m_29 HYMOD) instantiated for the run
requirements.notes: Determines numStores, numParams, flux composition and routing — a first-order structural lever.

requirements.name: delta t (time step)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: scalar in DAYS (1 for daily forcing); fluxes are scaled by delta_t in run()
requirements.notes: Must match forcing time step in days. Setting it to 24 (hours) scales all fluxes 24x.

requirements.name: Solver options (resnorm tolerance, resnorm maxiter)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: solver_opts struct; hardcoded defaults resnorm_tolerance=0.1 mm, resnorm_maxiter=6
requirements.notes: Increase resnorm_maxiter (12+) and/or tighten tolerance for stiff parameter combinations.

requirements.name: Calibration objective function selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: objective-function handle (of_NSE, of_KGE, of_log_NSE, RMSE, inverse variants) passed to calibrate()
requirements.notes: Used only in the optional calibration path, not in a plain forward run.
