requirements.name: Areal recharge (RCH RATE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: RCH package; array-based applied to highest active cell per column, or list-based per cellid
requirements.notes: A RATE in LENGTH/TIME, NOT a volume. Primary inflow driving head/water-table elevation. List-based cellid with layer>0 silently injects recharge into a deep layer and leaves the water table unresponsive.

requirements.name: Evapotranspiration demand (EVT)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: EVT package (surface elevation, max rate, extinction depth)
requirements.notes: Optional head-dependent sink representing ET withdrawal from the saturated zone.

requirements.name: Hydraulic conductivity tensor (K11/K22/K33)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: NPF package; K (horizontal), K33 (vertical), optional angle1/2/3 rotation
requirements.notes: Material-dependent (gravel 100-1000 to clay 1e-4..0.01 m/day); K33/K typically ~0.1 for layered sediments. NPF stores a pristine copy (k11input) so TVK/VSC can recompute working K each step.

requirements.name: Cell type (ICELLTYPE)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: NPF package; 0=confined (full thickness), 1=convertible (saturated thickness varies with head)

requirements.name: Specific storage (Ss)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Confined transient storage term.

requirements.name: Specific yield (Sy)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Water-table drainable porosity, 0.01-0.35 for natural materials (>0.5 physically impossible).

requirements.name: Grid geometry (TOP/BOTM, DELR/DELC)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: DIS/DISV/DISU package; TOP (2-D), BOTM (3-D), DELR/DELC cell spacing
requirements.notes: BOTM must be monotonically decreasing; zero-thickness layers (TOP==BOTM) produce NaN heads.

requirements.name: Active-domain mask (IDOMAIN)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: GWT dispersivity (ALH/ATH1/ATV) and diffusion
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: DSP package; ALH longitudinal (~L/10), ATH1 transverse (~ALH/10), ATV vertical (~ALH/100), diffc

requirements.name: GWT mobile-storage / sorption / decay (porosity, bulk density, distcoef, decay)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: porosity [-]; rho_b kg/L; Kd L/kg; lambda 1/day

requirements.name: SFR reach geometry and roughness (rlen, rwid, rgrd, rtp, rbth, rhk, man)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: rgrd must be > 0; rtp - rbth must lie above the cell BOTM.

requirements.name: Starting hydraulic head (STRT)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be >= BOTM and within layer bounds, else cells start dry and may never rewet. Also seeds NPF saturated-thickness initialization (THICKSTRT), not only the head vector.

requirements.name: Initial solute concentration
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Constant head (CHD)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CHD package; (cellid, head) — acts as infinite source/sink

requirements.name: Well pumping/injection (WEL)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: WEL package; volumetric rate, negative=pumping, positive=injection

requirements.name: Drain (DRN)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: DRN package; (cellid, elevation, conductance) — removes water when head > elevation

requirements.name: River (RIV)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: stage m; conductance m2/day; rbot m
requirements.model_input_format: RIV package; (cellid, stage, conductance, rbot) — rbot must be > cell BOTM and < stage

requirements.name: General head boundary (GHB)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Temporal discretization (TDIS)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: TDIS package; TIME_UNITS, NPER stress periods, PERLEN, NSTP, TSMULT
requirements.notes: Per-period boundary conditions held constant; steady-state vs transient set per period via the STO iss flag.

requirements.name: Solver configuration (IMS complexity preset)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: IMS package; COMPLEXITY SIMPLE/MODERATE/COMPLEX selecting linear method (CG vs BICGSTAB), under-relaxation, backtracking, DVCLOSE/RCLOSE
requirements.notes: Structural switch. SIMPLE/CG fails on the asymmetric matrix produced by Newton or convertible layers; GWT must use BICGSTAB. Default SIMPLE preset: DVCLOSE=1e-3, MXITER=25, no under-relaxation.

requirements.name: Newton-Raphson formulation switch (NEWTON UNDER RELAXATION)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch enabling stable drying/rewetting of unconfined cells; requires MODERATE/COMPLEX solver.

requirements.name: Output control (OC) save/print settings
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required to write .hds/.cbc spatial output; without it mf6 runs but emits no spatial output.

requirements.name: Advection scheme (ADV)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ADV package; UPSTREAM (stable), CENTRAL, or TVD (accurate)

shared_requirements.name: atmospheric CO2 concentration

shared_requirements.name: Kc factor per development stage

requirements.name: surface runoff (QOVER)

requirements.notes: BMI standard name surface_runoff_flux -> state hillslope_surface_runoff. Converted mm/s -> m3/s (x 0.001 x land_fraction x area) -> m/s internally and back each update().

requirements.name: subsurface runoff (QDRAI)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: wetland runoff (QGWL, optional)

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF demand field with monthly time coordinate, or BMI demand_flux

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: hillslope geometry (hslp, gxr)

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: mean monthly reservoir flow and demand schedules
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: model state restart
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

packages.name: OGGM

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: monthly mean temperature time series at the glacier; downscaled to elevation bands with a fixed lapse rate
requirements.notes: Baseline datasets W5E5 (default, calibration tuned against it), GSWP3, CRU TS4, ERA5. Default temperature lapse rate -6.5 K/km (cfg.PARAMS temp_default_gradient = -0.0065 K/m). CMIP6/ISIMIP3b raw fields may be delivered in Kelvin and must be converted to degC before use.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: monthly total precipitation at the glacier; no precipitation gradient applied by default, scaled by the precipitation factor
requirements.notes: Solid/liquid partition by temp_all_solid (default 0 degC) and temp_all_liq (default 2 degC), linearly interpolated.

requirements.name: melt f (degree-day / temperature-sensitivity melt factor; legacy mu star)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: per-glacier calibrated coefficient stored after mass-balance calibration
requirements.notes: v1.6 MonthlyTIModel uses melt_f; the v1.1-era equivalent is mu_star (typical 50-600, can reach 0-1000). Pinning at a bound signals climate mismatch.

requirements.name: prcp fac (precipitation correction factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: multiplicative factor applied to climate precipitation
requirements.notes: Default ~2.5; typical 0.5-5.0, higher (2-4) for high-altitude Himalaya/Karakoram due to gauge undercatch.

requirements.name: temp bias (temperature bias adjustment)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical -3 to +3 degC, compensates systematic climate biases.

requirements.name: T Melt (melt threshold temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: monthly mean air temperature threshold above which melt occurs
requirements.notes: Default -1 degC.

requirements.name: Glen creep parameter A (f d = 2A/(n+2), n=3)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: deformation parameter for the shallow-ice flow law
requirements.notes: Default ~2.4e-24; calibrated against the Farinotti 2019 consensus volume in OGGM v1.4+.

requirements.name: f s (basal sliding parameter)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: basal sliding coefficient in the velocity law
requirements.notes: Free parameter, zero by default (often ignored initially).

requirements.name: glacier outlines (RGI)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: RGI shapefile polygons (RGIId, GLIMSId, Area, Zmin/Zmax/Zmed, Aspect, TermType, Surging, Form); RGI v6.0 default, v7.0 partial

requirements.name: digital elevation model (DEM)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: raster GeoTIFF clipped to glacier extent plus border
requirements.notes: SRTM (60S-60N, default), COPDEM (global), NASADEM, AW3D30, DEM3, RAMP. Use COPDEM above 60N where SRTM has voids.

requirements.name: spun-up glacier geometry
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: flowline ice-thickness / surface geometry produced by dynamic spinup that evolves forward to match the RGI inventory date
requirements.notes: Spinup default on; if it fails (surging/calving/DEM-outline errors or short history) the run starts from the RGI-date geometry with an initial shock.

requirements.name: inverted bed topography and initial ice thickness
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: bed_h and section thickness from the mass-conservation bed inversion

requirements.name: geodetic mass-balance reference (Hugonnet et al. 2021)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: per-glacier 2000-2020 geodetic MB rate used as the calibration target for melt_f/prcp_fac/temp_bias
requirements.notes: ~1-3% of RGI glaciers lack geodetic MB; regional means or parameter transfer used as fallback. Per-glacier uncertainty ~200-500 mm w.e./yr — avoid overfitting.

requirements.name: Farinotti 2019 consensus ice thickness
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: consensus thickness/volume used to calibrate the inversion creep parameter A

requirements.name: CMIP6/ISIMIP3b GCM + SSP scenario selection

packages.name: OpenFOAM

requirements.name: Inlet velocity
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Volumetric discharge Q (m^3/s) is imposed as U = Q/A_inlet at the inlet patch; OpenFOAM consumes velocity, not discharge.

requirements.name: Outlet / reference pressure
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Incompressible solvers operate on kinematic pressure p/rho, NOT Pa; a dynamic-pressure (Pa) field crashes at startup with a dimension mismatch.

requirements.name: nu (kinematic viscosity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Kinematic nu = mu/rho, NOT dynamic mu [Pa.s]; water 20C ~1.004e-6, air 20C ~1.516e-5, seawater 15C ~1.19e-6. Sets the Reynolds number / flow regime.

requirements.name: sigma (surface tension)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Water-air at 20C = 0.072 N/m. dev incompressibleVoF expects a scalar sigma in phaseProperties (not the legacy ((air water) 0.07) syntax).

requirements.name: k-epsilon closure constants (Cmu, C1, C2, sigmak, sigmaEps)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: momentumTransport coeffDict (overridable; baked defaults Cmu=0.09, C1=1.44, C2=1.92, sigmak=1.0, sigmaEps=1.3)
requirements.notes: Hardcoded constructor defaults in the kEpsilon model; overridable but undocumented in the wrapper layer.

requirements.name: Initial velocity / pressure fields
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Vector fields require vector syntax 'uniform (0 0 0)'; a scalar 'uniform 0' for U is a fatal parse error.

requirements.name: Initial turbulence fields (k, epsilon, omega)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be non-zero/physical: k = 1.5*(U_ref*TI)^2 with TI 0.01-0.10; epsilon = Cmu^0.75*k^1.5/l; omega = k^0.5/(Cmu^0.25*l). Zero values make the closure equations singular.

requirements.name: Initial phase fraction alpha.water and hydrostatic p rgh
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: alpha.water=1 is water, 0 is air; uniform-0 init gives an all-air domain. p_rgh must be initialised to per-phase hydrostatic values aligned with the free surface, else a large interface imbalance drives spurious velocity spikes.

requirements.name: Computational mesh (polyMesh)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: blockMeshDict convertToMeters scales ALL vertices; a wrong value silently rescales the domain (e.g. 1000x) and every derived Re / pressure. Patch names must exactly match field-file patches.

requirements.name: Boundary-condition patch types
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: 0/<field> patch entries (fixedValue, zeroGradient, inletOutlet, noSlip, slip, empty, symmetry, wedge, cyclic, fixedFluxPressure)
requirements.notes: empty for 1D/2D (faces normal to ignored direction), wedge for axisymmetric, symmetryPlane only on a perfectly planar patch; cyclic requires matching face areas.

requirements.name: g (gravity)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must point downward in mesh coordinates: (0 -9.81 0) Y-up or (0 0 -9.81) Z-up; wrong sign/axis silently reverses buoyancy.

requirements.name: Discretisation schemes (fvSchemes)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects temporal order (Euler/backward/CrankNicolson), convection scheme (upwind/linearUpwind/QUICK/vanLeer) and non-orthogonal correction; controls numerical diffusion and stability. dev VoF compression set here via interfaceCompression (cAlpha removed).

requirements.name: Linear solvers and algorithm controls (fvSolution)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: system/fvSolution (GAMG for p, smoothSolver for U/k/eps; PIMPLE nOuterCorrectors/nCorrectors/nNonOrthogonalCorrectors/residualControl/relaxationFactors)
requirements.notes: nOuterCorrectors=1 is PISO, >1 is PIMPLE; SIMPLE uses relaxation <1 for steady pseudo-time.

requirements.name: Run controls (controlDict)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: system/controlDict (startTime/endTime, deltaT, adjustTimeStep, maxCo, writeControl, writeInterval, purgeWrite)
requirements.notes: deltaT and maxCo govern Courant stability; writeInterval units depend on writeControl mode; purgeWrite>0 silently deletes older time directories.

packages.name: PFLOTRAN

requirements.name: Recharge / infiltration flux (top boundary)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: FLOW_CONDITION LIQUID_FLUX NEUMANN; time-varying via FILE or RATE LIST
requirements.notes: recharge = precipitation * infiltration_fraction - ET; native unit m/s. Inline unit keyword (e.g. 'mm/yr') accepted and converted; bare numbers are interpreted as m/s.

requirements.name: Root-zone evapotranspiration sink
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Applied as a distributed volumetric sink over the root zone (negative = extraction), not as a negative top Neumann BC, to avoid single-cell depletion. Sign convention: extraction MUST be negative.

requirements.name: River / lake stage (head boundary)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: P = rho*g*(stage - z_cell) + P_atm; time-varying river stage imposed as a pressure (Dirichlet) lateral boundary.

requirements.name: Well pumping / injection rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Intrinsic permeability (PERM ISO)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Native basis is intrinsic permeability in m^2 (1e-20 to 1e-8), NOT hydraulic conductivity. Highest calibration priority; controls flow magnitude. Tensor (X/Y/Z) supported.

requirements.name: Porosity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Storage and transport-velocity control; 0.01-0.60. Must be a fraction, not percent.

requirements.name: Tortuosity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Longitudinal dispersivity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Capillary curve scale; native unit 1/Pa (1e-7 to 1e-3), NOT 1/cm. alpha_Pa = alpha_cm / 9804.139.

requirements.name: van Genuchten m
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: m = 1 - 1/n (Mualem constraint); 0.05-0.80; requires n > 1.

requirements.name: Liquid residual saturation
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: 0.0-0.40; must be < porosity.

requirements.name: Molecular diffusion coefficient
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Aqueous diffusion ~1e-9 to 1e-10 m^2/s; native unit m^2/s.

requirements.name: Reaction parameters (equilibrium constants, kinetic rates, sorption isotherm/ion-exchange/surface-complexation coefficients)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Reactive-transport mode only. Mineral kinetics use the transition-state-affinity rate law with optional rate limiters.

requirements.name: Initial liquid pressure / water table
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: INITIAL_CONDITION FLOW_CONDITION LIQUID_PRESSURE HYDROSTATIC with DATUM
requirements.notes: HYDROSTATIC recommended: fully saturated below the datum water table, suction per the vG curve above it. Bad ICs stall the solve at t=0.

requirements.name: Initial temperature
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Native input unit Celsius, NOT Kelvin.

requirements.name: Initial species concentrations
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Native unit mol/L, NOT mg/L.

requirements.name: Simulation mode selector
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: SIMULATION / SUBSURFACE_FLOW MODE (RICHARDS | TH | GENERAL | reactive transport | GEOMECHANICS)
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the governing-equation set.

requirements.name: Steady-state vs transient flag
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Saturation / relative-permeability function choice
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Method selectors for the retention and relative-permeability laws. SMOOTH option belongs ONLY in PERMEABILITY_FUNCTION, never SATURATION_FUNCTION.

requirements.name: Region / material / strata assignment
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Case-sensitive name binding of conditions and materials to grid regions; STRATA must cover the full domain.

requirements.model_input_format: BOUNDARY_CONDITION referencing FLOW_CONDITION (DIRICHLET head, NEUMANN flux, SEEPAGE face, no-flow default)

packages.name: PISM

requirements.name: air temp
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series (monthly or finer); near-surface air temperature consumed by the PDD/temperature-index surface model
requirements.notes: Distinct from ice_surface_temp used by the 'surface given' mode; supplying the wrong one for the chosen surface model is a silent error. degC accepted ONLY if the units attribute is set correctly, else +273.15 must be applied.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series; total precipitation, phase split by air temperature (>2C rain, <0C snow) in the PDD scheme
requirements.notes: Manual/source canonical flux unit is kg m-2 s-1; the bootstrap/per-year convenience unit kg m-2 year-1 is also accepted via UDUNITS. m w.e. year-1 is a fatal 1000x trap.

requirements.name: air temp sd
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF; standard deviation of daily temperature variation used by the PDD scheme

requirements.name: theta ocean
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series; potential temperature on the continental shelf (PICO ocean model input)
requirements.notes: PICO expects degC, not kelvin; supplying kelvin is a silent trap.

requirements.name: salinity ocean
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF time series; shelf salinity (PICO ocean model input)

requirements.name: delta SL
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar time series; sea-level offset relative to present

requirements.name: delta T
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar paleo time series; relative temperature anomaly applied to the surface forcing
requirements.notes: An anomaly: degC and K are equivalent here; adding 273.15 double-converts (silent ~273 K offset).

requirements.name: frac P / delta P
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar time series; multiplicative or additive precipitation scaling

requirements.name: SIA enhancement factor (stress balance.sia.enhancement factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Model's own default is E=1.0 (pism_config.cdl). Multiplies internal shear deformation; the single strongest control on ice volume and a primary control on flow speed.

requirements.name: SSA enhancement factor (stress balance.ssa.enhancement factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Scales membrane (shelf/stream) flow.

requirements.name: pseudo-plastic sliding exponent q (basal resistance.pseudo plastic.q)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: q=0 is purely plastic, q=1 is linear-viscous. With q=0 and no till friction parameterization, basal yield stress can collapse to zero (infinite sliding).

requirements.name: till effective fraction of overburden (basal yield stress.mohr coulomb.till effective fraction overburden)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: config parameter; model default 0.02 (delta in Bueler & van Pelt 2015)

requirements.name: till friction angle parameterization (topg to phi)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: config option (-topg_to_phi phi_min,phi_max,topg_min,topg_max); maps bed elevation to till friction angle
requirements.notes: Low bed elevation -> low friction angle -> weak till -> fast sliding.

requirements.name: PDD factor for ice (surface.pdd.factor ice)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: PDD factor for snow (surface.pdd.factor snow)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: ice density (constants.ice.density)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults

requirements.name: sea water density (constants.sea water.density)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: physical constant; default 1028 (sets flotation / grounding-line criterion)

requirements.name: adaptive timestep ratio (time stepping.adaptive ratio)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: config parameter; default 0.12 (safety ratio for the diffusivity-limited SIA timestep)

requirements.name: thk
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF bootstrap field (standard_name land_ice_thickness); required, cannot be missing

requirements.name: topg
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: CF-NetCDF bootstrap field (standard_name bedrock_altitude); required, cannot be missing

requirements.name: enthalpy
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: optional 3D bootstrap field; if absent it is established by spinup. Restart files MUST carry it or sub-models re-thermalize.

requirements.name: tillwat
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: optional 2D bootstrap field; till water layer thickness, else initialized to default

requirements.name: ice surface temp
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: bootstrap surface temperature; ice temperature at the surface below firn (used by 'surface given')

requirements.name: climatic mass balance
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: bootstrap surface mass balance flux into the ice (used by 'surface given'); m w.e. year-1 is a fatal 1000x trap

requirements.name: previous spinup state (restart)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: full PISM output read with -i FILE (no -bootstrap); preserves thermal/dynamic equilibrium from a 10k-200k year spinup

requirements.name: bheatflx
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: 2D field; geothermal heat flux applied at the base of the bedrock thermal layer (or ice base if no bedrock layer). mW m-2 is a silent 1000x trap.

requirements.name: domain / grid specification
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: grid extent and resolution (-Mx/-My/-Lx/-Ly/-dx/-dy horizontal; -Mz/-Lz ice, -Mbz/-Lbz bedrock vertical); Lz MUST exceed maximum ice thickness or the run crashes

requirements.name: map projection (PROJ)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: PROJ string global attribute (polar stereographic for ice sheets); required for lon/lat recomputation

requirements.name: grid registration
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: corner vs center registration switch; must match input data convention or a half-cell offset results

requirements.name: stress-balance model selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: structural switch: SIA | SSA | SIA+SSA hybrid | Blatter first-order (hybrid recommended for whole ice sheets)

requirements.name: energy model selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: structural switch (-energy): enthalpy (default, polythermal) | cold (temperature-based) | none

requirements.name: subglacial hydrology selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: structural switch (-hydrology): null (default, not map-plane mass-conserving) | routing (mass-conserving) | steady

requirements.name: surface (SMB) model selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: structural switch: pdd | debm_simple (energy-balance) | given (prescribed SMB)

requirements.name: ocean model selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: structural switch: constant | pico | th (three-equation) | given

requirements.name: calving / front-retreat selection
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: structural switch: eigen_calving | thickness_calving | vonmises_calving | hayhurst_calving | float_kill (combinable)

requirements.model_input_format: PFB forcing field / CLM met vector tas_forc
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only. Kelvin, not Celsius.

requirements.name: UGRD (u-wind)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PFB forcing field / CLM met vector u_forc
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PFB forcing field / CLM met vector v_forc
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PFB forcing field / CLM met vector patm_forc
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only. Pa, not hPa/kPa.

requirements.name: SPFH (specific humidity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PFB forcing field / CLM met vector qatm_forc
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only.

requirements.name: permeability / saturated conductivity K (perm x/y/z, anisotropic)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: PFB field per cell (ProblemData permeability tensor)
requirements.notes: Unit is m/hr in ParFlow (not m/day MODFLOW, not m/s SI). Use physical matrix Ksat from soil texture, not VIC-calibrated Ksat (includes macropores, 100-500x too high).

requirements.name: porosity (phi)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 0.2-0.6.

requirements.name: van Genuchten alpha
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Unit is 1/m (not 1/cm as in Rosetta/Carsel-Parrish; factor 100). Typical 0.5 (clay) to 15 (sand).

requirements.name: van Genuchten n
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives BOTH the saturation curve and the relative-permeability curve. m is derived as m=1-1/n (Mualem); user cannot set m independently. Typical 1.05-4.0.

requirements.name: specific storage Ss
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Elastic storage in saturated zone; typical 1e-5 to 1e-3.

requirements.name: Kz/Kx anisotropy ratio
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Vertical-to-horizontal conductivity ratio; typical 0.01-1.0 (default ~0.1).

requirements.name: Manning's roughness n
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 0.01 (urban) to 0.4 (dense forest); values < 0.01 cause CFL instability.

requirements.name: slope x, slope y (terrain slopes)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: PFB slope fields (TSlopeX/TSlopeY), derived from sink-filled DEM
requirements.notes: Sign convention: positive slope in positive coordinate direction. Min slope ~0.0001 in flat terrain.

requirements.name: CLM vegetation maps (IGBP type, LAI/SAI/z0 per PFT)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: CLM enabled only. All-barren/water (type 16/17) gives zero ET.

requirements.name: initial pressure-head field
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: constant, hydrostatic from water-table depth, or PFB file (e.g. global WTD / MODFLOW steady state)
requirements.notes: Negative = unsaturated suction, positive = saturated, zero = water table. Spinup of 10-100 yr (or less if seeded from steady state) needed to equilibrate; equilibrium when inter-annual water-balance residual < 1% of precipitation. HydroStaticPatch with bottom RefPatch sets pressure at the BOTTOM (surface = Value - total_depth).

requirements.name: domain mask / indicator field
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Defines basin extent.

requirements.name: Overland flow boundary condition (top patch)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Always present at the top; couples surface and subsurface via pressure continuity. Selecting the kinematic vs diffusive overland scheme is set through the top-patch BC TYPE, not a standalone Solver boolean.

requirements.name: lateral/bottom boundary conditions
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: FluxConst / DirEquilRefPatch / PressureConst / Dirichlet / Neumann per patch
requirements.notes: Bottom no-flow by default; sides no-flow by default. At least one outflow boundary (e.g. DirEquilRefPatch seepage face) required, otherwise the domain is a closed box with no drainage.

requirements.name: Solver mode selection (Richards vs Impes vs Diffusion)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Defaults to Impes (two-phase) if omitted; integrated surface-subsurface hydrology requires Solver=Richards. CLM coupling requires Solver=Richards plus Solver.LSM=CLM (compiled --with-clm; defaults to NOT calling CLM).

requirements.name: terrain-following grid + variable-dz (dz mult / nzList)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: With TerrainFollowingGrid=True, dz values are FRACTIONS of total depth summing to 1.0, not absolute thicknesses. dz_mult silently rescales vertical cell thickness in accumulation/flux terms.

requirements.name: Length
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Domain length parallel to inlet; default 5000 m. Must be in meters (km gives 1000x-too-small domain).

requirements.name: Width
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Domain width perpendicular to inlet; default 10000 m.

requirements.name: dx
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Cell face length / grid resolution; default 50 m. Must satisfy 0 < dx < Length and dx < Width.

requirements.name: L0 meters
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Inlet channel length; default 150 m. Realized inlet length L0 (in cells) is silently capped at L//4.

requirements.name: N0 meters
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Inlet channel width; default 250 m. Realized N0 (cells) is floored at 3 and capped at W//4; N0_meters/dx >= 3 required.

requirements.name: S0
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Characteristic dimensionless topset slope; default 0.00015. Enters the stability coefficient gamma = g*S0*dx/u0^2.

requirements.name: u0
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Reference inlet velocity; default 1.0. Sets Qw0, gamma, and the velocity cap u_max = 2*u0.

requirements.name: h0
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Reference inlet depth; default 5.0. Sets reference cell volume V0 = h0*dx^2 and dry_depth = min(0.1, 0.1*h0).

requirements.name: hb
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Basin depth; default null => hb = h0.

requirements.name: C0 percent
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Inlet sediment concentration as volume percent; default 0.1. Internally C0 = C0_percent/100; authoring as a fraction (0.001) makes supply 100x too low.

requirements.name: f bedload
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Fraction of sediment routed as sand/bedload; default 0.5. Natural deltas 0.2-0.7; 0 or 1 gives all-mud or all-sand.

requirements.name: Np water
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Number of water parcels routed per timestep; default 2000. Too low -> checkerboard/noisy free surface.

requirements.name: Np sed
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Number of sediment parcels per timestep; default 2000. Split f_bedload sand / (1-f_bedload) mud.

requirements.name: itermax
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Water-routing iterations per timestep; default 3; >=3 for free-surface convergence.

requirements.name: theta water
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Depth-weighting exponent in routing weights (R_i = 1/h_i^theta); default 1.0. Higher concentrates flow into deep channels.

requirements.name: coeff theta sand
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on theta_water for sand routing; default 2.0.

requirements.name: coeff theta mud
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multiplier on theta_water for mud routing; default 1.0.

requirements.name: beta
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exponent in sand transport capacity q_s_cap = q_s0 (u_loc/u0)^beta (Meyer-Peter & Muller 1948).

requirements.name: coeff U ero sand
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) for sand erosion.

requirements.name: coeff U ero mud
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) for mud erosion.

requirements.name: coeff U dep mud
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) below which mud deposits.

requirements.name: alpha
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Topographic cross-stream diffusion coefficient (bank erodibility / cross-slope sediment flux).

requirements.name: sed lag
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Lambda-style lag weighting on mud deposition.

requirements.name: Csmooth / omega sfc / omega flow / Nsmooth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Free-surface smoothing and flow under-relaxation coefficients controlling stability of the reconstructed stage and flow fields.

requirements.name: stepmax
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Max parcel walk steps; when null defaults to 2*(L+W) cells.

requirements.name: eta (initial bed)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Initial bed elevation built from S0 topset slope, h0, and basin geometry; not a user-supplied field.

requirements.name: H SL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial sea-level elevation; default 0.0. Advances each timestep by SLR*dt.

requirements.name: seed
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Random seed (numba RNG, not numpy). If unset a random seed is generated and always logged; required for reproducible runs.

requirements.name: resume checkpoint state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional restart: restores all grids, counters, H_SL, and RNG state from a prior checkpoint.

requirements.name: SLR
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Sea-level-rise rate; default 0.0. Must be m/s of model time (convert mm/yr via /1000/(365.25*86400)*If); realistic O(1e-12)-O(1e-9).

requirements.name: toggle subsidence
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Enables the radial subsidence sub-system; default false.

requirements.name: subsidence rate
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Maximum subsidence rate; default 2e-9. Same unit pitfall as SLR (mm/yr vs m/s).

requirements.name: start subsidence
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Model time at which subsidence begins; default 216000 s. Authoring in years starts subsidence immediately.

requirements.name: timesteps / target model time
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Run length; the run ends when elapsed model time >= requested time, so realized duration may exceed the request.

requirements.name: save dt
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Output save interval in seconds of model time; default 86400 (=daily). save_dt=1 yields per-second frames.

requirements.name: save <var> grids flags
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

shared_requirements.name: Length
shared_requirements.notes: Domain length parallel to inlet; default 5000 m. Must be in meters (km gives 1000x-too-small domain).

shared_requirements.name: Width
shared_requirements.notes: Domain width perpendicular to inlet; default 10000 m.

shared_requirements.name: dx
shared_requirements.notes: Cell face length / grid resolution; default 50 m. Must satisfy 0 < dx < Length and dx < Width.

shared_requirements.name: L0_meters
shared_requirements.notes: Inlet channel length; default 150 m. Realized inlet length L0 (in cells) is silently capped at L//4.

shared_requirements.name: N0_meters
shared_requirements.notes: Inlet channel width; default 250 m. Realized N0 (cells) is floored at 3 and capped at W//4; N0_meters/dx >= 3 required.

shared_requirements.name: S0
shared_requirements.notes: Characteristic dimensionless topset slope; default 0.00015. Enters the stability coefficient gamma = g*S0*dx/u0^2.

shared_requirements.name: u0
shared_requirements.notes: Reference inlet velocity; default 1.0. Sets Qw0, gamma, and the velocity cap u_max = 2*u0.

shared_requirements.name: h0
shared_requirements.notes: Reference inlet depth; default 5.0. Sets reference cell volume V0 = h0*dx^2 and dry_depth = min(0.1, 0.1*h0).

shared_requirements.name: hb
shared_requirements.notes: Basin depth; default null => hb = h0.

shared_requirements.name: C0_percent
shared_requirements.notes: Inlet sediment concentration as volume percent; default 0.1. Internally C0 = C0_percent/100; authoring as a fraction (0.001) makes supply 100x too low.

shared_requirements.name: f_bedload
shared_requirements.notes: Fraction of sediment routed as sand/bedload; default 0.5. Natural deltas 0.2-0.7; 0 or 1 gives all-mud or all-sand.

shared_requirements.name: Np_water
shared_requirements.notes: Number of water parcels routed per timestep; default 2000. Too low -> checkerboard/noisy free surface.

shared_requirements.name: Np_sed
shared_requirements.notes: Number of sediment parcels per timestep; default 2000. Split f_bedload sand / (1-f_bedload) mud.

shared_requirements.name: itermax
shared_requirements.notes: Water-routing iterations per timestep; default 3; >=3 for free-surface convergence.

shared_requirements.name: theta_water
shared_requirements.notes: Depth-weighting exponent in routing weights (R_i = 1/h_i^theta); default 1.0. Higher concentrates flow into deep channels.

shared_requirements.name: coeff_theta_sand
shared_requirements.notes: Multiplier on theta_water for sand routing; default 2.0.

shared_requirements.name: coeff_theta_mud
shared_requirements.notes: Multiplier on theta_water for mud routing; default 1.0.

shared_requirements.name: beta
shared_requirements.notes: Exponent in sand transport capacity q_s_cap = q_s0 (u_loc/u0)^beta (Meyer-Peter & Muller 1948).

shared_requirements.name: coeff_U_ero_sand
shared_requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) for sand erosion.

shared_requirements.name: coeff_U_ero_mud
shared_requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) for mud erosion.

shared_requirements.name: coeff_U_dep_mud
shared_requirements.notes: Velocity-threshold coefficient (x u0) below which mud deposits.

shared_requirements.name: alpha
shared_requirements.notes: Topographic cross-stream diffusion coefficient (bank erodibility / cross-slope sediment flux).

shared_requirements.name: sed_lag
shared_requirements.notes: Lambda-style lag weighting on mud deposition.

shared_requirements.name: Csmooth / omega_sfc / omega_flow / Nsmooth
shared_requirements.notes: Free-surface smoothing and flow under-relaxation coefficients controlling stability of the reconstructed stage and flow fields.

shared_requirements.name: stepmax
shared_requirements.notes: Max parcel walk steps; when null defaults to 2*(L+W) cells.

shared_requirements.name: eta (initial bed)
shared_requirements.notes: Initial bed elevation built from S0 topset slope, h0, and basin geometry; not a user-supplied field.

shared_requirements.name: H_SL
shared_requirements.notes: Initial sea-level elevation; default 0.0. Advances each timestep by SLR*dt.

shared_requirements.name: seed
shared_requirements.notes: Random seed (numba RNG, not numpy). If unset a random seed is generated and always logged; required for reproducible runs.

shared_requirements.name: resume_checkpoint state
shared_requirements.notes: Optional restart: restores all grids, counters, H_SL, and RNG state from a prior checkpoint.

shared_requirements.name: SLR
shared_requirements.notes: Sea-level-rise rate; default 0.0. Must be m/s of model time (convert mm/yr via /1000/(365.25*86400)*If); realistic O(1e-12)-O(1e-9).

shared_requirements.name: toggle_subsidence
shared_requirements.notes: Enables the radial subsidence sub-system; default false.

shared_requirements.name: subsidence_rate
shared_requirements.notes: Maximum subsidence rate; default 2e-9. Same unit pitfall as SLR (mm/yr vs m/s).

shared_requirements.name: start_subsidence
shared_requirements.notes: Model time at which subsidence begins; default 216000 s. Authoring in years starts subsidence immediately.

shared_requirements.name: timesteps / target model time
shared_requirements.notes: Run length; the run ends when elapsed model time >= requested time, so realized duration may exceed the request.

shared_requirements.name: save_dt
shared_requirements.notes: Output save interval in seconds of model time; default 86400 (=daily). save_dt=1 yields per-second frames.

shared_requirements.name: save_<var>_grids flags
shared_requirements.notes: Select which fields are written; with none enabled the NetCDF has coordinates only.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

packages.name: RAPID

requirements.name: Vlat
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: m3 (accumulated volume over ZS_TauR, NOT a rate)
requirements.notes: Surface+subsurface runoff volume entering each reach per routing period. RAPID internally computes Qlat = Vlat / ZS_TauR; supplying m3/s instead of m3 makes discharge ~ZS_TauR x (e.g. ~10800x) too small (silent). RAPID reads Vlat by position, so the rivid dimension order must match riv_bas_id ordering exactly.

requirements.name: k
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: k_file CSV, one value per reach ordered to riv_bas_id
requirements.notes: Muskingum wave travel time (k = length / celerity), typical hundreds to tens of thousands of s (range ~900-360000). Must be seconds not hours; too small relative to dtR drives unstable C1/C2/C3 and KSP divergence.

requirements.name: x
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: x_file CSV, one value per reach
requirements.notes: Muskingum attenuation weighting factor in [0, 0.5] (typical 0.1-0.3). x=0 maximizes attenuation; x=0.5 is pure translation. x>0.5 or x as percentage causes negative C3 and oscillating negative discharge.

requirements.name: kfac / xfac
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Multipliers applied to k and x during calibration (kfac ~0.1-10, xfac ~0.1-5, default 1.0).

requirements.name: rapid connect
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CSV: reach_id downstream_id num_upstream up_id_1..n (outlet downstream_id=0, headwater num_upstream=0)
requirements.notes: Defines the sparse network connectivity matrix Net (1 where reach j flows into reach i). IS_max_up must equal the actual max upstream count; undersizing overruns array bounds. Circular references cause water to recirculate.

requirements.name: riv bas id
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: CSV, one ordered reach ID per line
requirements.notes: Ordered list of reaches in the simulated subbasin; fixes the PETSc vector row order for ALL state vectors and must match the Vlat rivid order. IDs must all exist in rapid_connect exactly once or PETSc matrix assembly segfaults.

requirements.name: Qinit
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF Qout(time=1, rivid), read only if BS_opt_Qinit=.true.
requirements.notes: Initial reach discharge for restart. If absent the model cold-starts all reaches at zero flow (ZS_Qout0=0), requiring days-to-weeks spinup; best practice seeds Qinit from a prior warmup Qfinal. Initial volume defaults to a hardcoded ZS_V0=10000 m3 per reach when no Qinit supplied.

requirements.name: IS opt run
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects standard routing vs TAO k/x calibration vs Kalman-filter assimilation phases.

requirements.name: IS opt routing
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: namelist integer (1=matrix Muskingum KSP solve, 2=traditional, 3=transboundary, 4=Muskingum operator)
requirements.notes: Operator mode (4) prunes small matrix entries via ZS_threshold and gives results that differ from the KSP solve (1) by an approximation that is not documented as accuracy-affecting.

requirements.name: ZS TauM / ZS dtM / ZS TauR / ZS dtR
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: namelist reals (e.g. TauM=2592000, dtM=86400, TauR=10800, dtR=900)
requirements.notes: Total duration / output step / routing period (=Vlat step) / routing sub-step. Must satisfy divisibility (TauM mod dtM, TauR mod dtR, TauM mod TauR all 0) and TauM/TauR must equal the Vlat time-step count, or runs read past EOF or produce wrong step counts. dtR must satisfy the Courant/Muskingum stability bound.

requirements.name: Qobs (+ obs tot id / obs use id)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF Qobs(time, rivid) + CSV gage ID lists; required when IS_opt_run=2
requirements.notes: Observed gage discharge driving TAO calibration of k,x and the Kalman-filter correction. Must be m3/s (cfs mismatch gives +/-100% PBIAS).

requirements.name: Qfor / dam IDs
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional forced flow at specified reaches and dam-reach lists for the optional non-data-driven reservoir submodel; both off by default.

requirements.name: BS opt V / BS opt Qfinal / BS opt Qinit / BS opt influence
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Switch optional outputs (volume V, restart Qfinal, influence diagnostics) and restart read (Qinit) on/off.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: hierarchical text; 'value variable_name' pairs per object
requirements.notes: Whitespace/ordering-sensitive; misalignment causes silent misassignment or segfault (dt_011). Fixed per-level variable counts (17/18/22/47/71 for basin/hillslope/zone/patch/stratum).

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: maps definition IDs to .def files and lists base-station filenames

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: base station file

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

shared_requirements.name: rain (precipitation, rain+snow)

requirements.name: daily meteorology (Tmin, Tmax, wind run, solar radiation, relative humidity, rainfall; optional E-pan, PAR)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: Tmin/Tmax degC; wind km/day; SRAD MJ/m^2/day; RH %; rainfall mm; E-pan cm/day; PAR mol quanta/m^2/day
requirements.model_input_format: .met (36-line header then one 10-column row per day)
requirements.notes: No missing-value handler: every day must carry a complete numeric row. Setting E-pan and PAR columns to 0 triggers the model's internal Penman-Monteith/Shuttleworth-Wallace ET estimation; supplying non-zero values overrides it. Wind is a daily run (km/day), solar radiation is MJ/m^2/day. When the PAR column is 0/absent, the model internally derives PAR as 0.48 × shortwave (SRAD) in the meteorology reader (hmet); this is the model's built-in PAR estimate, not a host-tool conversion.

requirements.name: breakpoint (sub-daily) rainfall intensity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: .brk (20-line header, per-event control line, breakpoint time/depth pairs)
requirements.notes: Drives the sub-daily infiltration intensity that the Green-Ampt/macropore routine consumes. The binary expects breakpoint precipitation in INCHES (not mm); mm supplied without /25.4 inflates infiltration ~25x.

requirements.name: ambient CO2 concentration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Atmospheric driver to the crop assimilation routines; specified as a site property rather than a per-day column.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Basin/time or Basin/static table in database.gpkg (or NetCDF basin/time.nc)
requirements.notes: Per-area vertical flux in m/s; mm/day authoring is a silent ~86M-fold over-input.

requirements.name: potential evaporation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per-area flux in m/s; negative values are treated as condensation (adds water).

requirements.name: drainage
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Prescribed lateral inflow to the basin (e.g. from an external runoff source).

requirements.name: infiltration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Prescribed loss flux out of the basin.

requirements.name: FlowBoundary flow rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: External prescribed inflow/outflow time series; block (step) interpolation by default. Gaps may interpolate to zero (dry-spell artifact).

requirements.name: LevelBoundary level
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: External prescribed water level at a system edge.

requirements.name: UserDemand demand time series
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Time-varying demand per priority; consumes (1-return_factor) and returns the rest.

requirements.name: Basin profile (area-level-storage curve)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: level m / area m² / storage m³
requirements.notes: Most critical input; storage derived by trapezoidal integration of area over level. Levels must be strictly monotonically increasing.

requirements.name: Pump flow rate / min upstream level
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Outlet flow rate / min upstream level
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: TabulatedRatingCurve Q(h) table
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Stage-discharge lookup; one-directional upstream-head flow.

requirements.name: LinearResistance resistance / max flow rate
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Q = Δh/R; natural channels typically 1e2-1e6 s/m². Too high silently disconnects basins.

requirements.name: ManningResistance length / manning n / profile width / profile slope
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: manning_n typically 0.01-0.10.

requirements.name: PidControl gains (proportional, integral, derivative) and target
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Gains must be NEGATIVE for outlet/pump-based level regulation; positive gains cause runaway oscillation.

requirements.name: DiscreteControl conditions and logic (thresholds, truth-state→control-state)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Hysteresis band (threshold_high/threshold_low); too-small gap causes per-timestep chatter.

requirements.name: UserDemand return factor / min level / demand priority
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

shared_requirements.name: drainage

shared_requirements.name: infiltration
shared_requirements.notes: Prescribed loss flux out of the basin.

shared_requirements.name: FlowBoundary flow_rate
shared_requirements.notes: External prescribed inflow/outflow time series; block (step) interpolation by default. Gaps may interpolate to zero (dry-spell artifact).

shared_requirements.name: LevelBoundary level

shared_requirements.name: UserDemand demand time series
shared_requirements.notes: Time-varying demand per priority; consumes (1-return_factor) and returns the rest.

shared_requirements.name: Basin profile (area-level-storage curve)
shared_requirements.unit: level m / area m² / storage m³

shared_requirements.name: TabulatedRatingCurve Q(h) table
shared_requirements.notes: Stage-discharge lookup; one-directional upstream-head flow.

shared_requirements.name: LinearResistance resistance / max_flow_rate
shared_requirements.notes: Q = Δh/R; natural channels typically 1e2-1e6 s/m². Too high silently disconnects basins.

shared_requirements.name: ManningResistance length / manning_n / profile_width / profile_slope
shared_requirements.notes: manning_n typically 0.01-0.10.

shared_requirements.name: PidControl gains (proportional, integral, derivative) and target
shared_requirements.notes: Gains must be NEGATIVE for outlet/pump-based level regulation; positive gains cause runaway oscillation.

shared_requirements.name: DiscreteControl conditions and logic (thresholds, truth-state→control-state)
shared_requirements.notes: Hysteresis band (threshold_high/threshold_low); too-small gap causes per-timestep chatter.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: ASCII precipfile (time_seconds precip_mmhr); netprecipfile NetCDF path unreliable
requirements.notes: Instantaneous rate in mm/hr; drives pluvial flooding. Time-interpolated each step by the meteo module into prcp.

requirements.name: river discharge boundary
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Injected as point/source discharge qsrc; the CaMa-Flood->SFINCS fluvial coupling path.

requirements.name: water level boundary
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Coastal/downstream water-level BC; vertical datum must match the DEM datum.

requirements.name: wind speed and direction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: spiderweb / amu-amv wind fields (dtwnd update interval, default 1800 s)
requirements.notes: Optional; produces wind stress (tauwu/tauwv) for surge/setup. Not active in default pluvial/fluvial runs.

requirements.name: atmospheric pressure
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: atmospheric pressure forcing field / spwfile composite
requirements.notes: Optional; barometric forcing for surge runs.

requirements.name: bed level (topography/bathymetry)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: m (vertical datum must match boundary conditions)
requirements.model_input_format: sfincs.dep (binary float32 row-major), sourced from a DEM raster (GeoTIFF)
requirements.notes: Terrain elevation, positive upward; defines conveyance with subgrid tables.

requirements.name: active cell mask
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: SKILL.md convention adopted (1=active). Interior cells must be 1; mask=3 on interior makes SFINCS prescribe water level and compute zero flood depth.

requirements.name: active-cell index map
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Maps active cells to grid / subgrid; header int32 must equal n_active.

requirements.name: Manning's n roughness
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: sfincs.man (binary float32 row-major) or uniform manning; manning_land 0.04 / manning_sea 0.02 split at rgh_lev_land
requirements.notes: Primary calibration parameter. Precomputed once into gn2=g*n^2 at init (compute_fluxes reads gn2); editing manning after init is inert. In subgrid mode roughness is embedded in the subgrid tables instead.

requirements.name: subgrid tables
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Optional but dominant control on coarse-grid accuracy; continuity maps storage volume to water level via these tables.

requirements.name: infiltration parameters
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: qinf constant or qinffile; scsfile/sfacinf (CN); ksfile/sigmafile/psifile (Green-Ampt); f0file/fcfile/kdfile (Horton)
requirements.notes: Optional infiltration sink subtracted from precipitation in the continuity balance.

requirements.name: grid definition
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: EPSG must be a projected (UTM) CRS; geographic 4326 with metric dx/dy is fatal.

requirements.name: initial water level
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: zsini uniform (default 0.0) or inifile (binary spatially varying)
requirements.notes: Sets zs at simulation start.

requirements.name: restart state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: rstfile containing zs, qx, qy, umean, vmean
requirements.notes: Optional warm-start from a prior run.

requirements.name: momentum advection toggle
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the reduced-physics regime; default 0.

requirements.name: minimum flow depth threshold (huthresh)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Wetting/drying threshold; cells below huthresh treated dry, controlling flood-extent edges and wet/dry stability. Default split across streams: docs default 0.05 m (range 0.001-0.1); binary symbol __sfincs_data_MOD_huthresh default 0.01 m. Unresolved across docs vs binary streams - use SFINCS-manual 0.05 m unless byte-confirmed otherwise.

requirements.name: momentum time-integration / smoothing weight (theta)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Momentum time-integration / numerical-smoothing weight affecting stability. Default split across streams: source binary symbol __sfincs_data_MOD_theta default 0.9; docs default 1.0. Unresolved across docs vs binary streams.

requirements.name: simulation time window
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Reference, start and stop times; forcing times are relative to tref.

requirements.name: computational timestep control
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: alpha Courant limiter (default 0.5; binary alfa default 0.75) constraining dt <= alpha*dx/sqrt(g*h_max)
requirements.notes: Adaptive CFL-limited timestep; violation produces NaN crash.

requirements.name: output format and intervals
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: outputformat must be 'net' for NetCDF map/his output; otherwise binary.

requirements.name: hydraulic structures
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional; override fluxes between cells inside the momentum step.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: NSALT (number of solute species)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: IWRC (water retention curve selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 1=Campbell, 2=Brooks-Corey, 3=van Genuchten; with IWRC=3 set psi_e=0

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: JSTART / JEND (simulation start/end Julian day)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

shared_requirements.name: dewpoint_temperature
shared_requirements.notes: Daily format only

shared_requirements.name: precipitation
shared_requirements.notes: IFLAGSI=0 expects inches

shared_requirements.name: solar_radiation
shared_requirements.notes: Same unit regardless of IFLAGSI; daily mode expects average daily W/m2

shared_requirements.name: new_snow_density
shared_requirements.notes: 0 = model auto-computes new-snow density from air temperature

shared_requirements.name: saturated_hydraulic_conductivity (SATCON)
shared_requirements.notes: Always cm/hr regardless of IFLAGSI; valid approx 1e-4 to 100

shared_requirements.name: soil_node_depth (ZS)
shared_requirements.notes: First node ZS(1)=0.0 (surface); always meters regardless of IFLAGSI

shared_requirements.name: quartz_fraction (QUARTZ)
shared_requirements.notes: Johansen 1975 thermal parameter; quartz fraction of mineral particles

shared_requirements.name: pore_size_distribution_index (BPAR / Campbell b)
shared_requirements.notes: Rawls et al. 1982; controls water retention curve AND the unfrozen-water-vs-temperature relation critical to freeze-thaw; physically ~2-12

shared_requirements.name: site geometry (lat/lon/slope/aspect/elevation)
shared_requirements.notes: Elevation drives elevation-adjusted air pressure used in psychrometric calculations

shared_requirements.name: residue thermal/vapor coefficient (RESTKB)
shared_requirements.notes: Wind influence on residue heat/vapor transfer; ~4.0 lying residue, ~8.5 standing residue

shared_requirements.name: canopy/vegetation parameters (LAI, canopy height, stomatal-resistance coefficients, rooting depth)
soil_moisture_profile
shared_requirements.notes: >=2 profiles bracketing the simulation period required for interpolation; last profile must be at or after JEND

shared_requirements.name: soil_temperature_profile
shared_requirements.notes: 99999 sentinel = no measurement (model interpolates); some nodes per profile must carry valid values; last profile must be at or after JEND

shared_requirements.name: MTSTEP (weather timestep selector)
shared_requirements.notes: 0=hourly (9 col), 1=daily (8 col), 2=custom; must match weather column count

shared_requirements.name: IFLAGSI (unit system selector)
shared_requirements.notes: 0=English, 1=SI; must match forcing units

shared_requirements.name: MCANFLG (plant canopy flag)
shared_requirements.notes: 1 or 3 requires plant growth file

shared_requirements.name: IWRC (water retention curve selector)
shared_requirements.notes: 1=Campbell, 2=Brooks-Corey, 3=van Genuchten; with IWRC=3 set psi_e=0

shared_requirements.name: ITMPBC (lower temperature boundary method)
shared_requirements.notes: ITMPBC=1 uses a Hirota damping-depth dynamic bottom-node temperature rather than a fixed boundary

shared_requirements.name: JSTART / JEND (simulation start/end Julian day)
shared_requirements.notes: JSTART must be first weather DOY + 1 (DAY2HR needs previous-day data)

shared_requirements.name: HRNOON (solar noon hour)
shared_requirements.notes: Compute from longitude: 12.0 + (std_meridian - lon)/15; placeholder values mis-time the diurnal cycle and precipitation assignment

shared_requirements.name: HEIGHT (measurement reference height)
shared_requirements.notes: Must exceed maximum canopy height

shared_requirements.name: NS (number of soil nodes)
shared_requirements.notes: >=11 with fine near-surface spacing recommended to resolve frost penetration

shared_requirements.name: TOLER (Newton-Raphson convergence tolerance)
shared_requirements.notes: 0.001-0.01 recommended; 0.001 for freeze-thaw

shared_requirements.name: PONDMX (max ponding depth)
shared_requirements.notes: 0 forces immediate runoff of excess water

shared_requirements.name: MWATRXT (external soil source/sink flag)
shared_requirements.notes: 1 = external water injection/extraction file required

shared_requirements.name: LVLOUT output-level selectors
shared_requirements.notes: Select which of up to ~16 output files are written

packages.name: SNOWPACK

requirements.name: TA
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Air temperature; must be MKSA Kelvin. Drives the surface energy balance and Monin-Obukhov turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: RH
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Relative humidity as a 0-1 fraction (not percent); enters latent-heat / sublimation computation.

requirements.name: VW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wind speed; scales turbulent exchange coefficients and drives saltation/erosion and drifting-snow compaction.

requirements.name: DW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Wind direction; optional, used by drift bookkeeping.

requirements.name: ISWR / RSWR / NET SW
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Shortwave radiation; at least one form required. SW_MODE selects whether incoming, reflected, or both are provided (BOTH derives albedo = RSWR/ISWR).

requirements.name: ILWR
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: SMET column ILWR (or TSS as alternative upper-boundary surface temperature)
requirements.notes: Incoming longwave; if absent under FORCING=ATMOS the model assumes zero incoming longwave (severe cold bias).

requirements.name: PSUM
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Incremental precipitation per timestep (rain+snow); phase split internal. Either PSUM or measured HS must be supplied as the mass driver.

requirements.name: HS
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Measured snow depth; optional driver/assimilation source for snow-depth-based precipitation correction (do not combine with PSUM correction, double-count risk). NB: the .smet HS forcing is in metres, but the .met HS output column is emitted in centimetres - see safety.conflicts.

requirements.name: TSG
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Ground/soil surface temperature; lower-boundary forcing alternative to a prescribed geothermal flux.

requirements.name: P
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Atmospheric pressure; optional, affects vapour pressure and air density.

requirements.name: slope angle / azimuth
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Station slope and aspect; below Constants::min_slope_angle (3 deg) the site is treated as flat for precip routing.

requirements.name: latitude / longitude / altitude
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: ROUGHNESS LENGTH
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Aerodynamic roughness length entering Monin-Obukhov surface-layer fluxes.

requirements.name: HEIGHT OF METEO VALUES / HEIGHT OF WIND VALUE
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Must match real sensor install heights or stability extrapolation biases turbulent fluxes.

requirements.name: soil layer properties (Rho S, Conduc S, HeatCapac S, Vol Frac S)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Soil thermal/hydraulic properties supplied inside the initial profile file.

requirements.name: MINIMUM L ELEMENT / REDUCE N ELEMENTS
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Control finite-element layer thickness and merging; too-small values cause zero-thickness layers and ill-conditioned matrices.

requirements.name: soil albedo
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: initial layered stratigraphy
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: .sno data rows (soil bottom-to-top then snow bottom-to-top, 18 fields/row)
requirements.notes: Per-layer Layer_Thick, T, Vol_Frac_I/W/V/S, grain microstructure (rg, rb, dd, sp, mk), mass_hoar, CDot, metamo. Volume fractions per layer must sum to exactly 1.0. ProfileDate must be <= first forcing timestamp.

requirements.name: soil temperature and moisture profile (spun-up)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Requires spinup (>= ~2 annual cycles; permafrost 10+ years) to equilibrate before production, or a restart .sno from a prior run.

requirements.name: FORCING
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: ATMOS drives the full surface energy balance from radiation/wind/humidity; MASSBAL uses precipitation+temperature only (use when radiation absent).

requirements.name: SW MODE
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects which shortwave fields are present and how albedo is obtained.

requirements.name: CHANGE BC
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Toggles the surface thermal boundary between Neumann (flux) and Dirichlet (measured TSS).

requirements.name: GEO HEAT
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Geothermal/basal heat flux at the column base (alternative to prescribed TSG).

requirements.name: VARIANT
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects climate-regime presets that switch hardcoded new-snow microstructure, RH limits, and bond-strength factors; SEAICE force-enables coupled phase changes.

requirements.name: WATERTRANSPORTMODEL SNOW
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects the liquid-water percolation scheme; structurally controls meltwater timing and runoff.

requirements.name: ALBEDO PARAMETERIZATION
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Selects snow-albedo evolution scheme.

requirements.name: METAMORPHISM MODEL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: ATMOSPHERIC STABILITY
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Turbulence/stability correction scheme for the surface-layer flux computation.

requirements.name: CALCULATION STEP LENGTH
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Read internally as minutes; the explicit/adaptive solver diverges or floods the hazard-interval logic with overly large steps.

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: air temperature at measurement height; controls rain/snow phase partition and melt energy

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
