requirements.name: LWRadAtm
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: downward longwave radiation at upper boundary

requirements.name: windspd
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: wind speed at measurement height

requirements.name: airpres
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: air pressure at measurement height; expected ~80000-105000 Pa, in kPa breaks saturation-vapour-pressure/energy balance

requirements.name: spechum
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: specific humidity (mass ratio, numerically kg/kg); expected ~0.002-0.015; sets vapour-pressure deficit for ET

requirements.name: k soil (saturated hydraulic conductivity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: range ~1e-7 to 1e-3

requirements.name: theta sat (porosity / saturated water content)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: theta res (residual water content)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: must be < theta_sat; range ~0.01-0.15

requirements.name: vGn alpha (van Genuchten alpha)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: matric-head sign convention: SUMMA requires NEGATIVE values (valid ~[-1.0,-0.01]); positive yields NaN

requirements.name: vGn n (van Genuchten n shape)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: critSoilWilting (wilting point)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: ET shutoff; must satisfy theta_res < critSoilWilting < critSoilTranspire < fieldCapacity < theta_sat

requirements.name: critSoilTranspire (transpiration threshold)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: fieldCapacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: theta at -33 kPa; ~0.30

requirements.name: heightCanopyTop (canopy height)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: controls radiation and roughness; ~0.1-40 m

requirements.name: rootingDepth (root zone depth)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: qSurfScale (surface runoff scaling)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: aquiferScaleFactor (aquifer response time)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: tempCritRain (rain/snow threshold)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: frozenPrecipMultip (snow undercatch correction)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: vegTypeIndex / soilTypeIndex / slopeTypeIndex
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Precipitation (rainfall)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mm/hr (intensity) or mm/interval (volume), CMS; in/hr or in (CFS)
requirements.model_input_format: [RAINGAGES] + [TIMESERIES] in INP; FORMAT INTENSITY|VOLUME|CUMULATIVE, held constant within a runoff timestep
requirements.notes: FORMAT (INTENSITY vs VOLUME) must match the data encoding; an interval mismatch scales runoff by intervals-per-hour with no warning.

requirements.name: Air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drives snowmelt partitioning and Hargreaves evaporation.

requirements.name: Evaporation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: [EVAPORATION] time series (actual; pan x ~0.7) or Hargreaves from temperature
requirements.notes: SWMM expects actual evaporation; Hargreaves needs a multi-day (7-day running) temperature average.

requirements.name: Wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Refines snowmelt rate during rain-on-snow.

requirements.name: Area (A)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Characteristic width (W)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Implied overland flow length L = Area/Width; over-large W (e.g., sqrt(Area) shortcut) artificially peaks the hydrograph.

requirements.name: Slope (S)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Percent imperviousness
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: % Zero-Imperv (impervious area with no depression storage)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Manning's n (pervious n P, impervious n I)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: No range check; a dropped/added zero shifts velocity 10-13x. Typical range [0.005, 0.100].

requirements.name: Depression storage (pervious S-perv, impervious S-imperv)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Infiltration parameters
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Column layout MUST match the method in [OPTIONS] INFILTRATION; mismatch silently misreads columns.

requirements.name: Aquifer parameters (up to 14 per subcatchment)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Only required when groundwater is modeled.

requirements.name: Node attributes (invert elev, max depth, surcharge depth, ponded area Aponded)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: Conduit attributes (length, Manning roughness, inlet/outlet offsets, cross-section)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Length=0 (coincident nodes) causes division-by-zero/NaN.

requirements.name: LID layer properties (Surface/Soil/Pavement/Storage/Drain)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.unit: thicknesses mm; porosity/FC/WP fractions; conductivity mm/hr
requirements.notes: Soil layer must satisfy Wilting Point < Field Capacity < Porosity; SWMM does not validate this.

requirements.name: Pollutant buildup/washoff and treatment coefficients
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Ponded runoff depth d
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: Infiltration sub-states / antecedent dry time
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: Horton DryTime / soil moisture storage S
requirements.notes: Most infiltration sub-states (t_p, F_e, Fu, T, P) start at 0; soil moisture storage S is user-supplied.

requirements.name: Snow pack initial state (w snow, fw, ati)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Initial unsaturated moisture theta u and saturated depth d L
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Node initial depth / link initial flow
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: LID initial soil saturation (InitSat)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 30-50% typical for event runs; washes out over continuous simulation.

requirements.name: FLOW UNITS
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Silently sets the unit system for ALL inputs and outputs; no dimension validation. Single most dangerous silent error.

requirements.name: INFILTRATION method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: ROUTING MODEL
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Kinematic wave cannot represent adverse slopes, backwater, or surcharging; only dynamic wave handles reverse flow.

requirements.name: ALLOW PONDING
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Default NO removes flood water as a mass sink; YES with Aponded>0 conserves it.

requirements.name: Timesteps (WET STEP, DRY STEP, ROUTING STEP, REPORT STEP) and VARIABLE STEP
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: ROUTING_STEP must satisfy the Courant condition for dynamic wave.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: External inflow hydrographs / pollutographs at nodes
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: Dry-weather sanitary flow
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required for combined-sewer dry-weather base flow.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

packages.name: SimFire

requirements.name: wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mph (config); converted internally to ft/min via mph_to_ftpm
requirements.model_input_format: wind.simple.speed / wind.perlin.speed.range_* (mph) or wind.cfd.speed (m/s); per-pixel U grid in ft/min internally
requirements.notes: Authored in mph in YAML and converted by mph_to_ftpm; a pre-converted ft/min value is multiplied by ~88 again (catastrophic over-spread). m/s authored as mph under-spreads by ~2.24x. CFD path takes m/s.

requirements.name: wind direction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: TO-direction: 90 means wind blows toward East, the OPPOSITE of meteorological 'from' convention. rothermel.py uses radians(90 - U_dir); fire spreads toward U_dir.

requirements.name: dead fuel moisture
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Fraction not percent (0.03 = 3%). If M_f >= fuel moisture of extinction M_x, the moisture damping eta_M floors to ~0 and fire silently never spreads.

requirements.name: oven-dry fuel load (w 0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: per-pixel Fuel(w_0) from FBFM-13 preset (1-13) or procedural function; range 0.034-0.321
requirements.notes: FBFM-13 presets already in lb/ft2; only custom fuels risk kg/m2 confusion (x0.2048).

requirements.name: EM source frequencies / time channels / waveform
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: EM methods only. FDEM expects ordinary frequency f in Hz, NOT angular frequency omega (rad/s); f = omega/(2*pi). Wrong unit corrupts phase/amplitude silently.

requirements.name: inducing geomagnetic field (amplitude, inclination, declination)
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Magnetics only; total-field anomalies are typically 1-500 nT.

requirements.name: subsurface physical-property model (density / susceptibility / conductivity / resistivity / chargeability / velocity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: kg/m^3, SI, S/m, Ohm*m, V/V, m/s
requirements.model_input_format: model vector over active mesh cells, shape (n_active,)
requirements.notes: SI units are mandatory: density kg/m^3 (not g/cm^3; x1000), susceptibility SI (not CGS; x4*pi), conductivity S/m. Values are in MODEL space AFTER the map (e.g. ln(sigma) under ExpMap), not directly in physical-property space.

requirements.name: background physical-property value
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: For a log map the background is ln(sigma), not sigma.

requirements.name: air / inactive-cell physical-property value
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Must be a small nonzero value (1e-8 S/m / 1e8 Ohm*m, or ln(1e-8) under a log map); exactly 0 yields a singular stiffness matrix.

requirements.name: regularization weights alpha s / alpha x,y,z, depth weighting, sensitivity weighting
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: alpha_s (smallness, closeness-to-reference) vs alpha_x/y/z (smoothness); depth weighting counters potential-field kernel decay with depth. Default ratios assume ~uniform cells and need scaling on TreeMesh / stretched TensorMesh.

requirements.name: starting model m0
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: The Gauss-Newton iteration begins here; an over-large beta can leave the recovered model stuck near m0.

requirements.name: reference model m ref
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Enters the smallness term; biases the recovery toward known geology where data are uninformative.

requirements.name: finite-volume mesh discretization (cell counts, padding, mesh type)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Core region must extend >=2-3x target depth beyond the survey footprint with geometric padding (factor 1.3-1.5); TreeMesh recommended for large 3-D problems.

requirements.name: survey sources/receivers, locations, and measured component
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: z is ELEVATION (positive up), not depth. Receiver component (e.g. bz / tmi / bx) must match the actually measured field, else predicted data are silently wrong.

requirements.name: topography / active-cell definition
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Elevation positive up; passing depth (positive down) inverts air vs active cells.

requirements.name: observed geophysical data (dobs) with uncertainties
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.unit: method-specific (mGal, nT, Ohm*m, A/m, V/m^2, T/s, ...)
requirements.notes: std = sqrt(noise_floor^2 + (relative_error*|dobs|)^2); noise_floor must be >0 (about 1-5% of |d|) to avoid overfitting noise. Magnetics in nT not T (Tesla inflates misfit ~1e18).

requirements.name: geophysical method and model map type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: method in {gravity, magnetics, dc, ip, fdem, tdem, mt, seismic, flow}; map in {identity, exp/log, reciprocal}. DC defaults to sigmaMap (conductivity); supplying resistivity needs ReciprocalMap.

requirements.name: model upper / lower bounds
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Bounds are enforced only by the bounded optimizer (ProjectedGNCG); InexactGaussNewton ignores them.

requirements.name: trade-off schedule (beta0 ratio, coolingFactor) and iteration limits (maxIter, maxIterCG)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: BetaEstimate_ByEig sets the initial beta; BetaSchedule cools it each outer iteration; target is Phi_d ~= nD (chi-squared criterion).

packages.name: SuperflexPy

requirements.name: Precipitation (P)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: numpy array of length n_timesteps passed via set_input(); flux order is element-specific
requirements.notes: Total rainfall flux. Framework is unit-agnostic; mm/d is the operational convention. Input array order differs by entry element (GR4J InterceptionFilter expects [PET, P]; HBV UnsaturatedReservoir expects [P, PET]) — wrong order silently produces nonsense.

requirements.name: Potential evapotranspiration (PET)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: numpy array of length n_timesteps via set_input()
requirements.notes: Drives interception, production store, and unsaturated/upper-zone reservoir AET demand.

requirements.name: Temperature (T)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Consumed only by the Snow Reservoir element; required only when a snow module is present in the assembled structure.

requirements.name: x1 (GR4J production-store capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Production store size; partitions precipitation between storage and percolation. Very high calibration sensitivity. KI documents conflicting defaults (SKILL table 50.0 vs tool/example 350.0).

requirements.name: x2 (GR4J groundwater exchange coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exchange flux magnitude. SuperflexPy sign convention: positive x2 = EXPORT/loss from the catchment (losing stream), negative = import (gaining stream) — per gr4j.py docstring 'Exchange flux (F), positive if loss' (CORRECTED 2026-08-22; this note previously taught the inverted sign).

requirements.name: x3 (GR4J routing-store capacity)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Routing store size, controls baseflow depletion. KI default conflicts (table 20.0 vs tool 90.0).

requirements.name: x4 (GR4J unit-hydrograph base time)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: UH base time; controls peak timing. KI default conflicts (table 3.5 vs tool 1.7).

requirements.name: GR4J fixed shape exponents (alpha=2.0, beta=5.0, ni=4/9, gamma=5.0, omega=3.5)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: hardcoded element defaults in gr4j.py flux equations
requirements.notes: Canonical GR4J shape constants baked into the production-store, routing-store, and exchange flux equations; not normally calibrated.

requirements.name: HBV/HYMOD soil parameters (Smax, Ce, m, beta)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Smax = storage capacity (high sensitivity), beta = runoff partitioning exponent (high sensitivity), Ce = ET correction, m = smoothing coefficient. Smax/beta may be derived from soil databases (HWSD) via pedotransfer.

requirements.name: Power/linear reservoir parameters (k, alpha)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: k = recession rate coefficient, alpha = power-law outflow exponent (Q = k*S^alpha). KI default for k conflicts (table 0.01 vs tool/example 0.05).

requirements.name: Snow reservoir parameters (T0, m, k)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Temperature-threshold snowmelt; applicable only when a Snow Reservoir is in the structure.

requirements.name: Catchment area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used for Node/Network volumetric routing conversion (Q_m3s = Q_mm_d * area_km2 / 86.4); area in m2 instead of km2 breaks routing by ~1e6.

requirements.name: Reservoir initial storage (S0)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Typically 0-500 mm, often set ~0.5*Smax with a 1-2 yr warmup. Wrong units (m/cm) produce a long initial transient.

requirements.name: Lag-element initial state
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: MUST be None; the framework auto-sizes the lag-bin array from the lag-time parameter. A pre-allocated wrong-length array crashes the convolution.

requirements.name: HRU weights (Node)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: list of floats per Node, must sum to 1.0
requirements.notes: Fractional weights of parallel Units. Framework does not enforce normalization; weights as percentages (0-100) scale output ~100x.

requirements.name: Network topology
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be an acyclic tree (each node at most one downstream, outlet downstream=None); a cycle hangs the topological solver.

requirements.name: ODE approximator choice
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Implicit Euler is the recommended/stable choice; Explicit Euler can produce negative storage and NaN for large timesteps.

requirements.name: Root finder choice
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Pegasus (bracketing) is the default robust choice. Root-finder architecture (python/numba) must match the approximator architecture, validated at construction.

requirements.name: Timestep (dt)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must match the forcing temporal resolution (1.0 daily, 1/24 hourly); a mismatch silently corrupts storage dynamics.

requirements.name: rainfall (rain)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Internally treated as a per-step depth in metres; the 'h-1' BMI label is a misnomer when dt != 1 h, and the model is structurally only safe for dt = 1.0 in the inputs.dat header.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration (pe)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: TOPMODEL does NOT compute PET internally; it must be supplied (e.g., from Hargreaves or Penman-Monteith).

requirements.name: observed discharge (Qobs)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: inputs.dat column 3, per-timestep depth; optional, used only for diagnostic NSE and hyd.out comparison
requirements.notes: Read by inputs() in standalone mode; not a BMI input variable. Used by results() to compute internal NSE and to write the observed column of hyd.out.

requirements.name: szm
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exponential transmissivity-decay parameter; controls baseflow recession shape. szm > 0 is required (zero -> division by zero in qb = szq*exp(-sbar/szm)).

requirements.name: t0 (ln T0)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Input is the natural log of saturated surface transmissivity, NOT linear T0. The binary computes szq = exp(t0 + log(dt) - tl); supplying linear T0 silently mis-scales baseflow.

requirements.name: td
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Unsaturated-zone time delay per unit local saturation deficit.

requirements.name: chv
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Main-channel routing velocity used in the time-delay histogram.

requirements.name: rv
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Internal (overland) routing velocity used in the time-delay histogram.

requirements.name: srmax
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Maximum root-zone storage deficit; cap on ET supply and root-zone water available for percolation.

requirements.name: xk0
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Surface saturated hydraulic conductivity for the Green-Ampt option; consumed only when infex=1.

requirements.name: hf
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Green-Ampt wetting-front suction; consumed only when infex=1.

requirements.name: dth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Green-Ampt water-content change at the wetting front; consumed only when infex=1.

requirements.name: TWI histogram (lnaotb, dist area lnaotb)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: subcat.dat — 10-30 (ln(a/tanB), area-fraction) pairs ordered high to low TWI
requirements.notes: Derived from a depressionless DEM. Must be ordered HIGH to LOW TWI; the code does not check ordering and silently produces wrong qof if reversed. Area fractions must sum to ~1.0 (water-balance error otherwise).

requirements.name: channel network (cum dist area, dist from outlet)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Combined with chv and rv to build the time-delay histogram. Channel distances must be in metres, not km.

requirements.name: subcatchment area
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used to convert per-step depth fluxes to volumetric discharge.

requirements.name: Q0
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial subsurface flow; init_water_balance computes sbar = -szm*log(Q0/szq). Q0 = 0 produces -inf and silently propagates as NaN.

requirements.name: sr0
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Initial root-zone deficit; must satisfy sr0 <= srmax (otherwise initial water-balance error).

requirements.name: infex (infiltration-excess flag)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch enabling the Green-Ampt infiltration-excess path; default 0 (off).

requirements.name: stand alone flag
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Structural switch: 1 = standalone driver (reads inputs.dat, writes topmod.out/hyd.out); 0 = BMI framework coupling (rain/PE injected by caller).

requirements.name: catchment outlet
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: implicit — single subcatchment with one outlet defined by the channel-distance table
requirements.notes: TOPMODEL assumes a single outlet per subcatchment; basin boundary delineated externally from the DEM.

requirements.name: dt (timestep length)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Internally the code uses dt as an integer array index; the C binary is structurally safe only at dt = 1.0. Sub-hourly or daily dt values silently mis-index the rain/PE arrays and can read past the buffer.

packages.name: TRIGRS

requirements.name: rainfall intensity
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar per rainfall period (cri) and/or per-period intensity grids; step-function constant intensity over nper periods
requirements.notes: Strict m/s; supplied as nper constant-intensity periods. A negative scalar signals that a spatially-variable grid is read. May exceed infiltrability Ks, generating runoff.

requirements.name: steady background infiltration rate
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: scalar (rizero) or grid (negative scalar = read grid)
requirements.notes: Pre-storm steady seepage rate setting the initial pressure-head baseline; should be < Ks. Internally normalized to the background flux ratio rikzero = rizero/Ks, whose sign affects the beta line and upward-seepage path.

requirements.name: cohesion
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Pa, NOT kPa. Typical 0-50000 Pa; physical bound 0-100000.

requirements.name: friction angle
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 15-45 degrees.

requirements.name: total unit weight of soil
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: saturated hydraulic conductivity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: m/s, NOT cm/hr. Typical 1e-8 (clay) to 1e-3 (gravel).

requirements.name: saturated hydraulic diffusivity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: per property-zone scalar (symbol D0/dif); D0 = Ks/Ss
requirements.notes: Typical 1e-6 to 1e-2.

requirements.name: saturated volumetric water content
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Typical 0.2-0.7; must exceed theta_r.

requirements.name: residual volumetric water content
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Must satisfy theta_s > theta_r > 0.

requirements.name: gardner alpha
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Soil-water characteristic fitting parameter (Gardner 1958). Positive selects the unsaturated model; negative treats the zone as tension-saturated (saturated model). Typical magnitude 0.1-100.

requirements.name: unit weight of water
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Typically 9800 N/m^3.

requirements.name: property zone assignment
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: integer zones grid (zones.asc); each zone carries one uniform parameter set

requirements.name: initial water table depth
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: scalar or grid (negative scalar = read depthwt grid; symbol depth/d)
requirements.notes: Depth to the steady-state water table. Results are very sensitive to this; poorly estimated values render results hypothetical.

requirements.name: DEM elevation
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ESRI/GRASS ASCII grid (dem.asc); must be hydrologically corrected (pits removed) in GIS beforehand

requirements.name: slope angle
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: ESRI ASCII grid (slope.asc); read in degrees, converted internally to radians
requirements.notes: Degrees, NOT radians or percent. Not recommended above 60 degrees (1-D infiltration assumption breaks down).

requirements.name: flow direction
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: D8 direction grid (directions.asc) plus TopoIndex routing arrays (nxt, indx, dsc, wf) for optional runoff routing

requirements.name: maximum soil depth
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: scalar or grid (zmax; negative scalar = read grid)
requirements.notes: Depth to the basal boundary / base of potential slide; with the finite-depth model this is the impermeable basal boundary.

requirements.name: basal boundary depth model
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: mmax sign switch: positive = finite-depth (impermeable basal boundary at zmax); negative = infinite-depth Iverson solution (internally reset to 20 series terms)
requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the infiltration basal-boundary form. Negative mmax for shallow soils on bedrock prevents non-physical infinite drainage.

requirements.name: flow direction beta option
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: flowdir code: 'gener' (general, eq. 3A), 'slope' (slope-parallel, beta=cos^2 delta), or 'hydro' (hydrostatic, beta=1)
requirements.notes: Selects the beta-line cap on steady pressure head.

requirements.name: computation depth range
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: zmin (shallowest depth, ~0.01-0.1), czmax (max depth), nzs (number of vertical increments)
requirements.notes: zmin=0 produces surface artifacts; set zmin>0.

requirements.name: storm timing
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: total duration t and cumulative period boundaries capt (capt(1)=0, capt(nper+1)=t); nper rainfall periods
requirements.notes: Seconds, NOT hours.

requirements.name: minimum slope threshold
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: slomin scalar (also slomax); cells below slomin skip pore-pressure/Fs computation and are assigned Fs=11

requirements.name: background flux option
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: When off, multi-period runs can drive pore pressure below steady-state during dry periods.

requirements.name: series solution controls
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: nmax (max roots/terms in infinite-series solution), tx (output time-step multiplier)

shared_requirements.notes: Strict m/s; supplied as nper constant-intensity periods. A negative scalar signals that a spatially-variable grid is read. May exceed infiltrability Ks, generating runoff.

shared_requirements.name: slope_angle
shared_requirements.notes: Degrees, NOT radians or percent. Not recommended above 60 degrees (1-D infiltration assumption breaks down).

shared_requirements.name: maximum_soil_depth
shared_requirements.notes: Depth to the basal boundary / base of potential slide; with the finite-depth model this is the impermeable basal boundary.

shared_requirements.name: basal_boundary_depth_model
shared_requirements.notes: Structural switch selecting the infiltration basal-boundary form. Negative mmax for shallow soils on bedrock prevents non-physical infinite drainage.

shared_requirements.name: flow_direction_beta_option
shared_requirements.notes: Selects the beta-line cap on steady pressure head.

shared_requirements.name: computation_depth_range
shared_requirements.notes: zmin=0 produces surface artifacts; set zmin>0.

shared_requirements.name: storm_timing
shared_requirements.notes: Seconds, NOT hours.

shared_requirements.name: background_flux_option
shared_requirements.notes: When off, multi-period runs can drive pore pressure below steady-state during dry periods.

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: forcing JSON field prec_mm_d (basin-average daily series)
requirements.notes: Basin-averaged daily precipitation consumed each timestep; partitioned to rain/snow by t_snow threshold.

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: forcing JSON field temp_K (basin-average daily series)
requirements.notes: Expected in Kelvin; model subtracts 273.15 internally. Non-finite values silently replaced with 288 K inside the loop. Passing Celsius collapses PET to 0 and forces all precip to snow.

requirements.name: incoming solar radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: forcing JSON field srad_Wm2 (basin-average daily series)
requirements.notes: Drives PET via Rn = srad*0.0864/2.45. Expected W/m2 (~100-300 daily mean); MJ/m2/d or kJ/m2/d mis-units produce catastrophic PET errors. Non-finite values silently replaced with 150 W/m2.

requirements.name: layer porosity fraction (layer porosity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Per-layer void-space fraction; layer_cap = porosity*LAYER_THICK. Must be <1.0 (percent values inflate capacity 100x).

requirements.name: layer field-capacity fraction (layer fc frac)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: layer wilting-point fraction (layer wp frac)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: saturated hydraulic conductivity (layer ks mm d)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Default from Rawls/Clapp-Hornberger texture lookup with depth scaling. mm/h instead of mm/d makes percolation 24x too slow.

requirements.name: vertical percolation rate coefficients (perc1-3)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: L4 percolation is hardcoded to 0.0; only three percolation coefficients are honored by the engine.

requirements.name: lateral flow coefficients (klat1-4)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: baseflow recession coefficient (k base)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Draws L4 down to wilting point (not field capacity); too-low values let L4 grow without bound.

requirements.name: fast/slow reservoir recession (k fast, k slow)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: PET scale factor (pet scale)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Linear multiplier on PET; reasonable range [0.3,2.5], typical 0.8-1.5. Hargreaves PET is linearly sensitive to it.

requirements.name: degree-day melt factor (ddf)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: basin area
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value

requirements.name: direct-runoff fraction (f direct)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: per-layer soil water (sw[4])
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Starting far from equilibrium produces a strong first-year transient; first year (2-3 for L4) discarded as spin-up.

requirements.name: snow water equivalent (swe)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: fast/slow routing storage (S fast, S slow)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: snow/rain and melt temperature thresholds (t snow, t melt)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state

requirements.name: PSFC (surface pressure)

requirements.name: SWDOWN (incoming shortwave radiation)

requirements.notes: Physically capped at the ~1361 W/m^2 solar constant.

requirements.name: LWDOWN (incoming longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Q2D (specific humidity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: U2D (near-surface wind, u-component)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: V2D (near-surface wind, v-component)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: REFKDT
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Infiltration vs surface-runoff partition; #1 calibration parameter. Default 3.0; reduce to 0.3-1.0 for thin-soil mountain/semi-arid basins.

requirements.name: Soil hydraulic properties (SMCMAX, SMCREF, SMCWLT, DKSAT/SATDK, BEXP, SLOPE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: SMCMAX (max soil moisture) strongly influences flood generation.

requirements.name: NEXP (transmissivity depth-decay exponent)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Power-law exponent (default 1.0) for Ksat decay with depth in subsurface transmissivity T=(Ksat*D/n)(1-z/D)^n.

requirements.name: LKSATFAC (saturated conductivity multiplier)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: OV ROUGH / OVROUGHRTFAC (overland Manning roughness and scale factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: HYDRO.TBL (by USGS land class); OVROUGHRTFAC in Fulldom_hires.nc / hydro.namelist
requirements.notes: Default factor 1.0, range 0.1-10; controls overland flow speed and peak delay.

requirements.name: RETDEPRTFAC (surface retention depth factor)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: Channel geometry/roughness by Strahler order (Bw, ChSSlp, MannN, HLINK)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: MannN channel roughness controls hydrograph peak timing and attenuation; default ~0.02-0.09 by order.

requirements.name: GW bucket parameters (Coeff C, Expon E, Zmax, Zinit)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Exponential law Q=C(exp(E*z/Zmax)-1). Default Zmax 50 mm is too shallow for deep-aquifer basins (raise to 200-500); recommended Coeff ~0.04.

requirements.name: Lake level-pool parameters (WeirC/L/E, OrificeC/A/E, LkArea, LkMxE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Weir Qw=Cw*L*h^(3/2), orifice Qo=Co*Oa*sqrt(2gh); constant surface area assumed.

requirements.name: stream threshold (flow-accumulation channel-definition threshold)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Defines channel network density; must scale with basin size and routing resolution.

requirements.name: Soil moisture (SMOIS / SOIL M), 4 Noah layers
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Cold-start at field capacity over-generates ~237 mm/d day-1 runoff; discard 6-12 month spinup or reuse a RESTART.

requirements.name: Soil temperature (TSLB / SOILTEMP/TMN), 4 layers
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Must be non-zero (use 280-290 K); 0 K propagates NaN through the soil energy balance.

requirements.name: Snow water equivalent (SNEQV)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Cold start needs a full winter to accumulate.

requirements.name: GW bucket storage (z gwsubbas, init = Zinit)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Conceptual reservoir depth; needs months to equilibrate from cold start.

requirements.name: RUNOFF OPTION (runoff-generation scheme selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 1=SIMGM TOPMODEL, 2=SIMTOP, 3=Schaake96 infiltration-excess (default/only globally crash-safe), 4=BATS, 5=Xinanjiang/VIC (needs MMF_RUNOFF_FILE).

requirements.name: channel option (channel routing method selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 3=gridded diffusive wave (default); 1=Muskingum, 2=Muskingum-Cunge (require UDMP_OPT=1 + Route_Link.nc + spatialweights.nc).

requirements.name: GWBASESWCRT (groundwater scheme selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 1=exponential bucket (default), 2=pass-through, 4=area-dependent exponential (needs UDMP_OPT=1); 0 disables bucket and breaks water balance.

requirements.name: Routing activation switches (OVRTSWCRT, SUBRTSWCRT, CHANRTSWCRT, rt option)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: rt_option=1 (D8 steepest descent) is the only active overland scheme; rt_option=2 (CASC2D) is inactive in v5.2.0.

requirements.name: lake option (lake/reservoir routing selector)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: 0=disabled, 1=level pool, 2=pass-through.

requirements.name: UDMP OPT (user-defined mapping toggle)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Required (=1) for reach-based routing, area-dependent bucket, and compound channel.

requirements.notes: AGGFACTRT = Fulldom_x / wrfinput_x; DTRT must satisfy CFL DTRT_CH < DXRT/V_max.

packages.name: WSIMOD

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Land-node data_input_dict keyed by (variable, pandas.Timestamp); depth carries an associated VQIP quality
requirements.notes: WSIMOD expects m/timestep; common mm/day sources are 1000x too large (dt_001). Convert via MM_TO_M=1e-3.

requirements.name: potential evapotranspiration (ET0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Land-node data_input_dict; crop ET via Allen et al. 1998 crop coefficients
requirements.notes: Common mm/day sources are 1000x too large (dt_015). Convert via MM_TO_M=1e-3.

requirements.name: temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: Land-node data_input_dict; drives decay, crop growth, treatment transformations, demand wastewater quality
requirements.notes: Reference 20 degC for decay k(T)=k_ref*coeff^(T-20). Kelvin/Fahrenheit make the exponent astronomically wrong (dt_007).

requirements.name: atmospheric deposition
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: prescribed catchment inflow (flow + pollutant timeseries)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: m3/d or ML/d (flow); kg/timestep or mg/L (quality)
requirements.model_input_format: Catchment-node data_input_dict keyed by (variable, pandas.Timestamp); primary external-model coupling point
requirements.notes: Flow from m3/s sources must be x86400 to m3/d (dt_018). This is the coupling surface to upstream hydrology/quality models.

requirements.name: surface area
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: km2 or ha not converted gives 1e6x runoff error (dt_008). KM2_TO_M2=1e6.

requirements.name: soil depth
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: mm not converted gives instant saturation or overflow (dt_011).

requirements.name: field capacity / wilting point
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: PerviousSurface soil-moisture thresholds (e.g. 0.3 / 0.12); IHACRES infiltration/ET/runoff partitioning

requirements.name: tank / storage capacity
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default simulation volume is ML; mixing ML and m3 gives 1000x error and mass-balance violations (dt_002).

requirements.name: aperture b

requirements.name: transmissivity T
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Under-documented input path; only permeability is exercised in worked examples.

requirements.name: accumulation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Surface mass-balance source term in the mass-continuity equation; positive = accumulation. If supplied as m w.e./yr it must be scaled by rho_w/rho_i ~= 1.09 to m ice/yr.

requirements.name: fluidity (A)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Glen's-law rate factor; normally computed from temperature via icepack.rate_factor(T). Typical 1-100 over T in [-30,0] degC. Can instead be inferred via the inverse problem.

requirements.name: temperature (T)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Bulk ice temperature, converted to fluidity A; valid 243-273 K. rate_factor switches Arrhenius branch at 263.15 K (cold Q=60 kJ/mol vs warm Q=139 kJ/mol).

requirements.name: friction (C)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Weertman basal friction coefficient for grounded models; must be non-negative, typical 0.01-0.1. Can be inferred via the inverse problem. m = Weertman exponent (default 3).

requirements.name: bed (b)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: Weertman sliding exponent (m)

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.notes: Valid model range ~0-500 mm/day; mHM is sensitive to sub-daily-vs-daily aggregation errors (mm/3hr fed as daily underestimates ~8x).

requirements.name: mean air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Consumed directly when processCase(5)=0; otherwise PET is computed internally from tmin/tmax (Hargreaves-Samani), net radiation (Priestley-Taylor), or radiation+vapor pressure+wind (Penman-Monteith).

requirements.name: minimum/maximum air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Required when processCase(5)=1 (Hargreaves-Samani); if absent mHM silently substitutes tavg, biasing PET.

requirements.name: net radiation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used by radiation-based PET (Priestley-Taylor / Penman-Monteith).

requirements.name: absolute vapor pressure
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used by Penman-Monteith PET (processCase(5)=3).

requirements.name: wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Used by Penman-Monteith PET (processCase(5)=3).

requirements.name: MPR global transfer-function parameters (gammas)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: mhm_parameter.nml (~50-70 global parameters; per parameter: lower, upper, value, FLAG, SCALING)
requirements.notes: Transfer-function coefficients mapping L0 physiographic properties (sand%, clay%, bulk density, slope, LAI, geology) to effective L1 parameters (Ksat, porosity, recession k0/k1/k2/kp, degree-day factors, root fractions). Encode process, not location; calibrate once, transfer to ungauged basins. Defaults calibrated on German (Mosel) basins.

requirements.name: soil texture / hydraulic lookup
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

packages.name: mizuRoute

requirements.name: gridded runoff (surface RUNOFF + subsurface BASEFLOW)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF runoff time series on HRU/grid; variable name, units, and timestep declared in control file
requirements.notes: mizuRoute expects a runoff RATE in mm/s. Surface runoff and baseflow must be summed before routing (omitting baseflow loses roughly 30-70% of total flow). Driving land-surface models (VIC OUT_RUNOFF+OUT_BASEFLOW, WRF-Hydro SFCRNOFF+UGDRNOFF, mHM) report mm/timestep, so a divide-by-timestep conversion to mm/s is a model input-contract requirement.

requirements.name: river-network topology (seg id, tosegment, seg length, seg slope, hru id, hru seg id, hru area, hru lat, hru lon)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (m for length, m/m for slope, m2 for area)
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF; variable names configurable via control-file vname_* mappings (HydroCraft seg_id/tosegment, NHDPlus COMID/toComid, MERIT Hydro RIVID/NextDownID)
requirements.notes: Defines every reach and its contributing catchment (HRU). tosegment==0 marks an outlet. Topology must be a single connected tree with valid downstream references.

requirements.name: reach hydraulic/geometry parameters (R SLOPE, R MAN N, R WIDTH, R DEPTH bankfull, RLENGTH, R STORAGE, SIDE SLOPE)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (m/m slope, s/m^(1/3) Manning n, m width/depth, m3 storage)
requirements.model_input_format: RPARAM block derived from network NetCDF and parameter namelists; augmented params read only when hydGeometryOption / topoNetworkOption enabled
requirements.notes: Channel width may be estimated by a Leopold-Maddock power law W=a*A^b; default temperate coefficients are wrong for arid/tropical zones. Minimum reach slope clamped (model floor min_slope=1e-6; operational guidance applies max(slope,1e-4)).

requirements.name: routing-method parameters (wave velocity velo, diffusivity diff, KWT wave-scale, gamma-UH shape/timescale)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: velo m/s; diff m2/s; UH shape dimensionless; UH timescale s
requirements.model_input_format: parameter namelists (IRF_UH / KWT / HSLOPE) and control-file entries; defaults applied uncalibrated (velo~1.0, diff~800)
requirements.notes: IRF prescribed celerity+diffusivity; KWT/MC/DW celerity derived from Manning n and channel geometry. Several solver constants are hardcoded and not user-tunable: Muskingum weighting Y=0.5; KW/DW finite-difference nodes per reach=20; MC nodes=2; KWT particle cap MAXQPAR=20.

requirements.name: lake/reservoir attributes and operation parameters (is lake, lake id, lake area, lake max storage, lake min storage, d h d a; Doll03/Hanasaki06/HYPE blocks)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: mixed (m2 area, m3 storage, m/m2 height-area derivative)
requirements.model_input_format: NetCDF variables added to network topology + RPARAM reservoir blocks (D03_*, H06_* monthly inflow/demand, HYP_*)
requirements.notes: Read only when lake routing enabled (is_lake_sim=.True.). lake_model_type selects level-pool/Doll(1), Hanasaki(2), or HYPE(3).

requirements.name: reach routing state restart (per-reach discharge, channel volume, wave/particle states, future-runoff queues)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: optional restart NetCDF (QFUTURE, QFUTURE_IRF, per-method wave/particle states, REACH_VOL)
requirements.notes: Optional; initializes reach states for a continued run. Absent for a cold start.

requirements.name: routing method selection (route opt / routeMethods)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: control-file route_opt selecting accumulation(0), IRF, KWT, KW-Euler, MC, DW
requirements.notes: Multiple methods may be active simultaneously; each emits its own routed-discharge variable.

requirements.name: hillslope-routing switch (doesBasinRoute) and accumulation switch (doesAccumRunoff)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: doesBasinRoute=1 applies the gamma-UH hillslope delay before reach routing; set 0 to avoid double-counting against a driver that already includes hillslope delay (e.g. Lohmann).

requirements.name: simulation window and calendar (sim start, sim end, dt, calendar)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: dt must satisfy CFL (dt < dx/c) for the conditionally stable KW-Euler and DW methods.

requirements.name: spatial remapping enable (is remap) and remap weights
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: control-file is_remap + remap-weight NetCDF (area-weighted grid-to-HRU mapping)
requirements.notes: Required unless runoff units align 1:1 with routing basins. Per-HRU weight sum should be ~1.0; grid and HRU-polygon CRS must match.

requirements.name: temp (air temperature)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: station CSV column or NetCDF variable tas; valid 200-330 K
requirements.notes: Internal T0=273.15 K. Values <200 K (e.g. Celsius input) are silently set to NaN by the input filter.

requirements.name: precip (precipitation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.unit: kg m-2 per timestep (CSV) / kg m-2 s-1 (NetCDF rate)
requirements.model_input_format: station CSV column (accumulation) or NetCDF variable pr (flux)
requirements.notes: CSV is per-timestep accumulation; NetCDF is a rate auto-converted to accumulation ONLY when the units attribute is set to kg m-2 s-1. Phase split mutates this field in place (precip rewritten as snowfall+rainfall).

requirements.name: rel hum (relative humidity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: station CSV column or NetCDF variable hurs; valid 1-100%
requirements.notes: Fraction (0-1) input is silently set to NaN by the min=1 filter.

requirements.name: sw in (incoming shortwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: station CSV column or NetCDF variable rsds; valid 0-1500 W m-2
requirements.notes: Power units, not energy. Energy units (J/MJ) are 1000-86400x too high.

requirements.name: wind speed
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: station CSV column or NetCDF variable wss; valid 0-50 m s-1, runtime floor 0.1 m s-1
requirements.notes: Drives undercatch correction; km/h input overscales correction ~3.6x.

requirements.name: wind direction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: cloud fraction
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Auto-conversion from 0-1 is fragile (only when max<=1 and len>10); used to cloud-adjust shortwave/longwave when interpolation is off.

requirements.name: lw in (incoming longwave radiation)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: If absent, longwave is parameterized from temperature/humidity/cloudiness.

requirements.name: snow.albedo.max (fresh-snow albedo)

requirements.name: snow.albedo.cold snow decay timescale
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

packages.name: pyBadlands

requirements.name: uniform rainfall rate (rval)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Units are m/year, NOT mm/year or mm/day; convert mm/day via *365.25/1000. rval=0 yields zero runoff and no fluvial erosion.

requirements.name: spatial rainfall map
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this

requirements.name: orographic rainfall parameters (ortime, rbgd, rmin, rmax, windx, windy)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Elevation-dependent precipitation recomputed every ortime interval; couples topography back to rainfall.

requirements.name: sea-level curve
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Time column in years, NOT ka/Ma.

requirements.name: tectonic vertical (uplift/subsidence) displacement map (ufile)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: single-column z-value displacement map, no header, per displacement event
requirements.notes: Map holds TOTAL displacement over the event duration, NOT a rate (m/year).

requirements.name: tectonic horizontal (3D) displacement map (dfile)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: single-column displacement map referenced by <disp3d>; triggers TIN mesh reconstruction

requirements.name: river point input (rQw discharge, rQs sediment load, rposX/rposY)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: rQw in m^3/s (NOT L/s); rQs in Mt/year (internally qs_m3 = rQs*1e9/rhoS, so kg/year is 1e9x too large).

requirements.name: SPL discharge/area exponent m (SPLm)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.5 when absent; canonical XML tag is <sp_law>/<m> (not <SPLm>).

requirements.name: SPL slope exponent n (SPLn)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 1.0 when absent.

requirements.name: SPL erodibility coefficient Kd (SPLero)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0.0 -> NO fluvial erosion unless set (silent no-op). Units are dimensionally m-dependent; literature Kd must be calibrated with the same m,n. Bedrock ~1e-8-1e-5, alluvial ~1e-5-1e-3.

requirements.name: precipitation exponent l
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: Default 0 (off); climate-dependent weathering term, secondary.

requirements.name: aerial (subaerial) hillslope diffusion coefficient (caerial)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: m^2/year NOT m^2/kyr. Dominant denudation control on low-relief (<200 m) domains.

requirements.name: marine (submarine) hillslope diffusion coefficient (cmarine)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: critical slope Sc (non-linear diffusion threshold, cslp)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: river sediment diffusion coefficient (criver)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: mass-failure threshold slope (sfail) and failure diffusion coefficient (cfail)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice

requirements.name: transport-capacity coefficients (kt, mt, nt, modeltype)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.model_input_format: XML transport-law elements; modeltype selects detachment vs transport-limited variant

requirements.name: flexural isostasy parameters (dmantle, dsediment, youngMod, poisson, elasticH)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: elasticH in metres NOT km (typical 5e3-100e3 m); youngMod default 6.5e10 Pa, dmantle ~3300, dsediment ~2500 kg/m^3.

requirements.name: sediment porosity / compaction (poro0, poroC) and grain density (rhoS)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: poro0/poroC default 0 disables compaction -> stratigraphic thickness 2-3x too large. rhoS default 2650 kg/m^3.

requirements.name: wave parameters (wbase, d50, hs, dir, wEro)
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: d50 in metres NOT mm/um (sand 1e-4-1e-3 m); hs in metres NOT cm; wbase default 20 m.

requirements.name: carbonate growth rates (growth sp1, growth sp2) and depth/sediment/wave control curves
requirements.action_label: Needs a scientific choice
requirements.notes: depthControl curve must be monotonic peaking in the shallow photic zone (0-20 m).

requirements.name: multi-lithology erodibility layers (erocst/eromap, thcst/thmap, actlay)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: XML <erocoeff>/<erolay> with spatial maps and layer thicknesses
requirements.notes: When active, per-node erodibility is dynamically updated from net erosion depth each step (not static).

requirements.name: initial topography (DEM)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: GeoTIFF/netCDF/regular-grid CSV (x y z) via <grid>/<demfile>; converted to TIN
requirements.notes: Elevation must be in metres with no NoData/NaN; regular uniform grid. cm/mm/feet silently corrupt all slope-dependent erosion.

requirements.name: initial erodibility/thickness layers
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: restart checkpoint (rfolder, rstep)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: XML <time>/<restart> referencing a prior output step

requirements.name: domain boundary type
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: XML <grid>/<boundary> in {slope, flat, wall, fixed, outlet}
requirements.notes: Must match domain geometry; 'fixed'/'wall' on an open landscape ponds water at edges and prevents erosion. 'slope' for open domains, 'outlet' for single-outlet catchments.

requirements.name: flexure edge boundary conditions (boundary W/E/S/N)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: resolution factor (resfactor)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Too large drops effective resolution below feature scale; keep key features > 3x (DEM_res * resfactor).

requirements.name: simulation time window and adaptive timestep bounds (start, end, display, mindt, maxdt)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: mindt default 1.0, maxdt default 1e6 yr; maxdt too large with high Kd causes numerical overshoot/NaN and checkerboard oscillation.

requirements.name: ERT apparent resistivity (rhoa)
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.model_input_format: DataContainer from BERT/GIMLI .dat/.ohm, Res2DInv/ABEM/Syscal exports, or generic CSV (a,b,m,n,rhoa)
requirements.notes: The observation the inversion fits; consumed every Gauss-Newton iteration to form the data residual d_obs - d_pred. Must be apparent resistivity (geometric factor k applied), not raw resistance.

requirements.name: SRT first-arrival traveltime (t)
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Seconds, NOT milliseconds; ms input yields velocities 1000x too high.

requirements.name: IP apparent phase (ipa)
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: Negative (lag) sign convention expected; SIP/IP only.

requirements.name: EM apparent conductivity
requirements.action_label: Add your data or choose a public source
requirements.notes: EM methods only.

requirements.name: electrode / sensor positions
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.notes: Must be unique nodes (duplicates segfault Triangle) and in metres, local origin.

requirements.name: data error estimate (relative + absolute)
requirements.action_label: Confirm or provide a value
requirements.model_input_format: per-datum error vector; default ert.estimateError() relativeError=0.03 + absolute-V from assumed 0.1 A current
requirements.notes: Fraction, NOT percent; sets the data-weighting matrix W_d and therefore chi^2.

requirements.name: FEM mesh (parameter + forward)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: .bms native binary, .poly PLC, .msh Gmsh v2/v4, .vtk; or auto createParaMesh from geometry
requirements.notes: Parametric (investigation) domain ~0.2-0.5x sensor spread; boundary region 2-5x spread to avoid FEM boundary leakage.

requirements.name: regularization strength lambda
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: Trade-off between model smoothness and data fit; held constant per iteration unless lambdaFactor<1 sets a cooling schedule.

requirements.name: zWeight (vertical smoothness anisotropy)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.notes: <1 permits more vertical structure / improves depth resolution.

requirements.name: physical/petrophysical model parameters & region table
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Rock-type / borehole-log priors and phase-model constants for petrophysical joint inversion.

requirements.name: starting model (m0)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: homogeneous or layered; default = median of apparent data (ERT exp(mean(log(rhoa))); SRT vTop=500/vBottom=5000 m/s gradient)
requirements.notes: Gauss-Newton is locally convergent; a poor start stalls convergence (chi^2 plateau >2).

requirements.name: reference model (m ref)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: reference vector in the Tikhonov term lambda W_m (m - m_ref)
requirements.notes: Default equals the starting model unless a prior reference is supplied.

requirements.name: geophysical method
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Manager choice: ERTManager / TravelTimeManager / SIP SpectrumManager / FDEM-TDEM / VESManager / JointInversion
requirements.notes: Selects the forward operator, units, tokens and transforms — all input/output/state semantics are method-conditional.

requirements.name: electrode / measurement scheme
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: Wenner | Schlumberger | Dipole-Dipole | Gradient | custom (ABMN indices)
requirements.notes: Determines the analytical geometric factor k; non-standard/borehole geometry requires numerical createGeometricFactors().

requirements.name: data & model transforms
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.model_input_format: data transform (ERT TransLogLU / SRT TransLin) and model transform (TransLog/TransLogLU/TransCotLU); region default 'Log'
requirements.notes: Model transform must keep the inverted property positive; wrong transform diverges or yields negative resistivity.

requirements.name: singularity removal (sr)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: Subtracts the analytical primary potential at current electrodes; disabling causes checkerboard FEM artifacts.

requirements.name: robust data norm (robustData)
requirements.action_label: Agent can prepare a valid starting state
requirements.notes: True -> L1 (outlier-robust) data misfit; False -> L2.

shared_requirements.name: ERT apparent resistivity (rhoa)
shared_requirements.notes: The observation the inversion fits; consumed every Gauss-Newton iteration to form the data residual d_obs - d_pred. Must be apparent resistivity (geometric factor k applied), not raw resistance.

shared_requirements.name: SRT first-arrival traveltime (t)
shared_requirements.notes: Seconds, NOT milliseconds; ms input yields velocities 1000x too high.

shared_requirements.name: IP apparent phase (ipa)
shared_requirements.notes: Negative (lag) sign convention expected; SIP/IP only.

shared_requirements.name: EM apparent conductivity
shared_requirements.notes: EM methods only.

shared_requirements.name: electrode / sensor positions
shared_requirements.notes: Must be unique nodes (duplicates segfault Triangle) and in metres, local origin.

shared_requirements.name: data error estimate (relative + absolute)
shared_requirements.notes: Fraction, NOT percent; sets the data-weighting matrix W_d and therefore chi^2.

shared_requirements.name: FEM mesh (parameter + forward)
shared_requirements.notes: Parametric (investigation) domain ~0.2-0.5x sensor spread; boundary region 2-5x spread to avoid FEM boundary leakage.

shared_requirements.name: regularization strength lambda
shared_requirements.notes: Trade-off between model smoothness and data fit; held constant per iteration unless lambdaFactor<1 sets a cooling schedule.

shared_requirements.name: zWeight (vertical smoothness anisotropy)
shared_requirements.notes: <1 permits more vertical structure / improves depth resolution.

shared_requirements.name: physical/petrophysical model parameters & region table
shared_requirements.notes: Rock-type / borehole-log priors and phase-model constants for petrophysical joint inversion.

shared_requirements.name: starting model (m0)
shared_requirements.notes: Gauss-Newton is locally convergent; a poor start stalls convergence (chi^2 plateau >2).

shared_requirements.name: reference model (m_ref)
shared_requirements.notes: Default equals the starting model unless a prior reference is supplied.

shared_requirements.name: geophysical method
shared_requirements.notes: Selects the forward operator, units, tokens and transforms — all input/output/state semantics are method-conditional.

shared_requirements.name: electrode / measurement scheme
shared_requirements.notes: Determines the analytical geometric factor k; non-standard/borehole geometry requires numerical createGeometricFactors().

shared_requirements.name: data & model transforms
shared_requirements.notes: Model transform must keep the inverted property positive; wrong transform diverges or yields negative resistivity.

shared_requirements.name: singularity removal (sr)
shared_requirements.notes: Subtracts the analytical primary potential at current electrodes; disabling causes checkerboard FEM artifacts.

shared_requirements.name: robust data norm (robustData)
shared_requirements.notes: True -> L1 (outlier-robust) data misfit; False -> L2.

requirements.name: precipitation intensity field sequence
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: sequence of 2-D arrays (T, m, n) on a uniform Cartesian radar grid plus a metadata dict (projection, x1/y1/x2/y2, xpixelsize/ypixelsize, unit, transform, accutime, threshold, zerovalue, zr_a, zr_b)
