packages.name: wflow

requirements.name: precipitation
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF forcing variable (precip), per cell per timestep
requirements.notes: MUST be mm/timestep (mm/day at daily Δt), NOT mm/s or mm/3hr; no internal unit check, so a wrong unit silently scales runoff by up to 86400x.

requirements.name: air temperature
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF forcing variable (temp), per cell per timestep
requirements.notes: MUST be Celsius, NOT Kelvin; drives snow precipitation-phase split (threshold tt) and degree-day melt. Kelvin values silently break the snow module and PET.

requirements.name: potential (reference) evapotranspiration
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: gridded NetCDF forcing variable (pet), per cell per timestep
requirements.notes: Required unless wflow computes PET internally (Penman-Monteith / De Bruin) from individual met variables; if missing or zero, all precipitation becomes runoff.

requirements.name: vertical saturated hydraulic conductivity (KsatVer)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 10-10000 mm/day. Units differ across models (VIC mm/s, MODFLOW m/day); cross-model transfer without conversion makes the soil 86400x too permeable.

requirements.name: horizontal conductivity fraction (KsatHorFrac)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc per-cell grid (multiplier on KsatVer for lateral subsurface flow)
requirements.notes: Sets lateral subsurface saturated conductivity = KsatHorFrac × KsatVer; in practice the primary streamflow calibration parameter.

requirements.name: Ksat exponential decay parameter (f)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Exponential decline of saturated conductivity with depth; controls baseflow-vs-quickflow partitioning and recession. Too low → flat baseflow-dominated hydrograph.

requirements.name: soil thickness (SoilThickness)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 500-5000 mm; controls total column water storage capacity.

requirements.name: Brooks-Corey exponent (c)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc with a (layer, y, x) dimension
requirements.notes: Pore-size index; pore-size lambda derived internally as 2/(c-3). MUST carry a layer dimension or wflow raises a 'type InputEntries has no field' (3D-vs-2D) error.

requirements.name: saturated / residual water content (θS, θR)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: θS > θR required everywhere.

requirements.name: compacted infiltration capacity (InfiltCapSoil)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 50-500 mm/day; limits infiltration and thus saturation/infiltration-excess runoff.

requirements.name: rooting depth (RootingDepth)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Controls ET extraction depth and soil-moisture availability.

requirements.name: canopy/LAI parameters (max canopy storage, LAI, light extinction, canopy gap fraction, crop coefficient)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Drive Gash/modified-Rutter interception and transpiration.

requirements.name: snow degree-day and threshold parameters (degree-day coefficient, snowfall/melt thresholds, liquid water holding capacity)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc grids or config defaults (degree-day coeff default 3.75)
requirements.notes: HBV temperature-index snow; precipitation phase split at temperature threshold.

requirements.name: glacier parameters (initial ice equivalent, melting threshold, degree-day coefficient, accumulation fraction, glacier area fraction)
requirements.action_label: Agent can start from KI defaults
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc grids or config defaults (initial ice eq. default 5500, ddf default 3.0)
requirements.notes: Built-in degree-day glacier; GlacierFrac all-zeros silently disables glacier melt.

requirements.name: river Manning roughness (N River) and overland Manning roughness
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc per-cell grids (defaults 0.036 river, 0.072 overland when absent)
requirements.notes: Controls routed flow velocity and flood-peak timing/magnitude.

requirements.name: river/land geometry (slope, river width, bankfull depth, river length)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Placeholder (non-DEM-derived) geometry gives correct timing but 2-3x magnitude error.

requirements.name: paved/impervious fraction (PathFrac)
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 0-0.3; sets direct-runoff fraction.

requirements.name: USLE C cover-management factor
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Typical 0.01-0.3 (forest ~0.004, cropland ~0.30, bare ~0.90); near-zero everywhere → silent zero erosion. (sediment model only)

requirements.name: USLE K soil-erodibility factor
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: SI range 0.001-0.1; US-customary values must be ×0.1317 to SI or sediment yield is ~7.6x off. (sediment model only)

requirements.name: grain-size fractions (clay/silt/sand/small-agg/large-agg) and river-bed D50
requirements.action_label: Agent can source, convert, or generate this
requirements.notes: Five grain classes MUST sum to 1.0 per cell or the sediment budget is unclosed. (sediment model only)

requirements.name: initial model states (soil/snow/glacier/interception/surface/river storages)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: instates NetCDF (warm start) or cold_start__flag defaults
requirements.notes: cold_start__flag=true initializes from defaults but the TOML must still declare all 11 state variables under [state.variables].

requirements.name: initial reservoir water level (waterlevel reservoir)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc / instates; reservoir storage re-derived from water level on state load
requirements.notes: Active when reservoir__flag is set.

requirements.name: DEM / elevation (wflow dem)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc grid; y-axis MUST be descending (north first)
requirements.notes: Ascending y-axis inverts the LDD; wflow internally transposes (y,x) and reverses y.

requirements.name: local drain direction (wflow ldd)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc, float64 with NaN for inactive cells; must be cycle-free
requirements.notes: Cycles → 'cycles detected in flow graph' fatal; boundary cells must be pits in both numpy- and wflow-space.

requirements.name: subcatchment mask (wflow subcatch) and river mask (wflow river)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: staticmaps.nc, float64 with NaN inactive; river mask 1 = river cell
requirements.notes: Inactive cells set to 0 instead of NaN are treated as active zero-parameter cells; all-zero river mask → zero flow.

requirements.name: model configuration switches (variant sbm/sbm gwf/sediment, routing method kinematic vs local inertial, reservoir  flag, lake  flag, glacier toggle, cold start  flag)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it

requirements.name: simulation window and timestep (starttime, endtime, timestepsecs)
requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.model_input_format: TOML [time] section (backfilled from NetCDF time axis if absent)
requirements.notes: timestepsecs=86400 for daily.

requirements.action_label: Add data or ask the agent to prepare it
requirements.notes: Optional prescribed inflows/abstractions; outlet discharge itself is an emergent output, not a prescribed BC.

shared_requirements.name: vertical saturated hydraulic conductivity (KsatVer)
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 10-10000 mm/day. Units differ across models (VIC mm/s, MODFLOW m/day); cross-model transfer without conversion makes the soil 86400x too permeable.

shared_requirements.name: horizontal conductivity fraction (KsatHorFrac)
shared_requirements.notes: Sets lateral subsurface saturated conductivity = KsatHorFrac × KsatVer; in practice the primary streamflow calibration parameter.

shared_requirements.name: Ksat exponential decay parameter (f)
shared_requirements.notes: Exponential decline of saturated conductivity with depth; controls baseflow-vs-quickflow partitioning and recession. Too low → flat baseflow-dominated hydrograph.

shared_requirements.name: soil thickness (SoilThickness)
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 500-5000 mm; controls total column water storage capacity.

shared_requirements.name: Brooks-Corey exponent (c)
shared_requirements.notes: Pore-size index; pore-size lambda derived internally as 2/(c-3). MUST carry a layer dimension or wflow raises a 'type InputEntries has no field' (3D-vs-2D) error.

shared_requirements.name: saturated / residual water content (θS, θR)
shared_requirements.notes: θS > θR required everywhere.

shared_requirements.name: compacted infiltration capacity (InfiltCapSoil)
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 50-500 mm/day; limits infiltration and thus saturation/infiltration-excess runoff.

shared_requirements.name: rooting depth (RootingDepth)
shared_requirements.notes: Controls ET extraction depth and soil-moisture availability.

shared_requirements.name: canopy/LAI parameters (max canopy storage, LAI, light extinction, canopy gap fraction, crop coefficient)
shared_requirements.notes: Drive Gash/modified-Rutter interception and transpiration.

shared_requirements.name: snow degree-day and threshold parameters (degree-day coefficient, snowfall/melt thresholds, liquid water holding capacity)
shared_requirements.notes: HBV temperature-index snow; precipitation phase split at temperature threshold.

shared_requirements.name: glacier parameters (initial ice equivalent, melting threshold, degree-day coefficient, accumulation fraction, glacier area fraction)
shared_requirements.notes: Built-in degree-day glacier; GlacierFrac all-zeros silently disables glacier melt.

shared_requirements.name: river Manning roughness (N_River) and overland Manning roughness
shared_requirements.notes: Controls routed flow velocity and flood-peak timing/magnitude.

shared_requirements.name: river/land geometry (slope, river width, bankfull depth, river length)
shared_requirements.notes: Placeholder (non-DEM-derived) geometry gives correct timing but 2-3x magnitude error.

shared_requirements.name: paved/impervious fraction (PathFrac)
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 0-0.3; sets direct-runoff fraction.

shared_requirements.name: USLE C cover-management factor
shared_requirements.notes: Typical 0.01-0.3 (forest ~0.004, cropland ~0.30, bare ~0.90); near-zero everywhere → silent zero erosion. (sediment model only)

shared_requirements.name: USLE K soil-erodibility factor
shared_requirements.notes: SI range 0.001-0.1; US-customary values must be ×0.1317 to SI or sediment yield is ~7.6x off. (sediment model only)

shared_requirements.name: grain-size fractions (clay/silt/sand/small-agg/large-agg) and river-bed D50
shared_requirements.notes: Five grain classes MUST sum to 1.0 per cell or the sediment budget is unclosed. (sediment model only)

shared_requirements.name: initial model states (soil/snow/glacier/interception/surface/river storages)
shared_requirements.notes: cold_start__flag=true initializes from defaults but the TOML must still declare all 11 state variables under [state.variables].

shared_requirements.name: initial reservoir water level (waterlevel_reservoir)
shared_requirements.notes: Active when reservoir__flag is set.

shared_requirements.name: DEM / elevation (wflow_dem)
shared_requirements.notes: Ascending y-axis inverts the LDD; wflow internally transposes (y,x) and reverses y.

shared_requirements.name: local drain direction (wflow_ldd)
shared_requirements.notes: Cycles → 'cycles detected in flow graph' fatal; boundary cells must be pits in both numpy- and wflow-space.

shared_requirements.name: subcatchment mask (wflow_subcatch) and river mask (wflow_river)
shared_requirements.notes: Inactive cells set to 0 instead of NaN are treated as active zero-parameter cells; all-zero river mask → zero flow.

shared_requirements.name: model configuration switches (variant sbm/sbm_gwf/sediment, routing method kinematic vs local_inertial, reservoir__flag, lake__flag, glacier toggle, cold_start__flag)
shared_requirements.notes: Select which process and routing modules are active; structural levers.

shared_requirements.name: simulation window and timestep (starttime, endtime, timestepsecs)
shared_requirements.notes: timestepsecs=86400 for daily.

shared_requirements.name: lateral/external inflows and abstractions
shared_requirements.notes: Optional prescribed inflows/abstractions; outlet discharge itself is an emergent output, not a prescribed BC.

shared_requirements.name: reservoir operating parameters (ResMaxVolume, reservoir_area, ResDemand, ResMaxRelease, ResTargetFullFrac, ResTargetMinFrac, outflowfunc, storfunc)
shared_requirements.notes: ResMaxVolume in MCM instead of m³ (1e6 too small) → immediate overflow with no regulation; reservoir_area in km² instead of m² → negligible evaporation; reservoir not on a river cell is silently ignored. Active when reservoir__flag is set.
